Qt 6 + OpenGL 4.6 scientific rendering application supporting the VTK XML formats
(`.vtu`, `.vts`, `.vti`, `.vtp`, `.vtr`, `.vtm` multi-block), VTK legacy
(`.vtk`), STL, and OBJ files. Maps scalar data to surface colormaps, draws
instanced vector-field arrow glyphs, integrated streamlines, particle traces,
Line Integral Convolution (LIC), volume ray-marching, and isosurface extraction
via marching cubes. Plays ParaView `.pvd` time-series collections as streamed
animations and exports them to MJPEG AVI videos or PNG frame sequences.

Features include a 5-direction PBR-calibrated lighting kit, axis triad overlay
with pole-view handling, axis-aligned clipping and slice planes, wireframe
overlay, GPU-compute level-of-detail (LOD), depth-peel order-independent
transparency (1–8 layers), orthographic/perspective projection, screenshot
export, and a rich Qt Widgets sidebar with per-page control panels.

## Download (no build needed)

For users who don't want to build from source:

- **Installer (recommended):** `SciRender-Setup.exe` from the latest
  [GitHub Release](../../releases) → Next → Finish → Start Menu `SciRender`.
- **Portable (no install, no admin):** `SciRender-win64.zip` from the same
  Release → Extract All → double-click `SciRender.exe`.

Then drag-drop a `.vtu`/`.vts`/`.vti`/`.vtp`/`.vtr`/`.vtm`/`.vtk`/`.stl`/`.obj`/`.pvd`
file onto the window, or use `File > Open Mesh`. No Qt install required; all
`Qt6` DLLs and `shaders/` are included via `windeployqt`.

## Build (for developers)

Requires **Qt 6** (Core, Gui, Widgets, OpenGLWidgets), **OpenGL 4.6**,
a C++20 compiler, CMake ≥ 3.19, and **ZLIB** (system-installed or
auto-detected via `ZLIB_ROOT`). GLAD, GLM, pugixml, LZ4, and LZMA are
vendored under `vendor/`, no install needed.

```bash
cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH="<path-to-Qt6>"
cmake --build build -j4
```

The shaders in `src/shaders/` are copied next to the binary at build time, so
the program can run from the build directory.

To reproduce the Release package locally:

```bash
cmake -G "MinGW Makefiles" -S . -B build-mingw -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
cmake --build build-mingw -j4
cmake --install build-mingw --prefix package
C:/Qt/6.11.1/mingw_64/bin/windeployqt.exe --release --compiler-runtime package/SciRender.exe
# ZIP: Compress-Archive package/* SciRender-win64.zip
# Setup: iscc installer/SciRender.iss /DAppVersion=0.1.0  # requires Inno Setup 6
```

## Features

- Loads VTK XML (`.vtu`/`.vts`/`.vti`/`.vtp`/`.vtr`/`.vtm` multiblock),
  VTK legacy (`.vtk`), STL, and OBJ formats with auto-detected compression
  (ZLIB/LZ4/LZMA, `UInt32`/`UInt64` headers, `ASCII`/`BINARY`/`APPENDED`
  encodings, byte-order swap). `.vtm` merges `<DataSet file="..."/>` entries;
  `.pvd` time-series are streamed via the animation controller, not as a single
  mesh
- Scalar surface coloring with GPU colormap textures; per-dataset **surface**
  tessellation for curvilinear grids (boundary shell, not the full volume).
  Palettes: Turbo, Viridis, Inferno, CoolWarm, MutedCoolWarm, BWR, Cividis,
  Grayscale — each with reverse toggle and discrete bands (`0–32`)
- Vector field arrow glyphs with user-controllable density (stride), scaling,
  magnitude transform (linear/sqrt/log), and placement (vertex or cell-center).
  Supports per-vertex and per-cell vector fields; glyph colormap with independent
  magnitude and per-component (X/Y/Z) fixed-range windows and band counts
- **Line Integral Convolution (LIC):** dense vector-field texture (`VectorTextureCache`,
  3D `GL_RGB32F`, up to 4 entries LRU) convolved along streamlines in
  `surface_lic.frag`. Modes: `vectorVisMode` off/glyphs/LIC, steps `4–128`,
  step size `0.001–2.0`× diagonal, noise frequency `0.5–64`, grain
  `64/128/256/512`, enhanced 2-pass, LIC-only (unshaded), integrators
  Euler/Midpoint/RK4 (default RK4). `licNoiseTex` 3D, `GL_REPEAT`
- **Streamline integration** with configurable step size, max steps, direction
  (forward/backward/both), seeding modes (volume/surface/plane), plane counts
  U/V, plane position, jitter, ribbon width, taper factor, opacity, PBR shading
  (ambient/diffuse/specular/power), color modes (solid/magnitude/component X/Y/Z)
  and arrowheads (spacing/size)
- **Particle traces** with count, speed, size, and additive blending controls
- **Volume ray-marching** with step size, opacity, and colormap controls; 3D
  `GL_R32F` textures via `VolumeTextureCache` with PBO double-buffering and
  Beer-Lambert opacity
- **Volume slice overlay:** up to 3 axis-aligned textured quads (X/Y/Z) each with
  independent position (`0–1`), opacity, scalar field, show-colorbar toggle,
  and slice colormap (palette/reverse/bands + fixed-range window)
- **Isosurface extraction** via marching cubes with debounced (150 ms) async
  computation; isosurface surfaces are shaded by the colormap LUT with PBR
  lighting and participate in depth-peel transparency and LOD (own LOD path)
- **Colorbar legend:** GPU-composited colorbar overlay — sharp, borderless
  gradient bar (optional rounded background panel) + tick labels + title
  rendered into the viewport FBO so it is captured in screenshots.
  User-controllable tick count (`colorbarTicks`, 2–20) across the live data range.
  Independent colorbars for scalar, vector-magnitude/component, streamline
  magnitude/component, volume, and volume-slice data. Palette, reverse,
  fixed-range window and discrete bands are configured per colorbar via
  right-click → **Style…** dialog. Bar position/orientation/visibility are
  draggable and persisted per field; font family/bold/italic, scale, tick scale,
  length/thickness, and panel opacity are global style controls
- **Lighting system:** 5-direction light kit (key + fill + 2×back + head) that
  tracks the camera; key intensity, 3 K-ratios (`KF`/`KB`/`KH` relative to key),
  per-light azimuth/elevation, kit-wide warm tint (0 cold blue → 0.5 white →
  1 warm amber), 3 presets (Studio/CADFlat/Soft) and PBR material parameters
  (roughness, metallic, ambient/diffuse/specular)
- **Clipping:** axis-aligned clip planes with master `clipEnabled`, per-axis
  `clipEnabledX/Y/Z`, height sliders, per-axis invert toggles, and
  `crinkleClipMode` (geometry-shader clip vs fragment discard)
- **Slicing:** 3 independent slice planes (X/Y/Z) with bounds-aware sliders
  (see above) — distinct from clipping which discards geometry, slicing draws
  a textured quad
- **Scalar filter:** threshold filter (`filterMin`/`filterMax` + `filterEnabled`)
  via fragment discard, separate from clip planes
- **Axis triad overlay:** X/Y/Z coordinate triad in a corner viewport tracking
  camera rotation. Anti-aliased clip-space axis lines, solid-color conical tips,
  solid origin disc, and texture-atlas text labels. Handles pole views (±X/±Y/±Z)
  with end-on disc markers and label offset to avoid overlap. Configurable
  corner (4 positions) and size (96/128/160 px footprints), show/hide toggle
- **Viewport navigation:** left-drag orbit, right-drag pan (middle-drag alias
  retained), inverted wheel zoom, triad click-to-snap, fly-to-face animated
  transitions (400 ms ease-in-out), fit-all isometric framing
- **Light-direction markers:** visual markers in the gizmo corner showing the
  5 kit directions, tinted by the warm setting (toggle `showLightMarkers`)
- **Bounding box overlay:** axis-aligned bounding box (AABB) wireframe toggle
- **Quality overlays:** degenerate triangle, open-edge, and non-manifold edge
  visualization with exact vertex welding at 1e-8 tolerance and counts/watertight
  indicator
- **Wireframe / display:** wireframe overlay (`WireframePass`), flat/smooth shading
  toggle, cull modes (off/back/front), surface/point toggles, point size/opacity,
  line width, surface opacity, depth-peel layer count (1–8), orthographic vs
  perspective projection, auto-rotate
- **Screenshot export** (PNG/JPEG/BMP) with optional transparency, 5 resolution
  levels (Current/HD/FHD/2K/4K) and 3 AA presets (0/2/4 samples), colorbar and
  gizmo are captured
- **Recent files & Clear Mesh:** MRU list capped at 8 (persisted via `QSettings`);
  `File → Clear` frees GPU meshes, isosurface, volume/vector caches, LIC noise,
  streamline pending results, and `FieldResolver` derived-field cache, and resets
  scalar range (`0–1`), world bounds (`-10–10`, radius `1`), filter windows,
  and per-pass fixed-range overrides
- **PVD animation playback:** streams `.pvd` collections through an async,
  prefetching loader (3 concurrent parses, prefetch 8 ahead / keep 2 behind,
  LRU capped at 14 frames / 512 MB); transport controls (play/pause, step,
  timeline scrubbing with drag debouncing), FPS rate, loop toggle, speed
  multiplier; fixed-topology sequences take a scalar-only fast upload path
- **Animation colormap scaling:** *Whole sequence* holds one grow-only range
  across frames so colors and the colorbar never flicker; *Per frame*
  rescales to each frame's own extent. Ranges always describe the active
  field resolved per frame (point/cell/legacy/derived), reseeding on field
  switches mid-sequence
- **Animation export:** renders the loaded sequence offscreen to an MJPEG
  `.avi` video and/or numbered PNG frames with configurable resolution,
  JPEG quality, fps, and frame range (first/last), 30 s timeout; encoding
  overlaps capture on worker threads so exports stay fast regardless of viewport
  size (playback pauses for the duration)
- **Depth-peel transparency** for correct rendering of translucent surfaces
  (1–8 layers, default 4, per-layer `GL_DEPTH32F_STENCIL8`/`GL_RGBA8` FBOs,
  resolution-adaptive capping, UBO-driven composite)
- **FPS Head-up Display** (HUD) with smoothed frame-rate counter and particles
  animation time
- **Robust mesh loading:** sort-based vertex deduplication at `1/4096` tolerance,
  point-cloud support (`GL_POINTS` rendering via `renderAsPoints`), per-vertex
  or per-cell vector field support with `cellCenters`, and quality analysis
  (weld at `1e-8`)
- **Level-of-Detail (LOD):** GPU compute-shader vertex clustering decimation
  (3 dispatches: `lod.comp`/`lod_output.comp`/`lod_tris.comp`) that activates
  only while the camera is moving, debounced `0.14 s`, snaps back after
  `160 ms` settle; scalar field preservation on the decimated mesh.
  Eligibility: volumetric grids and surface meshes, ≥4000 vertices,
  `< 0.5×` triangles worthwhile, `kLodMaxCellsPerAxis 128`; multi-shell safety
  (`≤64` components, within-one-cell merge test)

### Level of Detail (LOD)

LOD uses three GPU compute shaders (`lod.comp` / `lod_output.comp` / `lod_tris.comp`,
HL `lod.comp` vertex clustering) to produce a coarser mesh only while the camera
is moving, debounced `0.14 s` and snaps back to full detail `160 ms` after motion
stops. It is used only when all of the following hold:

- **Dataset type:** volumetric grids (`STRUCTURED_GRID`, `RECTILINEAR_GRID`,
  `STRUCTURED_POINTS`) and surface meshes (`STL`, `POLYDATA`,
  `UNSTRUCTURED_GRID`).
- **Size:** at least 4000 vertices (`lodMinVertices`).
- **Worthwhile:** the decimated mesh has less than half the original triangles
  (`lodDecimateRatio` = 0.5).
- **Multi-shell safe:** a single connected solid is always supported. Meshes
  with multiple disconnected parts (`≤64` components) are only decimated when the
  parts are farther than one cluster cell (`kLodMaxCellsPerAxis 128`) apart;
  otherwise full resolution is used. Isosurface meshes have their own LOD path.

## Layout

| Path | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `src/app/` | Application entry point (`main.cpp`, GPU preference) |
| `src/core/` | VTK/STL/OBJ parsers, `.pvd` collection parser, mesh loading, mesh-quality analysis, field-name resolution (`FieldResolver`), camera, colormap definitions, isosurface extraction (marching cubes) |
| `src/render/` | OpenGL renderer, lighting model (`LightingModel`, 5-dir kit), mesh/LOD upload (`MeshGLManager`/`LodScheduler`), vector glyphs, streamlines + `StreamlineController`, particles, volume pass + `VolumeTextureCache`/`VectorTextureCache`, LIC (`surface_lic.frag`), colormap manager, colorbar overlay, axis triad + light markers, bbox/quality overlays, wireframe pass, depth-peel transparency, screenshot capture, animation playback controller + AVI/PNG exporter |
| `src/shaders/` | GLSL vertex/fragment/geometry/compute shaders — `mesh.{vert,frag,clip.geo}`, `glyph.{vert,frag}`, `wire.{vert,geo,frag}`, `bbox.{vert,frag}`, `streamline.{vert,frag}`, `seed.{vert,frag}`, `particle.{vert,frag}`, `volume.{vert,frag}`, `volume_slice.{vert,frag}`, `quality_overlay.{vert,frag}`, `depth_peel.{vert,frag}`/`composite.{vert,frag}`, `surface_lic.frag`, `pbr_common.glsl`, LOD `lod.comp`/`lod_output.comp`/`lod_tris.comp` |
| `src/ui/` | Qt Widgets main window, 12 sidebar pages (lighting, clipping, slice planes, volume, scalar, vectors, streamlines, view/display, screenshot, mesh info, animation, isosurface), animation export dialog, viewport widget, colorbar style dialog with per-colorbar palette/fixed-range (sharp, borderless bar), recent-files (8) + Clear Mesh |
| `tests/` | Regression suite (doctest + CTest) — parsers, PVD collections, marching-cubes isosurface, post-processing fields, camera math, AMG/transient configuration, streamline direction, and the **CFD fundamentals** (mesh geometry, gradient, divergence, Poisson, convection schemes, pressure/velocity correction, boundary conditions, residual). A CMake subdirectory of this project: it links the real `CoreLib`/`FvmCore`/`CfdLib`/`RenderCore` targets, so there is no separate test build system |
| `tools/` | Developer CLI diagnostics (not part of the test suite), e.g. the cylinder-vorticity probe |
| `samples/` | VTK/STL fixture files used by the regression suite |
| `assets/` | Application icon |
| `vendor/` | GLAD (OpenGL loader), GLM (math), pugixml (XML parsing), LZ4 & LZMA (compression), doctest (test framework) |

## Tests

The regression suite is part of the main CMake project, so the tests always run
against the same sources as the application. The application itself is not
built for a test-only configure, which means the suite needs **neither Qt nor
an OpenGL context**.

See **[tests/README.md](tests/README.md)** for the full guide: the layout, the
conventions, how to add a test, and how the known-failure registry works.

```bash
cmake --preset tests                                     # configure build-tests
cmake --build --preset tests                             # build the 4 test binaries
ctest --preset tests --output-on-failure                 # run everything
```

Or, in one step (configure if needed, build, run):

```bash
tests/run_tests.bat        # Windows
tests/run_tests.sh         # Linux / macOS / Git Bash
```

Every doctest test case is registered as **its own CTest row**, so a failure
names the behaviour that broke rather than "the binary failed":

```
12/81 Test #12: core.fields.overlapping_names_deduplicate ...........   Failed    0.01 sec
tests/core/field_names_test.cpp:34: ERROR: CHECK_MESSAGE( sizes_match(merged, {"velocity"}), "point/cell name dedup" ) is NOT correct!
  values: CHECK_MESSAGE( sizes_match(merged, {"velocity"}), "point/cell name dedup" )
```

Useful filters:

| Command | Effect |
|---|---|
| `ctest --test-dir build-tests -L core` | only the `core` layer (parsers, fields, isosurface, camera) |
| `ctest --test-dir build-tests -L fvm` | only the `fvm` layer (AMG, transient settings, CFD benchmark) |
| `ctest --test-dir build-tests -L render` | only the render-layer tests |
| `ctest --test-dir build-tests -L cfd` | only the CFD fundamentals suite |
| `ctest --test-dir build-tests -L known-broken -V` | the outstanding CFD defects, with their diagnostics |
| `ctest --test-dir build-tests -LE slow` | skip the slow CFD benchmark (`ctest --preset tests-fast`) |
| `ctest --test-dir build-tests -R "core.parse"` | only the tests whose name matches |
| `ctest --test-dir build-tests --output-on-failure` | print the failing assertion of every failed test |

Build switches: `SCIRENDER_BUILD_APP` (default `ON`), `SCIRENDER_BUILD_TESTS`
(default `ON`), `SCIRENDER_BUILD_TOOLS` (default `OFF`).

### The CFD fundamentals suite

`tests/cfd/` holds the unit tests for the FVM operators. Every test states one
contract of the operator it covers; the contracts and the tolerance policy are
documented in [`tests/cfd/README.md`](tests/cfd/README.md).

The defects that are known and still open are listed in
`tests/cfd/known_failures.txt`. Those rows pass while the defect is open and
turn **red** as soon as the solver is fixed — that is the signal to remove the
entry:

```
ctest --test-dir build-tests -L known-broken -V   # the worklist
```

### tools/cylinder2d_vorticity.cpp
```
// tools/cylinder2d_vorticity.cpp
//
// Developer diagnostic (NOT a test): the real parser + real post-field
// extraction on a 2D unstructured QUAD dataset. It prints diagnostics rather
// than asserting, because the point of this tool is to SEE what the pipeline
// produces for a given dataset.
//
// Usage: scirender_tool_cylinder2d <dataset.vtu>
//
// The dataset is not shipped with the repository. Point the tool at any 2D
// unstructured mesh with a point vector field and a point scalar field.
#include "core/mesh_loader.h"
#include "core/post_fields.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <exception>
#include <filesystem>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace {

void dumpMeshShape(const RenderMesh& m) {
    printf("datasetType=%s\n", m.datasetType.c_str());
    printf("vertices=%zu indices=%zu normals=%zu\n", m.vertices.size() / 3, m.indices.size() / 3,
           m.normals.size() / 3);
    printf("gridDim=%dx%dx%d sourcePointCount=%d\n", m.gridDimX, m.gridDimY, m.gridDimZ,
           m.sourcePointCount);
    printf("pointVectorCount=%zu cellVectorCount=%zu cellCenters=%zu\n", m.pointVectorCount,
           m.cellVectorCount, m.cellCenters.size());
    printf("vertexSourceIndex=%zu cellConnectivity=%zu cellOffsets=%zu\n", m.vertexSourceIndex.size(),
           m.cellConnectivity.size(), m.cellOffsets.size());
    printf("available scalars: ");
    for (auto& s : m.availableScalarNames)
        printf("%s; ", s.c_str());
    printf("\navailable point vectors: ");
    for (auto& s : m.availableVectorNames)
        printf("%s; ", s.c_str());
    printf("\navailable cell vectors: ");
    for (auto& s : m.availableCellVectorNames)
        printf("%s; ", s.c_str());
    printf("\n");
    float zmin = 1e30f, zmax = -1e30f;
    for (size_t i = 2; i < m.vertices.size(); i += 3) {
        zmin = std::min(zmin, m.vertices[i]);
        zmax = std::max(zmax, m.vertices[i]);
    }
    printf("z range: %.6g .. %.6g\n", zmin, zmax);
    postfields::CartesianGrid g;
    printf("extractCartesianGrid -> %s\n",
           postfields::extractCartesianGrid(m, g) ? "true (structured!)" : "false (unstructured LSQ)");
}

void statLine(const char* tag, std::vector<float>& v) {
    if (v.empty())
        return;
    std::sort(v.begin(), v.end());
    const size_t n = v.size();
    printf("%s: max=%.4g p1=%.4g p10=%.4g med=%.4g p90=%.4g p99=%.4g\n", tag, v[n - 1], v[n / 100],
           v[n / 10], v[n / 2], v[(n * 9) / 10], v[(n * 99) / 100]);
}

// Area-weighted piecewise-linear (Green-Gauss) node gradient over surface
// triangles, in logical-point space.
struct GGImpl {
    std::vector<float> dx, dy, ar;
    GGImpl(size_t N) : dx(N, 0), dy(N, 0), ar(N, 0) {}
    template <typename PosFn, typename SF>
    void accumulate(const RenderMesh& m, const std::vector<int>& logicalOf, PosFn pos, SF sf) {
        for (size_t t = 0; t + 2 < m.indices.size(); t += 3) {
            const int a = logicalOf[m.indices[t]], b = logicalOf[m.indices[t + 1]],
                      c = logicalOf[m.indices[t + 2]];
            if (a < 0 || b < 0 || c < 0)
                continue;
            const glm::vec2 pa = pos(a), pb = pos(b), pc = pos(c);
            const glm::vec2 d1 = pb - pa, d2 = pc - pa;
            const float twiceA = d1.x * d2.y - d1.y * d2.x;
            if (std::abs(twiceA) < 1e-14f)
                continue;
            const float A = 0.5f * std::abs(twiceA);
            const float fa = sf(a), fb = sf(b), fc = sf(c);
            const glm::vec2 g = ((fb - fa) * glm::vec2(d2.y, -d2.x) +
                                 (fc - fa) * -glm::vec2(d1.y, -d1.x)) /
                                twiceA;
            dx[a] += g.x * A;
            dy[a] += g.y * A;
            dx[b] += g.x * A;
            dy[b] += g.y * A;
            dx[c] += g.x * A;
            dy[c] += g.y * A;
            ar[a] += A;
            ar[b] += A;
            ar[c] += A;
        }
    }
};
using GG = GGImpl;

} // namespace

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    std::setvbuf(stdout, nullptr, _IONBF, 0);

    if (argc < 2) {
        fprintf(stderr,
                "usage: %s <dataset.vtu>\n"
                "\n"
                "This diagnostic needs a 2D unstructured dataset with a point vector field\n"
                "and a point scalar field. The repository does not ship one; pass the path\n"
                "to your own dataset as the first argument.\n",
                argv[0]);
        return 2;
    }

    const std::string path = argv[1];
    if (!std::filesystem::exists(path)) {
        fprintf(stderr, "dataset not found: %s\n", path.c_str());
        return 2;
    }

    RenderMesh m;
    try {
        m = loadMeshFile(path);
    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        printf("PARSE FAIL: %s\n", e.what());
        return 1;
    }
    dumpMeshShape(m);

    if (m.availableVectorNames.empty() || m.availableScalarNames.empty()) {
        printf("no vector or no scalar data; aborting probe\n");
        return 1;
    }
    const std::string vname = m.availableVectorNames[0];
    const std::string pname = m.availableScalarNames[0];
    size_t vcount = 0;
    const glm::vec3* vel = m.vectorFieldData(vname, vcount);
    if (!vel) {
        printf("vector data null\n");
        return 1;
    }
    const float* pres = nullptr;
    if (m.attributes) {
        auto it = m.attributes->pointScalars.find(pname);
        if (it != m.attributes->pointScalars.end())
            pres = it->second.data();
    }

    // ---- Shared GG machinery: fold split indices to logical, area-weighted PL gradient ----
    const size_t N = vel ? m.pointVectorCount : 0;
    const size_t splitN = m.vertexSourceIndex.size();
    std::vector<int> logicalOf(splitN, -1), repVertexOfLogical(N, -1);
    for (size_t v = 0; v < splitN; ++v) {
        const uint32_t s =
            v < splitN && m.vertexSourceIndex[v] < N ? m.vertexSourceIndex[v] : UINT32_MAX;
        if (s >= N)
            continue;
        if (repVertexOfLogical[s] < 0)
            repVertexOfLogical[s] = static_cast<int>(v);
        logicalOf[v] = static_cast<int>(s);
    }
    auto pos = [&](int logical) -> glm::vec2 {
        const int v = repVertexOfLogical[logical];
        return glm::vec2(m.vertices[v * 3], m.vertices[v * 3 + 1]);
    };

    postfields::PostFieldsRequest req;
    req.velocity = vel;
    req.pressure = pres;
    auto r = postfields::computePostFields(m, req);
    printf("computePostFields -> ok=%d err=%s\n", static_cast<int>(r.ok), r.error.c_str());
    if (!r.ok)
        return 1;

    // Reference: cell-vector velocity input (what the user reaches if the app
    // resolves the CELL Velocity for vorticity). With dead cellConnectivity the
    // extrapolation degenerates to cellData[i % cellCount] -> striped garbage.
    {
        size_t ccount = 0;
        const glm::vec3* cvel = m.cellVectorFieldData(vname, ccount);
        printf("\ncell-vector branch: count=%zu ptr=%s\n", ccount, cvel ? "ok" : "null");
        if (cvel && pres) {
            postfields::PostFieldsRequest creq;
            creq.velocity = cvel;
            creq.pressure = pres;
            auto cr = postfields::computePostFields(m, creq);
            printf("cell-vector computePostFields -> ok=%d err=%s N=%zu\n", static_cast<int>(cr.ok),
                   cr.error.c_str(), cr.vorticity.size());
            if (cr.ok) {
                std::vector<float> cw;
                for (auto& w : cr.vorticity)
                    cw.push_back(w.z);
                statLine("cell-vector wz", cw);
            }
        }
    }

    // ---- GG vorticity vs LSQ vorticity on the real field ----
    {
        GG ggU(N), ggV(N);
        ggU.accumulate(m, logicalOf, pos, [&](int i) { return vel[i].x; });
        ggV.accumulate(m, logicalOf, pos, [&](int i) { return vel[i].y; });
        std::vector<float> lsInt, refInt, diffInt;
        float maxArea = 0;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i)
            maxArea = std::max(maxArea, ggU.ar[i]);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            if (ggU.ar[i] < 0.04f * maxArea)
                continue; // skip partial-ring boundary nodes
            const float ls = r.vorticity[i].z;
            const float ref = ggV.dx[i] / ggV.ar[i] - ggU.dy[i] / ggU.ar[i];
            lsInt.push_back(ls);
            refInt.push_back(ref);
            diffInt.push_back(ls - ref);
        }
        printf("\nLSQ vs GG (interior %zu nodes)\n", diffInt.size());
        statLine("LSQ   wz(int)", lsInt);
        statLine("GG    wz(int)", refInt);
        statLine("diff  wz(int)", diffInt);
        size_t big = 0;
        float reldiff = 0;
        size_t abstol = 0;
        float peak = 0;
        for (auto& f : lsInt)
            peak = std::max(peak, std::abs(f));
        for (auto& f : refInt)
            peak = std::max(peak, std::abs(f));
        const float tol = 0.02f * peak;
        for (size_t k = 0; k < diffInt.size(); ++k) {
            const float scale = std::max(1e-6f, std::abs(refInt[k]));
            const float rd = std::abs(diffInt[k]) / scale;
            reldiff = std::max(reldiff, rd);
            if (rd > 0.05f)
                ++big;
            if (std::abs(diffInt[k]) > tol)
                ++abstol;
        }
        printf("interior: |wz diff|>5%% of |GG|: %zu/%zu; |>2%% peak| (tol=%.3g): %zu\n", big,
               diffInt.size(), tol, abstol);
        // Location of the worst absolute residuals, via direct recompute per node
        struct Rec {
            float diff, ls, gg;
            glm::vec2 p;
            int id;
        };
        std::vector<Rec> recs;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            if (ggU.ar[i] < 0.04f * maxArea)
                continue;
            const float ls = r.vorticity[i].z;
            const float gg = ggV.dx[i] / ggV.ar[i] - ggU.dy[i] / ggU.ar[i];
            recs.push_back({std::abs(ls - gg), ls, gg, pos(static_cast<int>(i)), static_cast<int>(i)});
        }
        std::sort(recs.begin(), recs.end(), [](const Rec& a, const Rec& b) { return a.diff > b.diff; });
        for (size_t k = 0; k < 5 && k < recs.size(); ++k) {
            const Rec& rr = recs[k];
            printf("worst#%d node(%d): pos=(%.4f,%.4f) |diff|=%.3g lsq=%.3g gg=%.3g ar=%.4g\n",
                   static_cast<int>(k) + 1, rr.id, rr.p.x, rr.p.y, rr.diff, rr.ls, rr.gg,
                   ggU.ar[rr.id]);
        }
        // residual k-t histogram vs peak scale
        size_t d01 = 0, d02 = 0, d05 = 0;
        for (auto& rr : recs) {
            const float a = rr.diff;
            if (a > 0.2f * peak)
                ++d02;
            if (a > 0.05f * peak)
                ++d05;
            if (a > 0.01f * peak)
                ++d01;
        }
        printf("resid: >1%% peak: %zu | >5%% peak: %zu | >20%% peak: %zu (peak=%.3g)\n", d01, d05,
               d02, peak);
    }

    // ---- Discriminator: LINEAR velocity (u=x, v=y) on the SAME mesh ----
    // Both LSQ and GG must reproduce grad u=(1,0), grad v=(0,1), omega=0.
    {
        std::vector<glm::vec3> lin(N);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            const glm::vec2 p = pos(static_cast<int>(i));
            lin[i] = glm::vec3(p.x, p.y, 0.0f);
        }
        postfields::PostFieldsRequest lreq;
        lreq.velocity = lin.data();
        lreq.pressure = pres;
        auto lr = postfields::computePostFields(m, lreq);
        if (lr.ok) {
            float e1 = 0;
            for (auto& w : lr.vorticity)
                e1 = std::max(e1, std::abs(w.z));
            printf("\nlinear discriminator: LSQ omega_z err=%.3g\n", e1);
            GG ggA(N), ggB(N);
            ggA.accumulate(m, logicalOf, pos, [&](int i) { return lin[i].x; });
            ggB.accumulate(m, logicalOf, pos, [&](int i) { return lin[i].y; });
            float maxa = 0;
            for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i)
                maxa = std::max(maxa, ggA.ar[i]);
            float egx = 0, egy = 0;
            size_t gbad = 0;
            for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i)
                if (ggA.ar[i] > 0.04f * maxa) {
                    const float x1 = std::abs(ggA.dx[i] / ggA.ar[i] - 1.0f);
                    const float y1 = std::abs(ggB.dy[i] / ggB.ar[i] - 1.0f);
                    if (x1 > 1e-3f || y1 > 1e-3f)
                        ++gbad;
                    egx = std::max(egx, x1);
                    egy = std::max(egy, y1);
                }
            printf("linear discriminator: GG  duDx err=%.3g dvDy err=%.3g (bad interior=%zu)\n",
                   egx, egy, gbad);
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <QApplication>
#include <QDebug>
#include <QIcon>
#include <QFile>
#include <QSurfaceFormat>

#include "ui/main_window.h"

int main(int argc, char *argv[]) {
    // Crash handler for post-animation terminate
    std::set_terminate([](){
        qCritical() << "[CRASH] std::terminate called";
        try { std::rethrow_exception(std::current_exception()); }
        catch (const std::exception& e) { qCritical() << "  exception:" << e.what(); }
        catch (...) { qCritical() << "  unknown exception"; }
        std::abort();
    });
    qDebug() << "[LAUNCH DIAGNOSTIC 1/4] Main entry executed. Allocating resources...";

    // Stable QSettings scope (must be set before any QSettings access)
    QCoreApplication::setOrganizationName("SciRender");
    QCoreApplication::setApplicationName("SciRender");

    // Force desktop OpenGL 4.6 Core profile
    QSurfaceFormat glFormat;
    glFormat.setRenderableType(QSurfaceFormat::OpenGL);
    glFormat.setVersion(4, 6);
    glFormat.setProfile(QSurfaceFormat::CoreProfile);
    glFormat.setDepthBufferSize(24);
    glFormat.setSamples(0);
    QSurfaceFormat::setDefaultFormat(glFormat);

    qDebug() << "[LAUNCH DIAGNOSTIC 2/4] Graphics API bound to desktop OpenGL 4.6 Core.";

    QApplication app(argc, argv);
    app.setStyle("Fusion");

    // Window icon
    {
        const QString exeIcon = QApplication::applicationDirPath() + "/app_icon.ico";
        QIcon icon(QFile::exists(exeIcon) ? exeIcon : QStringLiteral(APP_ICON_SRC));
        if (!icon.isNull()) app.setWindowIcon(icon);
    }

    qDebug() << "[LAUNCH DIAGNOSTIC 3/4] Ready.";

    MainWindow window;
    window.show();

    qDebug() << "[LAUNCH DIAGNOSTIC 4/4] MainWindow created and shown.";

    int ret = 0;
    try { ret = app.exec(); }
    catch (const std::exception& e) { qCritical() << "[CRASH] app.exec exception:" << e.what(); ret = -1; }
    catch (...) { qCritical() << "[CRASH] app.exec unknown exception"; ret = -1; }
    qDebug() << "[SHUTDOWN] app.exec returned" << ret;
    return ret;
}

### src/cfd/amg_settings_bridge.h
```
#pragma once

#include "cfd/cfd_types.h"
#include "fvm/AMG.h"

namespace cfd {

// Translate the UI's plain AMG mirror into the solver's multigrid config.
//
// cfd::AmgSettings exists so the UI never has to include Eigen; this header is
// the single place the two representations meet. Every field is copied
// explicitly, so a knob added to fvm::AMGHierarchy::Config shows up here as a
// compile error rather than silently defaulting. The cfd::AmgSettings enums are
// declared in the same order as their fvm counterparts, so the switch cases
// read top-to-bottom.
inline fvm::AMGHierarchy::Config toFvmAmg(const AmgSettings& s) {
    fvm::AMGHierarchy::Config c;

    switch (s.coarseningType) {
        case AmgSettings::CoarseningType::RS:
            c.coarseningType = fvm::AMGHierarchy::CoarseningType::RS; break;
        case AmgSettings::CoarseningType::PMIS:
            c.coarseningType = fvm::AMGHierarchy::CoarseningType::PMIS; break;
    }
    switch (s.interpolationType) {
        case AmgSettings::InterpolationType::Direct:
            c.interpolationType = fvm::AMGHierarchy::InterpolationType::Direct; break;
        case AmgSettings::InterpolationType::Extended:
            c.interpolationType = fvm::AMGHierarchy::InterpolationType::Extended; break;
    }
    switch (s.cycleType) {
        case AmgSettings::CycleType::V:
            c.cycleType = fvm::AMGHierarchy::CycleType::V; break;
        case AmgSettings::CycleType::F:
            c.cycleType = fvm::AMGHierarchy::CycleType::F; break;
    }
    switch (s.smootherType) {
        case AmgSettings::SmootherType::SymmetricGaussSeidel:
            c.smootherType = fvm::AMGHierarchy::SmootherType::SymmetricGaussSeidel; break;
        case AmgSettings::SmootherType::ForwardGaussSeidel:
            c.smootherType = fvm::AMGHierarchy::SmootherType::ForwardGaussSeidel; break;
        case AmgSettings::SmootherType::ForwardSOR:
            c.smootherType = fvm::AMGHierarchy::SmootherType::ForwardSOR; break;
    }

    c.smootherOmega = s.smootherOmega;
    c.strengthThreshold = s.strengthThreshold;
    c.truncThreshold = s.truncThreshold;
    c.maxLevels = s.maxLevels;
    c.minCoarseSize = s.minCoarseSize;
    c.preSweeps = s.preSweeps;
    c.postSweeps = s.postSweeps;
    c.maxIterations = s.maxIterations;
    c.tolerance = s.tolerance;
    c.rngSeed = s.rngSeed;
    c.stagnationFactor = s.stagnationFactor;
    c.stagnationMinIter = s.stagnationMinIter;
    c.stagnationLooseFactor = s.stagnationLooseFactor;
    c.galerkinDropTol = s.galerkinDropTol;
    return c;
}

} // namespace cfd

### src/cfd/case_codec.h
```
#pragma once

#include "cfd/cfd_types.h"

#include <QByteArray>
#include <QDataStream>
#include <QJsonDocument>
#include <QJsonObject>
#include <QJsonArray>

namespace cfd {

// Qt-based case settings/BC codec. Keeps the SCFD file format's JSON payload
// in one place so CfdController only handles file I/O and thread orchestration.
inline QByteArray serializeCaseSettings(const CaseSettings& s, const std::vector<PatchBC>& patchBCs) {
    QJsonObject o;
    o["rho"] = s.rho;
    o["nu"] = s.nu;
    o["tolerance"] = s.tolerance;
    o["maxIterations"] = (qint64)s.maxIterations;
    o["runFixedIterations"] = s.runFixedIterations;
    o["convergenceHoldIterations"] = s.convergenceHoldIterations;
    o["alphaU"] = s.alphaU;
    o["alphaP"] = s.alphaP;
    o["simplec"] = s.simplec;
    o["scheme"] = s.scheme;
    o["gradientScheme"] = s.gradientScheme;
    o["rhieChow"] = s.rhieChow;
    o["turbulence"] = s.turbulence;
    o["kInf"] = s.kInf;
    o["omegaInf"] = s.omegaInf;
    o["alphaK"] = s.alphaK;
    o["alphaOmega"] = s.alphaOmega;
    o["pressureRefCell"] = (qint64)s.pressureRefCell;
    o["pressureCorrectors"] = s.pressureCorrectors;
    o["limitPressureCorrection"] = s.limitPressureCorrection;
    o["pressureCorrectionLimit"] = s.pressureCorrectionLimit;
    o["printFrequency"] = (qint64)s.printFrequency;
    o["residualHistoryWindow"] = (qint64)s.residualHistoryWindow;
    o["numThreads"] = s.numThreads;
    o["pressureUseAMG"] = s.pressureUseAMG;
    o["pressureUseAMGPreconditioner"] = s.pressureUseAMGPreconditioner;
    o["pressureAmgThreshold"] = (qint64)s.pressureAmgThreshold;
    o["useAMGMomentum"] = s.useAMGMomentum;
    o["momentumAmgThreshold"] = (qint64)s.momentumAmgThreshold;
    o["momentumAmgCycles"] = s.momentumAmgCycles;
    o["momentumAmgMaxResidual"] = s.momentumAmgMaxResidual;
    o["momentumSolverStats"] = s.momentumSolverStats;

    QJsonObject t;
    t["enabled"] = s.transient.enabled;
    t["dt"] = s.transient.dt;
    t["tEnd"] = s.transient.tEnd;
    t["timeScheme"] = (int)s.transient.timeScheme;
    t["adaptiveCfl"] = s.transient.adaptiveCfl;
    t["cfl"] = s.transient.cfl;
    t["minDt"] = s.transient.minDt;
    t["maxDt"] = s.transient.maxDt;
    t["writeInterval"] = s.transient.writeInterval;
    t["maxOuterCorrectors"] = s.transient.maxOuterCorrectors;
    t["nonOrthogonalCorrectors"] = s.transient.nonOrthogonalCorrectors;
    t["pvdFile"] = QString::fromStdString(s.transient.pvdFile);
    o["transient"] = t;

    QJsonArray bcArr;
    for (const auto& pbc : patchBCs) {
        QJsonObject b;
        b["patchName"] = QString::fromStdString(pbc.patchName);
        b["type"] = (int)pbc.type;
        b["u"] = pbc.u; b["v"] = pbc.v; b["w"] = pbc.w;
        b["pressure"] = pbc.pressure;
        b["suppressBackflow"] = pbc.suppressBackflow;
        b["backflowU"] = pbc.backflowU; b["backflowV"] = pbc.backflowV; b["backflowW"] = pbc.backflowW;
        b["backflowK"] = pbc.backflowK; b["backflowOmega"] = pbc.backflowOmega;
        b["kInlet"] = pbc.kInlet; b["omegaInlet"] = pbc.omegaInlet;
        bcArr.append(b);
    }
    o["patchBCs"] = bcArr;

    return QJsonDocument(o).toJson(QJsonDocument::Compact);
}

inline bool deserializeCaseSettings(const QByteArray& settings, CaseSettings& s, std::vector<PatchBC>& patchBCs) {
    QJsonDocument doc = QJsonDocument::fromJson(settings);
    if (!doc.isObject()) return false;
    const QJsonObject o = doc.object();

    s.rho = o.value("rho").toDouble(s.rho);
    s.nu = o.value("nu").toDouble(s.nu);
    s.tolerance = o.value("tolerance").toDouble(s.tolerance);
    s.maxIterations = (std::size_t)o.value("maxIterations").toVariant().toULongLong();
    s.runFixedIterations = o.value("runFixedIterations").toBool(s.runFixedIterations);
    s.convergenceHoldIterations = o.value("convergenceHoldIterations").toInt(s.convergenceHoldIterations);
    s.alphaU = o.value("alphaU").toDouble(s.alphaU);
    s.alphaP = o.value("alphaP").toDouble(s.alphaP);
    s.simplec = o.value("simplec").toBool(s.simplec);
    s.scheme = o.value("scheme").toInt(s.scheme);
    s.gradientScheme = o.value("gradientScheme").toInt(s.gradientScheme);
    s.rhieChow = o.value("rhieChow").toBool(s.rhieChow);
    s.turbulence = o.value("turbulence").toBool(s.turbulence);
    s.kInf = o.value("kInf").toDouble(s.kInf);
    s.omegaInf = o.value("omegaInf").toDouble(s.omegaInf);
    s.alphaK = o.value("alphaK").toDouble(s.alphaK);
    s.alphaOmega = o.value("alphaOmega").toDouble(s.alphaOmega);
    s.pressureRefCell = (std::size_t)o.value("pressureRefCell").toVariant().toULongLong();
    s.pressureCorrectors = o.value("pressureCorrectors").toInt(s.pressureCorrectors);
    s.limitPressureCorrection = o.value("limitPressureCorrection").toBool(s.limitPressureCorrection);
    s.pressureCorrectionLimit = o.value("pressureCorrectionLimit").toDouble(s.pressureCorrectionLimit);
    s.printFrequency = (std::size_t)o.value("printFrequency").toVariant().toULongLong();
    s.residualHistoryWindow = (std::size_t)o.value("residualHistoryWindow").toVariant().toULongLong();
    s.numThreads = o.value("numThreads").toInt(s.numThreads);
    s.pressureUseAMG = o.value("pressureUseAMG").toBool(s.pressureUseAMG);
    s.pressureUseAMGPreconditioner = o.value("pressureUseAMGPreconditioner").toBool(s.pressureUseAMGPreconditioner);
    s.pressureAmgThreshold = (std::size_t)o.value("pressureAmgThreshold").toVariant().toULongLong();
    s.useAMGMomentum = o.value("useAMGMomentum").toBool(s.useAMGMomentum);
    s.momentumAmgThreshold = (std::size_t)o.value("momentumAmgThreshold").toVariant().toULongLong();
    s.momentumAmgCycles = o.value("momentumAmgCycles").toInt(s.momentumAmgCycles);
    s.momentumAmgMaxResidual = o.value("momentumAmgMaxResidual").toDouble(s.momentumAmgMaxResidual);
    s.momentumSolverStats = o.value("momentumSolverStats").toBool(s.momentumSolverStats);

    const QJsonObject t = o.value("transient").toObject();
    s.transient.enabled = t.value("enabled").toBool(s.transient.enabled);
    s.transient.dt = t.value("dt").toDouble(s.transient.dt);
    s.transient.tEnd = t.value("tEnd").toDouble(s.transient.tEnd);
    s.transient.timeScheme = (cfd::TransientSettings::TimeScheme)t.value("timeScheme").toInt((int)s.transient.timeScheme);
    s.transient.adaptiveCfl = t.value("adaptiveCfl").toBool(s.transient.adaptiveCfl);
    s.transient.cfl = t.value("cfl").toDouble(s.transient.cfl);
    s.transient.minDt = t.value("minDt").toDouble(s.transient.minDt);
    s.transient.maxDt = t.value("maxDt").toDouble(s.transient.maxDt);
    s.transient.writeInterval = t.value("writeInterval").toInt(s.transient.writeInterval);
    s.transient.maxOuterCorrectors = t.value("maxOuterCorrectors").toInt(s.transient.maxOuterCorrectors);
    s.transient.nonOrthogonalCorrectors = t.value("nonOrthogonalCorrectors").toInt(s.transient.nonOrthogonalCorrectors);
    s.transient.pvdFile = t.value("pvdFile").toString(QString::fromStdString(s.transient.pvdFile)).toStdString();

    const QJsonArray bcArr = o.value("patchBCs").toArray();
    if (!bcArr.isEmpty()) {
        patchBCs.clear();
        for (const auto& v : bcArr) {
            const QJsonObject b = v.toObject();
            cfd::PatchBC pbc;
            pbc.patchName = b.value("patchName").toString().toStdString();
            pbc.type = static_cast<cfd::BCType>(b.value("type").toInt((int)cfd::BCType::WallNoSlip));
            pbc.u = b.value("u").toDouble(pbc.u);
            pbc.v = b.value("v").toDouble(pbc.v);
            pbc.w = b.value("w").toDouble(pbc.w);
            pbc.pressure = b.value("pressure").toDouble(pbc.pressure);
            pbc.suppressBackflow = b.value("suppressBackflow").toBool(pbc.suppressBackflow);
            pbc.backflowU = b.value("backflowU").toDouble(pbc.backflowU);
            pbc.backflowV = b.value("backflowV").toDouble(pbc.backflowV);
            pbc.backflowW = b.value("backflowW").toDouble(pbc.backflowW);
            pbc.backflowK = b.value("backflowK").toDouble(pbc.backflowK);
            pbc.backflowOmega = b.value("backflowOmega").toDouble(pbc.backflowOmega);
            pbc.kInlet = b.value("kInlet").toDouble(pbc.kInlet);
            pbc.omegaInlet = b.value("omegaInlet").toDouble(pbc.omegaInlet);
            patchBCs.push_back(pbc);
        }
    }
    return true;
}

} // namespace cfd

### src/cfd/cfd_mesh_adapter.cpp
```
#include "cfd/cfd_mesh_adapter.h"

#include "io/ANSYSMeshReader.h"
#include "io/GmshReader.h"
#include "mesh/Mesh.h"
#include "core/cell_topology.h"
#include "core/mesh_loader.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <fstream>
#include <string>
#include <unordered_set>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

namespace cfd {

namespace {

std::string sniffFormat(const std::string& path) {
    std::ifstream in(path, std::ios::binary);
    if (!in) return "gmsh";
    char buf[16] = {0};
    in.read(buf, 15);
    std::string header(buf);
    if (header.find("(0") == 0) return "fluent";
    if (header.find("$Mesh") != std::string::npos) return "gmsh";
    // extension fallback
    if (path.size() >= 4 && path.substr(path.size()-4) == ".msh") return "fluent";
    return "gmsh";
}

// Boundary faces are identified by their neighbour: the mesh's face list uses
// npos for a face that has no second cell.
constexpr std::size_t kNoNeighbor = static_cast<std::size_t>(-1);

uint64_t edgeKey(std::uint32_t a, std::uint32_t b) {
    if (a > b) std::swap(a, b);
    return (static_cast<uint64_t>(a) << 32) | static_cast<uint64_t>(b);
}

// Canonical VTK corner order for a 3D cell. The reader already canonicalizes
// ANSYS cells; Gmsh files are canonical by construction. Re-canonicalizing
// here keeps the RenderMesh independent of the source and, more importantly,
// lets a cell that cannot be laid out as a tet/hex/wedge/pyramid be marked
// unsupported (kPolyhedron) so the volume and isosurface paths skip it.
void canonicalCell(const fvm::Mesh<3>& m, std::size_t cellIndex,
                   std::vector<std::size_t>& out, std::uint8_t& type) {
    const auto& faceIds = m.cellFaces(cellIndex);
    std::vector<std::vector<std::size_t>> loops;
    loops.reserve(faceIds.size());
    for (std::size_t f : faceIds) loops.push_back(m.faceVertices(f));

    out = m.cells()[cellIndex];
    type = cell_topology::canonicalize(out, loops, m.vertices());
    if (type == cell_topology::kPolyhedron) out = m.cells()[cellIndex];
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
std::shared_ptr<const RenderMesh> buildRenderMesh(const fvm::Mesh<Dim>& m) {
    RenderMesh rm;
    rm.datasetType = "CFD MESH";
    rm.fileFormat = "MSH";

    const auto& verts = m.vertices();
    rm.vertices.reserve(verts.size() * 3);
    for (const auto& v : verts) {
        rm.vertices.push_back(static_cast<float>(v[0]));
        rm.vertices.push_back(static_cast<float>(v[1]));
        if constexpr (Dim == 3) {
            rm.vertices.push_back(static_cast<float>(v[2]));
        } else {
            rm.vertices.push_back(0.0f);  // 2D CFD lives in the z=0 plane
        }
    }

    if constexpr (Dim == 2) {
        // Every cell is a surface polygon: fan-triangulate it.
        for (const auto& cell : m.cells()) {
            if (cell.size() < 3) continue;
            for (std::size_t i = 1; i + 1 < cell.size(); ++i) {
                rm.indices.push_back(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(cell[0]));
                rm.indices.push_back(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(cell[i]));
                rm.indices.push_back(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(cell[i + 1]));
            }
        }
    } else {
        // A volume mesh must render its external surface: only faces without a
        // neighbour on the other side. Using the solver's face topology (instead
        // of a per-cell face-count heuristic) is exact for polyhedra.
        std::vector<std::uint32_t> edges;
        std::unordered_set<uint64_t> seenEdges;
        for (std::size_t f = 0; f < m.nFaces(); ++f) {
            if (m.neighbor(f) != kNoNeighbor) continue;
            const auto& loop = m.faceVertices(f);
            if (loop.size() < 3) continue;
            for (std::size_t i = 1; i + 1 < loop.size(); ++i) {
                rm.indices.push_back(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(loop[0]));
                rm.indices.push_back(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(loop[i]));
                rm.indices.push_back(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(loop[i + 1]));
            }
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < loop.size(); ++i) {
                const auto a = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(loop[i]);
                const auto b = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(loop[(i + 1) % loop.size()]);
                if (seenEdges.insert(edgeKey(a, b)).second) {
                    edges.push_back(a);
                    edges.push_back(b);
                }
            }
        }
        rm.cellEdgeIndices = std::move(edges);
    }

    // Cell topology (shared by the post-field extrapolation, glyph placement
    // and the least-squares gradient neighbour builder).
    std::size_t cellIndex = 0;
    for (const auto& cell : m.cells()) {
        if constexpr (Dim == 3) {
            std::vector<std::size_t> canonical;
            std::uint8_t type = cell_topology::kPolyhedron;
            canonicalCell(m, cellIndex, canonical, type);
            for (std::size_t vi : canonical) {
                rm.cellConnectivity.push_back(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(vi));
            }
            rm.cellTypes.push_back(type);
            if (cell_topology::isVolumeCell(type)) ++rm.unstructuredVolumeCellCount;
        } else {
            for (std::size_t vi : cell) {
                rm.cellConnectivity.push_back(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(vi));
            }
            rm.cellTypes.push_back(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(
                cell.size() == 3 ? 5 : (cell.size() == 4 ? 9 : 7)));
        }
        rm.cellOffsets.push_back(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(rm.cellConnectivity.size()));
        ++cellIndex;
    }

    // Cell centres
    rm.cellCenters.reserve(m.nCells());
    for (std::size_t c = 0; c < m.nCells(); ++c) {
        const auto cc = m.cellCenter(c);
        if constexpr (Dim == 3) {
            rm.cellCenters.emplace_back(static_cast<float>(cc[0]),
                                        static_cast<float>(cc[1]),
                                        static_cast<float>(cc[2]));
        } else {
            rm.cellCenters.emplace_back(static_cast<float>(cc[0]),
                                        static_cast<float>(cc[1]),
                                        0.0f);
        }
    }
    rm.cellVectorCount = m.nCells();

    // Pre-normal-split point count (what the UI reports and what point fields
    // are sized against).
    rm.sourcePointCount = static_cast<int>(rm.vertices.size() / 3);
    mesh_utils::computeBounds(rm);
    mesh_utils::computeNormals(rm);
    if (rm.normals.empty() && !rm.vertices.empty()) {
        rm.normals.assign(rm.vertices.size(), 0.0f);
        for (std::size_t i = 2; i < rm.normals.size(); i += 3) rm.normals[i] = 1.0f;
    }
    mesh_utils::finalizeGeometrySignatures(rm);
    return std::make_shared<const RenderMesh>(std::move(rm));
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void fillResult(const fvm::Mesh<Dim>& mesh, MeshLoadResult& res) {
    for (const auto& kv : mesh.boundaryGroups()) {
        PatchInfo p;
        p.name = kv.first;
        p.faceCount = kv.second.size();
        res.patches.push_back(std::move(p));
    }
}

} // namespace

MeshLoadResult loadMesh(const std::string& path) {
    MeshLoadResult res;
    const std::string fmt = sniffFormat(path);
    try {
        const int dim = (fmt == "fluent")
            ? fvm::ANSYSMeshReader<2>::detectDimension(path)
            : fvm::GmshReader<2>::detectDimension(path);
        res.dim = dim;

        if (dim == 3) {
            if (fmt == "fluent") {
                auto r = fvm::ANSYSMeshReader<3>::read(path);
                auto mesh = std::make_shared<const fvm::Mesh<3>>(std::move(r.mesh));
                fillResult(*mesh, res);
                res.mesh3 = std::move(mesh);
            } else {
                auto r = fvm::GmshReader<3>::read(path);
                auto mesh = std::make_shared<const fvm::Mesh<3>>(std::move(r.mesh));
                fillResult(*mesh, res);
                res.mesh3 = std::move(mesh);
            }
            if (!res.mesh3) {
                res.error = "The 3D mesh could not be read.";
                return res;
            }
            res.renderMesh = buildRenderMesh(*res.mesh3);
        } else {
            if (fmt == "fluent") {
                auto r = fvm::ANSYSMeshReader<2>::read(path);
                auto mesh = std::make_shared<const fvm::Mesh<2>>(std::move(r.mesh));
                fillResult(*mesh, res);
                res.mesh2 = std::move(mesh);
            } else {
                auto r = fvm::GmshReader<2>::read(path);
                auto mesh = std::make_shared<const fvm::Mesh<2>>(std::move(r.mesh));
                fillResult(*mesh, res);
                res.mesh2 = std::move(mesh);
            }
            if (!res.mesh2) {
                res.error = "The 2D mesh could not be read.";
                return res;
            }
            res.renderMesh = buildRenderMesh(*res.mesh2);
        }
    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        res.error = e.what();
        return res;
    }

    if (!res.renderMesh || res.renderMesh->vertices.empty()) {
        res.error = "The mesh contains no geometry to render.";
    }
    return res;
}

} // namespace cfd

### src/cfd/cfd_result_builder.cpp
```
#include "cfd/cfd_result_builder.h"

#include "field/Field.h"
#include "field/VectorField.h"
#include "mesh/Mesh.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

namespace cfd {

namespace {

std::pair<float, float> rangeOf(const std::vector<float>& v) {
    if (v.empty()) return {0.0f, 1.0f};
    const auto mm = std::minmax_element(v.begin(), v.end());
    return {*mm.first, *mm.second};
}

} // namespace

template<std::size_t Dim>
std::shared_ptr<const RenderMesh> buildResultMesh(
    const std::shared_ptr<const RenderMesh>& baseMesh,
    const fvm::Mesh<Dim>& mesh,
    const SolutionSnapshot& state,
    const CaseSettings& settings,
    const std::vector<PatchBC>& patchBCs) {

    if (!baseMesh || !state.hasFields() || state.cells != mesh.nCells()) return nullptr;

    RenderMesh rm = *baseMesh; // copy geometry + cell topology CSRs
    auto& attrs = mesh_utils::ensureAttributes(rm);

    const int nCells = static_cast<int>(mesh.nCells());
    if (nCells <= 0) return nullptr;
    const int nSrc = (rm.sourcePointCount > 0)
        ? rm.sourcePointCount
        : static_cast<int>(rm.vertices.size() / 3);
    const int nFinal = static_cast<int>(rm.vertices.size() / 3);
    if (nSrc <= 0 || nFinal <= 0) return nullptr;

    auto expandToFinal = [&](const std::vector<float>& src) {
        std::vector<float> out(static_cast<std::size_t>(nFinal), 0.0f);
        if (static_cast<int>(src.size()) == nFinal) return src;
        if (rm.vertexSourceIndex.size() == static_cast<std::size_t>(nFinal)) {
            for (int i = 0; i < nFinal; ++i) {
                const uint32_t s = rm.vertexSourceIndex[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)];
                if (s < src.size()) out[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)] = src[s];
            }
        } else {
            for (int i = 0; i < nFinal && i < static_cast<int>(src.size()); ++i)
                out[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)] = src[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)];
        }
        return out;
    };

    // ── Pressure ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Store BOTH cell and point data. The renderer resolves the active surface
    // field per-vertex (FieldStore::resolveScalar(Vertex)); without a
    // pointScalars entry it falls back to the cell-sized array and uploads it
    // 1:1 against the larger vertex buffer, which scrambles the surface. The
    // extrapolated point copy is what the GPU actually shades.
    std::vector<float> cellPres(static_cast<std::size_t>(nCells));
    for (int c = 0; c < nCells; ++c)
        cellPres[static_cast<std::size_t>(c)] = static_cast<float>(state.pressure[static_cast<std::size_t>(c)]);

    attrs.cellScalars["pressure"] = cellPres;
    attrs.cellScalarRanges["pressure"] = rangeOf(cellPres);

    std::vector<float> pointPresSrc = mesh_utils::extrapolateCellToPoints<float>(rm, cellPres, static_cast<std::size_t>(nCells), static_cast<std::size_t>(nSrc));
    std::vector<float> pointPres = expandToFinal(pointPresSrc);

    attrs.pointScalars["pressure"] = pointPres;
    attrs.pointScalarRanges["pressure"] = rangeOf(pointPresSrc);

    rm.scalars = pointPres;
    rm.scalarName = "pressure";

    // ── Velocity ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    std::vector<glm::vec3> cellVel(static_cast<std::size_t>(nCells));
    for (int c = 0; c < nCells; ++c) {
        const auto uc = static_cast<std::size_t>(c);
        float z = 0.0f;
        if constexpr (Dim >= 3) z = static_cast<float>(state.velocity[2][uc]);
        cellVel[uc] = glm::vec3(static_cast<float>(state.velocity[0][uc]),
                                static_cast<float>(state.velocity[1][uc]),
                                z);
    }

    rm.cellVectorsData = cellVel;
    rm.cellVectorOffset.clear();
    rm.cellVectorOffset["velocity"] = 0;
    rm.availableCellVectorNames = {"velocity"};
    rm.cellVectorName = "velocity";
    rm.cellVectorCount = static_cast<std::size_t>(nCells);

    // Point-located velocity (glyphs, streamlines, LIC read this contiguous run).
    std::vector<glm::vec3> pointVel = mesh_utils::extrapolateCellToPoints<glm::vec3>(rm, cellVel, static_cast<std::size_t>(nCells), static_cast<std::size_t>(nSrc));

    // Preserve prescribed boundary velocities at boundary vertices instead of
    // leaving them as the average of adjacent cell centers. This keeps the
    // visualized field consistent with the applied boundary conditions (e.g. a
    // lid moving at 1 m/s shows up as 1 m/s on the lid).
    for (const auto& pbc : patchBCs) {
        auto git = mesh.boundaryGroups().find(pbc.patchName);
        if (git == mesh.boundaryGroups().end()) continue;
        glm::vec3 bvel(0.0f);
        bool apply = false;
        switch (pbc.type) {
            case BCType::VelocityInlet:
            case BCType::MovingWall:
                bvel = glm::vec3(static_cast<float>(pbc.u),
                                 static_cast<float>(pbc.v),
                                 static_cast<float>(pbc.w));
                apply = true;
                break;
            case BCType::WallNoSlip:
                apply = true;
                break;
            default:
                break;
        }
        if (!apply) continue;
        for (std::size_t f : git->second) {
            for (std::size_t vid : mesh.faceVertices(f)) {
                if (vid < pointVel.size()) pointVel[vid] = bvel;
            }
        }
    }

    rm.pointVectorsData = pointVel;
    rm.pointVectorOffset.clear();
    rm.pointVectorOffset["velocity"] = 0;
    rm.availableVectorNames = {"velocity"};
    rm.vectorName = "velocity";
    rm.pointVectorCount = static_cast<std::size_t>(nSrc);

    // ── Turbulence ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    if (settings.turbulence && state.hasTurbulence()) {
        std::vector<float> k(static_cast<std::size_t>(nCells));
        std::vector<float> om(static_cast<std::size_t>(nCells));
        std::vector<float> nt(static_cast<std::size_t>(nCells));
        for (int c = 0; c < nCells; ++c) {
            const auto uc = static_cast<std::size_t>(c);
            k[uc] = static_cast<float>(state.turbulence.k[uc]);
            om[uc] = static_cast<float>(state.turbulence.omega[uc]);
            nt[uc] = static_cast<float>(state.turbulence.nut[uc]);
        }
        const std::pair<const char*, const std::vector<float>*> fields[] = {
            {"k", &k}, {"omega", &om}, {"nut", &nt}
        };
        for (const auto& [name, cellVals] : fields) {
            attrs.cellScalars[name] = *cellVals;
            attrs.cellScalarRanges[name] = rangeOf(*cellVals);
            std::vector<float> ptsSrc = mesh_utils::extrapolateCellToPoints<float>(rm, *cellVals, static_cast<std::size_t>(nCells), static_cast<std::size_t>(nSrc));
            std::vector<float> pts = expandToFinal(ptsSrc);
            attrs.pointScalars[name] = pts;
            attrs.pointScalarRanges[name] = rangeOf(ptsSrc);
        }
    }

    // ── Scalar metadata ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Legacy global range = union of cell + point extents (wide enough for
    // both the cell-center and the extrapolated per-vertex coloring paths).
    attrs.scalarMin = std::min(attrs.cellScalarRanges["pressure"].first,
                               attrs.pointScalarRanges["pressure"].first);
    attrs.scalarMax = std::max(attrs.cellScalarRanges["pressure"].second,
                               attrs.pointScalarRanges["pressure"].second);

    rm.availableScalarNames.clear();
    rm.availableScalarNames.push_back("pressure");
    if (settings.turbulence && state.hasTurbulence()) {
        rm.availableScalarNames.push_back("k");
        rm.availableScalarNames.push_back("omega");
        rm.availableScalarNames.push_back("nut");
    }

    mesh_utils::finalizeGeometrySignatures(rm);
    return std::make_shared<const RenderMesh>(std::move(rm));
}

template std::shared_ptr<const RenderMesh> buildResultMesh<2>(
    const std::shared_ptr<const RenderMesh>&,
    const fvm::Mesh<2>&,
    const SolutionSnapshot&,
    const CaseSettings&,
    const std::vector<PatchBC>&);

template std::shared_ptr<const RenderMesh> buildResultMesh<3>(
    const std::shared_ptr<const RenderMesh>&,
    const fvm::Mesh<3>&,
    const SolutionSnapshot&,
    const CaseSettings&,
    const std::vector<PatchBC>&);

} // namespace cfd
