### src/cfd/cfd_session.cpp
```
#include "cfd/cfd_session.h"

#include "cfd/cfd_result_builder.h"
#include "cfd/solver_config_bridge.h"

#include "field/Field.h"
#include "field/VectorField.h"
#include "fvm/SIMPLE.h"
#include "fvm/SSTModel.h"
#include "io/VTKXMLWriter.h"
#include "mesh/Mesh.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <atomic>
#include <cstdio>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
#include <string>
#include <type_traits>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

namespace cfd {

namespace {

template<std::size_t Dim>
class CfdSession final : public ICfdSession {
public:
    using Solver = fvm::SIMPLE<Dim>;
    using Velocity = fvm::VectorField<Dim>;
    using Scalar = fvm::Field<Dim>;

    explicit CfdSession(std::shared_ptr<const fvm::Mesh<Dim>> mesh)
        : m_mesh(std::move(mesh)) {}

    int dim() const override { return static_cast<int>(Dim); }
    std::size_t cells() const override { return m_mesh ? m_mesh->nCells() : 0; }

    void clear() override {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(m_mutex);
        m_solver.reset();
        m_solverMesh.reset();
        m_velocity.reset();
        m_pressure.reset();
        m_state.clear();
        m_transientRun = false;
    }

    bool setState(const SolutionSnapshot& state, std::string& error) override {
        if (state.dim != 0 && state.dim != static_cast<int>(Dim)) {
            error = "The saved solution is " + std::to_string(state.dim) +
                    "D but the mesh is " + std::to_string(Dim) + "D.";
            return false;
        }
        if (state.hasFields() && state.cells != m_mesh->nCells()) {
            error = "The saved fields do not match the mesh (" +
                    std::to_string(state.cells) + " cells in the file, " +
                    std::to_string(m_mesh->nCells()) + " in the mesh).";
            return false;
        }

        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(m_mutex);
        m_solver.reset();
        m_solverMesh.reset();
        m_transientRun = false;
        m_velocity.reset();
        m_pressure.reset();
        if (state.hasFields()) seedFields(state);
        m_state = state.hasFields() ? state : SolutionSnapshot{};
        return true;
    }

    SolutionSnapshot initialize(const InitConditions& ic,
                                const CaseSettings& settings) override {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(m_mutex);
        m_solver.reset();
        m_solverMesh.reset();
        m_transientRun = false;

        m_velocity = std::make_shared<Velocity>(*m_mesh, 0.0);
        m_pressure = std::make_shared<Scalar>(*m_mesh, ic.pressure);
        m_velocity->assign(0, ic.ux);
        if constexpr (Dim >= 2) m_velocity->assign(1, ic.uy);
        if constexpr (Dim >= 3) m_velocity->assign(2, ic.uz);

        SolutionSnapshot state = snapshotFields();
        if (settings.turbulence) {
            typename fvm::SSTModel<Dim>::Config cfg{};
            cfg.kInf = ic.k;
            cfg.omegaInf = ic.omega;
            cfg.alphaK = settings.alphaK;
            cfg.alphaOmega = settings.alphaOmega;
            fvm::SSTModel<Dim> model(*m_mesh, cfg);
            model.initialize(settings.nu * settings.rho, settings.rho);
            fillTurbulence(state, model);
        }
        m_state = state;
        return state;
    }

    bool startRun(const CaseSettings& settings,
                  const std::vector<PatchBC>& bcs,
                  const SolutionSnapshot& restart,
                  const RunHooks& hooks,
                  std::string& error) override {
        if (restart.dim != 0 && restart.dim != static_cast<int>(Dim)) {
            error = "The saved solution does not match the mesh dimension.";
            return false;
        }
        if (settings.transient.enabled) {
            if (!(settings.transient.tEnd > 0.0)) {
                error = "End time must be greater than zero.";
                return false;
            }
            if (restart.transientValid &&
                restart.time >= settings.transient.tEnd - 1e-12) {
                char buf[320];
                std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf),
                              "The saved state is already at t = %g s (end time %g s). "
                              "Raise the end time to continue the run.",
                              restart.time, settings.transient.tEnd);
                error = buf;
                return false;
            }
        }

        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(m_mutex);

        // Continue from the supplied snapshot when it belongs to this mesh;
        // otherwise start from zero. Initialize is the explicit reset.
        if (restart.hasFields() && restart.cells == m_mesh->nCells()) {
            seedFields(restart);
        } else {
            m_velocity = std::make_shared<Velocity>(*m_mesh, 0.0);
            m_pressure = std::make_shared<Scalar>(*m_mesh, 0.0);
        }

        typename Solver::Config sc = toFvmConfig<Dim>(settings);
        if (settings.turbulence) {
            for (const auto& pbc : bcs) {
                if (pbc.type != BCType::VelocityInlet) continue;
                typename Solver::InletTurbulence it;
                it.patch = pbc.patchName;
                it.k = pbc.kInlet;
                it.omega = pbc.omegaInlet;
                sc.inletTurbulence.push_back(it);
            }
        }
        if (hooks.iteration) {
            sc.iterationCallback = [hooks](int iter, double cont, double mom) {
                hooks.iteration(iter, cont, mom);
            };
        }

        // The render callback copies velocity, pressure and turbulence into a
        // self-contained snapshot on the solver thread. Reading turbulence
        // through the atomic pointer set below means the consumer never has to
        // query the solver while it is running.
        auto turbSlot = std::make_shared<std::atomic<const fvm::SSTModel<Dim>*>>(nullptr);
        if (settings.transient.enabled && hooks.frame) {
            const std::size_t n = m_mesh->nCells();
            sc.renderCallback = [n, turbSlot, hooks](
                int step, double time, const Velocity& velocity, const Scalar& pressure) {
                SolutionSnapshot state;
                state.dim = static_cast<int>(Dim);
                state.cells = n;
                state.velocity.resize(Dim);
                for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) {
                    const auto values = velocity[d].values();
                    state.velocity[d].assign(values.begin(), values.end());
                }
                state.pressure.assign(pressure.values().begin(), pressure.values().end());

                if (const auto* turb = turbSlot->load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
                    fillTurbulence(state, *turb);
                }
                state.transientValid = true;
                state.time = time;
                state.step = step;
                hooks.frame(state);
            };
        }

        auto solver = std::make_shared<Solver>(*m_mesh, settings.rho, settings.nu, sc);
        if (settings.turbulence) {
            solver->enableTurbulence(settings.kInf, settings.omegaInf,
                                     settings.alphaK, settings.alphaOmega);
        }
        solver->bindVelocity(*m_velocity);
        solver->bindPressure(*m_pressure);

        for (const auto& pbc : bcs) {
            auto it = m_mesh->boundaryGroups().find(pbc.patchName);
            if (it == m_mesh->boundaryGroups().end()) continue;
            const std::vector<std::size_t>& faces = it->second;
            std::string typeStr;
            switch (pbc.type) {
                case BCType::VelocityInlet: typeStr = "inlet"; break;
                case BCType::PressureOutlet: typeStr = "pressure_outlet"; break;
                case BCType::Outlet: typeStr = "outlet"; break;
                case BCType::WallNoSlip: typeStr = "wall"; break;
                case BCType::SlipWall: typeStr = "slip_wall"; break;
                case BCType::Symmetry: typeStr = "symmetry"; break;
                case BCType::MovingWall: typeStr = "moving_wall"; break;
            }
            if (pbc.type == BCType::PressureOutlet) {
                solver->setPressureOutletOnFacesWithBackflow(
                    faces, pbc.pressure, pbc.suppressBackflow, pbc.backflowU,
                    pbc.backflowV, pbc.backflowW, pbc.backflowK, pbc.backflowOmega);
            } else {
                const bool slip = (pbc.type == BCType::SlipWall ||
                                   pbc.type == BCType::Symmetry);
                solver->setVelocityBCOnFacesWithSlip(faces, typeStr, pbc.u, pbc.v,
                                                     pbc.w, slip, pbc.pressure);
            }
        }

        // Queue the restart payload. initializeSolve_ applies it after the
        // turbulence model exists, so restored k/omega/nut survive.
        if (restart.hasFields() || restart.hasTurbulence() ||
            (settings.transient.enabled && restart.transientValid)) {
            typename Solver::RestartState rs;
            if (restart.hasFields()) {
                rs.hasVelocity = true;
                for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) rs.velocity[d] = restart.velocity[d];
                rs.pressure = restart.pressure;
            }
            if (restart.hasTurbulence()) {
                rs.hasTurbulence = true;
                rs.k = restart.turbulence.k;
                rs.omega = restart.turbulence.omega;
                rs.nut = restart.turbulence.nut;
            }
            if (settings.transient.enabled && restart.transientValid) {
                rs.hasTransient = true;
                rs.time = restart.time;
                rs.dt = restart.dt;
                rs.dtPrev = restart.dtPrev;
                rs.step = restart.step;
                if (restart.hasVelocityHistorySized()) {
                    rs.hasVelocityHistory = true;
                    for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d)
                        rs.velocityNM1[d] = restart.velocityNM1[d];
                }
                if (restart.hasTurbulenceHistory()) {
                    rs.hasTurbulenceHistory = true;
                    rs.kNM1 = restart.turbulence.kNM1;
                    rs.omegaNM1 = restart.turbulence.omegaNM1;
                }
            }
            solver->setRestartState(std::move(rs));
        }

        *turbSlot = solver->turbulence();
        m_solver = std::move(solver);
        m_solverMesh = m_mesh;
        m_transientRun = settings.transient.enabled;
        m_state = restart;
        return true;
    }

    void solve() override {
        std::shared_ptr<Solver> solver;
        std::shared_ptr<Velocity> velocity;
        std::shared_ptr<Scalar> pressure;
        bool transient = false;
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(m_mutex);
            solver = m_solver;
            velocity = m_velocity;
            pressure = m_pressure;
            transient = m_transientRun;
        }
        if (!solver || !velocity || !pressure) return;

        if (transient) {
            solver->solveTransient(*velocity, *pressure);
        } else {
            solver->solve(*velocity, *pressure);
        }
    }

    void requestCancel() override { withSolver([](Solver& s) { s.requestCancel(); }); }
    void requestPause() override { withSolver([](Solver& s) { s.requestPause(); }); }
    void requestResume() override { withSolver([](Solver& s) { s.requestResume(); }); }
    void requestStep() override { withSolver([](Solver& s) { s.requestStep(); }); }

    bool isPaused() const override {
        return withSolver([](const Solver& s) { return s.isPaused(); });
    }
    bool isPausedSettled() const override {
        return withSolver([](const Solver& s) { return s.isPauseSettled(); });
    }

    int currentStep() const override {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(m_mutex);
        if (m_solver) return m_solver->currentStep();
        return m_state.transientValid ? m_state.step : 0;
    }

    double currentTime() const override {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(m_mutex);
        if (m_solver) return m_solver->currentTime();
        return m_state.transientValid ? m_state.time : 0.0;
    }

    SessionStatus status() const override {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(m_mutex);
        if (!m_solver) return SessionStatus::Idle;
        switch (m_solver->status()) {
            case Solver::Status::NotConverged: return SessionStatus::NotConverged;
            case Solver::Status::Converged: return SessionStatus::Converged;
            case Solver::Status::Completed: return SessionStatus::Completed;
            case Solver::Status::Aborted: return SessionStatus::Aborted;
            case Solver::Status::Cancelled: return SessionStatus::Cancelled;
        }
        return SessionStatus::Idle;
    }

    int lastIterations() const override {
        return withSolver([](const Solver& s) { return s.lastIterations(); });
    }

    double finalContinuityResidual() const override {
        return withSolver([](const Solver& s) { return s.finalContinuityResidual(); });
    }

    SolutionSnapshot capture() const override {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(m_mutex);
        if (m_solver && m_solverMesh == m_mesh && m_velocity && m_pressure) {
            SolutionSnapshot state = snapshotFields();
            if (const auto* turb = m_solver->turbulence()) {
                fillTurbulence(state, *turb);
            }
            if (m_transientRun) {
                state.transientValid = m_solver->hasTransientState();
                state.time = m_solver->currentTime();
                state.dt = m_solver->currentDt();
                state.dtPrev = m_solver->currentDtPrev();
                state.step = m_solver->currentStep();
                if (state.transientValid) {
                    const auto& vnm1 = m_solver->velocityNM1();
                    bool complete = vnm1.size() == m_mesh->nCells();
                    if constexpr (Dim >= 2) {
                        complete = complete && vnm1[1].size() == m_mesh->nCells();
                    }
                    if constexpr (Dim >= 3) {
                        complete = complete && vnm1[2].size() == m_mesh->nCells();
                    }
                    if (complete) {
                        state.hasVelocityHistory = true;
                        state.velocityNM1.resize(Dim);
                        for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) {
                            state.velocityNM1[d].resize(m_mesh->nCells());
                            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < m_mesh->nCells(); ++i)
                                state.velocityNM1[d][i] = vnm1[d][i];
                        }
                    }
                    if (m_solver->turbulence()) {
                        const auto& kn = m_solver->kNM1();
                        const auto& on = m_solver->omegaNM1();
                        if (kn.size() == m_mesh->nCells() && on.size() == m_mesh->nCells()) {
                            state.turbulence.hasHistory = true;
                            state.turbulence.kNM1.resize(m_mesh->nCells());
                            state.turbulence.omegaNM1.resize(m_mesh->nCells());
                            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < m_mesh->nCells(); ++i) {
                                state.turbulence.kNM1[i] = kn[i];
                                state.turbulence.omegaNM1[i] = on[i];
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            return state;
        }
        return m_state;
    }

    std::shared_ptr<const RenderMesh> buildResult(
        const std::shared_ptr<const RenderMesh>& base,
        const SolutionSnapshot& state,
        const CaseSettings& settings,
        const std::vector<PatchBC>& bcs) const override {
        if (!base || !state.hasFields() || state.cells != m_mesh->nCells()) return nullptr;
        return buildResultMesh<Dim>(base, *m_mesh, state, settings, bcs);
    }

    void exportVtu(const std::string& path, const SolutionSnapshot& state) const override {
        if (!state.hasFields() || state.cells != m_mesh->nCells()) return;

        Scalar pressure(*m_mesh, 0.0);
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < state.cells; ++i) pressure[i] = state.pressure[i];

        std::array<Scalar, Dim> velocity;
        std::array<const Scalar*, Dim> velocityPtrs{};
        for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) {
            velocity[d] = Scalar(*m_mesh, 0.0);
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < state.cells; ++i)
                velocity[d][i] = state.velocity[d][i];
            velocityPtrs[d] = &velocity[d];
        }

        Scalar kField, omegaField, nutField;
        const Scalar* kPtr = nullptr;
        const Scalar* omegaPtr = nullptr;
        const Scalar* nutPtr = nullptr;
        if (state.hasTurbulence()) {
            kField = Scalar(*m_mesh, 0.0);
            omegaField = Scalar(*m_mesh, 0.0);
            nutField = Scalar(*m_mesh, 0.0);
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < state.cells; ++i) {
                kField[i] = state.turbulence.k[i];
                omegaField[i] = state.turbulence.omega[i];
                nutField[i] = state.turbulence.nut[i];
            }
            kPtr = &kField;
            omegaPtr = &omegaField;
            nutPtr = &nutField;
        }

        fvm::VTKXMLWriter<Dim>::writeWithVelocity(path, *m_mesh, pressure, velocityPtrs,
                                                  "pressure", kPtr, omegaPtr, nutPtr);
    }

    void exportTurbulence(const std::string& path,
                          const SolutionSnapshot& state) const override {
        if (!state.hasTurbulence()) return;
        Scalar kField(*m_mesh, 0.0);
        Scalar omegaField(*m_mesh, 0.0);
        Scalar nutField(*m_mesh, 0.0);
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < state.cells; ++i) {
            kField[i] = state.turbulence.k[i];
            omegaField[i] = state.turbulence.omega[i];
            nutField[i] = state.turbulence.nut[i];
        }
        fvm::VTKXMLWriter<Dim>::writeTurbulence(path, *m_mesh, kField, omegaField, nutField);
    }

    std::string outputExtension() const override {
        if (m_mesh->isUnstructured()) return ".vtu";
        return m_mesh->isUniform() ? ".vti" : ".vtr";
    }

private:
    void seedFields(const SolutionSnapshot& state) {
        m_velocity = std::make_shared<Velocity>(*m_mesh, 0.0);
        m_pressure = std::make_shared<Scalar>(*m_mesh, 0.0);
        for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) {
            const auto& source = state.velocity[d];
            auto& target = (*m_velocity)[d];
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < state.cells && i < target.size(); ++i)
                target[i] = source[i];
        }
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < state.cells && i < m_pressure->size(); ++i)
            (*m_pressure)[i] = state.pressure[i];
    }

    SolutionSnapshot snapshotFields() const {
        SolutionSnapshot state;
        state.dim = static_cast<int>(Dim);
        state.cells = m_mesh->nCells();
        state.velocity.resize(Dim);
        for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) {
            const auto values = (*m_velocity)[d].values();
            state.velocity[d].assign(values.begin(), values.end());
        }
        state.pressure.assign(m_pressure->values().begin(), m_pressure->values().end());
        return state;
    }

    static void fillTurbulence(SolutionSnapshot& state,
                               const fvm::SSTModel<Dim>& turbulence) {
        const std::size_t n = state.cells;
        state.turbulence.valid = true;
        state.turbulence.k.resize(n);
        state.turbulence.omega.resize(n);
        state.turbulence.nut.resize(n);
        const auto& k = turbulence.k();
        const auto& omega = turbulence.omega();
        const auto& nut = turbulence.nut();
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            state.turbulence.k[i] = k[i];
            state.turbulence.omega[i] = omega[i];
            state.turbulence.nut[i] = nut[i];
        }
    }

    // Calls `fn` with the live solver, holding the session mutex only long
    // enough to take a reference. Returns a value-initialised result when no
    // solver exists (false/0/0.0), which is what every caller expects.
    template<typename Fn>
    std::invoke_result_t<Fn, Solver&> withSolver(Fn&& fn) const {
        using Result = std::invoke_result_t<Fn, Solver&>;
        std::shared_ptr<Solver> solver;
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(m_mutex);
            solver = m_solver;
        }
        if constexpr (std::is_void_v<Result>) {
            if (solver) fn(*solver);
        } else {
            if (!solver) return Result{};
            return fn(*solver);
        }
    }

    std::shared_ptr<const fvm::Mesh<Dim>> m_mesh;
    std::shared_ptr<Velocity> m_velocity;
    std::shared_ptr<Scalar> m_pressure;

    std::shared_ptr<Solver> m_solver;
    std::shared_ptr<const fvm::Mesh<Dim>> m_solverMesh;
    bool m_transientRun = false;

    SolutionSnapshot m_state;
    mutable std::mutex m_mutex;
};

} // namespace

std::unique_ptr<ICfdSession> makeSession(const MeshLoadResult& mesh) {
    if (mesh.mesh3) return std::make_unique<CfdSession<3>>(mesh.mesh3);
    if (mesh.mesh2) return std::make_unique<CfdSession<2>>(mesh.mesh2);
    return nullptr;
}

} // namespace cfd
```

### src/cfd/cfd_session.h
```
#pragma once

#include "cfd/cfd_mesh_adapter.h"
#include "cfd/cfd_types.h"
#include "cfd/solution_state.h"

#include <cstddef>
#include <functional>
#include <memory>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace cfd {

// Initial condition entered in the Initialize dialog.
struct InitConditions {
    double ux = 0.0, uy = 0.0, uz = 0.0;
    double pressure = 0.0;
    double k = 1e-3;
    double omega = 1.0;
};

// Dimension-free view of a solver's termination status.
enum class SessionStatus {
    Idle,
    NotConverged,
    Converged,
    Completed,
    Aborted,
    Cancelled
};

// Callbacks a run may publish.
//
// `iteration` is invoked from the solver thread for the residual table.
// `frame` is invoked from the solver thread once per transient time step with a
// complete snapshot (velocity, pressure and turbulence already copied), so the
// consumer never reaches back into the solver.
struct RunHooks {
    std::function<void(int, double, double)> iteration;
    std::function<void(const SolutionSnapshot&)> frame;
};

// A solver bound to one mesh, at one dimension.
//
// The controller owns a single ICfdSession and never sees SIMPLE<2> or
// SIMPLE<3>. Everything that needs the compile-time dimension lives behind
// this interface: field storage, the solver, restart payloads and the result
// exporter. The interface is virtual only at coarse boundaries (start/stop,
// capture, build, export) — never inside an iteration.
class ICfdSession {
public:
    virtual ~ICfdSession() = default;

    virtual int dim() const = 0;
    virtual std::size_t cells() const = 0;

    // Drops the solver and all state, keeping the mesh.
    virtual void clear() = 0;

    // Installs a loaded state. An empty snapshot clears the fields; a snapshot
    // whose dimension or cell count does not match the mesh is rejected.
    virtual bool setState(const SolutionSnapshot& state, std::string& error) = 0;

    // Zero/initial fields for the loaded mesh, returned as a snapshot.
    virtual SolutionSnapshot initialize(const InitConditions& ic,
                                        const CaseSettings& settings) = 0;

    // Prepares fields and a solver for a run. The `restart` snapshot (may be
    // empty) seeds the fields and the transient clock. Returns false without
    // changing the state when the run cannot be started (e.g. it is already at
    // the configured end time).
    virtual bool startRun(const CaseSettings& settings,
                          const std::vector<PatchBC>& bcs,
                          const SolutionSnapshot& restart,
                          const RunHooks& hooks,
                          std::string& error) = 0;

    // Blocking solve; called on the controller's worker future.
    virtual void solve() = 0;

    virtual void requestCancel() = 0;
    virtual void requestPause() = 0;
    virtual void requestResume() = 0;
    virtual void requestStep() = 0;
    virtual bool isPaused() const = 0;
    virtual bool isPausedSettled() const = 0;
    virtual int currentStep() const = 0;
    virtual double currentTime() const = 0;
    virtual SessionStatus status() const = 0;
    virtual int lastIterations() const = 0;
    virtual double finalContinuityResidual() const = 0;

    // Live state (solver fields if one exists, otherwise the installed state).
    // Safe to call at a pause boundary or after the run finished; it must not
    // be called while the solver is actively writing.
    virtual SolutionSnapshot capture() const = 0;

    virtual std::shared_ptr<const RenderMesh> buildResult(
        const std::shared_ptr<const RenderMesh>& base,
        const SolutionSnapshot& state,
        const CaseSettings& settings,
        const std::vector<PatchBC>& bcs) const = 0;

    virtual void exportVtu(const std::string& path, const SolutionSnapshot& state) const = 0;
    virtual void exportTurbulence(const std::string& path, const SolutionSnapshot& state) const = 0;
    // ".vtu" for unstructured meshes, ".vti"/".vtr" for structured ones.
    virtual std::string outputExtension() const = 0;
};

// Runtime dispatch: mesh3 -> CfdSession<3>, mesh2 -> CfdSession<2>.
std::unique_ptr<ICfdSession> makeSession(const MeshLoadResult& mesh);

} // namespace cfd
```

### src/cfd/cfd_types.h
```
#pragma once
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <cstddef>

namespace cfd {

enum class BCType { VelocityInlet, PressureOutlet, Outlet, WallNoSlip, SlipWall, Symmetry, MovingWall };

struct PatchBC {
    std::string patchName;
    BCType type = BCType::WallNoSlip;
    double u = 0.0, v = 0.0, w = 0.0;
    double pressure = 0.0;
    bool suppressBackflow = false;
    double backflowU = 0.0, backflowV = 0.0, backflowW = 0.0;
    double backflowK = 0.0, backflowOmega = 0.0;
    // Turbulence inlet values (used for velocity inlets).
    double kInlet = 1e-3, omegaInlet = 1.0;
};

// UI-facing mirror of fvm::AMGHierarchy::Config. Kept as a plain struct with
// plain enums so the UI layer never has to include Eigen; the single
// translation to the solver type lives in cfd/amg_settings_bridge.h. Field
// names and defaults are intentionally identical to AMGHierarchy::Config so the
// two stay easy to compare.
struct AmgSettings {
    enum class CoarseningType { RS, PMIS };
    enum class InterpolationType { Direct, Extended };
    enum class CycleType { V, F };
    enum class SmootherType { SymmetricGaussSeidel, ForwardGaussSeidel, ForwardSOR };

    CoarseningType coarseningType = CoarseningType::RS;
    InterpolationType interpolationType = InterpolationType::Extended;
    CycleType cycleType = CycleType::F;
    SmootherType smootherType = SmootherType::SymmetricGaussSeidel;
    // Relaxation for ForwardSOR. 1.0 degenerates to plain Gauss-Seidel.
    double smootherOmega = 1.0;
    double strengthThreshold = 0.25;
    double truncThreshold = 0.2;
    int maxLevels = 30;
    int minCoarseSize = 10;
    int preSweeps = 2;
    int postSweeps = 2;
    // Only used by a standalone AMG solve, i.e. when AMG is configured as the
    // pressure solver rather than as a Krylov preconditioner.
    int maxIterations = 100;
    double tolerance = 1e-8;
    // Hardening options (address silent-failure observations)
    int rngSeed = 42; // 0 = nondeterministic (random_device)
    double stagnationFactor = 1.05;
    int stagnationMinIter = 10;
    double stagnationLooseFactor = 5.0;
    double galerkinDropTol = 1e-12;

    // Defaults the solver applies per hierarchy, so "Reset" lands on the
    // values the application ships with. Pressure uses a V-cycle with direct
    // interpolation; momentum additionally needs a forward-only smoother
    // because its operator is nonsymmetric.
    static AmgSettings pressureDefaults() {
        AmgSettings s;
        s.interpolationType = InterpolationType::Direct;
        s.cycleType = CycleType::V;
        return s;
    }
    static AmgSettings momentumDefaults() {
        AmgSettings s;
        s.interpolationType = InterpolationType::Direct;
        s.cycleType = CycleType::V;
        s.smootherType = SmootherType::ForwardGaussSeidel;
        s.preSweeps = 1;
        s.postSweeps = 1;
        return s;
    }
};

// UI-facing mirror of fvm::SIMPLE::TransientConfig, plus the mode switch that
// decides whether run() calls solve() or solveTransient(). Only the transient
// path reads these; the steady path uses tolerance/maxIterations instead.
//
// Defaults are identical to TransientConfig's initialisers so the UI, the
// solver and "Restore defaults" cannot disagree.
struct TransientSettings {
    // The solver's TimeScheme::Euler is implicit, i.e. backward Euler. Named
    // for what it is so the UI does not have to explain "Euler".
    enum class TimeScheme { BackwardEuler, BDF2 };

    // false = steady: the transient controls are not shown and not consulted.
    bool enabled = false;
    // Initial step size. Always clamped into [minDt, maxDt], which applies to
    // the fixed-step case too, not just adaptive.
    double dt = 0.001;
    // Must be > 0: the solver loops "while (time < tEnd)", so 0 runs no steps.
    double tEnd = 1.0;
    TimeScheme timeScheme = TimeScheme::BackwardEuler;
    bool adaptiveCfl = false;
    double cfl = 0.5; // only consulted when adaptiveCfl is on
    double minDt = 1e-6;
    double maxDt = 0.01;
    // Output cadence in time steps; 0 disables file output entirely.
    int writeInterval = 1;
    // Non-orthogonal correctors per pressure solve (PISO).
    int nonOrthogonalCorrectors = 1;
    // Pressure correctors per step (PISO: 1 predictor + this many correctors).
    int maxOuterCorrectors = 3;
    // Base name or full path for the .pvd/.vtu output. Empty = "transient".
    std::string pvdFile;
};

struct CaseSettings {
    double rho = 1.0, nu = 0.01;
    double tolerance = 1e-3;
    std::size_t maxIterations = 500;
    // Ignore the residual tolerance and run exactly maxIterations iterations.
    bool runFixedIterations = false;
    // Consecutive iterations the residual criterion must hold before the run
    // is declared converged.
    int convergenceHoldIterations = 3;
    double alphaU = 0.7, alphaP = 0.3;
    bool simplec = false;
    int scheme = 0; // 0 upwind, 1 central, 2 second-order upwind
    // 0 least squares, 1 green-gauss cell based, 2 green-gauss node based
    int gradientScheme = 0;
    bool rhieChow = true;
    bool turbulence = false;
    double kInf = 1e-3, omegaInf = 1.0;
    double alphaK = 0.7, alphaOmega = 0.7;

    // Advanced SIMPLE settings
    std::size_t pressureRefCell = 0; // 0 = auto (last cell)
    int pressureCorrectors = 1;
    bool limitPressureCorrection = false;
    double pressureCorrectionLimit = 5.0;
    std::size_t printFrequency = 1;
    std::size_t residualHistoryWindow = 20;

    // Number of OpenMP threads used by the solver (matrix assembly, AMG,
    // residuals). 0 = auto (OpenMP runtime default / OMP_NUM_THREADS).
    int numThreads = 1;
    // Pressure-correction linear solver (see fvm::PressureCorrection::Config)
    bool pressureUseAMG = true;
    bool pressureUseAMGPreconditioner = true;
    std::size_t pressureAmgThreshold = 10000;
    AmgSettings pressureAmg = AmgSettings::pressureDefaults();

    // Momentum linear solver (see fvm::SIMPLE::Config)
    bool useAMGMomentum = false;
    std::size_t momentumAmgThreshold = 20000;
    int momentumAmgCycles = 1;
    double momentumAmgMaxResidual = 1e-8;
    bool momentumSolverStats = false;
    AmgSettings momentumAmg = AmgSettings::momentumDefaults();

    // Steady vs transient. See TransientSettings above.
    TransientSettings transient;
};

} // namespace cfd
```

### src/cfd/solution_state.h
```
#pragma once
#include <cstddef>
#include <vector>

namespace cfd {

// Turbulence fields carried alongside a solution snapshot.
//
// The values are stored by value (not as a pointer to a live solver) because
// snapshots are published to worker threads and written to disk: a frame must
// never observe the solver overwriting k/omega while it is being rendered.
struct TurbulenceState {
    bool valid = false;
    std::vector<double> k;
    std::vector<double> omega;
    std::vector<double> nut;

    // BDF2 history. Restoring a transient run without it silently falls back
    // to backward Euler for the first step.
    bool hasHistory = false;
    std::vector<double> kNM1;
    std::vector<double> omegaNM1;

    bool matches(std::size_t cells) const {
        return valid && k.size() == cells && omega.size() == cells && nut.size() == cells;
    }

    bool historyMatches(std::size_t cells) const {
        return hasHistory && kNM1.size() == cells && omegaNM1.size() == cells;
    }

    void clear() { *this = TurbulenceState{}; }
};

// A complete, dimension-agnostic solution state.
//
// This is the one type the controller, the save/load codec, the frame bus and
// the exporter agree on. It exists so none of them has to know whether the
// case is 2D or 3D: `dim` selects how many velocity components are present,
// and every other block is a flat cell array.
struct SolutionSnapshot {
    int dim = 0;             // 0 = empty snapshot
    std::size_t cells = 0;

    // Velocity has exactly `dim` components, each `cells` long. Keeping rows
    // (rather than an interleaved array) matches Field/VectorField and the
    // on-disk layout.
    std::vector<std::vector<double>> velocity;
    std::vector<double> pressure;

    TurbulenceState turbulence;

    // Transient clock and BDF2 history. Absent for a steady run.
    bool transientValid = false;
    double time = 0.0;
    double dt = 0.0;
    double dtPrev = 0.0;
    int step = 0;
    bool hasVelocityHistory = false;
    std::vector<std::vector<double>> velocityNM1;

    bool hasFields() const {
        if (dim <= 0 || cells == 0) return false;
        if (velocity.size() != static_cast<std::size_t>(dim)) return false;
        for (const auto& component : velocity) {
            if (component.size() != cells) return false;
        }
        return pressure.size() == cells;
    }

    bool hasTurbulence() const {
        return hasFields() && turbulence.matches(cells);
    }

    bool hasTurbulenceHistory() const {
        return transientValid && turbulence.valid &&
               turbulence.historyMatches(cells);
    }

    bool hasVelocityHistorySized() const {
        if (!transientValid || !hasVelocityHistory) return false;
        if (velocityNM1.size() != static_cast<std::size_t>(dim)) return false;
        for (const auto& component : velocityNM1) {
            if (component.size() != cells) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    void clear() { *this = SolutionSnapshot{}; }
};

} // namespace cfd
```

### src/cfd/solver_config_bridge.h
```
#pragma once

#include "cfd/cfd_types.h"
#include "fvm/SIMPLE.h"
#include "fvm/SIMPLETypes.h"
#include "cfd/amg_settings_bridge.h"
#include "cfd/transient_settings_bridge.h"

namespace cfd {

// Single place where CaseSettings becomes the solver's SIMPLE config, so the
// UI controller never has to spell out the 40-field mapping and a knob added
// to fvm::SIMPLE::Config surfaces here as a compile error.
template <std::size_t Dim>
inline typename fvm::SIMPLE<Dim>::Config toFvmConfig(const CaseSettings& settings) {
    typename fvm::SIMPLE<Dim>::Config sc;

    sc.maxIterations = settings.maxIterations;
    sc.tolerance = settings.tolerance;
    sc.runFixedIterations = settings.runFixedIterations;
    sc.convergenceHoldIterations = settings.convergenceHoldIterations;
    sc.alphaU = settings.alphaU;
    sc.alphaP = settings.alphaP;
    sc.simplec = settings.simplec;
    sc.rhieChow = settings.rhieChow;
    sc.convectionScheme = settings.scheme == 1 ? fvm::ConvectionScheme::Central
                          : (settings.scheme == 2 ? fvm::ConvectionScheme::SecondOrderUpwind
                             : (settings.scheme == 3 ? fvm::ConvectionScheme::QUICK : fvm::ConvectionScheme::Upwind));
    sc.gradientScheme = settings.gradientScheme == 1 ? fvm::GradientScheme::GreenGaussCellBased
                       : (settings.gradientScheme == 2 ? fvm::GradientScheme::GreenGaussNodeBased : fvm::GradientScheme::LeastSquares);
    sc.printFrequency = settings.printFrequency;
    sc.residualHistoryWindow = settings.residualHistoryWindow;
    sc.pressureCorrectors = settings.pressureCorrectors;
    sc.limitPressureCorrection = settings.limitPressureCorrection;
    sc.pressureCorrectionLimit = settings.pressureCorrectionLimit;
    sc.pressureRefCell = settings.pressureRefCell == 0 ? SIZE_MAX : settings.pressureRefCell;
    sc.pressureUseAMG = settings.pressureUseAMG;
    sc.pressureUseAMGPreconditioner = settings.pressureUseAMGPreconditioner;
    sc.pressureAmgThreshold = settings.pressureAmgThreshold;
    sc.pressureAmgConfig = toFvmAmg(settings.pressureAmg);
    sc.useAMGMomentum = settings.useAMGMomentum;
    sc.momentumAmgThreshold = settings.momentumAmgThreshold;
    sc.momentumAmgCycles = settings.momentumAmgCycles;
    sc.momentumAmgMaxResidual = settings.momentumAmgMaxResidual;
    sc.momentumSolverStats = settings.momentumSolverStats;
    sc.momentumAmgConfig = toFvmAmg(settings.momentumAmg);
    sc.solverType = toFvmSolverType(settings.transient);
    sc.transient = toFvmTransient<Dim>(settings.transient);

    return sc;
}

} // namespace cfd

### src/cfd/transient_settings_bridge.h
```
#pragma once

#include "cfd/cfd_types.h"
#include "fvm/SIMPLE.h"
#include "fvm/SIMPLETypes.h"

namespace cfd {

// Which solver drives the run. PISO is chosen for transient runs because it
// treats the pressure-velocity coupling implicitly (one momentum predictor plus
// a fixed number of correctors on frozen coefficients) instead of iterating the
// whole SIMPLE loop inside every time step. Note the consequences, which the UI
// reflects by disabling the affected controls: PISO forces alphaU = alphaP = 1
// and turns Rhie-Chow on, so the relaxation and Rhie-Chow settings are inert.
inline fvm::SolverType toFvmSolverType(const TransientSettings& s) {
    return s.enabled ? fvm::SolverType::PISO : fvm::SolverType::SIMPLE;
}

// Translate the UI's plain transient mirror into the solver's transient config.
//
// Like cfd::toFvmAmg, this is the single place the two representations meet, so
// a field added to fvm::SIMPLE::TransientConfig surfaces here as a visible edit
// rather than silently taking its default. `piso` is deliberately left alone:
// it is the deprecated legacy switch, superseded by Config::solverType.
template <std::size_t Dim>
inline typename fvm::SIMPLE<Dim>::TransientConfig toFvmTransient(const TransientSettings& s) {
    typename fvm::SIMPLE<Dim>::TransientConfig c;

    c.enabled = s.enabled;
    c.dt = s.dt;
    c.tEnd = s.tEnd;

    switch (s.timeScheme) {
        case TransientSettings::TimeScheme::BackwardEuler:
            c.scheme = fvm::TimeScheme::Euler; break;
        case TransientSettings::TimeScheme::BDF2:
            c.scheme = fvm::TimeScheme::BDF2; break;
    }

    c.adaptive = s.adaptiveCfl;
    c.cfl = s.cfl;
    c.minDt = s.minDt;
    c.maxDt = s.maxDt;
    c.writeInterval = s.writeInterval;
    c.maxOuterCorrectors = s.maxOuterCorrectors;
    c.nonOrthogonalCorrectors = s.nonOrthogonalCorrectors;
    c.pvdFile = s.pvdFile;
    return c;
}

} // namespace cfd
```

### src/core/AlignedAllocator.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <limits>
#include <new>

#ifdef _WIN32
#include <malloc.h>
#endif

namespace fvm {

template<typename T, std::size_t Alignment = 64>
struct AlignedAllocator {
    using value_type = T;
    using pointer = T*;
    using const_pointer = const T*;
    using reference = T&;
    using const_reference = const T&;
    using size_type = std::size_t;
    using difference_type = std::ptrdiff_t;

    template<typename U>
    struct rebind { using other = AlignedAllocator<U, Alignment>; };

    AlignedAllocator() noexcept = default;

    template<typename U>
    constexpr AlignedAllocator(const AlignedAllocator<U, Alignment>&) noexcept {}

    [[nodiscard]] pointer allocate(size_type n) {
        if (n > std::numeric_limits<size_type>::max() / sizeof(T))
            throw std::bad_array_new_length();

        void* ptr = nullptr;
#ifdef _WIN32
        ptr = _aligned_malloc(n * sizeof(T), Alignment);
        if (!ptr) throw std::bad_alloc();
#else
        if (posix_memalign(&ptr, Alignment, n * sizeof(T)) != 0)
            throw std::bad_alloc();
#endif
        return static_cast<pointer>(ptr);
    }

    void deallocate(pointer p, size_type) noexcept {
#ifdef _WIN32
        _aligned_free(p);
#else
        free(p);
#endif
    }

    template<typename U, typename... Args>
    void construct(U* p, Args&&... args) {
        ::new(static_cast<void*>(p)) U(std::forward<Args>(args)...);
    }

    template<typename U>
    void destroy(U* p) { p->~U(); }

    constexpr bool operator==(const AlignedAllocator&) const noexcept { return true; }
    constexpr bool operator!=(const AlignedAllocator&) const noexcept { return false; }
};

} // namespace fvm
```

### src/core/AlignedBuffer.hpp
```
#pragma once

#include "AlignedAllocator.hpp"
#include <span>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstddef>

namespace fvm {

template<typename T, std::size_t Alignment = 64>
using AlignedVector = std::vector<T, AlignedAllocator<T, Alignment>>;

template<typename T, std::size_t Alignment = 64>
class AlignedBuffer {
public:
    static constexpr std::size_t alignment = Alignment;

    AlignedBuffer() noexcept = default;

    explicit AlignedBuffer(std::size_t n)
        : data_(n) {}

    AlignedBuffer(std::size_t n, const T& val)
        : data_(n, val) {}

    void resize(std::size_t n) { data_.resize(n); }

    void assign(std::size_t n, const T& val) { data_.assign(n, val); }

    void clear() { data_.clear(); }

    T& operator[](std::size_t i) { return data_[i]; }
    const T& operator[](std::size_t i) const { return data_[i]; }

    T& at(std::size_t i) { return data_.at(i); }
    const T& at(std::size_t i) const { return data_.at(i); }

    T* data() noexcept { return data_.data(); }
    const T* data() const noexcept { return data_.data(); }

    [[nodiscard]] std::size_t size() const noexcept { return data_.size(); }
    [[nodiscard]] bool empty() const noexcept { return data_.empty(); }

    void fill(const T& val) { std::fill(data_.begin(), data_.end(), val); }

    std::span<T> span() { return std::span<T>(data_.data(), data_.size()); }
    std::span<const T> span() const { return std::span<const T>(data_.data(), data_.size()); }

    typename AlignedVector<T, Alignment>::iterator begin() { return data_.begin(); }
    typename AlignedVector<T, Alignment>::iterator end() { return data_.end(); }
    typename AlignedVector<T, Alignment>::const_iterator begin() const { return data_.begin(); }
    typename AlignedVector<T, Alignment>::const_iterator end() const { return data_.end(); }

private:
    AlignedVector<T, Alignment> data_;
};

} // namespace fvm

### src/core/Camera.cpp
```
#include "Camera.h"
#include <algorithm> // For std::clamp

Camera::Camera()
    : position(0.0, 0.0, 3.0),
    focalPoint(0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
    viewUp(0.0, 1.0, 0.0),
    distance(3.0),
    maxDistance(1.0e6) {
}

void Camera::azimuth(double angle) {
    glm::dmat4 transform = glm::translate(glm::dmat4(1.0), focalPoint)
        * glm::rotate(glm::dmat4(1.0), glm::radians(angle), viewUp)
        * glm::translate(glm::dmat4(1.0), -focalPoint);

    position = glm::dvec3(transform * glm::dvec4(position, 1.0));
}

void Camera::elevation(double angle) {
    glm::dvec3 dir = directionOfProjection();
    glm::dvec3 right = glm::cross(viewUp, dir);

    if (glm::length(right) < 0.001) {
        right = glm::dvec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0);
    }
    else {
        right = glm::normalize(right);
    }

// Rotate about +right (= cross(viewUp, directionOfProjection)). The
       // negation here previously inverted the elevation sign, so dragging up
       // moved the model down.
    glm::dmat4 transform = glm::translate(glm::dmat4(1.0), focalPoint)
        * glm::rotate(glm::dmat4(1.0), glm::radians(angle), right)
        * glm::translate(glm::dmat4(1.0), -focalPoint);

    position = glm::dvec3(transform * glm::dvec4(position, 1.0));

    viewUp = glm::normalize(glm::dvec3(transform * glm::dvec4(viewUp, 0.0)));
}

void Camera::orthogonalizeViewUp() {
    glm::dvec3 dir = directionOfProjection();
    glm::dvec3 side = glm::cross(dir, viewUp);
    if (glm::length(side) < 0.001) return; // Prevent collapse at poles
    side = glm::normalize(side);
    viewUp = glm::normalize(glm::cross(side, dir));
}

void Camera::pan(double dx, double dy) {
    double panSpeed = distance * 0.002;
    glm::dvec3 dir = directionOfProjection();
    glm::dvec3 right = glm::cross(dir, viewUp);
    if (glm::length(right) < 0.001) right = glm::dvec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0);
    right = glm::normalize(right);
    glm::dvec3 up = glm::normalize(glm::cross(right, dir)); // true up
    // Grab-style: moving the mouse right should drag the scene right (negate X).
    // Vertical must use the true up so it tracks the horizontal axis consistently.
    glm::dvec3 motion = (-right) * dx * panSpeed + up * dy * panSpeed;
    focalPoint += motion;
    position += motion;
}

void Camera::dolly(double factor) {
    if (factor <= 0.0) factor = 0.001; // Guard against division by zero/negative zoom
    double newDist = distance / factor;
    if (newDist > maxDistance) newDist = maxDistance; // Clamp how far we can zoom out
    glm::dvec3 dir = directionOfProjection();
    position = focalPoint - dir * newDist;

    updateDistance();
}

void Camera::updateDistance() {
    distance = glm::length(focalPoint - position);
}

glm::dvec3 Camera::directionOfProjection() const {
    return glm::normalize(focalPoint - position);
}

void Camera::snapToOrthoView(int axis) {
    // Axial presets: the SAME world axis stays "up" for each opposite pair, so
    // +X/-X, +Y/-Y, +Z/-Z only differ by azimuth (a horizontal mirror), never a
    // vertical flip. This keeps the reference axis always pointing up, which is
    // the expected behaviour for a 3D viewer's axis buttons.
    //   X / Y faces -> world +Z is up;  Z face -> world +Y is up.
    glm::dvec3 target = focalPoint;
    glm::dvec3 up(0.0, 1.0, 0.0);
    switch (axis) {
    case 0: target.x += distance; up = { 0.0, 0.0,  1.0 }; break;  // +X
    case 1: target.x -= distance; up = { 0.0, 0.0,  1.0 }; break;  // -X
    case 2: target.y += distance; up = { 0.0, 0.0,  1.0 }; break;  // +Y
    case 3: target.y -= distance; up = { 0.0, 0.0,  1.0 }; break;  // -Y
    case 4: target.z += distance; up = { 0.0, 1.0,  0.0 }; break;  // +Z
    case 5: target.z -= distance; up = { 0.0, 1.0,  0.0 }; break;  // -Z
    default: return; // Unknown axis: leave camera untouched
    }
    position = target;
    viewUp = up;
    orthogonalizeViewUp();
}

glm::mat4 Camera::getViewMatrix() const {
    return glm::lookAt(glm::vec3(position), glm::vec3(focalPoint), glm::vec3(viewUp));
}
```

#pragma once

#include <glm/glm.hpp>
#include <glm/gtc/quaternion.hpp>
#include <glm/gtc/matrix_transform.hpp>

class Camera {
public:
    Camera();
    ~Camera() = default;

    // Camera state vectors. Double precision throughout, so repeated matrix
    // composition during orbiting does not accumulate visible jitter.
    glm::dvec3 position;
    glm::dvec3 focalPoint;
    glm::dvec3 viewUp;
    double distance;
    double maxDistance; // upper bound on `distance` set by the renderer on reset

    // Core Transformation Methods
    void azimuth(double angle);
    void elevation(double angle);
    void pan(double dx, double dy);
    void dolly(double factor);

    // Utilities & Space Mappings
    void orthogonalizeViewUp();
    void snapToOrthoView(int axis);
    void updateDistance();

    glm::dvec3 directionOfProjection() const;
    glm::mat4 getViewMatrix() const;
};

### src/core/Colormaps.h
```
#pragma once
#include <glm/glm.hpp>
#include <cmath>
#include <array>

enum class ColormapType {
    Turbo = 0,         // Google's Engineering Rainbow: High-contrast replacement for Jet/Rainbow
    Viridis = 1,       // CFD/FEA Default: Perceptually uniform scalar magnitude (Stress, Speed)
    Inferno = 2,       // Sequential Thermal: Excellent for localized energy dissipation/hot-spots
    CoolWarm = 3,      // Balanced Diverging: Smooth sign-variant fields (e.g., pressure differentials)
    MutedCoolWarm = 4, // 3D Mesh-Friendly: Prevents whiteout, preserves surface lighting/shading
    BWR = 5,           // Classical Diverging: Explicit Blue-White-Red mapping (Tension/Compression)
    Cividis = 6,       // Print & Colorblind Safe: Matches strict engineering publication standards
    Grayscale = 7,     // Shading Baseline: Verifies geometry visibility and light interaction

    Count
};

namespace Colormaps {

    inline const char* getName(ColormapType type) {
        switch (type) {
        case ColormapType::Viridis:   return "Viridis";
        case ColormapType::Inferno:   return "Inferno";
        case ColormapType::Turbo:     return "Turbo";
        case ColormapType::CoolWarm:  return "CoolWarm";
        case ColormapType::MutedCoolWarm: return "Muted CoolWarm";
        case ColormapType::BWR:       return "BWR";
        case ColormapType::Cividis:   return "Cividis";
        case ColormapType::Grayscale: return "Grayscale";
        default:                      return "Unknown";
        }
    }

    inline glm::vec3 viridis(float t) {
        float clampedT = glm::clamp(t, 0.0f, 1.0f);
        glm::vec3 c0 = glm::vec3(0.267f, 0.004f, 0.329f);
        glm::vec3 c1 = glm::vec3(0.224f, 0.463f, 0.557f);
        glm::vec3 c2 = glm::vec3(0.122f, 0.733f, 0.494f);
        glm::vec3 c3 = glm::vec3(0.992f, 0.906f, 0.144f);

        if (clampedT < 0.33f)      return glm::mix(c0, c1, clampedT / 0.33f);
        else if (clampedT < 0.66f) return glm::mix(c1, c2, (clampedT - 0.33f) / 0.33f);
        else                       return glm::mix(c2, c3, (clampedT - 0.66f) / 0.34f);
    }

    inline glm::vec3 inferno(float t) {
        float clampedT = glm::clamp(t, 0.0f, 1.0f);
        glm::vec3 c0 = glm::vec3(0.000f, 0.000f, 0.004f);
        glm::vec3 c1 = glm::vec3(0.475f, 0.102f, 0.353f);
        glm::vec3 c2 = glm::vec3(0.914f, 0.349f, 0.086f);
        glm::vec3 c3 = glm::vec3(0.988f, 0.906f, 0.655f);

        if (clampedT < 0.33f)      return glm::mix(c0, c1, clampedT / 0.33f);
        else if (clampedT < 0.66f) return glm::mix(c1, c2, (clampedT - 0.33f) / 0.33f);
        else                       return glm::mix(c2, c3, (clampedT - 0.66f) / 0.34f);
    }

    // Google Turbo: exact 256-entry LUT generated from Google's published
    // 5th-order polynomial approximation. Avoids per-fragment polynomial
    // evaluation and matches the reference to float precision.
    inline glm::vec3 turbo(float t) {
        float clampedT = glm::clamp(t, 0.0f, 1.0f);

        constexpr int N = 256;
        static const auto lut = []() {
            std::array<glm::vec3, N> table{};
            // Google's published polynomial coefficients for Turbo.
            const glm::vec4 kRedVec4 = { 0.13572138f, 4.61539260f, -42.66032258f, 132.13108234f };
            const glm::vec4 kGreenVec4 = { 0.09140261f, 2.19418839f, 4.84296658f, -14.18503333f };
            const glm::vec4 kBlueVec4 = { 0.10667330f, 12.64194608f, -60.58204836f, 110.36276771f };
            const glm::vec2 kRedVec2 = { -152.94239396f, 59.28637943f };
            const glm::vec2 kGreenVec2 = { 4.27729857f, 2.82956604f };
            const glm::vec2 kBlueVec2 = { -89.90310912f, 27.34824973f };
            for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
                float x = static_cast<float>(i) / static_cast<float>(N - 1);
                glm::vec4 v4 = { 1.0f, x, x * x, x * x * x };
                glm::vec2 v2 = { v4.z * v4.z, v4.z * v4.w };
                float r = glm::dot(v4, kRedVec4) + glm::dot(v2, kRedVec2);
                float g = glm::dot(v4, kGreenVec4) + glm::dot(v2, kGreenVec2);
                float b = glm::dot(v4, kBlueVec4) + glm::dot(v2, kBlueVec2);
                table[i] = glm::clamp(glm::vec3(r, g, b), 0.0f, 1.0f);
            }
            return table;
        }();

        float f = clampedT * static_cast<float>(N - 1);
        int i0 = static_cast<int>(f);
        int i1 = (i0 + 1 < N) ? i0 + 1 : i0;
        float frac = f - static_cast<float>(i0);
        return glm::mix(lut[i0], lut[i1], frac);
    }

    inline glm::vec3 coolwarm(float t) {
        float clampedT = glm::clamp(t, 0.0f, 1.0f);
        glm::vec3 blue = glm::vec3(0.230f, 0.299f, 0.754f);
        glm::vec3 white = glm::vec3(0.865f, 0.865f, 0.865f);
        glm::vec3 red = glm::vec3(0.706f, 0.016f, 0.150f);

        float s = clampedT < 0.5f ? clampedT * 2.0f : (clampedT - 0.5f) * 2.0f;
        float h = s * s * (3.0f - 2.0f * s);
        return clampedT < 0.5f ? glm::mix(blue, white, h) : glm::mix(white, red, h);
    }

    // Muted CoolWarm: Restricts midpoint brightness to prevent clipping out 3D light vectors
    inline glm::vec3 mutedCoolWarm(float t) {
        float clampedT = glm::clamp(t, 0.0f, 1.0f);
        glm::vec3 darkBlue = glm::vec3(0.230f, 0.299f, 0.754f);
        glm::vec3 neutralBg = glm::vec3(0.700f, 0.700f, 0.700f); // Muted core preserves STL edge shadow details
        glm::vec3 darkRed = glm::vec3(0.706f, 0.016f, 0.150f);

        float s = clampedT < 0.5f ? clampedT * 2.0f : (clampedT - 0.5f) * 2.0f;
        return clampedT < 0.5f ? glm::mix(darkBlue, neutralBg, s) : glm::mix(neutralBg, darkRed, s);
    }

    // BWR: Strict Linear Blue-White-Red Diverging map
    inline glm::vec3 bwr(float t) {
        float clampedT = glm::clamp(t, 0.0f, 1.0f);
        glm::vec3 blue = glm::vec3(0.000f, 0.000f, 1.000f);
        glm::vec3 white = glm::vec3(1.000f, 1.000f, 1.000f);
        glm::vec3 red = glm::vec3(1.000f, 0.000f, 0.000f);

        float s = clampedT < 0.5f ? clampedT * 2.0f : (clampedT - 0.5f) * 2.0f;
        return clampedT < 0.5f ? glm::mix(blue, white, s) : glm::mix(white, red, s);
    }

    inline glm::vec3 cividis(float t) {
        float clampedT = glm::clamp(t, 0.0f, 1.0f);
        glm::vec3 c0 = glm::vec3(0.000f, 0.134f, 0.311f);
        glm::vec3 c1 = glm::vec3(0.301f, 0.334f, 0.457f);
        glm::vec3 c2 = glm::vec3(0.603f, 0.550f, 0.518f);
        glm::vec3 c3 = glm::vec3(0.992f, 0.854f, 0.220f);

        if (clampedT < 0.33f)      return glm::mix(c0, c1, clampedT / 0.33f);
        else if (clampedT < 0.66f) return glm::mix(c1, c2, (clampedT - 0.33f) / 0.33f);
        else                       return glm::mix(c2, c3, (clampedT - 0.66f) / 0.34f);
    }

    inline glm::vec3 grayscale(float t) {
        return glm::vec3(glm::clamp(t, 0.0f, 1.0f));
    }

    inline glm::vec3 evaluate(float t, ColormapType type) {
        switch (type) {
        case ColormapType::Viridis:       return viridis(t);
        case ColormapType::Inferno:       return inferno(t);
        case ColormapType::Turbo:         return turbo(t);
        case ColormapType::CoolWarm:      return coolwarm(t);
        case ColormapType::MutedCoolWarm: return mutedCoolWarm(t);
        case ColormapType::BWR:           return bwr(t);
        case ColormapType::Cividis:       return cividis(t);
        case ColormapType::Grayscale:     return grayscale(t);
        default:                          return glm::vec3(1.0f);
        }
    }

} // namespace Colormaps
```

### src/core/FieldStore.cpp
```
#include "core/FieldStore.h"
#include <cmath>
#include <limits>
#include <algorithm>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <span>

namespace FieldStore {
namespace {

// Derived arrays are shared_ptr-owned so a caller can outlive a cache refill:
// handles returned in ScalarField::owner keep the data alive even after
// clearCache()/a different mesh swaps the map contents.
thread_local std::unordered_map<std::string, std::shared_ptr<const std::vector<float>>> s_derivedCache;
thread_local const RenderMesh* s_derivedLastMesh = nullptr;
thread_local uint64_t s_derivedLastHash = 0;

inline int placementToInt(Placement p) { return static_cast<int>(p); }

Range makeRangeFromScan(float mn, float mx, bool have) {
    if (!have) return {0.0f, 1.0f};
    if (std::abs(mx - mn) < 1e-6f) mx = mn + 1.0f;
    return {mn, mx};
}

// Shared derived synthesis — single implementation for both surface and volume paths.
std::vector<float> synthesizeDerivedArray(const glm::vec3* data, size_t count,
                                           const std::string& suffix, int comp) {
    std::vector<float> out; out.reserve(count);
    bool isMag = (suffix == " [Magnitude]");
    for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
        float v;
        if (isMag) v = std::sqrt(data[i].x*data[i].x + data[i].y*data[i].y + data[i].z*data[i].z);
        else if (comp == 0) v = data[i].x;
        else if (comp == 1) v = data[i].y;
        else v = data[i].z;
        out.push_back(v);
    }
    return out;
}

} // anonymous

void clearCache() {
    decltype(s_derivedCache)().swap(s_derivedCache);
    s_derivedLastMesh = nullptr;
    s_derivedLastHash = 0;
}

namespace {
Range rangeFromSpan(std::span<const float> s) {
    if (s.empty()) return {0.0f, 1.0f};
    float mn = std::numeric_limits<float>::max();
    float mx = std::numeric_limits<float>::lowest();
    bool have = false;
    for (float f : s) {
        if (!std::isfinite(f)) continue;
        mn = std::min(mn, f);
        mx = std::max(mx, f);
        have = true;
    }
    if (!have) return {0.0f, 1.0f};
    return makeRangeFromScan(mn, mx, true);
}
} // anon

Range computeRange(const std::vector<float>& v) {
    return rangeFromSpan(std::span<const float>(v.data(), v.size()));
}

Range computeRange(const float* data, size_t count) {
    if (!data || count == 0) return {0.0f, 1.0f};
    return rangeFromSpan(std::span<const float>(data, count));
}

// ── Scalar ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

std::string resolveActiveScalar(const RenderMesh& mesh, const std::string& requested, Placement placement,
                                const postfields::ComputedSnapshot* snap) {
    if (!requested.empty()) {
        if (snap) {
            if (snap->scalars.find(requested) != snap->scalars.end()) return requested;
            if (snap->vectors.find(requested) != snap->vectors.end()) return requested;
            // Synthesized scalars on snapshot vectors ("V_vorticity [Magnitude]"
            // etc.): the snapshot maps hold the raw base name, so strip the
            // derived suffix before the claim test.
            for (const std::string sfx : {std::string(" [Magnitude]"), std::string(" [X]"), std::string(" [Y]"), std::string(" [Z]")}) {
                if (requested.size() > sfx.size() && requested.compare(requested.size() - sfx.size(), sfx.size(), sfx) == 0)
                    if (snap->vectors.count(requested.substr(0, requested.size() - sfx.size())))
                        return requested;
            }
        }
        if (mesh.attributes) {
            if (placement == Placement::CellCenter) {
                auto cit = mesh.attributes->cellScalars.find(requested);
                if (cit != mesh.attributes->cellScalars.end()) return requested;
                auto it = mesh.attributes->pointScalars.find(requested);
                if (it != mesh.attributes->pointScalars.end()) return requested;
            } else {
                auto it = mesh.attributes->pointScalars.find(requested);
                if (it != mesh.attributes->pointScalars.end()) return requested;
                auto cit = mesh.attributes->cellScalars.find(requested);
                if (cit != mesh.attributes->cellScalars.end()) return requested;
            }
        }
        for (auto& n : mesh.availableScalarNames) if (n == requested) return requested;
        for (auto& n : derivedScalarNames(mesh)) if (n == requested) return requested;
    }
    if (placement == Placement::CellCenter && mesh.attributes && !mesh.attributes->cellScalars.empty())
        return mesh.attributes->cellScalars.begin()->first;
    if (!mesh.availableScalarNames.empty()) return mesh.availableScalarNames.front();
    auto d = derivedScalarNames(mesh);
    if (!d.empty()) return d.front();
    if (mesh.attributes && !mesh.attributes->pointScalars.empty())
        return mesh.attributes->pointScalars.begin()->first;
    if (mesh.attributes && !mesh.attributes->cellScalars.empty())
        return mesh.attributes->cellScalars.begin()->first;
    return {};
}

const std::vector<float>* scalarData(const RenderMesh& mesh, const std::string& name,
                                     float& outMin, float& outMax, Placement placement,
                                     const postfields::ComputedSnapshot* snap) {
    ScalarField f = resolveScalar(mesh, {name, placement}, snap);
    if (!f.data) { outMin = 0; outMax = 1; return nullptr; }
    outMin = f.range.min; outMax = f.range.max;
    return f.data;
}

const std::vector<float>* volumeScalarData(const RenderMesh& mesh, const std::string& name,
                                           float& outMin, float& outMax, Placement placement,
                                           const postfields::ComputedSnapshot* snap) {
    ScalarField f = resolveScalarForVolume(mesh, {name, placement}, snap);
    if (!f.data) { outMin = 0; outMax = 1; return nullptr; }
    outMin = f.range.min; outMax = f.range.max;
    return f.data;
}

ScalarField resolveScalar(const RenderMesh& mesh, const FieldKey& key,
                          const postfields::ComputedSnapshot* snap) {
    const std::string& name = key.name;
    const Placement placement = key.placement;
    const bool wantCell = (placement == Placement::CellCenter);

    // Computed snapshot shadows mesh fields by name (immutable shared payload).
    if (snap) {
        auto it = snap->scalars.find(name);
        if (it != snap->scalars.end() && it->second && !it->second->empty()) {
            auto rit = snap->scalarRanges.find(name);
            Range r = (rit != snap->scalarRanges.end())
                ? Range{rit->second.first, rit->second.second} : computeRange(*it->second);
            return {it->second.get(), r, false};
        }
    }

    // Attribute-backed fields — authoritative ranges live in pointScalarRanges / cellScalarRanges
    if (mesh.attributes) {
        if (wantCell) {
            auto cit = mesh.attributes->cellScalars.find(name);
            if (cit != mesh.attributes->cellScalars.end()) {
                Range r{0,1};
                auto rit = mesh.attributes->cellScalarRanges.find(name);
                if (rit != mesh.attributes->cellScalarRanges.end()) r = {rit->second.first, rit->second.second};
                else r = computeRange(cit->second);
                // surface needs point-sized data; return extrapolated point copy when it exists but keep cell range
                auto pit = mesh.attributes->pointScalars.find(name);
                if (pit != mesh.attributes->pointScalars.end())
                    return {&pit->second, r, true};
                return {&cit->second, r, true};
            }
            auto it = mesh.attributes->pointScalars.find(name);
            if (it != mesh.attributes->pointScalars.end()) {
                auto rit = mesh.attributes->pointScalarRanges.find(name);
                Range r = (rit != mesh.attributes->pointScalarRanges.end())
                    ? Range{rit->second.first, rit->second.second} : computeRange(it->second);
                return {&it->second, r, false};
            }
        } else {
            auto it = mesh.attributes->pointScalars.find(name);
            if (it != mesh.attributes->pointScalars.end()) {
                auto rit = mesh.attributes->pointScalarRanges.find(name);
                Range r = (rit != mesh.attributes->pointScalarRanges.end())
                    ? Range{rit->second.first, rit->second.second} : computeRange(it->second);
                return {&it->second, r, false};
            }
            auto cit = mesh.attributes->cellScalars.find(name);
            if (cit != mesh.attributes->cellScalars.end()) {
                auto rit = mesh.attributes->cellScalarRanges.find(name);
                Range r = (rit != mesh.attributes->cellScalarRanges.end())
                    ? Range{rit->second.first, rit->second.second} : computeRange(cit->second);
                return {&cit->second, r, true};
            }
        }
        // Range map authoritative but storage may live under different key (extrapolated case)
        auto rit = mesh.attributes->pointScalarRanges.find(name);
        if (rit != mesh.attributes->pointScalarRanges.end()) {
            auto pit = mesh.attributes->pointScalars.find(name);
            if (pit != mesh.attributes->pointScalars.end())
                return {&pit->second, {rit->second.first, rit->second.second}, false};
            auto cit2 = mesh.attributes->cellScalars.find(name);
            if (cit2 != mesh.attributes->cellScalars.end()) {
                auto cr = mesh.attributes->cellScalarRanges.find(name);
                Range r = (cr != mesh.attributes->cellScalarRanges.end())
                    ? Range{cr->second.first, cr->second.second} : computeRange(cit2->second);
                return {&cit2->second, r, true};
            }
        }
    }

    if (!mesh.scalars.empty() && (name == mesh.scalarName || name.empty())) {
        Range r = computeRange(mesh.scalars);
        return {&mesh.scalars, r, false};
    }

    // Derived vector -> scalar (snapshot-aware for post vorticity etc) — uses shared synthesizer.
    auto tryDerived = [&](const std::string& suffix, int comp) -> ScalarField {
        if (name.size() <= suffix.size() || name.substr(name.size() - suffix.size()) != suffix)
            return {nullptr, {0,1}, false};
        std::string base = name.substr(0, name.size() - suffix.size());
        VectorField vfPoint = resolveVector(mesh, base, Placement::Vertex, snap);
        VectorField vfCell  = resolveVector(mesh, base, Placement::CellCenter, snap);
        bool hasPoint = vfPoint.data && vfPoint.count > 0;
        bool hasCell  = vfCell.data && vfCell.count > 0;
        if (!hasPoint && !hasCell) return {nullptr, {0,1}, false};
        const uint64_t curHash = mesh.geometryHash ? mesh.geometryHash : reinterpret_cast<uint64_t>(&mesh);
        if (s_derivedLastMesh != &mesh || s_derivedLastHash != curHash) { s_derivedCache.clear(); s_derivedLastMesh = &mesh; s_derivedLastHash = curHash; }

        std::string keyPoint = name + "#vert";
        std::shared_ptr<const std::vector<float>> pointOwner;
        Range pRange{0,1};
        auto itP = s_derivedCache.find(keyPoint);
        if (itP != s_derivedCache.end()) {
            pointOwner = itP->second;
            pRange = computeRange(*pointOwner);
        } else if (hasPoint) {
            pointOwner = std::make_shared<const std::vector<float>>(
                synthesizeDerivedArray(vfPoint.data, vfPoint.count, suffix, comp));
            pRange = computeRange(*pointOwner);
            s_derivedCache[keyPoint] = pointOwner;
        }

        if (placement == Placement::CellCenter && hasCell) {
            std::string keyCell = name + "#cell";
            auto itC = s_derivedCache.find(keyCell);
            Range cRange{0,1};
            if (itC != s_derivedCache.end()) {
                cRange = computeRange(*itC->second);
            } else {
                auto derivedC = std::make_shared<const std::vector<float>>(
                    synthesizeDerivedArray(vfCell.data, vfCell.count, suffix, comp));
                cRange = computeRange(*derivedC);
                s_derivedCache[keyCell] = derivedC;
            }
            // surface data stays point-sized but range is cell-wide
            if (pointOwner) return {pointOwner.get(), cRange, true, pointOwner};
            auto itCF = s_derivedCache.find(keyCell);
            if (itCF != s_derivedCache.end())
                return {itCF->second.get(), cRange, true, itCF->second};
        }
        if (pointOwner) return {pointOwner.get(), pRange, false, pointOwner};
        return {nullptr, {0,1}, false};
    };

    ScalarField r;
    r = tryDerived(" [Magnitude]", -1); if (r.data) return r;
    r = tryDerived(" [X]", 0); if (r.data) return r;
    r = tryDerived(" [Y]", 1); if (r.data) return r;
    r = tryDerived(" [Z]", 2); if (r.data) return r;
    return {nullptr, {0,1}, false};
}

ScalarField resolveScalarForVolume(const RenderMesh& mesh, const FieldKey& key,
                                   const postfields::ComputedSnapshot* snap) {
    const std::string& name = key.name;
    const Placement placement = key.placement;

    if (snap) {
        auto it = snap->scalars.find(name);
        if (it != snap->scalars.end() && it->second && !it->second->empty()) {
            auto rit = snap->scalarRanges.find(name);
            Range r = (rit != snap->scalarRanges.end())
                ? Range{rit->second.first, rit->second.second} : computeRange(*it->second);
            return {it->second.get(), r, false};
        }
    }

    if (mesh.attributes) {
        if (placement == Placement::CellCenter) {
            auto cit = mesh.attributes->cellScalars.find(name);
            if (cit != mesh.attributes->cellScalars.end()) {
                auto rit = mesh.attributes->cellScalarRanges.find(name);
                Range r = (rit != mesh.attributes->cellScalarRanges.end())
                    ? Range{rit->second.first, rit->second.second} : computeRange(cit->second);
                return {&cit->second, r, true};
            }
        } else {
            auto it = mesh.attributes->pointScalars.find(name);
            if (it != mesh.attributes->pointScalars.end()) {
                auto rit = mesh.attributes->pointScalarRanges.find(name);
                Range r = (rit != mesh.attributes->pointScalarRanges.end())
                    ? Range{rit->second.first, rit->second.second} : computeRange(it->second);
                return {&it->second, r, false};
            }
        }
        // fallback
        if (placement == Placement::CellCenter) {
            auto it = mesh.attributes->pointScalars.find(name);
            if (it != mesh.attributes->pointScalars.end()) {
                auto rit = mesh.attributes->pointScalarRanges.find(name);
                Range r = (rit != mesh.attributes->pointScalarRanges.end())
                    ? Range{rit->second.first, rit->second.second} : computeRange(it->second);
                return {&it->second, r, false};
            }
        } else {
            auto cit = mesh.attributes->cellScalars.find(name);
            if (cit != mesh.attributes->cellScalars.end()) {
                auto rit = mesh.attributes->cellScalarRanges.find(name);
                Range r = (rit != mesh.attributes->cellScalarRanges.end())
                    ? Range{rit->second.first, rit->second.second} : computeRange(cit->second);
                return {&cit->second, r, true};
            }
        }
    }
    if (!mesh.scalars.empty() && (name == mesh.scalarName || name.empty())) {
        return {&mesh.scalars, computeRange(mesh.scalars), false};
    }
    auto tryDerivedVol = [&](const std::string& suffix, int comp) -> ScalarField {
        if (name.size() <= suffix.size() || name.substr(name.size() - suffix.size()) != suffix)
            return {nullptr, {0,1}, false};
        std::string base = name.substr(0, name.size() - suffix.size());
        VectorField vf = resolveVector(mesh, base, placement, snap);
        if (!vf.data || vf.count == 0) {
            Placement alt = (placement == Placement::CellCenter) ? Placement::Vertex : Placement::CellCenter;
            vf = resolveVector(mesh, base, alt, snap);
            if (!vf.data || vf.count == 0) return {nullptr, {0,1}, false};
        }
        std::string cacheKey = name + (placement == Placement::CellCenter ? "#volcell" : "#volvert");
        const uint64_t curHash2 = mesh.geometryHash ? mesh.geometryHash : reinterpret_cast<uint64_t>(&mesh);
        if (s_derivedLastMesh != &mesh || s_derivedLastHash != curHash2) { s_derivedCache.clear(); s_derivedLastMesh = &mesh; s_derivedLastHash = curHash2; }
        auto itc = s_derivedCache.find(cacheKey);
        if (itc != s_derivedCache.end()) {
            return {itc->second.get(), computeRange(*itc->second), vf.isCell, itc->second};
        }
        auto derived = std::make_shared<const std::vector<float>>(
            synthesizeDerivedArray(vf.data, vf.count, suffix, comp));
        Range r = computeRange(*derived);
        s_derivedCache[cacheKey] = derived;
        return {derived.get(), r, vf.isCell, derived};
    };
    ScalarField r;
    r = tryDerivedVol(" [Magnitude]", -1); if (r.data) return r;
    r = tryDerivedVol(" [X]", 0); if (r.data) return r;
    r = tryDerivedVol(" [Y]", 1); if (r.data) return r;
    r = tryDerivedVol(" [Z]", 2); if (r.data) return r;
    return {nullptr, {0,1}, false};
}

// ── Vector ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

VectorField resolveVector(const RenderMesh& mesh, const std::string& requested, Placement placement,
                          const postfields::ComputedSnapshot* snap) {
    VectorField out;
    if (snap && !requested.empty()) {
        auto it = snap->vectors.find(requested);
        if (it != snap->vectors.end() && it->second && !it->second->empty()) {
            out.data = it->second->data();
            out.count = it->second->size();
            out.isCell = false;
            return out;
        }
    }
    if (placement == Placement::CellCenter && mesh.meshHasCellVectors()) {
        std::string name = requested;
        if (name.empty() && !mesh.availableCellVectorNames.empty()) name = mesh.availableCellVectorNames.front();
        if (name.empty() && !mesh.cellVectorName.empty()) name = mesh.cellVectorName;
        size_t cnt = 0;
        const glm::vec3* d = mesh.cellVectorFieldData(name, cnt);
        if (d && cnt) { out.data = d; out.count = cnt; out.isCell = true; return out; }
    }
    std::string name = requested;
    if (name.empty() && !mesh.availableVectorNames.empty()) name = mesh.availableVectorNames.front();
    size_t cnt = 0;
    const glm::vec3* d = mesh.vectorFieldData(name, cnt);
    if (d && cnt) { out.data = d; out.count = cnt; out.isCell = false; }
    return out;
}

std::string resolveVectorName(const RenderMesh& mesh, const std::string& requested, Placement placement,
                              const postfields::ComputedSnapshot* snap) {
    if (!requested.empty()) {
        if (snap && snap->vectors.find(requested) != snap->vectors.end()) return requested;
        auto f = resolveVector(mesh, requested, placement);
        if (f.data) return requested;
    }
    if (placement == Placement::CellCenter) {
        if (!mesh.cellVectorName.empty()) {
            size_t c; if (mesh.cellVectorFieldData(mesh.cellVectorName, c) && c) return mesh.cellVectorName;
        }
        if (!mesh.availableCellVectorNames.empty()) return mesh.availableCellVectorNames.front();
    }
    if (!mesh.availableVectorNames.empty()) return mesh.availableVectorNames.front();
    if (!mesh.vectorName.empty()) return mesh.vectorName;
    return requested;
}

std::vector<std::string> derivedScalarNames(const RenderMesh& mesh) {
    std::vector<std::string> out;
    for (auto &n : availableVectorNames(mesh)) {
        out.push_back(n + " [Magnitude]");
        out.push_back(n + " [X]");
        out.push_back(n + " [Y]");
        out.push_back(n + " [Z]");
    }
    return out;
}

std::vector<std::string> availableScalarNamesWithDerived(const RenderMesh& mesh) {
    std::vector<std::string> out = mesh.availableScalarNames;
    auto d = derivedScalarNames(mesh);
    out.insert(out.end(), d.begin(), d.end());
    std::sort(out.begin(), out.end());
    out.erase(std::unique(out.begin(), out.end()), out.end());
    return out;
}

std::vector<std::string> availableVectorNames(const RenderMesh& mesh) {
    std::vector<std::string> out;
    out.reserve(mesh.availableVectorNames.size() + mesh.availableCellVectorNames.size());
    out.insert(out.end(), mesh.availableVectorNames.begin(), mesh.availableVectorNames.end());
    out.insert(out.end(), mesh.availableCellVectorNames.begin(), mesh.availableCellVectorNames.end());
    std::sort(out.begin(), out.end());
    out.erase(std::unique(out.begin(), out.end()), out.end());
    return out;
}

bool hasScalar(const RenderMesh& mesh) { return mesh.hasScalarData(); }

std::vector<std::string> availableScalars(const RenderMesh& mesh, const postfields::ComputedSnapshot* snap) {
    std::vector<std::string> out = mesh.availableScalarNames;
    // cell scalars that lack point counterpart (hasScalarData fix) — expose directly
    if (mesh.attributes) {
        for (auto &kv : mesh.attributes->cellScalars) out.push_back(kv.first);
        for (auto &kv : mesh.attributes->pointScalars) out.push_back(kv.first);
    }
    auto d = derivedScalarNames(mesh);
    out.insert(out.end(), d.begin(), d.end());
    if (snap) {
        for (auto &kv : snap->scalars) out.push_back(kv.first);
        // Snapshot vectors (vorticity, gradP) also expose derived scalars ( [Magnitude]/ [X]/ [Y]/ [Z])
        // so customer can visualize e.g. p_grad [Magnitude] via scalar coloring
        for (auto &kv : snap->vectors) {
            out.push_back(kv.first + " [Magnitude]");
            out.push_back(kv.first + " [X]");
            out.push_back(kv.first + " [Y]");
            out.push_back(kv.first + " [Z]");
        }
    }
    std::sort(out.begin(), out.end());
    out.erase(std::unique(out.begin(), out.end()), out.end());
    return out;
}

std::vector<std::string> availableVectors(const RenderMesh& mesh, const postfields::ComputedSnapshot* snap) {
    std::vector<std::string> out = availableVectorNames(mesh);
    if (snap) {
        for (auto &kv : snap->vectors) out.push_back(kv.first);
        std::sort(out.begin(), out.end());
        out.erase(std::unique(out.begin(), out.end()), out.end());
    }
    return out;
}

bool hasAnyScalar(const RenderMesh& mesh, const postfields::ComputedSnapshot* snap) {
    if (mesh.hasScalarData()) return true;
    if (snap && !snap->scalars.empty()) return true;
    // derived scalars count as scalars when vectors exist
    if (!derivedScalarNames(mesh).empty()) return true;
    return false;
}

bool hasScalarField(const RenderMesh& mesh, const std::string& name, const postfields::ComputedSnapshot* snap) {
    float mn, mx;
    if (snap && snap->scalars.find(name) != snap->scalars.end()) return true;
    // probe via FieldStore resolution (covers derived as well)
    if (scalarData(mesh, name, mn, mx, Placement::Vertex, snap)) return true;
    if (scalarData(mesh, name, mn, mx, Placement::CellCenter, snap)) return true;
    return false;
}

} // namespace FieldStore
```

### src/core/FieldStore.h
```
#pragma once
#include "core/mesh_loader.h"
#include "core/post_fields.h"
#include <memory>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <optional>
#include <glm/glm.hpp>

// Deep module behind Mesh data model seam.
// Single interface hides point vs cell, extrapolation, derived field synthesis, and range.
// Consumers use FieldKey + Placement instead of (string, int) placement plumbing.
//
// Post-processed fields: every resolver takes an optional ComputedSnapshot
