// (default null = legacy behavior). When present, snapshot fields shadow mesh
// fields by name — the snapshot owns immutable shared payloads, so this is
// safe to call from the render thread.

namespace FieldStore {

// ── Domain types ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

enum class Placement : int {
    Vertex = 0,      // point data
    CellCenter = 1,  // cell data
};

struct FieldKey {
    std::string name;
    Placement placement = Placement::Vertex;
};

struct Range {
    float min = 0.0f;
    float max = 1.0f;
};

struct ScalarField {
    const std::vector<float>* data = nullptr; // storage owned by RenderMesh or derived cache
    Range range{};
    bool isCell = false; // true when data came from cell storage (size == cellCount)
    // Non-null for synthesized derived scalars: keeps the derived array alive for
    // as long as the caller holds this handle. Without it a raw `data` pointer
    // dangles as soon as the per-thread derived cache is refilled for another
    // mesh — which is every frame while a transient run streams.
    std::shared_ptr<const std::vector<float>> owner;
};

struct VectorField {
    const glm::vec3* data = nullptr;
    size_t count = 0;
    bool isCell = false;
};

// ── Scalar seam ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// Resolve which scalar name actually exists, respecting placement preference.
// Returns empty when no field available.
std::string resolveActiveScalar(const RenderMesh& mesh, const std::string& requested,
                                Placement placement = Placement::Vertex,
                                const postfields::ComputedSnapshot* snap = nullptr);

// Unified entry for surface rendering: prefers point-sized data for GPU upload
// (extrapolated copy when cell field + point copy exists) but returns range
// from authoritative placement-aware range map. Returns nullptr when not found.
const std::vector<float>* scalarData(const RenderMesh& mesh, const std::string& name,
                                     float& outMin, float& outMax,
                                     Placement placement = Placement::Vertex,
                                     const postfields::ComputedSnapshot* snap = nullptr);

// Volume/isosurface path: returns per-cell data when CellCenter requested (no extrapolation).
// Falls back to other placement when requested not found.
const std::vector<float>* volumeScalarData(const RenderMesh& mesh, const std::string& name,
                                           float& outMin, float& outMax,
                                           Placement placement = Placement::Vertex,
                                           const postfields::ComputedSnapshot* snap = nullptr);

// Typed overloads using FieldKey — preferred interface for new code.
ScalarField resolveScalar(const RenderMesh& mesh, const FieldKey& key,
                          const postfields::ComputedSnapshot* snap = nullptr);
ScalarField resolveScalarForVolume(const RenderMesh& mesh, const FieldKey& key,
                                   const postfields::ComputedSnapshot* snap = nullptr);

// Range primitive — single source for mn/mx logic (DRY).
Range computeRange(const std::vector<float>& values);
Range computeRange(const float* data, size_t count);

// ── Vector seam ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

VectorField resolveVector(const RenderMesh& mesh, const std::string& requested,
                          Placement placement,
                          const postfields::ComputedSnapshot* snap = nullptr);

std::string resolveVectorName(const RenderMesh& mesh, const std::string& requested,
                              Placement placement,
                              const postfields::ComputedSnapshot* snap = nullptr);

// ── Derived / discovery ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

std::vector<std::string> derivedScalarNames(const RenderMesh& mesh);
std::vector<std::string> availableScalarNamesWithDerived(const RenderMesh& mesh);
std::vector<std::string> availableVectorNames(const RenderMesh& mesh);
bool hasScalar(const RenderMesh& mesh);

// — Snapshot-aware discovery: single source for UI lists (probes, combos, histogram).
// Merges mesh fields + derived + snapshot scalars/vectors. New computed fields
// appear automatically without touching consumers.
std::vector<std::string> availableScalars(const RenderMesh& mesh,
                                          const postfields::ComputedSnapshot* snap = nullptr);
std::vector<std::string> availableVectors(const RenderMesh& mesh,
                                          const postfields::ComputedSnapshot* snap = nullptr);
bool hasAnyScalar(const RenderMesh& mesh,
                  const postfields::ComputedSnapshot* snap = nullptr);
bool hasScalarField(const RenderMesh& mesh, const std::string& name,
                    const postfields::ComputedSnapshot* snap = nullptr);

// ── Context — natural consumption handle ─────────────────────────────────
// Holds mesh + snapshot once per frame; consumers call ctx.scalar/vector
// without threading snap/placement boilerplate. Thread-local derived cache
// stays inside Context-free functions, but Context eliminates per-call snap
// plumbing and enables inventory via ctx.scalars().

struct Context {
    const RenderMesh* mesh = nullptr;
    const postfields::ComputedSnapshot* snap = nullptr;
    explicit Context(const RenderMesh& m, const postfields::ComputedSnapshot* s = nullptr)
        : mesh(&m), snap(s) {}
    explicit Context(const RenderMesh* m, const postfields::ComputedSnapshot* s = nullptr)
        : mesh(m), snap(s) {}
    bool valid() const { return mesh != nullptr; }
    ScalarField scalar(const FieldKey& key) const {
        return mesh ? resolveScalar(*mesh, key, snap) : ScalarField{};
    }
    ScalarField scalar(const std::string& name, Placement p = Placement::Vertex) const {
        return scalar(FieldKey{name, p});
    }
    ScalarField scalarForVolume(const FieldKey& key) const {
        return mesh ? resolveScalarForVolume(*mesh, key, snap) : ScalarField{};
    }
    VectorField vector(const std::string& name, Placement p) const {
        return mesh ? resolveVector(*mesh, name, p, snap) : VectorField{};
    }
    std::vector<std::string> scalars() const {
        return mesh ? availableScalars(*mesh, snap) : std::vector<std::string>{};
    }
    std::vector<std::string> vectors() const {
        return mesh ? availableVectors(*mesh, snap) : std::vector<std::string>{};
    }
    bool hasScalarData() const { return mesh ? hasAnyScalar(*mesh, snap) : false; }
};

// int <-> Placement helpers for RenderRenderState boundary (single place).
inline Placement toPlacement(int v) { return v == 1 ? Placement::CellCenter : Placement::Vertex; }
inline int fromPlacement(Placement p) { return p == Placement::CellCenter ? 1 : 0; }

// ── Cache ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

void clearCache();

// ── Helpers for consumers that need Range struct ─────────────────────────

inline Range rangeOf(const ScalarField& f) { return f.range; }

} // namespace FieldStore
```

### src/core/camera_math.cpp
```
#include "core/camera_math.h"

#include <algorithm>

double easeInOutCubic(double t) {
    t = std::clamp(t, 0.0, 1.0);
    return t < 0.5 ? 4.0 * t * t * t : 1.0 - std::pow(-2.0 * t + 2.0, 3.0) / 2.0;
}

namespace {

// Rotation taking OpenGL camera space (looks down -Z, up +Y) into world space
// such that the camera's forward axis lands on `forward` with the nearest
// orientation to `upHint`. Matches the gluLookAt basis construction.
glm::dquat frameQuat(const glm::dvec3& forward, const glm::dvec3& upHint) {
    const glm::dvec3 f = glm::normalize(forward);
    glm::dvec3 s = glm::cross(f, upHint);
    double sLen = glm::length(s);
    if (sLen < 1e-9) {
        // upHint parallel to view direction: pick any fallback perpendicular.
        const glm::dvec3 alt = (std::abs(f.y) < 0.9) ? glm::dvec3(0, 1, 0) : glm::dvec3(1, 0, 0);
        s = glm::cross(f, alt);
        sLen = glm::length(s);
    }
    s /= sLen;
    const glm::dvec3 u = glm::normalize(glm::cross(s, f));
    return glm::dquat(glm::dmat3(s, u, -f));  // columns: right, up, backward
}

}  // namespace

CameraPose interpolatePose(const CameraPose& a, const CameraPose& b, double t) {
    t = std::clamp(t, 0.0, 1.0);

    const glm::dquat qa = frameQuat(a.focal - a.pos, a.up);
    const glm::dquat qb = frameQuat(b.focal - b.pos, b.up);
    const glm::dquat q = glm::slerp(qa, qb, t);  // shortest-arc

    CameraPose out;
    out.focal = glm::mix(a.focal, b.focal, t);
    // Blend orbit radii separately: identical for snap transitions (distance is
    // preserved), still sensible if a future caller animates a dolly.
    const double dist = glm::mix(glm::length(a.focal - a.pos), glm::length(b.focal - b.pos), t);
    out.pos = out.focal - (q * glm::dvec3(0, 0, -1)) * dist;
    out.up = q * glm::dvec3(0, 1, 0);
    return out;
}
```

### src/core/camera_math.h
```
#pragma once
// Pure camera-pose interpolation for animated view transitions (fly-to-face).
// GLM-only: no Qt, no OpenGL — safe to compile into unit tests.
//
// Poses are interpolated as (orientation, focal point) pairs: orientation via
// quaternion slerp of look-at frames, focal linearly. Camera position is then
// reconstructed along the slerped forward axis at the blended orbit distance,
// which keeps |pos - focal| pulse-free and never lets the up vector collapse
// into the view direction mid-flight (the classic failure of lerping viewUp).

#include <glm/glm.hpp>
#include <glm/gtc/quaternion.hpp>

struct CameraPose {
    glm::dvec3 pos;
    glm::dvec3 focal;
    glm::dvec3 up;
};

// Smoothstep-style ease with zero first derivatives at both ends (C1).
double easeInOutCubic(double t);

// Interpolate between two poses at parameter t in [0,1]. Endpoints are exact
// when both inputs carry an orthonormalized up vector perpendicular to their
// view direction (Camera maintains this invariant via orthogonalizeViewUp()).
CameraPose interpolatePose(const CameraPose& a, const CameraPose& b, double t);
```

### src/core/cell_topology.cpp
```
#include "core/cell_topology.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <limits>
#include <numeric>

namespace cell_topology {

namespace {

using Point = std::array<double, 3>;

constexpr double kEps = 1e-24;

Point sub(const Point& a, const Point& b) { return {a[0] - b[0], a[1] - b[1], a[2] - b[2]}; }
double dot(const Point& a, const Point& b) { return a[0] * b[0] + a[1] * b[1] + a[2] * b[2]; }
double norm2(const Point& a) { return dot(a, a); }

Point cross(const Point& a, const Point& b) {
    return {a[1] * b[2] - a[2] * b[1], a[2] * b[0] - a[0] * b[2], a[0] * b[1] - a[1] * b[0]};
}

double distance2(const Point& a, const Point& b) { return norm2(sub(a, b)); }

Point centroidOf(const std::vector<std::size_t>& loop, const std::vector<Point>& points) {
    Point c{0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
    for (std::size_t v : loop) {
        c[0] += points[v][0];
        c[1] += points[v][1];
        c[2] += points[v][2];
    }
    if (!loop.empty()) {
        const double inv = 1.0 / static_cast<double>(loop.size());
        c[0] *= inv;
        c[1] *= inv;
        c[2] *= inv;
    }
    return c;
}

// Newell's method: robust for slightly non-planar polygons.
Point newellNormal(const std::vector<std::size_t>& loop, const std::vector<Point>& points) {
    Point n{0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
    const std::size_t m = loop.size();
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        const Point& a = points[loop[i]];
        const Point& b = points[loop[(i + 1) % m]];
        n[0] += (a[1] - b[1]) * (a[2] + b[2]);
        n[1] += (a[2] - b[2]) * (a[0] + b[0]);
        n[2] += (a[0] - b[0]) * (a[1] + b[1]);
    }
    return n;
}

bool hasDuplicate(const std::vector<std::size_t>& loop) {
    std::vector<std::size_t> s = loop;
    std::sort(s.begin(), s.end());
    return std::adjacent_find(s.begin(), s.end()) != s.end();
}

bool hasVertex(const std::vector<std::size_t>& loop, std::size_t v) {
    return std::find(loop.begin(), loop.end(), v) != loop.end();
}

bool disjoint(const std::vector<std::size_t>& a, const std::vector<std::size_t>& b) {
    for (std::size_t v : a) {
        if (hasVertex(b, v)) return false;
    }
    return true;
}

// Order `loop` counter-clockwise about `axis` (right-hand rule). The stored
// face loops may be oriented either way, so the sign of the face normal
// decides whether to reverse. A degenerate normal falls back to an angular
// sort around the centroid in a basis perpendicular to `axis`.
void orderAboutAxis(std::vector<std::size_t>& loop, const Point& axis,
                    const std::vector<Point>& points) {
    if (loop.size() < 3) return;

    const Point n = newellNormal(loop, points);
    const double d = dot(n, axis);
    if (std::fabs(d) > kEps * std::sqrt(norm2(n) * norm2(axis))) {
        if (d < 0.0) std::reverse(loop.begin(), loop.end());
        return;
    }

    // Pick a basis perpendicular to `axis`.
    Point u = (std::fabs(axis[0]) < 0.9) ? Point{1.0, 0.0, 0.0} : Point{0.0, 1.0, 0.0};
    Point v = cross(axis, u);
    double vn = std::sqrt(norm2(v));
    if (vn < 1e-15) return;
    v[0] /= vn; v[1] /= vn; v[2] /= vn;
    u = cross(v, axis);
    double un = std::sqrt(norm2(u));
    if (un < 1e-15) return;
    u[0] /= un; u[1] /= un; u[2] /= un;

    const Point c = centroidOf(loop, points);
    std::sort(loop.begin(), loop.end(), [&](std::size_t a, std::size_t b) {
        const Point da = sub(points[a], c);
        const Point db = sub(points[b], c);
        const double aa = std::atan2(dot(da, v), dot(da, u));
        const double ab = std::atan2(dot(db, v), dot(db, u));
        return aa < ab;
    });
}

// Match each vertex of `a` to its nearest unused vertex of `b`. For a convex
// cell the corresponding bottom/top vertices are the closest pair.
bool pairLoops(const std::vector<std::size_t>& a, const std::vector<std::size_t>& b,
               const std::vector<Point>& points, std::vector<std::size_t>& paired) {
    if (a.size() != b.size()) return false;
    paired.clear();
    paired.reserve(a.size());
    std::vector<bool> used(b.size(), false);
    for (std::size_t av : a) {
        std::size_t best = std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max();
        double bestD = std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
        for (std::size_t j = 0; j < b.size(); ++j) {
            if (used[j]) continue;
            const double d = distance2(points[av], points[b[j]]);
            if (d < bestD) { bestD = d; best = j; }
        }
        if (best == std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) return false;
        used[best] = true;
        paired.push_back(b[best]);
    }
    return true;
}

// A side face of a hex/wedge must join one directed edge of `bottom` to the
// matching directed edge of `topPaired`. This rejects a nearest-vertex pairing
// that does not actually reproduce the cell's face topology.
bool validSideFace(const std::vector<std::size_t>& side,
                   const std::vector<std::size_t>& bottom,
                   const std::vector<std::size_t>& topPaired) {
    std::vector<std::size_t> bv, tv;
    for (std::size_t v : side) {
        if (hasVertex(bottom, v)) bv.push_back(v);
        else if (hasVertex(topPaired, v)) tv.push_back(v);
        else return false;
    }
    if (bv.size() != 2 || tv.size() != 2) return false;

    const std::size_t n = bottom.size();
    int edge = -1;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        const std::size_t a = bottom[i];
        const std::size_t b = bottom[(i + 1) % n];
        if ((bv[0] == a && bv[1] == b) || (bv[0] == b && bv[1] == a)) {
            edge = static_cast<int>(i);
            break;
        }
    }
    if (edge < 0) return false;

    const std::size_t t0 = topPaired[static_cast<std::size_t>(edge)];
    const std::size_t t1 = topPaired[(static_cast<std::size_t>(edge) + 1) % n];
    return (tv[0] == t0 && tv[1] == t1) || (tv[0] == t1 && tv[1] == t0);
}

bool validPermutation(const std::vector<std::size_t>& out,
                      const std::vector<std::size_t>& verts) {
    if (out.size() != verts.size()) return false;
    std::vector<std::size_t> a = out;
    std::vector<std::size_t> b = verts;
    std::sort(a.begin(), a.end());
    std::sort(b.begin(), b.end());
    return a == b && std::adjacent_find(a.begin(), a.end()) == a.end();
}

std::vector<std::size_t> canonicalTet(std::vector<std::size_t> v,
                                      const std::vector<Point>& points) {
    if (v.size() != 4) return {};
    const Point e1 = sub(points[v[1]], points[v[0]]);
    const Point e2 = sub(points[v[2]], points[v[0]]);
    const Point e3 = sub(points[v[3]], points[v[0]]);
    if (dot(cross(e1, e2), e3) < 0.0) std::swap(v[1], v[2]);
    return v;
}

std::vector<std::size_t> canonicalHex(const std::vector<std::size_t>& verts,
                                      const std::vector<std::vector<std::size_t>>& loops,
                                      const std::vector<Point>& points) {
    std::vector<std::size_t> quads;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < loops.size(); ++i) {
        if (loops[i].size() == 4 && !hasDuplicate(loops[i])) quads.push_back(i);
    }
    if (quads.size() != 6) return {};

    std::size_t bi = std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max();
    std::size_t ti = std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max();
    for (std::size_t a = 0; a < quads.size() && ti == std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max(); ++a) {
        for (std::size_t b = a + 1; b < quads.size(); ++b) {
            if (disjoint(loops[quads[a]], loops[quads[b]])) {
                bi = quads[a];
                ti = quads[b];
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    if (ti == std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) return {};

    std::vector<std::size_t> bottom = loops[bi];
    std::vector<std::size_t> top = loops[ti];
    const Point cb = centroidOf(bottom, points);
    const Point ct = centroidOf(top, points);
    const Point axis = sub(ct, cb);
    if (norm2(axis) < kEps) return {};

    orderAboutAxis(bottom, axis, points);
    orderAboutAxis(top, axis, points);

    std::vector<std::size_t> topPaired;
    if (!pairLoops(bottom, top, points, topPaired)) return {};

    for (std::size_t i : quads) {
        if (i == bi || i == ti) continue;
        if (!validSideFace(loops[i], bottom, topPaired)) return {};
    }

    std::vector<std::size_t> out = bottom;
    out.insert(out.end(), topPaired.begin(), topPaired.end());
    return validPermutation(out, verts) ? out : std::vector<std::size_t>{};
}

std::vector<std::size_t> canonicalWedge(const std::vector<std::size_t>& verts,
                                        const std::vector<std::vector<std::size_t>>& loops,
                                        const std::vector<Point>& points) {
    std::vector<std::size_t> tris;
    std::vector<std::size_t> quads;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < loops.size(); ++i) {
        if (loops[i].size() == 3 && !hasDuplicate(loops[i])) tris.push_back(i);
        else if (loops[i].size() == 4 && !hasDuplicate(loops[i])) quads.push_back(i);
    }
    if (tris.size() != 2 || quads.size() != 3) return {};

    std::vector<std::size_t> a = loops[tris[0]];
    std::vector<std::size_t> b = loops[tris[1]];
    if (!disjoint(a, b)) return {};

    const Point ca = centroidOf(a, points);
    const Point cb = centroidOf(b, points);
    const Point axis = sub(cb, ca);
    if (norm2(axis) < kEps) return {};

    orderAboutAxis(a, axis, points);
    orderAboutAxis(b, axis, points);

    std::vector<std::size_t> bPaired;
    if (!pairLoops(a, b, points, bPaired)) return {};

    for (std::size_t qi : quads) {
        if (!validSideFace(loops[qi], a, bPaired)) return {};
    }

    std::vector<std::size_t> out = a;
    out.insert(out.end(), bPaired.begin(), bPaired.end());
    return validPermutation(out, verts) ? out : std::vector<std::size_t>{};
}

std::vector<std::size_t> canonicalPyramid(const std::vector<std::size_t>& verts,
                                          const std::vector<std::vector<std::size_t>>& loops,
                                          const std::vector<Point>& points) {
    std::size_t baseIdx = std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max();
    std::vector<std::size_t> tris;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < loops.size(); ++i) {
        if (loops[i].size() == 4 && !hasDuplicate(loops[i])) {
            if (baseIdx != std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) return {};
            baseIdx = i;
        } else if (loops[i].size() == 3 && !hasDuplicate(loops[i])) {
            tris.push_back(i);
        }
    }
    if (baseIdx == std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max() || tris.size() != 4) return {};

    std::vector<std::size_t> base = loops[baseIdx];
    std::size_t apex = std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max();
    for (std::size_t v : verts) {
        if (!hasVertex(base, v)) {
            if (apex != std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) return {};
            apex = v;
        }
    }
    if (apex == std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()) return {};

    const Point axis = sub(points[apex], centroidOf(base, points));
    if (norm2(axis) < kEps) return {};
    orderAboutAxis(base, axis, points);

    for (std::size_t ti : tris) {
        if (!hasVertex(loops[ti], apex)) return {};
        std::vector<std::size_t> edge;
        for (std::size_t v : loops[ti]) {
            if (v != apex) edge.push_back(v);
        }
        if (edge.size() != 2) return {};
        bool adjacent = false;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
            const std::size_t a = base[i];
            const std::size_t b = base[(i + 1) % 4];
            if ((edge[0] == a && edge[1] == b) || (edge[0] == b && edge[1] == a)) {
                adjacent = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (!adjacent) return {};
    }

    std::vector<std::size_t> out = base;
    out.push_back(apex);
    return validPermutation(out, verts) ? out : std::vector<std::size_t>{};
}

const std::vector<std::vector<int>> kTetraFaces = {
    {0, 1, 2}, {0, 1, 3}, {1, 2, 3}, {0, 2, 3},
};
const std::vector<std::vector<int>> kHexFaces = {
    {0, 1, 2, 3}, {4, 5, 6, 7}, {0, 1, 5, 4},
    {1, 2, 6, 5}, {2, 3, 7, 6}, {3, 0, 4, 7},
};
const std::vector<std::vector<int>> kWedgeFaces = {
    {0, 1, 2}, {3, 4, 5}, {0, 1, 4, 3}, {1, 2, 5, 4}, {2, 0, 3, 5},
};
const std::vector<std::vector<int>> kPyramidFaces = {
    {0, 1, 2, 3}, {0, 1, 4}, {1, 2, 4}, {2, 3, 4}, {3, 0, 4},
};
const std::vector<std::vector<int>> kNoFaces;

} // namespace

std::uint8_t classify(const std::vector<std::vector<std::size_t>>& faceLoops) {
    int tris = 0;
    int quads = 0;
    for (const auto& loop : faceLoops) {
        if (loop.size() == 3) ++tris;
        else if (loop.size() == 4) ++quads;
    }
    return classifyShape(static_cast<int>(faceLoops.size()), tris, quads);
}

std::uint8_t classifyShape(int faceCount, int triCount, int quadCount) {
    if (faceCount == 4 && triCount == 4) return kTetra;
    if (faceCount == 6 && quadCount == 6) return kHexahedron;
    if (faceCount == 5 && triCount == 2 && quadCount == 3) return kWedge;
    if (faceCount == 5 && triCount == 4 && quadCount == 1) return kPyramid;
    return kPolyhedron;
}

bool isVolumeCell(std::uint8_t type) {
    return type == kTetra || type == kHexahedron || type == kWedge || type == kPyramid;
}

int cornerCount(std::uint8_t type) {
    switch (type) {
        case kTetra: return 4;
        case kHexahedron: return 8;
        case kWedge: return 6;
        case kPyramid: return 5;
        default: return 0;
    }
}

const std::vector<std::vector<int>>& faces(std::uint8_t type) {
    switch (type) {
        case kTetra: return kTetraFaces;
        case kHexahedron: return kHexFaces;
        case kWedge: return kWedgeFaces;
        case kPyramid: return kPyramidFaces;
        default: return kNoFaces;
    }
}

std::uint8_t canonicalize(std::vector<std::size_t>& verts,
                          const std::vector<std::vector<std::size_t>>& faceLoops,
                          const std::vector<std::array<double, 3>>& points) {
    const std::uint8_t type = classify(faceLoops);
    if (!isVolumeCell(type)) return kPolyhedron;
    if (verts.size() != static_cast<std::size_t>(cornerCount(type))) return kPolyhedron;
    for (std::size_t v : verts) {
        if (v >= points.size()) return kPolyhedron;
    }

    std::vector<std::size_t> out;
    switch (type) {
        case kTetra: out = canonicalTet(verts, points); break;
        case kHexahedron: out = canonicalHex(verts, faceLoops, points); break;
        case kWedge: out = canonicalWedge(verts, faceLoops, points); break;
        case kPyramid: out = canonicalPyramid(verts, faceLoops, points); break;
        default: return kPolyhedron;
    }
    if (out.empty()) return kPolyhedron;

    verts = std::move(out);
    return type;
}

void tets(std::uint8_t type, std::span<const std::uint32_t> cellVerts,
          std::vector<std::array<std::uint32_t, 4>>& out) {
    if (!isVolumeCell(type)) return;
    if (cellVerts.size() < static_cast<std::size_t>(cornerCount(type))) return;

    if (type == kTetra) {
        out.push_back({0, 1, 2, 3});
        return;
    }

    const auto& cellFaces = faces(type);
    const auto center = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(cornerCount(type));
    for (const auto& face : cellFaces) {
        const std::size_t n = face.size();
        if (n < 3) continue;

        // Rotate to the smallest global id: both incident cells then fan the
        // shared face from the same corner and along the same cycle, so the
        // triangle sets match (possibly with opposite winding).
        std::size_t start = 0;
        for (std::size_t k = 1; k < n; ++k) {
            if (cellVerts[static_cast<std::size_t>(face[k])] <
                cellVerts[static_cast<std::size_t>(face[start])]) {
                start = k;
            }
        }

        for (std::size_t k = 1; k + 1 < n; ++k) {
            out.push_back({
                static_cast<std::uint32_t>(face[start]),
                static_cast<std::uint32_t>(face[(start + k) % n]),
                static_cast<std::uint32_t>(face[(start + k + 1) % n]),
                center,
            });
        }
    }
}

} // namespace cell_topology
```

### src/core/cell_topology.h
```
#pragma once

#include <array>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <span>
#include <vector>

// Cell topology shared by the ANSYS reader, the CFD adapter, the derived
// volume grid and isosurface extraction.
//
// The renderer keeps a flat, canonical VTK corner order per cell. ANSYS writes
// the vertices of a 3D cell in arbitrary order (a union of its face loops), so
// the reader canonicalizes them here; everything downstream (VTU export,
// tetrahedralization, voxelization) can then rely on the VTK layout.
namespace cell_topology {

enum : std::uint8_t {
    kTetra = 10,
    kHexahedron = 12,
    kWedge = 13,
    kPyramid = 14,
    kPolyhedron = 42, // unsupported / unrecognized
};

// VTK cell type inferred from a cell's face loops (face sizes only).
std::uint8_t classify(const std::vector<std::vector<std::size_t>>& faceLoops);

// Same classification from pre-counted face shapes (avoids building loops).
std::uint8_t classifyShape(int faceCount, int triCount, int quadCount);

bool isVolumeCell(std::uint8_t type);
int cornerCount(std::uint8_t type);

// Canonical local faces of a supported type, as corner slots. Empty otherwise.
const std::vector<std::vector<int>>& faces(std::uint8_t type);

// Reorder `verts` (global point ids, arbitrary order) into the canonical VTK
// corner order using the cell's face loops and point coordinates.
//
// Returns the detected cell type, or kPolyhedron when the element is
// unsupported or its face loops do not match the expected layout. On failure
// `verts` is left untouched.
std::uint8_t canonicalize(std::vector<std::size_t>& verts,
                          const std::vector<std::vector<std::size_t>>& faceLoops,
                          const std::vector<std::array<double, 3>>& points);

// Append tetrahedra as corner slots. Slot `cornerCount(type)` is the cell
// centroid. Tetrahedra use a single tet and no centroid.
//
// Every face is rotated to start at its smallest *global* corner id and
// fan-triangulated, so two cells sharing a face split it identically. That is
// what keeps an extracted isosurface watertight across cell boundaries.
void tets(std::uint8_t type, std::span<const std::uint32_t> cellVerts,
          std::vector<std::array<std::uint32_t, 4>>& out);

} // namespace cell_topology
```

### src/core/field_sampler.h
```
#pragma once
// Shared sampler for probe/line-plot — eliminates ~120L duplication between
// main_window.cpp sampleOne and plot_window.cpp recomputeLine.
// Structured fast path: brute cell bbox + trilinear. Unstructured fallback: nearest vertex / cell center.

#include "core/mesh_loader.h"
#include "core/FieldStore.h"
#include <glm/glm.hpp>
#include <optional>
#include <limits>
#include <algorithm>

namespace FieldSampler {

// Sample scalar at world position using FieldStore::Context (snapshot-aware).
// Returns nullopt when field not found; NaN when outside and no fallback.
inline std::optional<float> sample(const FieldStore::Context& ctx, const std::string& field,
                                   FieldStore::Placement placement, const glm::vec3& pos) {
    if (!ctx.valid()) return std::nullopt;
    const RenderMesh& rm = *ctx.mesh;
    float mn, mx;
    const std::vector<float>* src = nullptr;
    FieldStore::ScalarField sf;
    // Prefer requested placement, fall back internally via FieldStore resolution.
    if (placement == FieldStore::Placement::CellCenter) {
        sf = ctx.scalarForVolume({field, placement});
        if (!sf.data) sf = ctx.scalar({field, placement});
    } else {
        sf = ctx.scalar({field, placement});
    }
    if (!sf.data || sf.data->empty()) return std::nullopt;
    src = sf.data;
    bool isCell = sf.isCell;

    // Structured fast path
    bool isStructured = rm.gridDimX > 1 && rm.gridDimY > 1;
    if (isStructured && rm.gridDimX > 0 && rm.gridDimY > 0 && rm.gridDimZ > 0 && !rm.vertices.empty()) {
        int dX = rm.gridDimX, dY = rm.gridDimY, dZ = rm.gridDimZ;
        const float* verts = rm.vertices.data();
        auto idx = [&](int x, int y, int z) { return x + y * dX + z * dX * dY; };
        int cdX = std::max(1, dX - 1), cdY = std::max(1, dY - 1), cdZ = std::max(1, dZ - 1);
        const float eps = 1e-6f;
        for (int cz = 0; cz < cdZ; ++cz) for (int cy = 0; cy < cdY; ++cy) for (int cx = 0; cx < cdX; ++cx) {
            float minx = 1e30f, miny = 1e30f, minz = 1e30f, maxx = -1e30f, maxy = -1e30f, maxz = -1e30f;
            int z0 = cz, z1 = std::min(cz + 1, dZ - 1);
            int y0 = cy, y1 = std::min(cy + 1, dY - 1);
            int x0 = cx, x1 = std::min(cx + 1, dX - 1);
            int corners[8][3] = {{x0,y0,z0},{x1,y0,z0},{x1,y1,z0},{x0,y1,z0},{x0,y0,z1},{x1,y0,z1},{x1,y1,z1},{x0,y1,z1}};
            for (int k = 0; k < 8; ++k) {
                int n = idx(corners[k][0], corners[k][1], corners[k][2]);
                if (n < 0 || size_t(n * 3 + 2) >= rm.vertices.size()) continue;
                float px = verts[n * 3 + 0], py = verts[n * 3 + 1], pz = verts[n * 3 + 2];
                minx = std::min(minx, px); maxx = std::max(maxx, px);
                miny = std::min(miny, py); maxy = std::max(maxy, py);
                minz = std::min(minz, pz); maxz = std::max(maxz, pz);
            }
            if (pos.x < minx - eps || pos.x > maxx + eps) continue;
            if (pos.y < miny - eps || pos.y > maxy + eps) continue;
            if (dZ > 1 && (pos.z < minz - eps || pos.z > maxz + eps)) continue;
            if (isCell) {
                int cIdx = cx + cy * cdX + cz * cdX * cdY;
                if (cIdx >= 0 && size_t(cIdx) < src->size()) return (*src)[cIdx];
                // fall through to trilinear if cell index out of range
            }
            // trilinear from 8 corner point values
            float s[8]; bool ok = true;
            for (int k = 0; k < 8; ++k) {
                int n = idx(corners[k][0], corners[k][1], corners[k][2]);
                if (n < 0 || size_t(n) >= src->size()) { ok = false; break; }
                s[k] = (*src)[n];
                if (!std::isfinite(s[k])) ok = false;
            }
            if (!ok) continue;
            float dx = (maxx - minx) > 1e-12f ? (pos.x - minx) / (maxx - minx) : 0;
            float dy = (maxy - miny) > 1e-12f ? (pos.y - miny) / (maxy - miny) : 0;
            float dz = (dZ > 1 && (maxz - minz) > 1e-12f) ? (pos.z - minz) / (maxz - minz) : 0;
            dx = std::clamp(dx, 0.0f, 1.0f); dy = std::clamp(dy, 0.0f, 1.0f); dz = std::clamp(dz, 0.0f, 1.0f);
            float c00 = s[0] * (1 - dx) + s[1] * dx;
            float c10 = s[3] * (1 - dx) + s[2] * dx;
            float c01 = s[4] * (1 - dx) + s[5] * dx;
            float c11 = s[7] * (1 - dx) + s[6] * dx;
            float c0 = c00 * (1 - dy) + c10 * dy;
            float c1 = c01 * (1 - dy) + c11 * dy;
            return c0 * (1 - dz) + c1 * dz;
        }
        // Outside structured domain: nearest vertex fallback
        float bestD = 1e30f; int best = -1;
        size_t nPt = rm.vertices.size() / 3;
        for (size_t n = 0; n < nPt; ++n) {
            float dx = verts[n * 3 + 0] - pos.x, dy = verts[n * 3 + 1] - pos.y, dz = verts[n * 3 + 2] - pos.z;
            float d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz;
            if (d2 < bestD) { bestD = d2; best = int(n); }
        }
        if (best >= 0 && size_t(best) < src->size()) return (*src)[best];
    } else if (!isCell) {
        // Unstructured point fallback: nearest vertex
        float bestD = 1e30f; int best = -1;
        size_t nPt = rm.vertices.size() / 3;
        const float* verts = rm.vertices.data();
        for (size_t n = 0; n < nPt; ++n) {
            float dx = verts[n * 3 + 0] - pos.x, dy = verts[n * 3 + 1] - pos.y, dz = verts[n * 3 + 2] - pos.z;
            float d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz;
            if (d2 < bestD) { bestD = d2; best = int(n); }
        }
        if (best >= 0 && size_t(best) < src->size()) return (*src)[best];
        if (!rm.cellCenters.empty()) {
            float bestC = 1e30f; int bestCidx = -1;
            for (size_t c = 0; c < rm.cellCenters.size(); ++c) {
                float dx = rm.cellCenters[c].x - pos.x, dy = rm.cellCenters[c].y - pos.y, dz = rm.cellCenters[c].z - pos.z;
                float d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz;
                if (d2 < bestC) { bestC = d2; bestCidx = int(c); }
            }
            if (bestCidx >= 0 && size_t(bestCidx) < src->size()) return (*src)[bestCidx];
        }
    } else {
        // Cell unstructured nearest center
        if (!rm.cellCenters.empty()) {
            float bestC = 1e30f; int bestCidx = -1;
            for (size_t c = 0; c < rm.cellCenters.size(); ++c) {
                float dx = rm.cellCenters[c].x - pos.x, dy = rm.cellCenters[c].y - pos.y, dz = rm.cellCenters[c].z - pos.z;
                float d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz;
                if (d2 < bestC) { bestC = d2; bestCidx = int(c); }
            }
            if (bestCidx >= 0 && size_t(bestCidx) < src->size()) return (*src)[bestCidx];
        }
    }
    return std::numeric_limits<float>::quiet_NaN();
}

} // namespace FieldSampler
```

### src/core/gradient_estimator.cpp
```
#include "core/gradient_estimator.h"
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <limits>
#include <unordered_set>

namespace gradient {

namespace {

inline bool solve3x3(const float ATA[3][3], const float ATb[3], glm::vec3& out) {
    // Invert 3x3 via adjugate; scale-relative singularity check for high-performance CFD
    // (extent may be 1e-6..1e6, so absolute 1e-12 is meaningless)
    const float a00=ATA[0][0], a01=ATA[0][1], a02=ATA[0][2];
    const float a11=ATA[1][1], a12=ATA[1][2];
    const float a22=ATA[2][2];
    const float det = a00*(a11*a22 - a12*a12) - a01*(a01*a22 - a12*a02) + a02*(a01*a12 - a11*a02);
    const float scale = std::max({std::abs(a00), std::abs(a11), std::abs(a22), 1e-12f});
    if (std::abs(det) < 1e-12f * scale*scale*scale) return false;
    const float invDet = 1.0f/det;
    const float b00 =  (a11*a22 - a12*a12);
    const float b01 = -(a01*a22 - a12*a02);
    const float b02 =  (a01*a12 - a11*a02);
    const float b11 =  (a00*a22 - a02*a02);
    const float b12 = -(a00*a12 - a01*a02);
    const float b22 =  (a00*a11 - a01*a01);
    out.x = invDet * (b00*ATb[0] + b01*ATb[1] + b02*ATb[2]);
    out.y = invDet * (b01*ATb[0] + b11*ATb[1] + b12*ATb[2]);
    out.z = invDet * (b02*ATb[0] + b12*ATb[1] + b22*ATb[2]);
    return true;
}

inline bool solve2x2(const float ATA2[2][2], const float ATb2[2], float& gx, float& gy) {
    const float det = ATA2[0][0]*ATA2[1][1] - ATA2[0][1]*ATA2[0][1];
    const float scale = std::max({std::abs(ATA2[0][0]), std::abs(ATA2[1][1]), 1e-12f});
    if (std::abs(det) < 1e-12f * scale*scale) return false;
    const float inv = 1.0f/det;
    gx = inv * ( ATA2[1][1]*ATb2[0] - ATA2[0][1]*ATb2[1]);
    gy = inv * (-ATA2[0][1]*ATb2[0] + ATA2[0][0]*ATb2[1]);
    return true;
}

bool solveLeastSquares(const std::vector<glm::vec3>& dX,
                       const std::vector<float>& dF,
                       glm::vec3& grad)
{
    if (dX.size() < 3 || dX.size()!=dF.size()) return false;
    float ATA[3][3] = {};
    float ATb[3] = {};
    for (size_t k=0;k<dX.size();++k){
        const auto &d = dX[k];
        const float b = dF[k];
        const float dist2 = d.x*d.x + d.y*d.y + d.z*d.z + 1e-12f;
        const float w = 1.0f / dist2; // inverse-distance weighting for stretched CFD meshes
        ATA[0][0] += w*d.x*d.x; ATA[0][1] += w*d.x*d.y; ATA[0][2] += w*d.x*d.z;
        ATA[1][1] += w*d.y*d.y; ATA[1][2] += w*d.y*d.z;
        ATA[2][2] += w*d.z*d.z;
        ATb[0] += w*d.x*b; ATb[1] += w*d.y*b; ATb[2] += w*d.z*b;
    }
    ATA[1][0]=ATA[0][1]; ATA[2][0]=ATA[0][2]; ATA[2][1]=ATA[1][2];
    if (solve3x3(ATA, ATb, grad)) return true;
    // Planar fallback for 2D VTI / thin plates: try 2D LSQ on dominant plane
    // Build 2x2 systems for XY, XZ, YZ and pick best conditioned
    {
        const float ATAxy[2][2] = {{ATA[0][0], ATA[0][1]}, {ATA[0][1], ATA[1][1]}};
        const float ATbxy[2] = {ATb[0], ATb[1]};
        float gx, gy;
        if (solve2x2(ATAxy, ATbxy, gx, gy)) { grad = glm::vec3(gx, gy, 0.0f); return true; }
    }
    {
        const float ATAxz[2][2] = {{ATA[0][0], ATA[0][2]}, {ATA[0][2], ATA[2][2]}};
        const float ATbxz[2] = {ATb[0], ATb[2]};
        float gx, gz;
        if (solve2x2(ATAxz, ATbxz, gx, gz)) { grad = glm::vec3(gx, 0.0f, gz); return true; }
    }
    {
        const float ATAyz[2][2] = {{ATA[1][1], ATA[1][2]}, {ATA[1][2], ATA[2][2]}};
        const float ATbyz[2] = {ATb[1], ATb[2]};
        float gy, gz;
        if (solve2x2(ATAyz, ATbyz, gy, gz)) { grad = glm::vec3(0.0f, gy, gz); return true; }
    }
    // Ridge regularization as last resort (thin sliver)
    {
        float scale = std::max({std::abs(ATA[0][0]), std::abs(ATA[1][1]), std::abs(ATA[2][2]), 1e-12f});
        float eps = 1e-6f * scale;
        ATA[0][0] += eps; ATA[1][1] += eps; ATA[2][2] += eps;
        if (solve3x3(ATA, ATb, grad)) return true;
    }
    return false;
}

} // anonymous (internal helper duplicated as static for class)

bool LeastSquaresEstimator::solveLeastSquares(const std::vector<glm::vec3>& dX,
                                              const std::vector<float>& dF,
                                              glm::vec3& grad)
{
    return ::gradient::solveLeastSquares(dX,dF,grad);
}

LeastSquaresEstimator::LeastSquaresEstimator(const RenderMesh& mesh): m_mesh(&mesh) {
    // For split meshes (post-normal split, 177 verts vs 125 logical points) the
    // LSQ field arrays are sized to sourcePointCount. Use logical count to avoid
    // zero-distance duplicate neighbors that make ATA singular and cause seam artifacts.
    const size_t vertN = mesh.vertices.size()/3;
    const bool isSplit = !mesh.vertexSourceIndex.empty()
                      && mesh.vertexSourceIndex.size()==vertN
                      && mesh.sourcePointCount>0
                      && (size_t)mesh.sourcePointCount <= vertN;
    if (isSplit) {
        m_pointCount = (size_t)mesh.sourcePointCount;
        // Build deduplicated logical positions for LSQ (first occurrence per source id)
        m_logicalVerts.resize(m_pointCount*3);
        std::vector<char> filled(m_pointCount, 0);
        for (size_t v=0; v<vertN; ++v) {
            uint32_t src = mesh.vertexSourceIndex[v];
            if (src < m_pointCount && !filled[src]) {
                m_logicalVerts[src*3+0] = mesh.vertices[v*3+0];
                m_logicalVerts[src*3+1] = mesh.vertices[v*3+1];
                m_logicalVerts[src*3+2] = mesh.vertices[v*3+2];
                filled[src]=1;
            }
        }
        // Fallback: if some ids never filled (should not happen), copy from front
        for (size_t i=0;i<m_pointCount;++i) if(!filled[i]) {
            m_logicalVerts[i*3+0]=mesh.vertices[0];
            m_logicalVerts[i*3+1]=mesh.vertices[1];
            m_logicalVerts[i*3+2]=mesh.vertices[2];
        }
    } else {
        m_pointCount = vertN;
    }
    if (m_pointCount==0) return;
    // Structured grids (ImageData/RectilinearGrid/STRUCTURED_GRID incl. curvilinear)
    // Use i,j,k 6-connectivity when dims match logical count — works for curvilinear via actual xyz.
    if (buildNeighborsStructured()) return;
    if (mesh.hasUnstructuredTopology()) {
        if (buildNeighborsFromTopology()) return;
    }
    if (!mesh.indices.empty()) {
        if (buildNeighborsFromIndices()) return;
    }
    buildNeighborsFromRadius();
}

bool LeastSquaresEstimator::buildNeighborsStructured(){
    int dX=m_mesh->gridDimX, dY=m_mesh->gridDimY, dZ=m_mesh->gridDimZ;
    // Need at least 2D structured (two dims >1). For 3D, all three.
    int dimsGT1 = (dX>1)+(dY>1)+(dZ>1);
    if (dimsGT1 < 2) return false;
    size_t expected = (size_t)dX*dY*dZ;
    if (expected != m_pointCount && (size_t)m_mesh->sourcePointCount != m_pointCount) {
        // For split meshes vertices may be duplicated; use sourcePointCount as true N
        if ((size_t)dX*dY*dZ != (size_t)m_mesh->sourcePointCount) return false;
        // For split case we cannot map i,j,k to vertices index directly; fall back to other methods
        return false;
    }
    if (expected != m_pointCount) return false;
    m_neighbors.assign(m_pointCount, {});
    auto idx=[&](int x,int y,int z){ return x + y*dX + z*dX*dY; };
    for(int z=0;z<dZ;++z) for(int y=0;y<dY;++y) for(int x=0;x<dX;++x){
        int n=idx(x,y,z);
        if(n<0|| (size_t)n>=m_pointCount) continue;
        if(x>0) m_neighbors[n].push_back(idx(x-1,y,z));
        if(x+1<dX) m_neighbors[n].push_back(idx(x+1,y,z));
        if(y>0) m_neighbors[n].push_back(idx(x,y-1,z));
        if(y+1<dY) m_neighbors[n].push_back(idx(x,y+1,z));
        if(z>0) m_neighbors[n].push_back(idx(x,y,z-1));
        if(z+1<dZ) m_neighbors[n].push_back(idx(x,y,z+1));
    }
    return true;
}

bool LeastSquaresEstimator::buildNeighborsFromTopology(){
    const auto& conn = m_mesh->cellConnectivity;
    const auto& off  = m_mesh->cellOffsets;
    if (conn.empty()||off.empty()) return false;
    m_neighbors.assign(m_pointCount, {});
    // For each cell, connect its points fully (clique)
    uint32_t start=0;
    for (size_t c=0;c<off.size();++c){
        uint32_t end = off[c];
        if (end>conn.size()) return false;
        for (uint32_t a=start;a<end;++a){
            uint32_t pa = conn[a];
            if (pa>=m_pointCount) continue;
            for (uint32_t b=start;b<end;++b){
                uint32_t pb = conn[b];
                if (pb>=m_pointCount||pb==pa) continue;
                m_neighbors[pa].push_back(pb);
            }
        }
        start=end;
    }
    // dedup + cap
    for (auto &nb: m_neighbors){
        std::sort(nb.begin(), nb.end());
        nb.erase(std::unique(nb.begin(), nb.end()), nb.end());
        if (nb.size()>32) nb.resize(32);
    }
    return true;
}

bool LeastSquaresEstimator::buildNeighborsFromIndices(){
    const auto& idx = m_mesh->indices;
    if (idx.size()<3) return false;
    m_neighbors.assign(m_pointCount, {});
    // Split meshes: indices are in split-vertex space (0..vertN-1) while the
    // LSQ field arrays are in logical point space (0..sourcePointCount-1).
    // Fold each index through vertexSourceIndex so the neighbor ring is the
    // TRUE mesh one-ring; without this the ring is incomplete (skipped tri
    // entries) and the estimator silently degrades to the radius-ball
    // heuristic, which is badly inaccurate on stretched boundary-layer meshes.
    const uint32_t* vmap = nullptr;
    if (!m_mesh->vertexSourceIndex.empty()
        && m_mesh->vertexSourceIndex.size() == m_mesh->vertices.size()/3
        && m_pointCount <= m_mesh->vertexSourceIndex.size()) {
        vmap = m_mesh->vertexSourceIndex.data();
    }
    for (size_t t=0; t+2<idx.size(); t+=3){
        uint32_t a=idx[t], b=idx[t+1], c=idx[t+2];
        if (vmap) {
            if (a>=m_mesh->vertexSourceIndex.size()||b>=m_mesh->vertexSourceIndex.size()||c>=m_mesh->vertexSourceIndex.size()) continue;
            a=vmap[a]; b=vmap[b]; c=vmap[c];
        }
        if (a>=m_pointCount||b>=m_pointCount||c>=m_pointCount) continue;
        m_neighbors[a].push_back(b); m_neighbors[a].push_back(c);
        m_neighbors[b].push_back(a); m_neighbors[b].push_back(c);
        m_neighbors[c].push_back(a); m_neighbors[c].push_back(b);
    }
    // expand to 2-ring for stability (one-ring may be only 6 for regular tri mesh)
    // simple: for each point, add neighbors-of-neighbors (capped)
    std::vector<std::vector<uint32_t>> expanded = m_neighbors;
    for (size_t i=0;i<m_pointCount;++i){
        std::unordered_set<uint32_t> s(expanded[i].begin(), expanded[i].end());
        for (uint32_t nb: m_neighbors[i]){
            if (nb>=m_neighbors.size()) continue;
            for (uint32_t nn: m_neighbors[nb]){
                if (nn!=i) s.insert(nn);
            }
        }
        expanded[i].assign(s.begin(), s.end());
        if (expanded[i].size()>24) expanded[i].resize(24);
    }
    m_neighbors.swap(expanded);
    return true;
}

bool LeastSquaresEstimator::buildNeighborsFromRadius(){
    // Adaptive radius for high-performance CFD: 3.5× avg spacing, clamped.
    // Works for 2D VTI (planar) and dense 12M unstructured via bucket.
    m_neighbors.assign(m_pointCount, {});
    const float* verts = vertData();
    const float extent = std::abs((float)m_mesh->bounds.extent);
    float avgSpacing = 1.0f;
    if (extent > 1e-6f && m_pointCount > 8) {
        // Detect planar 2D (depth/height/width collapse) → use sqrt, else cbrt
        const double dx = m_mesh->bounds.width(), dy = m_mesh->bounds.height(), dz = m_mesh->bounds.depth();
        const double minDim = std::min({dx, dy, dz});
        const bool planar = minDim < 1e-6 * extent;
        if (planar) avgSpacing = (float)(extent / std::sqrt((double)m_pointCount));
        else avgSpacing = (float)(extent / std::cbrt((double)m_pointCount));
    } else if (extent > 1e-6f) {
        avgSpacing = extent * 0.08f;
    }
    float radius = avgSpacing * 3.5f;
    if (extent > 1e-6f) radius = std::clamp(radius, extent*0.01f, extent*0.15f);
    else radius = 1.0f;
    const float r2 = radius*radius;
    // Build quantized grid to avoid O(N²) for large meshes: map posKey -> list
    std::unordered_map<uint64_t, std::vector<uint32_t>> buckets;
    buckets.reserve(m_pointCount*2);
    auto qKey = [&](float x,float y,float z)->uint64_t{
        int64_t qx = (int64_t)std::llround(x*4.0f);
        int64_t qy = (int64_t)std::llround(y*4.0f);
        int64_t qz = (int64_t)std::llround(z*4.0f);
        return ((uint64_t)(qx+ 1LL<<33)<<42) ^ ((uint64_t)(qy+ 1LL<<33)<<21) ^ (uint64_t)(qz+ 1LL<<33);
    };
    for (size_t i=0;i<m_pointCount;++i){
        buckets[qKey(verts[i*3], verts[i*3+1], verts[i*3+2])].push_back((uint32_t)i);
    }
    // For each point, collect neighbors within radius from own + adjacent buckets (expanded brute)
    for (size_t i=0;i<m_pointCount;++i){
        float xi=verts[i*3], yi=verts[i*3+1], zi=verts[i*3+2];
        // brute scan limited buckets: just check all points within radius² by scanning points with nearby bucket key not efficient,
        // fallback to brute over all points when N < 8000
        if (m_pointCount < 8000){
            for (size_t j=0;j<m_pointCount;++j) if(j!=i){
                float dx=verts[j*3]-xi, dy=verts[j*3+1]-yi, dz=verts[j*3+2]-zi;
                if (dx*dx+dy*dy+dz*dz < r2) m_neighbors[i].push_back((uint32_t)j);
                if (m_neighbors[i].size()>=24) break;
            }
        } else {
            // bucket check 27 neighboring quantized cells
            int64_t qx=(int64_t)std::llround(xi*4.0f), qy=(int64_t)std::llround(yi*4.0f), qz=(int64_t)std::llround(zi*4.0f);
            for(int dz=-1;dz<=1;++dz) for(int dy=-1;dy<=1;++dy) for(int dx=-1;dx<=1;++dx){
                auto it=buckets.find(qKey((qx+dx)/4.0f,(qy+dy)/4.0f,(qz+dz)/4.0f));
                if(it==buckets.end()) continue;
                for(uint32_t j: it->second){ if(j==i) continue; float ddx=verts[j*3]-xi,ddy=verts[j*3+1]-yi,ddz=verts[j*3+2]-zi; if(ddx*ddx+ddy*ddy+ddz*ddz < r2) m_neighbors[i].push_back(j); if(m_neighbors[i].size()>=24) break; } if(m_neighbors[i].size()>=24) break;
            }
        }
        if (m_neighbors[i].empty()){
            // ensure at least 4 nearest brute
            float best[4]={1e30f,1e30f,1e30f,1e30f}; int bestIdx[4]={-1,-1,-1,-1};
            for(size_t j=0;j<m_pointCount;++j) if(j!=i){
                float dx=verts[j*3]-xi, dy=verts[j*3+1]-yi, dz=verts[j*3+2]-zi; float d2=dx*dx+dy*dy+dz*dz;
                for(int k=0;k<4;++k) if(d2<best[k]){ for(int t=3;t>k;--t){best[t]=best[t-1]; bestIdx[t]=bestIdx[t-1];} best[k]=d2; bestIdx[k]=(int)j; break; }
            }
            for(int k=0;k<4;++k) if(bestIdx[k]>=0) m_neighbors[i].push_back((uint32_t)bestIdx[k]);
        }
    }
    return true;
}

bool LeastSquaresEstimator::estimate(size_t pid, const float* scalar, glm::vec3& gradOut) const {
    if (pid>=m_pointCount||!scalar||pid>=m_neighbors.size()) return false;
    const auto& nb = m_neighbors[pid];
    if (nb.size()<3) return false;
    const float* verts = vertData();
    glm::vec3 xi(verts[pid*3], verts[pid*3+1], verts[pid*3+2]);
    float pi = scalar[pid];
    std::vector<glm::vec3> dX; dX.reserve(nb.size());
    std::vector<float> dF; dF.reserve(nb.size());
    for(uint32_t j: nb){
        if (j>=m_pointCount) continue;
        glm::vec3 xj(verts[j*3], verts[j*3+1], verts[j*3+2]);
        dX.push_back(xj - xi);
        dF.push_back(scalar[j]-pi);
    }
    return solveLeastSquares(dX,dF,gradOut);
}

bool LeastSquaresEstimator::estimate(size_t pid, const glm::vec3* vec, GradTensors& g, const float* pressure) const {
    if (pid>=m_pointCount||!vec) return false;
    const auto& nb = m_neighbors[pid];
    if (nb.size()<3) return false;
    const float* verts = vertData();
    glm::vec3 xi(verts[pid*3], verts[pid*3+1], verts[pid*3+2]);
    std::vector<glm::vec3> dX; dX.reserve(nb.size());
    for(uint32_t j: nb){
        glm::vec3 xj(verts[j*3], verts[j*3+1], verts[j*3+2]);
        dX.push_back(xj - xi);
    }
    // Solve per component
    std::vector<float> dU,dV,dW;
    dU.reserve(nb.size()); dV.reserve(nb.size()); dW.reserve(nb.size());
    for(uint32_t j: nb){ dU.push_back(vec[j].x - vec[pid].x); dV.push_back(vec[j].y - vec[pid].y); dW.push_back(vec[j].z - vec[pid].z); }
    glm::vec3 gu,gv,gw;
    if (!solveLeastSquares(dX,dU,gu)) return false;
    if (!solveLeastSquares(dX,dV,gv)) return false;
    if (!solveLeastSquares(dX,dW,gw)) return false;
    g.dudx=gu.x; g.dudy=gu.y; g.dudz=gu.z;
    g.dvdx=gv.x; g.dvdy=gv.y; g.dvdz=gv.z;
    g.dwdx=gw.x; g.dwdy=gw.y; g.dwdz=gw.z;
    if (pressure){
        std::vector<float> dP; dP.reserve(nb.size());
        for(uint32_t j: nb) dP.push_back(pressure[j]-pressure[pid]);
        glm::vec3 gp;
        if (solveLeastSquares(dX,dP,gp)) g.gradP=gp;
    }
    return true;
}

void LeastSquaresEstimator::estimateAll(const glm::vec3* velocity, const float* pressure,
                                        std::vector<GradTensors>& out) const {
    out.assign(m_pointCount, GradTensors{});
    for(size_t i=0;i<m_pointCount;++i){
        GradTensors gt;
        if (velocity) estimate(i, velocity, gt, pressure);
        else if (pressure) { glm::vec3 gp; if(estimate(i, pressure, gp)) gt.gradP=gp; }
        out[i]=gt;
    }
}

} // namespace gradient
```

### src/core/gradient_estimator.h
```
#pragma once
// Deep module behind post_fields seam: gradient reconstruction for
// arbitrary meshes. Structured path uses weighted finite differences;
// unstructured path uses moving least-squares on 1-ring + spatial neighbors.

#include "core/mesh_loader.h"
#include <glm/glm.hpp>
#include <vector>

namespace gradient {

// 3x3 velocity gradient tensor + pressure gradient
struct GradTensors {
    // G = [ dudx dudy dudz
    //       dvdx dvdy dvdz
    //       dwdx dwdy dwdz ]
    float dudx=0,dudy=0,dudz=0;
    float dvdx=0,dvdy=0,dvdz=0;
    float dwdx=0,dwdy=0,dwdz=0;
    glm::vec3 gradP{0.0f};
};

// Least-squares gradient for unstructured / polydata meshes.
// Neighbors built from cell topology if present, else from triangle indices / radius search.
class LeastSquaresEstimator {
public:
    // Build once per mesh (captures positions, builds spatial index)
    explicit LeastSquaresEstimator(const RenderMesh& mesh);
    bool estimate(size_t pointId, const float* scalarField, glm::vec3& gradOut) const;
    bool estimate(size_t pointId, const glm::vec3* vectorField, GradTensors& g, const float* pressureField) const;
    // Batch for all points (post_fields convenience)
    void estimateAll(const glm::vec3* velocity, const float* pressure,
                     std::vector<GradTensors>& outTensors) const;
    size_t pointCount() const { return m_pointCount; }
private:
    const RenderMesh* m_mesh = nullptr;
    size_t m_pointCount = 0;
    std::vector<std::vector<uint32_t>> m_neighbors; // per-point neighbor ids (includes self-ring)
    // For split meshes (177 verts vs 125 logical points) store deduplicated positions
    // so LSQ dX is computed on logical points, not duplicated split verts (zero-dist).
    std::vector<float> m_logicalVerts; // size m_pointCount*3 when split, empty otherwise
    const float* vertData() const { return m_logicalVerts.empty() ? m_mesh->vertices.data() : m_logicalVerts.data(); }
    // Fallback spatial: uniform grid for radius search when topology absent
    bool buildNeighborsStructured();
    bool buildNeighborsFromTopology();
    bool buildNeighborsFromIndices();
    bool buildNeighborsFromRadius();
    static bool solveLeastSquares(const std::vector<glm::vec3>& dX,
                                  const std::vector<float>& dF,
                                  glm::vec3& grad);
};

} // namespace gradient
```

### src/core/isosurface.cpp
```
#include "core/isosurface.h"
#include "core/mesh_loader.h"
#include "core/cell_topology.h"
#include "core/FieldStore.h"
#include "core/unstructured_volume.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>
#include <limits>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>

namespace isosurface {

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Isosurface extraction via marching cubes.
//
// Design: the algorithm is TABLE-FREE. Rather than the 256-entry edgeTable /
// 256x16 triTable (whose verbatim transcription is a classic source of subtle
// topology bugs), each cube cell is processed directly:
//   1. Classify the 8 corner nodes as high/low by (scalar >= isovalue).
//   2. For each of the 12 edges, if the endpoints straddle the isovalue,
//      interpolate a surface vertex on that edge. Vertices are shared across
//      cells via an edge -> vertex map (keyed by the grid edge, so adjacent
//      cells reuse the same vertex -> a watertight, duplicate-free manifold).
//   3. The crossed-edge vertices of a cell are partitioned into closed
//      loops by walking face adjacency (2 crossings on a face pair
//      directly; 4 = ambiguous saddle paired by the face-center decider,
//      which agrees from both sides of a shared face). Each loop is
//      angle-sorted around its centroid (projected onto the loop's
//      best-fit plane) and fan-triangulated — disjoint loops are never
//      bridged, so no open-edge holes.
//   3b. Bitwise-identical vertices are welded (node-on-level degeneracy:
//      a node with value == iso emits one vertex per incident edge at the
//      exact node position); collapsed triangles are dropped.
//   4. Per-vertex normals come from mesh_utils::computeNormals (shared vertex
//      positions => correctly averaged; sharp-edge split preserved).
//
// This is equivalent to marching cubes for every non-ambiguous cell. Ambiguous
// saddle cells (a checkerboard face, ~16 cell configs) resolve with the
// conventional single-fan diagonal rather than an asymptotic decider -- a
// documented, acceptable trade-off yielding a valid closed surface.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

struct EdgeDef { int lowerRel; int axis; };

static int nodeIndexOf(int x, int y, int z, int dX, int dY, int /*dZ*/) {
    return x + y * dX + z * dX * dY;
}

bool canExtract(const RenderMesh& volumeMesh, const std::string& field, int placement,
                const postfields::ComputedSnapshot* snap) {
    if (volumeMesh.vertices.empty()) return false;
    // Structured grids use the IJK node layout; an unstructured mesh needs its
    // volume cells (and a real 3D AABB) instead.
    if (!volumeMesh.hasVolumeGrid() && !volume::eligible(volumeMesh)) return false;
    float mn, mx;
    auto p = placement == 1 ? FieldStore::Placement::CellCenter : FieldStore::Placement::Vertex;
    auto altP = placement == 1 ? FieldStore::Placement::Vertex : FieldStore::Placement::CellCenter;
    if (FieldStore::scalarData(volumeMesh, field, mn, mx, p, snap)) return true;
    if (FieldStore::scalarData(volumeMesh, field, mn, mx, altP, snap)) return true;
    // Also check derived via scalarData already covers it; final fallback to hasScalarData
    if (snap && snap->scalars.find(field) != snap->scalars.end()) return true;
    return volumeMesh.hasScalarData();
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Dense edge-vertex cache: O(1) direct-index instead of unordered_map.
// Each grid edge is uniquely identified by (lowerMinNode, axis) -> index = nA*3+axis.
// Uses generation tagging to clear in O(1) per contour (no O(numNodes) fill).
// Falls back to no-cache when numNodes is huge to avoid 500MB+ allocation.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
struct EdgeVertexCache {
    static constexpr uint32_t kSentinel = std::numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max();
    // Threshold: 64M nodes *3 = 192M entries. 192M * (4+4) ~1.5GB -> too large.
    // Use dense only up to ~48M nodes (~144M edges ~ ~1.1GB). Above that use hash fallback.
    // In practice most volumes are < 256^3 (16M nodes).
    static constexpr size_t kDenseNodeLimit = 48'000'000;

    std::vector<uint32_t> verts; // size numNodes*3, value = vertex index
    std::vector<uint32_t> tags;  // generation tag per slot
    uint32_t curGen = 1;
    bool useDense = false;
    size_t numNodes = 0;

    bool init(size_t nNodes) {
        numNodes = nNodes;
        if (nNodes == 0 || nNodes > kDenseNodeLimit) {
            useDense = false;
            return false;
        }
        const size_t need = nNodes * 3;
        // Guard against size_t overflow / bad alloc
        if (need / 3 != nNodes) { useDense = false; return false; }
        try {
            verts.assign(need, kSentinel);
            tags.assign(need, 0);
            curGen = 1;
            useDense = true;
        } catch (const std::bad_alloc&) {
            verts.clear(); tags.clear();
            useDense = false;
        }
        return useDense;
    }

    inline void nextContour() {
        if (!useDense) return;
        ++curGen;
        if (curGen == 0) { // wrapped (2^32 contours extremely unlikely)
            std::fill(tags.begin(), tags.end(), 0);
            curGen = 1;
        }
        // No fill of verts needed — tags gate validity.
    }

    inline bool find(uint32_t nA, int axis, uint32_t &out) const {
        if (!useDense) return false;
        const size_t idx = static_cast<size_t>(nA) * 3 + static_cast<size_t>(axis);
        if (idx >= tags.size()) return false;
        if (tags[idx] == curGen) { out = verts[idx]; return true; }
        return false;
    }

    inline void insert(uint32_t nA, int axis, uint32_t vi) {
        if (!useDense) return;
        const size_t idx = static_cast<size_t>(nA) * 3 + static_cast<size_t>(axis);
        if (idx >= verts.size()) return;
        verts[idx] = vi;
        tags[idx] = curGen;
    }
};

static void triangulateFan(RenderMesh& out,
                           const uint32_t* cellVerts, int nVerts,
                           const float gradN[3]) {
    // Best-fit plane normal: normalized mean of pairwise cross(v_i - C).
    // nVerts <=12 so O(n^2) <=66 pairs is trivial; keep order-independent fit.
    float C[3] = {0, 0, 0};
    for (int i = 0; i < nVerts; ++i) {
        const float* v = &out.vertices[cellVerts[i] * 3];
        C[0] += v[0]; C[1] += v[1]; C[2] += v[2];
    }
    C[0] /= nVerts; C[1] /= nVerts; C[2] /= nVerts;

    float N[3] = {0, 0, 0};
    for (int i = 0; i < nVerts; ++i) {
        const float* vi = &out.vertices[cellVerts[i] * 3];
        for (int j = i + 1; j < nVerts; ++j) {
            const float* vj = &out.vertices[cellVerts[j] * 3];
            float a[3] = {vi[0]-C[0], vi[1]-C[1], vi[2]-C[2]};
            float b[3] = {vj[0]-C[0], vj[1]-C[1], vj[2]-C[2]};
            N[0] += a[1]*b[2] - a[2]*b[1];
            N[1] += a[2]*b[0] - a[0]*b[2];
            N[2] += a[0]*b[1] - a[1]*b[0];
        }
    }
    float nlen = std::sqrt(N[0]*N[0] + N[1]*N[1] + N[2]*N[2]);
    if (nlen < 1e-9f) { N[0]=0; N[1]=0; N[2]=1; nlen=1; }
    N[0]/=nlen; N[1]/=nlen; N[2]/=nlen;

    if (N[0]*gradN[0] + N[1]*gradN[1] + N[2]*gradN[2] < 0) {
        N[0] = -N[0]; N[1] = -N[1]; N[2] = -N[2];
    }

    float U[3] = { std::fabs(N[0]) < 0.9f ? 1.0f : 0.0f,
                   std::fabs(N[0]) < 0.9f ? 0.0f : 1.0f, 0.0f };
    float V[3];
    V[0] = N[1]*U[2] - N[2]*U[1];
    V[1] = N[2]*U[0] - N[0]*U[2];
    V[2] = N[0]*U[1] - N[1]*U[0];
    float vlen = std::sqrt(V[0]*V[0]+V[1]*V[1]+V[2]*V[2]);
    if (vlen < 1e-9f) {
        if (std::fabs(N[0]) < 0.9f) { U[0]=1;U[1]=0;U[2]=0; } else { U[0]=0;U[1]=1;U[2]=0; }
        V[0]=N[1]*U[2]-N[2]*U[1]; V[1]=N[2]*U[0]-N[0]*U[2]; V[2]=N[0]*U[1]-N[1]*U[0];
        vlen = std::sqrt(V[0]*V[0]+V[1]*V[1]+V[2]*V[2]);
    }
    if (vlen < 1e-9f) {
        U[0]=0;U[1]=1;U[2]=0;
        V[0]=N[1]*U[2]-N[2]*U[1]; V[1]=N[2]*U[0]-N[0]*U[2]; V[2]=N[0]*U[1]-N[1]*U[0];
        vlen=1.0f;
    }
    V[0]/=vlen; V[1]/=vlen; V[2]/=vlen;
    U[0] = N[1]*V[2] - N[2]*V[1];
    U[1] = N[2]*V[0] - N[0]*V[2];
    U[2] = N[0]*V[1] - N[1]*V[0];

    // Angle-sort without trig: sort by quadrant+cross (avoids atan2 per vertex).
    struct Item { uint32_t vi; float u; float v; };
    Item items[12];
    for (int i = 0; i < nVerts; ++i) {
        const float* vv = &out.vertices[cellVerts[i] * 3];
        float dx = vv[0]-C[0], dy = vv[1]-C[1], dz = vv[2]-C[2];
        items[i].vi = cellVerts[i];
        items[i].u = dx*U[0]+dy*U[1]+dz*U[2];
        items[i].v = dx*V[0]+dy*V[1]+dz*V[2];
    }
    auto half = [](const Item& p) -> int {
        // atan2 half-plane: 0 = upper (v>0 or v==0&&u>0)
        if (p.v > 0) return 0;
        if (p.v < 0) return 1;
        return (p.u < 0) ? 1 : 0;
    };
    std::sort(items, items + nVerts, [&](const Item& a, const Item& b){
        int ha = half(a), hb = half(b);
        if (ha != hb) return ha < hb;
        float cross = a.u * b.v - a.v * b.u;
        if (cross != 0) return cross > 0;
        // tie: closer to center first (stable)
        float da = a.u*a.u + a.v*a.v;
        float db = b.u*b.u + b.v*b.v;
        return da < db;
    });

    for (int i = 1; i + 1 < nVerts; ++i) {
        out.indices.push_back(items[0].vi);
        out.indices.push_back(items[i].vi);
        out.indices.push_back(items[i+1].vi);
    }
}


namespace {

// Shared tail for both extractors: weld coincident vertices, drop collapsed
// triangles, derive smooth normals, compute bounds and name the surface.
void finalizeSurface(RenderMesh& result, const std::string& inheritedScalarName,
                     const std::string& field) {
    if (result.vertices.empty()) return;

    // Weld bitwise-identical vertices. Node-on-level degeneracy (a grid
    // node whose value == iso) makes every incident crossed edge emit a
    // vertex at the exact node position under distinct indices — identical
    // coordinates that read as open edges. Exact matching is zero-risk
    // (never merges legitimately distinct vertices); near-misses stay
    // closed slivers topologically. Drops degenerate tris + compacts.
    {
        const size_t nv0 = result.vertices.size() / 3;
        std::vector<uint32_t> remap(nv0);
        {
            struct Key { uint32_t x, y, z; uint32_t i; };
            std::vector<Key> keys;
            keys.reserve(nv0);
            // Canonicalize -0.0 to +0.0: arithmetically identical positions
            // must hash identically or the weld silently misses.
            auto canon = [](uint32_t b) { return b == 0x80000000u ? 0u : b; };
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < nv0; ++i) {
                uint32_t b[3];
                std::memcpy(b, &result.vertices[i * 3], 12);
                keys.push_back({canon(b[0]), canon(b[1]), canon(b[2]), i});
            }
            std::sort(keys.begin(), keys.end(), [](const Key& a, const Key& b) {
                if (a.x != b.x) return a.x < b.x;
                if (a.y != b.y) return a.y < b.y;
                if (a.z != b.z) return a.z < b.z;
                return a.i < b.i;
            });
            uint32_t rep = 0;
            for (size_t k = 0; k < keys.size(); ++k) {
                if (k > 0 && (keys[k].x != keys[k-1].x || keys[k].y != keys[k-1].y || keys[k].z != keys[k-1].z))
                    ++rep;
                remap[keys[k].i] = rep;
            }
            const uint32_t nUnique = keys.empty() ? 0 : rep + 1;
            if (nUnique < nv0) {
                std::vector<float> nv_(nUnique * 3), ns_(nUnique), nn_(nUnique * 3, 0.0f);
                std::vector<char> seen(nUnique, 0);
                for (uint32_t i = 0; i < nv0; ++i) {
                    const uint32_t r = remap[i];
                    if (!seen[r]) {
                        seen[r] = 1;
                        nv_[r*3] = result.vertices[i*3];
                        nv_[r*3+1] = result.vertices[i*3+1];
                        nv_[r*3+2] = result.vertices[i*3+2];
                        ns_[r] = result.scalars[i];
                    }
                }
                result.vertices.swap(nv_);
                result.scalars.swap(ns_);
                result.normals.assign(nUnique * 3, 0.0f);
                std::vector<uint32_t> ni;
                ni.reserve(result.indices.size());
                for (size_t t = 0; t + 2 < result.indices.size(); t += 3) {
                    const uint32_t a = remap[result.indices[t]];
                    const uint32_t b = remap[result.indices[t+1]];
                    const uint32_t c = remap[result.indices[t+2]];
                    if (a == b || b == c || a == c) continue; // collapsed
                    ni.push_back(a); ni.push_back(b); ni.push_back(c);
                }
                result.indices.swap(ni);
            }
        }
    }

    if (result.indices.empty()) { result.vertices.clear(); result.scalars.clear(); result.normals.clear(); return; }

    {
        const size_t nv = result.vertices.size() / 3;
        const size_t nt = result.indices.size() / 3;
        result.normals.assign(nv * 3, 0.0f);
        for (size_t t = 0; t < nt; ++t) {
            uint32_t i0 = result.indices[t*3], i1 = result.indices[t*3+1], i2 = result.indices[t*3+2];
            float v0x = result.vertices[i0*3], v0y = result.vertices[i0*3+1], v0z = result.vertices[i0*3+2];
            float v1x = result.vertices[i1*3], v1y = result.vertices[i1*3+1], v1z = result.vertices[i1*3+2];
            float v2x = result.vertices[i2*3], v2y = result.vertices[i2*3+1], v2z = result.vertices[i2*3+2];
            float e1x = v1x - v0x, e1y = v1y - v0y, e1z = v1z - v0z;
            float e2x = v2x - v0x, e2y = v2y - v0y, e2z = v2z - v0z;
            float nx = e1y*e2z - e1z*e2y, ny = e1z*e2x - e1x*e2z, nz = e1x*e2y - e1y*e2x;
            float len = std::sqrt(nx*nx+ny*ny+nz*nz);
            if (len < 1e-12f) continue;
            nx/=len; ny/=len; nz/=len;
            for (uint32_t idx : {i0,i1,i2}) { result.normals[idx*3]+=nx; result.normals[idx*3+1]+=ny; result.normals[idx*3+2]+=nz; }
        }
        for (size_t v = 0; v < nv; ++v) {
            float nx = result.normals[v*3], ny = result.normals[v*3+1], nz = result.normals[v*3+2];
            float len = std::sqrt(nx*nx+ny*ny+nz*nz);
            if (len > 1e-12f) { result.normals[v*3]=nx/len; result.normals[v*3+1]=ny/len; result.normals[v*3+2]=nz/len; }
            else { result.normals[v*3]=0; result.normals[v*3+1]=0; result.normals[v*3+2]=1; }
        }
        result.vertexSourceIndex.clear();
        result.vertexSourceIndex.reserve(nv);
        for (size_t i=0;i<nv;++i) result.vertexSourceIndex.push_back(static_cast<int>(i));
    }
    mesh_utils::computeBounds(result);

    // Explicit field wins; otherwise inherit the source mesh's name (which
    // the dual-grid path already set to the contoured cell field).
    result.scalarName = field.empty() ? inheritedScalarName : field;
    result.availableScalarNames = result.scalarName.empty()
        ? std::vector<std::string>{}
        : std::vector<std::string>{result.scalarName};
    // Trim over-reserved capacity after extraction
    result.vertices.shrink_to_fit();
    result.indices.shrink_to_fit();
    result.normals.shrink_to_fit();
    result.scalars.shrink_to_fit();
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Marching tetrahedra over an unstructured mesh's volume cells.
//
// Every cell is decomposed by cell_topology::tets(). Faces are triangulated
// from the smallest *global* vertex id, so two incident cells split their
// shared face identically. Together with welding crossing vertices by the
// global id pair of their edge, that keeps the surface watertight across cell
// boundaries. Centroid edges get a virtual id per cell, so they weld within a
// cell (as they must) but never across cells.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
RenderMesh extractUnstructured(const RenderMesh& volumeMesh,
                               const std::vector<float>& isovalues,
                               const std::string& field,
                               int placement,
                               const postfields::ComputedSnapshot* snap) {
    RenderMesh result;
    if (isovalues.empty()) return result;

    const std::size_t nCells = volumeMesh.cellOffsets.size();
    const std::size_t nVerts = volumeMesh.vertices.size() / 3;
    if (nCells == 0 || nVerts == 0) return result;
    const std::size_t virtualBase = volumeMesh.sourcePointCount > 0
        ? static_cast<std::size_t>(volumeMesh.sourcePointCount)
        : nVerts;

    // Resolve the field into per-vertex values. Cell-centred data has no
    // crossing inside a cell (it is constant there), so it is averaged to the
    // nodes first -- the same approximation as the structured dual grid, made
    // explicit here.
    std::vector<float> pointValues;
    std::vector<float> scratch;
    const std::vector<float>* values = nullptr;
    float mn = 0.0f, mx = 1.0f;

    if (placement == 1) {
        const std::string effField = field.empty()
            ? FieldStore::resolveActiveScalar(volumeMesh, "", FieldStore::Placement::CellCenter, snap)
            : field;
        const std::vector<float>* cells = nullptr;
        if (!effField.empty() && volumeMesh.attributes) {
            auto it = volumeMesh.attributes->cellScalars.find(effField);
            if (it != volumeMesh.attributes->cellScalars.end() && it->second.size() >= nCells) {
                cells = &it->second;
                auto rit = volumeMesh.attributes->cellScalarRanges.find(effField);
                if (rit != volumeMesh.attributes->cellScalarRanges.end()) {
                    mn = rit->second.first;
                    mx = rit->second.second;
                }
            }
        }
        if (cells) {
            pointValues = mesh_utils::extrapolateCellToPoints<float>(
                volumeMesh, *cells, nCells, virtualBase);
            values = &pointValues;
        } else {
            // No exact per-cell storage: fall back to the point copy.
            placement = 0;
        }
    }

    if (placement != 1) {
        const std::vector<float>* cand =
            FieldStore::scalarData(volumeMesh, field, mn, mx, FieldStore::Placement::Vertex, snap);
        if ((!cand || cand->empty()) && !volumeMesh.scalars.empty()) cand = &volumeMesh.scalars;
        if (!cand) return result;
        if (!volume::sourcePointValues(volumeMesh, *cand, scratch, values) || !values) return result;
    }
    if (!values || values->size() < virtualBase) return result;

    const float* verts = volumeMesh.vertices.data();

    static const int kTetEdges[6][2] = {
        {0, 1}, {1, 2}, {2, 0}, {0, 3}, {1, 3}, {2, 3},
    };

    // Edge -> extracted-vertex cache. The key is the unordered global id pair,
    // so both incident cells hit the same entry.
    std::unordered_map<uint64_t, uint32_t> vertexCache;

    std::vector<std::array<std::uint32_t, 4>> tets;
    std::array<std::uint32_t, 8> gid{};
    std::array<float, 9> cval{};

    for (float iso : isovalues) {
        vertexCache.clear();

        for (std::size_t c = 0; c < nCells; ++c) {
            const std::uint8_t type = volumeMesh.cellTypes[c];
            if (!cell_topology::isVolumeCell(type)) continue;

            const std::uint32_t begin = (c == 0) ? 0u : volumeMesh.cellOffsets[c - 1];
            const std::uint32_t end = volumeMesh.cellOffsets[c];
            const int corners = cell_topology::cornerCount(type);
            if (end <= begin) continue;
            if (static_cast<std::size_t>(end - begin) < static_cast<std::size_t>(corners)) continue;

            std::array<double, 3> centroid{0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
            double cornerValueSum = 0.0;
            bool ok = true;
            for (int k = 0; k < corners; ++k) {
                const std::uint32_t id =
                    volumeMesh.cellConnectivity[begin + static_cast<std::size_t>(k)];
                if (id >= virtualBase || id >= nVerts) { ok = false; break; }
                gid[static_cast<std::size_t>(k)] = id;
                cval[static_cast<std::size_t>(k)] = (*values)[id];
                centroid[0] += verts[id * 3];
                centroid[1] += verts[id * 3 + 1];
                centroid[2] += verts[id * 3 + 2];
                cornerValueSum += static_cast<double>((*values)[id]);
            }
            if (!ok) continue;
            for (double& v : centroid) v /= static_cast<double>(corners);
            cval[static_cast<std::size_t>(corners)] =
                static_cast<float>(cornerValueSum / static_cast<double>(corners));

            tets.clear();
            cell_topology::tets(type,
                std::span<const std::uint32_t>(
                    volumeMesh.cellConnectivity.data() + begin,
                    static_cast<std::size_t>(corners)),
                tets);
            if (tets.empty()) continue;

            for (const auto& tet : tets) {
                // Reconstruct the tet's four corners in global space. Slots
                // point into the cell corner array; the centroid slot maps to
                // a per-cell virtual id so it welds inside the cell only.
                std::uint32_t tGid[4];
                float tVal[4];
                std::array<double, 3> tPos[4];
                for (int j = 0; j < 4; ++j) {
                    const std::uint32_t slot = tet[static_cast<std::size_t>(j)];
                    if (slot < static_cast<std::uint32_t>(corners)) {
                        tGid[j] = gid[slot];
                        tVal[j] = cval[slot];
                        tPos[j] = {verts[tGid[j] * 3], verts[tGid[j] * 3 + 1],
                                   verts[tGid[j] * 3 + 2]};
                    } else {
                        tGid[j] = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(virtualBase + c);
                        tVal[j] = cval[static_cast<std::size_t>(corners)];
                        tPos[j] = centroid;
                    }
                }

                bool inside[4];
                int insideCount = 0;
                for (int j = 0; j < 4; ++j) {
                    inside[j] = (tVal[j] >= iso);
                    if (inside[j]) ++insideCount;
                }
                if (insideCount == 0 || insideCount == 4) continue;

                // Direction from the sub-iso region to the supra-iso region:
                // always points along increasing scalar, so the emitted
                // winding (and therefore the smooth normal) faces outward.
                double gx = 0.0, gy = 0.0, gz = 0.0;
                for (int j = 0; j < 4; ++j) {
                    const double s = inside[j] ? 1.0 : -1.0;
                    gx += s * tPos[j][0];
                    gy += s * tPos[j][1];
                    gz += s * tPos[j][2];
                }
                float gradN[3] = {static_cast<float>(gx), static_cast<float>(gy),
                                  static_cast<float>(gz)};

                uint32_t crossVerts[4];
                int nCross = 0;
                for (int e = 0; e < 6; ++e) {
                    const int a = kTetEdges[e][0];
                    const int b = kTetEdges[e][1];
                    if (inside[a] == inside[b]) continue;

                    std::uint32_t lo = tGid[a], hi = tGid[b];
                    float vLo = tVal[a], vHi = tVal[b];
                    std::array<double, 3> pLo = tPos[a], pHi = tPos[b];
                    if (lo > hi) {
                        std::swap(lo, hi);
                        std::swap(vLo, vHi);
                        std::swap(pLo, pHi);
                    }
                    const uint64_t key = (static_cast<uint64_t>(lo) << 32) | hi;

                    auto it = vertexCache.find(key);
                    if (it != vertexCache.end()) {
                        crossVerts[nCross++] = it->second;
                        continue;
                    }

                    float t = 0.5f;
                    const float denom = vHi - vLo;
                    if (std::fabs(denom) > 1e-12f) {
                        t = (iso - vLo) / denom;
                        t = std::clamp(t, 0.0f, 1.0f);
                    }
                    const size_t base = result.vertices.size();
                    if (t <= 0.0f) {
                        result.vertices.push_back(static_cast<float>(pLo[0]));
