### src/fvm/AMG.cpp
```
#include "fvm/AMG.h"

#include <Eigen/Cholesky>
#include <Eigen/SparseLU>
#include <Eigen/LU>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <iostream>
#include <limits>
#include <numeric>
#include <random>
#include <unordered_set>

namespace fvm {

using SparseMatrixRM = Eigen::SparseMatrix<double, Eigen::RowMajor>;

void AMGHierarchy::build(const SparseMatrix& A) {
    levels_.clear();
    if (A.rows() == 0 || A.cols() == 0) return;

    SparseMatrix currentA = A;

    for (int level = 0; level < config_.maxLevels; ++level) {
        const int n = static_cast<int>(currentA.rows());

        if (n <= config_.minCoarseSize) {
            AMGLevel coarseLevel;
            coarseLevel.ARM = currentA;
            levels_.push_back(std::move(coarseLevel));
            break;
        }

        std::vector<std::vector<int>> strongNeighbors;
        strengthOfConnection(currentA, strongNeighbors);

        std::vector<int> cfSplit;
        int nCoarse = 0;
        if (config_.coarseningType == CoarseningType::RS) {
            rsCoarsening(strongNeighbors, cfSplit, nCoarse);
        } else {
            pmisCoarsening(strongNeighbors, cfSplit, nCoarse);
        }

        if (nCoarse == 0 || nCoarse >= n || static_cast<double>(nCoarse) >= 0.9 * n) {
            AMGLevel coarseLevel;
            coarseLevel.ARM = currentA;
            levels_.push_back(std::move(coarseLevel));
            break;
        }

        SparseMatrix P;
        if (config_.interpolationType == InterpolationType::Extended) {
            extendedInterpolation(currentA, strongNeighbors, cfSplit, nCoarse, P);
        } else {
            directInterpolation(currentA, strongNeighbors, cfSplit, nCoarse, P);
        }

        truncateInterpolation(P);

        AMGLevel lvl;
        lvl.ARM = currentA;
        lvl.P = P;
        lvl.R = P.transpose();
        lvl.cfSplit = std::move(cfSplit);
        lvl.nCoarse = nCoarse;
        levels_.push_back(std::move(lvl));

        SparseMatrix Ac = galerkinProduct(currentA, P);
        currentA = Ac;
    }
}

void AMGHierarchy::strengthOfConnection(const SparseMatrix& A,
                                         std::vector<std::vector<int>>& strongNeighbors) const {
    const int n = static_cast<int>(A.rows());
    strongNeighbors.assign(n, {});

    const double theta = config_.strengthThreshold;
    // Use RowMajor view for correct row-wise strong connections (A is ColMajor)
    SparseMatrixRM AR = A;
    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        double maxOffDiag = 0.0;
        // First pass: find max without allocation
        for (SparseMatrixRM::InnerIterator it(AR, i); it; ++it) {
            if (static_cast<int>(it.col()) != i) {
                double absVal = std::abs(it.value());
                if (absVal > maxOffDiag) maxOffDiag = absVal;
            }
        }
        if (maxOffDiag == 0.0) continue;
        const double threshold = theta * maxOffDiag;
        // Use stack-local buffer and assign (not swap with thread_local) to avoid aliasing
        std::vector<int> strongBuf;
        strongBuf.reserve(8);
        for (SparseMatrixRM::InnerIterator it(AR, i); it; ++it) {
            int j = static_cast<int>(it.col());
            if (j == i) continue;
            if (std::abs(it.value()) >= threshold) strongBuf.push_back(j);
        }
        std::sort(strongBuf.begin(), strongBuf.end());
        strongNeighbors[i] = std::move(strongBuf);
    }
}

void AMGHierarchy::rsCoarsening(const std::vector<std::vector<int>>& strongNeighbors,
                                 std::vector<int>& cfSplit, int& nCoarse) const {
    const int n = static_cast<int>(strongNeighbors.size());
    cfSplit.assign(n, 0);

    std::vector<double> weights(n);
    std::mt19937 rng;
    if (config_.rngSeed == 0) {
        std::random_device rd;
        rng.seed(rd());
    } else {
        // Mix seed with problem size to escape pathological traps while keeping determinism
        std::seed_seq seq{static_cast<unsigned int>(config_.rngSeed),
                          static_cast<unsigned int>(n),
                          static_cast<unsigned int>(strongNeighbors.size())};
        rng.seed(seq);
    }
    std::uniform_real_distribution<double> dist(0.0, 1.0);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) weights[i] = dist(rng);

    std::vector<int> state(n, 0);

    for (int pass = 0; pass < 2; ++pass) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            if (state[i] == 1) continue;

            bool isMax = true;
            for (int j : strongNeighbors[i]) {
                if (j < 0 || j >= n) continue;
                if (weights[j] > weights[i]) {
                    isMax = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!isMax) continue;

            bool neighborIsMax = false;
            for (int j : strongNeighbors[i]) {
                if (j < 0 || j >= n) continue;
                if (weights[j] == weights[i] && j < i) {
                    neighborIsMax = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (neighborIsMax) continue;

            cfSplit[i] = 1;
            state[i] = 1;
            for (int j : strongNeighbors[i]) {
                if (j >= 0 && j < n && state[j] == 0) {
                    state[j] = -1;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            if (state[i] == -1) state[i] = 0;
        }
    }

    bool changed = true;
    while (changed) {
        changed = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            if (cfSplit[i] == 1) continue;

            bool hasStrongC = false;
            for (int j : strongNeighbors[i]) {
                if (j >= 0 && j < n && cfSplit[j] == 1) {
                    hasStrongC = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!hasStrongC) {
                double bestWeight = -1.0;
                int bestNeighbor = -1;
                for (int j : strongNeighbors[i]) {
                    if (j >= 0 && j < n && weights[j] > bestWeight) {
                        bestWeight = weights[j];
                        bestNeighbor = j;
                    }
                }
                if (bestNeighbor >= 0 && cfSplit[bestNeighbor] == 0) {
                    cfSplit[bestNeighbor] = 1;
                    changed = true;
                } else {
                    cfSplit[i] = 1;
                    changed = true;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    nCoarse = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (cfSplit[i] == 1) ++nCoarse;
    }
}

void AMGHierarchy::pmisCoarsening(const std::vector<std::vector<int>>& strongNeighbors,
                                   std::vector<int>& cfSplit, int& nCoarse) const {
    const int n = static_cast<int>(strongNeighbors.size());
    cfSplit.assign(n, 0);

    std::vector<double> weights(n);
    std::mt19937 rng;
    if (config_.rngSeed == 0) {
        std::random_device rd;
        rng.seed(rd());
    } else {
        std::seed_seq seq{static_cast<unsigned int>(config_.rngSeed),
                          static_cast<unsigned int>(n * 1315423911u + 2654435761u),
                          static_cast<unsigned int>(strongNeighbors.size())};
        rng.seed(seq);
    }
    std::uniform_real_distribution<double> dist(0.0, 1.0);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) weights[i] = dist(rng);

    std::vector<int> color(n, 0);

    for (int pass = 0; pass < 2; ++pass) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            if (color[i] != 0) continue;

            bool isMax = true;
            for (int j : strongNeighbors[i]) {
                if (j < 0 || j >= n) continue;
                if (weights[j] > weights[i]) {
                    isMax = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!isMax) continue;

            bool neighborIsMax = false;
            for (int j : strongNeighbors[i]) {
                if (j < 0 || j >= n) continue;
                if (weights[j] == weights[i] && j < i) {
                    neighborIsMax = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (neighborIsMax) continue;

            cfSplit[i] = 1;
            color[i] = 1;
            for (int j : strongNeighbors[i]) {
                if (j >= 0 && j < n && color[j] == 0) {
                    color[j] = -1;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            if (color[i] == -1) color[i] = 0;
        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (cfSplit[i] == 1) continue;

        bool hasStrongC = false;
        for (int j : strongNeighbors[i]) {
            if (j >= 0 && j < n && cfSplit[j] == 1) {
                hasStrongC = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (!hasStrongC) {
            double bestWeight = -1.0;
            int bestNeighbor = -1;
            for (int j : strongNeighbors[i]) {
                if (j >= 0 && j < n && weights[j] > bestWeight) {
                    bestWeight = weights[j];
                    bestNeighbor = j;
                }
            }
            if (bestNeighbor >= 0) {
                cfSplit[bestNeighbor] = 1;
            } else {
                cfSplit[i] = 1;
            }
        }
    }

    nCoarse = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (cfSplit[i] == 1) ++nCoarse;
    }
}

void AMGHierarchy::directInterpolation(const SparseMatrix& A,
                                        const std::vector<std::vector<int>>& strongNeighbors,
                                        const std::vector<int>& cfSplit, int nCoarse,
                                        SparseMatrix& P) const {
    const int n = static_cast<int>(A.rows());
    P.resize(n, nCoarse);
    P.reserve(Eigen::VectorXi::Constant(n, 4));

    std::vector<int> coarseIndex(n, -1);
    int idx = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (cfSplit[i] == 1) {
            coarseIndex[i] = idx++;
        }
    }

    thread_local std::vector<Triplet> triplets;
    triplets.clear();
    triplets.reserve(n * 4);
    SparseMatrixRM AR = A;

    auto isStrong = [&](int i, int j) -> bool {
        const auto& s = strongNeighbors[i];
        return std::binary_search(s.begin(), s.end(), j);
    };

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (cfSplit[i] == 1) {
            triplets.emplace_back(i, coarseIndex[i], 1.0);
        } else {
            std::vector<int> cStrong;
            cStrong.reserve(8);
            double aii = 0.0;
            double sumWeak = 0.0;
            // Collect row values once to avoid second scan for aij
            std::vector<std::pair<int,double>> rowVals;
            rowVals.reserve(16);
            for (SparseMatrixRM::InnerIterator it(AR, i); it; ++it) {
                int j = static_cast<int>(it.col());
                double v = it.value();
                rowVals.emplace_back(j, v);
                if (j == i) aii = v;
                else if (cfSplit[j] == 1 && isStrong(i, j)) cStrong.push_back(j);
                else if (j != i && cfSplit[j] != 1) sumWeak += v;
            }

            if (cStrong.empty()) {
                // Try weak C neighbor fallback before arbitrary col 0
                int fallback = -1;
                double bestAbs = 0.0;
                for (auto& [j, v] : rowVals) {
                    if (j != i && cfSplit[j] == 1 && std::abs(v) > bestAbs) {
                        bestAbs = std::abs(v);
                        fallback = j;
                    }
                }
                if (fallback >= 0) triplets.emplace_back(i, coarseIndex[fallback], 1.0);
                else triplets.emplace_back(i, 0, 1.0);
            } else {
                double denom = aii;
                if (std::abs(sumWeak) > 1e-30) denom -= sumWeak;
                if (std::abs(denom) < 1e-30) {
                    int fallback = cStrong[0];
                    triplets.emplace_back(i, coarseIndex[fallback], 1.0);
                } else {
                    for (int j : cStrong) {
                        double aij = 0.0;
                        for (auto& [col, val] : rowVals) if (col == j) { aij = val; break; }
                        double val = -aij / denom;
                        if (std::abs(val) > 1e-15) triplets.emplace_back(i, coarseIndex[j], val);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    P.setFromTriplets(triplets.begin(), triplets.end());
    P.makeCompressed();
}

void AMGHierarchy::extendedInterpolation(const SparseMatrix& A,
                                          const std::vector<std::vector<int>>& strongNeighbors,
                                          const std::vector<int>& cfSplit, int nCoarse,
                                          SparseMatrix& P) const {
    const int n = static_cast<int>(A.rows());
    P.resize(n, nCoarse);
    P.reserve(Eigen::VectorXi::Constant(n, 8));

    std::vector<int> coarseIndex(n, -1);
    int idx = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) if (cfSplit[i] == 1) coarseIndex[i] = idx++;

    thread_local std::vector<Triplet> triplets;
    triplets.clear();
    triplets.reserve(n * 8);
    SparseMatrixRM AR = A;

    auto isStrong = [&](int i, int j) -> bool {
        const auto& s = strongNeighbors[i];
        return std::binary_search(s.begin(), s.end(), j);
    };

    // Cache row values for fast aij lookup (degree small)
    std::vector<std::vector<std::pair<int,double>>> rowCache(n);
    // Lazy build: fill only when needed for i or k that is F, but we can build on demand
    // Pre-build for all rows that are F-adjacent to avoid repeated scans
    // Simple: build on the fly with thread-local cache; for now scan directly via AR

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (cfSplit[i] == 1) {
            triplets.emplace_back(i, coarseIndex[i], 1.0);
            continue;
        }

        // First scan of row i
        double aii = 0.0, sumWeak = 0.0;
        std::vector<int> cStrong; cStrong.reserve(8);
        std::vector<std::pair<int,double>> rowI;
        rowI.reserve(16);
        for (SparseMatrixRM::InnerIterator it(AR, i); it; ++it) {
            int j = static_cast<int>(it.col());
            double v = it.value();
            rowI.emplace_back(j, v);
            if (j == i) aii = v;
            else if (cfSplit[j] == 1 && isStrong(i, j)) cStrong.push_back(j);
            else if (j != i && cfSplit[j] != 1) sumWeak += v;
        }

        // Build extended set: distance-2 via strong F neighbors
        std::vector<int> cExtended; cExtended.reserve(8);
        // Deduplicate via small sort+unique rather than unordered_set
        std::vector<int> seenMark; seenMark.reserve(16);
        for (int k : strongNeighbors[i]) {
            if (k < 0 || k >= n || cfSplit[k] != 0) continue;
            double aik = 0.0;
            for (auto& [col, val] : rowI) if (col == k) { aik = val; break; }
            if (std::abs(aik) < 1e-30) continue;
            for (int c : strongNeighbors[k]) {
                if (c < 0 || c >= n || cfSplit[c] != 1) continue;
                if (isStrong(i, c)) continue;
                // Check sumAkc for row k
                double sumAkc = 0.0;
                for (SparseMatrixRM::InnerIterator it(AR, k); it; ++it) {
                    int j = static_cast<int>(it.col());
                    if (cfSplit[j] == 1 && isStrong(i, j)) sumAkc += it.value();
                }
                if (std::abs(sumAkc) > 1e-30) cExtended.push_back(c);
            }
        }
        if (!cExtended.empty()) {
            std::sort(cExtended.begin(), cExtended.end());
            cExtended.erase(std::unique(cExtended.begin(), cExtended.end()), cExtended.end());
        }

        if (cStrong.empty() && cExtended.empty()) {
            // Fallback to weak C or col 0
            int fallback = -1;
            double bestAbs = 0.0;
            for (auto& [j, v] : rowI) if (cfSplit[j] == 1 && std::abs(v) > bestAbs) { bestAbs = std::abs(v); fallback = j; }
            if (fallback >= 0) triplets.emplace_back(i, coarseIndex[fallback], 1.0);
            else triplets.emplace_back(i, 0, 1.0);
        } else {
            double denom = aii;
            if (std::abs(sumWeak) > 1e-30) denom -= sumWeak;
            if (std::abs(denom) < 1e-30) {
                int fb = cStrong.empty() ? cExtended[0] : cStrong[0];
                triplets.emplace_back(i, coarseIndex[fb], 1.0);
            } else {
                for (int j : cStrong) {
                    double aij = 0.0;
                    for (auto& [col, val] : rowI) if (col == j) { aij = val; break; }
                    double val = -aij / denom;
                    if (std::abs(val) > 1e-15) triplets.emplace_back(i, coarseIndex[j], val);
                }
                // Second pass: compute distance-2 contributions using cached rowI and rowK
                for (int c : cExtended) {
                    double aij_dist2 = 0.0;
                    for (int k : strongNeighbors[i]) {
                        if (k < 0 || k >= n || cfSplit[k] != 0) continue;
                        double aik = 0.0;
                        for (auto& [col, val] : rowI) if (col == k) { aik = val; break; }
                        if (std::abs(aik) < 1e-30) continue;
                        double akc = 0.0, sumAkc = 0.0;
                        for (SparseMatrixRM::InnerIterator it(AR, k); it; ++it) {
                            int j = static_cast<int>(it.col());
                            double v = it.value();
                            if (j == c) akc = v;
                            if (cfSplit[j] == 1 && isStrong(i, j)) sumAkc += v;
                        }
                        if (std::abs(sumAkc) > 1e-30) aij_dist2 += aik * akc / sumAkc;
                    }
                    double val = -aij_dist2 / denom;
                    if (std::abs(val) > 1e-15) triplets.emplace_back(i, coarseIndex[c], val);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    P.setFromTriplets(triplets.begin(), triplets.end());
    P.makeCompressed();
}

void AMGHierarchy::truncateInterpolation(SparseMatrix& P) const {
    const double eps = config_.truncThreshold;
    const bool doDrop = (eps > 0.0 && eps < 1.0);

    const int n = static_cast<int>(P.rows());
    // Row-major view for efficient row-wise truncation; move-assign back avoids extra copy
    SparseMatrixRM PRM = P;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        double maxVal = 0.0;
        for (SparseMatrixRM::InnerIterator it(PRM, i); it; ++it) maxVal = std::max(maxVal, std::abs(it.value()));
        if (maxVal < 1e-30) continue;
        double threshold = doDrop ? (eps * maxVal) : 0.0;
        double rowSum = 0.0;
        int count = 0;
        for (SparseMatrixRM::InnerIterator it(PRM, i); it; ++it) {
            double v = it.value();
            if (std::abs(v) >= threshold) { rowSum += v; ++count; }
        }
        // Always enforce partition-of-unity (row sum = 1) so interpolation
        // reproduces the constant null space of the Poisson operator. Hypre's
        // classical interpolation is constructed to satisfy P*1 = 1; without this
        // normalization the coarse grid degrades for constant fields.
        if (count > 0 && std::abs(rowSum) > 1e-30) {
            double scale = 1.0 / rowSum;
            for (SparseMatrixRM::InnerIterator it(PRM, i); it; ++it) {
                if (std::abs(it.value()) < threshold) it.valueRef() = 0.0;
                else it.valueRef() *= scale;
            }
        }
    }
    PRM.prune(0.0);
    PRM.makeCompressed();
    P = std::move(PRM);
}

void AMGHierarchy::updateFineValues(const SparseMatrix& A) {
    // Coarse levels depend on A through the Galerkin product, so a value-only
    // update of the fine level is unsound. Rebuild the full hierarchy so that
    // strength/interpolation and the Galerkin coarse operator stay consistent
    // with the current matrix values (e.g. momentum matrices in transient SIMPLE).
    build(A);
}

SparseMatrix AMGHierarchy::galerkinProduct(const SparseMatrix& A, const SparseMatrix& P) const {
    SparseMatrix AP = A * P;
    SparseMatrix Ac = P.transpose() * AP;
    if (config_.galerkinDropTol > 0.0) {
        Ac.prune(config_.galerkinDropTol);
    }
    Ac.makeCompressed();
    return Ac;
}

void AMGHierarchy::gaussSeidel(const SparseMatrixRM& ARM, const Eigen::VectorXd& b,
                                Eigen::VectorXd& x, int numSweeps, bool forward) const {
    const int n = static_cast<int>(ARM.rows());
    // Cache diagonal positions to avoid per-sweep scan
    std::vector<int> diagPos(n, -1);
    std::vector<double> diagVal(n, 0.0);
    int missingDiagCount = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (SparseMatrixRM::InnerIterator it(ARM, i); it; ++it) {
            if (static_cast<int>(it.col()) == i) { diagPos[i] = 1; diagVal[i] = it.value(); break; }
        }
        if (diagPos[i] < 0) ++missingDiagCount;
    }
    // Structural hole (e.g., isolated Dirichlet coarse node) is expected for pressure
    // reference cell and handled via damped Jacobi fallback — no warning.
    (void)missingDiagCount;

    // Clamp omega into a range that keeps the standalone smoother convergent.
    double omega = config_.smootherOmega;
    if (!(omega > 0.0) || omega > 1.0) omega = 1.0;

    for (int sweep = 0; sweep < numSweeps; ++sweep) {
        for (int k = 0; k < n; ++k) {
            const int i = forward ? k : (n - 1 - k);
            double diag = diagVal[i];
            if (diagPos[i] < 0 || std::abs(diag) < 1e-30) {
                diag = 0.0;
                for (SparseMatrixRM::InnerIterator it(ARM, i); it; ++it) if (static_cast<int>(it.col()) == i) { diag = it.value(); break; }
                if (std::abs(diag) < 1e-30) {
                    x(i) = 0.5 * x(i) + 0.5 * b(i);
                    continue;
                }
                diagVal[i] = diag;
                diagPos[i] = 1;
            }
            double sigma = 0.0;
            for (SparseMatrixRM::InnerIterator it(ARM, i); it; ++it) {
                int j = static_cast<int>(it.col());
                if (j != i) sigma += it.value() * x(j);
            }
            const double gs = (b(i) - sigma) / diag;
            // omega == 1 -> plain Gauss-Seidel
            x(i) = (omega == 1.0) ? gs : x(i) + omega * (gs - x(i));
        }
    }
}

void AMGHierarchy::smoothPre_(const SparseMatrixRM& ARM, const Eigen::VectorXd& b,
                              Eigen::VectorXd& x, int numSweeps) const {
    if (numSweeps <= 0) return;
    switch (config_.smootherType) {
        case SmootherType::ForwardGaussSeidel:
        case SmootherType::ForwardSOR:
            // Forward only: the sweep order defines the iteration for a
            // nonsymmetric operator, so a forward pre-sweep is paired with a
            // forward post-sweep to keep a fixed linear preconditioner.
            gaussSeidel(ARM, b, x, numSweeps, true);
            return;
        case SmootherType::SymmetricGaussSeidel:
        default:
            gaussSeidel(ARM, b, x, numSweeps, true);
            gaussSeidel(ARM, b, x, numSweeps, false);
            return;
    }
}

void AMGHierarchy::smoothPost_(const SparseMatrixRM& ARM, const Eigen::VectorXd& b,
                               Eigen::VectorXd& x, int numSweeps) const {
    if (numSweeps <= 0) return;
    switch (config_.smootherType) {
        case SmootherType::ForwardGaussSeidel:
        case SmootherType::ForwardSOR:
            gaussSeidel(ARM, b, x, numSweeps, true);
            return;
        case SmootherType::SymmetricGaussSeidel:
        default:
            gaussSeidel(ARM, b, x, numSweeps, false);
            return;
    }
}


void AMGHierarchy::vCycle(int level, const Eigen::VectorXd& b, Eigen::VectorXd& x) const {
    const AMGLevel& lvl = levels_[level];
    const int n = static_cast<int>(lvl.ARM.rows());

    if (level == static_cast<int>(levels_.size()) - 1) {
        const SparseMatrixRM& Ac = lvl.ARM;
        const int nc = static_cast<int>(Ac.rows());

        if (nc <= 30) {
            Eigen::MatrixXd denseA = Eigen::MatrixXd::Zero(nc, nc);
            for (int i = 0; i < nc; ++i) {
                for (SparseMatrixRM::InnerIterator it(Ac, i); it; ++it) {
                    denseA(i, static_cast<int>(it.col())) = it.value();
                }
            }
            Eigen::VectorXd bc(nc);
            for (int i = 0; i < nc; ++i) bc(i) = b(i);
            // Use FullPivLU for robustness on small coarse (handles non-SPD)
            x = denseA.fullPivLu().solve(bc);
            if (!x.allFinite()) x = denseA.ldlt().solve(bc);
        } else {
            bool isSymmetric = false;
            if (Ac.rows() == Ac.cols()) {
                SparseMatrixRM At = Ac.transpose();
                At = At - Ac;
                double nrm = Ac.norm();
                isSymmetric = (nrm < 1e-30) || (At.norm() < 1e-12 * nrm);
            }
            if (isSymmetric) {
                Eigen::SimplicialLDLT<SparseMatrixRM> ldl;
                ldl.compute(Ac);
                if (ldl.info() == Eigen::Success && ldl.vectorD().minCoeff() > 0) {
                    Eigen::VectorXd xt = ldl.solve(b);
                    double bnorm = b.norm();
                    double rnorm = (Ac * xt - b).norm();
                    // Tight verification: require true SPD solve, not loose 1e6
                    if (xt.allFinite() && rnorm < 100.0 * config_.tolerance * (bnorm + 1.0)) { x = xt; return; }
                }
            }
            Eigen::SparseLU<SparseMatrixRM> lu;
            lu.compute(Ac);
            if (lu.info() == Eigen::Success) x = lu.solve(b);
            else x = b;
        }
        return;
    }

    smoothPre_(lvl.ARM, b, x, config_.preSweeps);

    Eigen::VectorXd residual = b - lvl.ARM * x;
    Eigen::VectorXd rCoarse = lvl.R * residual;

    Eigen::VectorXd eCoarse = Eigen::VectorXd::Zero(rCoarse.size());
    vCycle(level + 1, rCoarse, eCoarse);

    x += lvl.P * eCoarse;

    smoothPost_(lvl.ARM, b, x, config_.postSweeps);
}

void AMGHierarchy::fCycle(int level, const Eigen::VectorXd& b, Eigen::VectorXd& x) const {
    const AMGLevel& lvl = levels_[level];

    if (level == static_cast<int>(levels_.size()) - 1) {
        const SparseMatrixRM& Ac = lvl.ARM;
        const int nc = static_cast<int>(Ac.rows());

        if (nc <= 30) {
            Eigen::MatrixXd denseA = Eigen::MatrixXd::Zero(nc, nc);
            for (int i = 0; i < nc; ++i) {
                for (SparseMatrixRM::InnerIterator it(Ac, i); it; ++it) {
                    denseA(i, static_cast<int>(it.col())) = it.value();
                }
            }
            Eigen::VectorXd bc(nc);
            for (int i = 0; i < nc; ++i) bc(i) = b(i);
            x = denseA.fullPivLu().solve(bc);
            if (!x.allFinite()) x = denseA.ldlt().solve(bc);
        } else {
            bool isSymmetric = false;
            if (Ac.rows() == Ac.cols()) {
                SparseMatrixRM At = Ac.transpose();
                At = At - Ac;
                double nrm = Ac.norm();
                isSymmetric = (nrm < 1e-30) || (At.norm() < 1e-12 * nrm);
            }
            if (isSymmetric) {
                Eigen::SimplicialLDLT<SparseMatrixRM> ldl;
                ldl.compute(Ac);
                if (ldl.info() == Eigen::Success && ldl.vectorD().minCoeff() > 0) {
                    Eigen::VectorXd xt = ldl.solve(b);
                    double bnorm = b.norm();
                    double rnorm = (Ac * xt - b).norm();
                    if (xt.allFinite() && rnorm < 100.0 * config_.tolerance * (bnorm + 1.0)) { x = xt; return; }
                }
            }
            Eigen::SparseLU<SparseMatrixRM> lu;
            lu.compute(Ac);
            if (lu.info() == Eigen::Success) x = lu.solve(b);
            else x = b;
        }
        return;
    }

    smoothPre_(lvl.ARM, b, x, config_.preSweeps);

    Eigen::VectorXd residual = b - lvl.ARM * x;
    Eigen::VectorXd rCoarse = lvl.R * residual;

    Eigen::VectorXd eCoarse = Eigen::VectorXd::Zero(rCoarse.size());
    fCycle(level + 1, rCoarse, eCoarse);

    x += lvl.P * eCoarse;

    smoothPost_(lvl.ARM, b, x, config_.postSweeps);

    // Second stage is intentionally V-cycle (standard F-cycle = F + V), not recursive F.
    // Changing this to fCycle would make cost O(2^levels) instead of O(levels).
    residual = b - lvl.ARM * x;
    rCoarse = lvl.R * residual;
    eCoarse.setZero();
    vCycle(level + 1, rCoarse, eCoarse);

    x += lvl.P * eCoarse;

    smoothPost_(lvl.ARM, b, x, config_.postSweeps);
}

void AMGHierarchy::cycle(int level, const Eigen::VectorXd& b, Eigen::VectorXd& x) const {
    if (config_.cycleType == CycleType::F) {
        fCycle(level, b, x);
    } else {
        vCycle(level, b, x);
    }
}

void AMGHierarchy::applyCycle(const Eigen::VectorXd& b, Eigen::VectorXd& x) const {
    if (levels_.empty()) { x = b; return; }
    // x is the caller's current guess and is NOT discarded: the cycle is a
    // stationary iteration on top of it, so calling applyCycle repeatedly
    // applies multiple cycles (AMGPreconditioner::setCycles).
    cycle(0, b, x);
}

bool AMGHierarchy::solve(const Eigen::VectorXd& b, Eigen::VectorXd& x) const {
    if (levels_.empty()) return false;

    const int n = static_cast<int>(levels_[0].ARM.rows());
    if (x.size() != n) {
        x.resize(n);
        x.setZero();
    } else if (!x.allFinite()) {
        x.setZero();
    }

    double bnorm = b.norm();
    if (bnorm < 1e-30) {
        x.setZero();
        return true;
    }

    double prevResidual = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();

    for (int iter = 0; iter < config_.maxIterations; ++iter) {
        cycle(0, b, x);

        double residual = (b - levels_[0].ARM * x).norm();
        double relResidual = residual / bnorm;

        if (relResidual < config_.tolerance) {
            return true;
        }

        if (residual > prevResidual * config_.stagnationFactor && iter >= config_.stagnationMinIter) {
            return relResidual < config_.tolerance * config_.stagnationLooseFactor;
        }
        prevResidual = residual;
    }

    return (b - levels_[0].ARM * x).norm() / bnorm < config_.tolerance * config_.stagnationLooseFactor;
}

} // namespace fvm
```

### src/fvm/AMG.h
```
#pragma once

#include "fvm/Types.h"
#include <Eigen/Sparse>
#include <Eigen/SparseLU>
#include <vector>
#include <cstddef>
#include <iostream>

namespace fvm {

struct AMGLevel {
    SparseMatrix P;
    SparseMatrix R;
    Eigen::SparseMatrix<double, Eigen::RowMajor> ARM;
    std::vector<int> cfSplit;
    int nCoarse = 0;
};

class AMGHierarchy {
public:
    enum class CoarseningType { RS, PMIS };
    enum class InterpolationType { Direct, Extended };
    enum class CycleType { V, F };
    // Smoother choice. The momentum (convection-diffusion) matrix is
    // nonsymmetric even for an SPD-looking operator, and forward+backward
    // Gauss-Seidel is only guaranteed convergent for SPD systems. For
    // nonsymmetric operators use forward-only GS, or forward SOR with
    // omega < 1 which is more robust (AGMG/Notay pick omega heuristically).
    enum class SmootherType { SymmetricGaussSeidel, ForwardGaussSeidel, ForwardSOR };

    struct Config {
        CoarseningType coarseningType = CoarseningType::RS;
        InterpolationType interpolationType = InterpolationType::Extended;
        CycleType cycleType = CycleType::F;
        SmootherType smootherType = SmootherType::SymmetricGaussSeidel;
        // Relaxation for ForwardSOR. 1.0 degenerates to plain Gauss-Seidel.
        // Values above 1 can make the standalone smoother divergent on
        // nonsymmetric operators, so the default stays conservative.
        double smootherOmega = 1.0;
        double strengthThreshold = 0.25;
        double truncThreshold = 0.2;
        int maxLevels = 30;
        int minCoarseSize = 10;
        int preSweeps = 2;
        int postSweeps = 2;
        int maxIterations = 100;
        double tolerance = 1e-8;
        // Hardening options (address silent-failure observations)
        int rngSeed = 42; // 0 = nondeterministic (random_device)
        double stagnationFactor = 1.05;
        int stagnationMinIter = 10;
        double stagnationLooseFactor = 5.0;
        double galerkinDropTol = 1e-12;
    };

    AMGHierarchy() = default;
    explicit AMGHierarchy(Config config) : config_(config) {}

    void build(const SparseMatrix& A);

    bool solve(const Eigen::VectorXd& b, Eigen::VectorXd& x) const;

    // One multigrid cycle applied to the caller's current guess `x`. Pass a
    // zeroed x for an independent cycle; calling it repeatedly on the growing
    // x applies multiple cycles. Never discards the incoming x.
    void applyCycle(const Eigen::VectorXd& b, Eigen::VectorXd& x) const;

    bool isBuilt() const { return !levels_.empty(); }
    void invalidate() { levels_.clear(); }
    void setConfig(Config config) { config_ = config; }
    void updateFineValues(const SparseMatrix& A);

    int numLevels() const { return static_cast<int>(levels_.size()); }
    int fineSize() const { return levels_.empty() ? 0 : static_cast<int>(levels_[0].ARM.rows()); }

private:
    Config config_;
    std::vector<AMGLevel> levels_;

    void strengthOfConnection(const SparseMatrix& A, std::vector<std::vector<int>>& strongNeighbors) const;

    void rsCoarsening(const std::vector<std::vector<int>>& strongNeighbors,
                      std::vector<int>& cfSplit, int& nCoarse) const;

    void pmisCoarsening(const std::vector<std::vector<int>>& strongNeighbors,
                        std::vector<int>& cfSplit, int& nCoarse) const;

    void directInterpolation(const SparseMatrix& A,
                             const std::vector<std::vector<int>>& strongNeighbors,
                             const std::vector<int>& cfSplit, int nCoarse,
                             SparseMatrix& P) const;

    void extendedInterpolation(const SparseMatrix& A,
                               const std::vector<std::vector<int>>& strongNeighbors,
                               const std::vector<int>& cfSplit, int nCoarse,
                               SparseMatrix& P) const;

    void truncateInterpolation(SparseMatrix& P) const;

    SparseMatrix galerkinProduct(const SparseMatrix& A, const SparseMatrix& P) const;

    void vCycle(int level, const Eigen::VectorXd& b, Eigen::VectorXd& x) const;

    void fCycle(int level, const Eigen::VectorXd& b, Eigen::VectorXd& x) const;

    void cycle(int level, const Eigen::VectorXd& b, Eigen::VectorXd& x) const;

    // Direction-aware smoother. `forward == true` sweeps i = 0..n-1 only
    // (correct for nonsymmetric operators); `forward == false` sweeps in
    // reverse and, combined with a preceding forward sweep, gives symmetric
    // Gauss-Seidel (only valid for SPD). omega implements SOR on the
    // diagonal: x_i = x_i + omega * ((b_i - sigma)/a_ii - x_i).
    void gaussSeidel(const Eigen::SparseMatrix<double, Eigen::RowMajor>& ARM,
                     const Eigen::VectorXd& b, Eigen::VectorXd& x,
                     int numSweeps, bool forward) const;

    // Pre/post smoothing according to config_.smootherType. For the
    // nonsymmetric variants both are forward sweeps so the composed
    // preconditioner stays a fixed linear operator.
    void smoothPre_(const Eigen::SparseMatrix<double, Eigen::RowMajor>& ARM,
                    const Eigen::VectorXd& b, Eigen::VectorXd& x, int numSweeps) const;
    void smoothPost_(const Eigen::SparseMatrix<double, Eigen::RowMajor>& ARM,
                     const Eigen::VectorXd& b, Eigen::VectorXd& x, int numSweeps) const;
};

class AMGPreconditioner {
public:
    AMGPreconditioner() : amg_(nullptr) {}

    void setAMG(const AMGHierarchy* amg) { amg_ = amg; }

    // Multigrid cycles applied per preconditioner application. More cycles
    // make the preconditioner stronger at proportional cost; 1 (a single
    // V/F-cycle) is the usual choice for a Krylov preconditioner.
    void setCycles(int cycles) { cycles_ = cycles < 1 ? 1 : cycles; }

    template<typename MatrixType>
    void analyzePattern(const MatrixType&) const {}

    template<typename MatrixType>
    void factorize(const MatrixType&) const {}

    template<typename MatrixType>
    void compute(const MatrixType&) const {}

    inline Eigen::ComputationInfo info() const { return Eigen::Success; }

    template<typename Rhs>
    inline const Rhs solve(const Rhs& b) const {
        Eigen::VectorXd b_vec = b;
        Eigen::VectorXd x_vec = Eigen::VectorXd::Zero(b_vec.rows());
        if (amg_ && amg_->isBuilt()) {
            for (int i = 0; i < cycles_; ++i) amg_->applyCycle(b_vec, x_vec);
        }
        return x_vec;
    }

    template<typename Rhs>
    inline void solveInPlace(Rhs& x) const {
        if (amg_ && amg_->isBuilt()) {
            Rhs b = x;
            x.setZero();
            for (int i = 0; i < cycles_; ++i) amg_->applyCycle(b, x);
        }
    }

    inline int rows() const { return amg_ ? amg_->fineSize() : 0; }
    inline int cols() const { return amg_ ? amg_->fineSize() : 0; }

private:
    const AMGHierarchy* amg_;
    int cycles_ = 1;
};

} // namespace fvm
```

### src/fvm/BoundaryConditions.cpp
```
#include "fvm/BoundaryConditions.h"
#include "mesh/BoundaryUtils.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <iostream>

namespace fvm {

template<std::size_t Dim>
BoundaryConditions<Dim>::BoundaryConditions(const Mesh<Dim>& mesh, double k)
    : mesh_(mesh), k_(k), bc_(mesh) {
    dirichletMask_.assign(mesh.nCells(), 0);
    dirichletValues_.assign(mesh.nCells(), 0.0);
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void BoundaryConditions<Dim>::setWall(std::size_t d, int sign, BCType type, double value) {
    if (type == BCType::Dirichlet) {
        bc_.setVelocityBC(d, sign, VelocityBCType::Inlet, value, value, value);
    } else {
        bc_.setVelocityBC(d, sign, VelocityBCType::Outlet, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
        neumannWalls_.push_back({d, sign, value});
    }
    bcsConfigured_ = false;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void BoundaryConditions<Dim>::setMin(std::size_t d, BCType type, double value) {
    if (type == BCType::Dirichlet) {
        bc_.setVelocityBC(d, -1, VelocityBCType::Inlet, value, value, value);
    } else {
        bc_.setVelocityBC(d, -1, VelocityBCType::Outlet, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
        neumannWalls_.push_back({d, -1, value});
    }
    bcsConfigured_ = false;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void BoundaryConditions<Dim>::setMax(std::size_t d, BCType type, double value) {
    if (type == BCType::Dirichlet) {
        bc_.setVelocityBC(d, +1, VelocityBCType::Inlet, value, value, value);
    } else {
        bc_.setVelocityBC(d, +1, VelocityBCType::Outlet, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
        neumannWalls_.push_back({d, +1, value});
    }
    bcsConfigured_ = false;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void BoundaryConditions<Dim>::addPatch(const std::string& name,
                                       std::size_t d, int sign,
                                       BCType type, double value) {
    if (type == BCType::Dirichlet) {
        bc_.addVelocityPatch(name, d, sign, VelocityBCType::Inlet, value, value, value);
    } else {
        bc_.addVelocityPatch(name, d, sign, VelocityBCType::Outlet, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
        neumannWalls_.push_back({d, sign, value});
    }
    bcsConfigured_ = false;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
bool BoundaryConditions<Dim>::bcsConfigured() const { return bcsConfigured_; }

template<std::size_t Dim>
const Patch* BoundaryConditions<Dim>::findPatch(const std::string& name) const {
    const VelocityPatch* vp = bc_.findVelocityPatch(name);
    if (!vp) return nullptr;
    patchesCache_.push_back(toPatch(*vp));
    return &patchesCache_.back();
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
BCType BoundaryConditions<Dim>::patchType(const std::string& name) const {
    const VelocityPatch* p = bc_.findVelocityPatch(name);
    if (!p) return BCType::Dirichlet;
    return (p->type == VelocityBCType::Inlet || p->type == VelocityBCType::MovingWall)
           ? BCType::Dirichlet : BCType::Neumann;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
double BoundaryConditions<Dim>::patchValue(const std::string& name) const {
    const VelocityPatch* p = bc_.findVelocityPatch(name);
    return p ? p->u : 0.0;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
const std::vector<Patch>& BoundaryConditions<Dim>::patches() const {
    patchesCache_.clear();
    for (const auto& vp : bc_.velocityPatches()) {
        patchesCache_.push_back(toPatch(vp));
    }
    return patchesCache_;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void BoundaryConditions<Dim>::buildDirichletMask() {
    disc_ = bc_.build();

    std::fill(dirichletMask_.begin(), dirichletMask_.end(), char(0));
    std::fill(dirichletValues_.begin(), dirichletValues_.end(), 0.0);

    for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) {
        const auto& mask = disc_.dirichletMask(d);
        const auto& vals = disc_.dirichletVals(d);
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < mesh_.nCells(); ++i) {
            if (mask[i]) {
                dirichletMask_[i] = 1;
                dirichletValues_[i] = vals[i];
            }
        }
    }

    for (const auto& [f, value] : faceDirichlet_) {
        std::size_t cell = mesh_.owner(f);
        dirichletMask_[cell] = 1;
        dirichletValues_[cell] = value;
    }

    bcsConfigured_ = true;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
const std::vector<char>& BoundaryConditions<Dim>::dirichletMask() const {
    return dirichletMask_;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
const std::vector<double>& BoundaryConditions<Dim>::dirichletValues() const {
    return dirichletValues_;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void BoundaryConditions<Dim>::setDirichletOnFaces(const std::vector<std::size_t>& faceIndices,
                                                  double value) {
    for (std::size_t f : faceIndices) {
        if (f >= mesh_.nFaces()) {
            std::cerr << "BoundaryConditions: face index " << f
                      << " exceeds nFaces (" << mesh_.nFaces() << ")\n";
            continue;
        }
        if (mesh_.neighbor(f) != std::size_t(-1)) {
            std::cerr << "BoundaryConditions: face " << f
                      << " is not a boundary face, skipping Dirichlet BC\n";
            continue;
        }
        faceDirichlet_.emplace_back(f, value);
    }
    bcsConfigured_ = false;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void BoundaryConditions<Dim>::setNeumannOnFaces(const std::vector<std::size_t>& faceIndices,
                                                double flux) {
    for (std::size_t f : faceIndices) {
        if (f >= mesh_.nFaces()) {
            std::cerr << "BoundaryConditions: face index " << f
                      << " exceeds nFaces (" << mesh_.nFaces() << ")\n";
            continue;
        }
        if (mesh_.neighbor(f) != std::size_t(-1)) {
            std::cerr << "BoundaryConditions: face " << f
                      << " is not a boundary face, skipping Neumann BC\n";
            continue;
        }
        faceNeumann_.emplace_back(f, flux);
    }
    bcsConfigured_ = false;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void BoundaryConditions<Dim>::addNeumannContributions(Eigen::VectorXd& b) const {
    for (const auto& [f, flux] : faceNeumann_) {
        std::size_t cell = mesh_.owner(f);
        b(cell) += k_ * flux * mesh_.faceArea(f);
    }
    for (const auto& nw : neumannWalls_) {
        if (nw.sign == -1) addNeumannMin_(nw.d, nw.flux, b);
        else addNeumannMax_(nw.d, nw.flux, b);
    }
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
const Mesh<Dim>& BoundaryConditions<Dim>::mesh() const { return mesh_; }

template<std::size_t Dim>
void BoundaryConditions<Dim>::markDirichletMin_(std::size_t d, double value) {
    bc_.setVelocityBC(d, -1, VelocityBCType::Inlet, value, 0.0, 0.0);
    bcsConfigured_ = false;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void BoundaryConditions<Dim>::markDirichletMax_(std::size_t d, double value) {
    bc_.setVelocityBC(d, +1, VelocityBCType::Inlet, value, 0.0, 0.0);
    bcsConfigured_ = false;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void BoundaryConditions<Dim>::addNeumannMin_(std::size_t d, double flux, Eigen::VectorXd& b) const {
    forEachBoundaryFace(mesh_, d, -1, [&](std::size_t f, std::size_t) {
        b(mesh_.owner(f)) += k_ * flux * mesh_.faceArea(f);
    });
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void BoundaryConditions<Dim>::addNeumannMax_(std::size_t d, double flux, Eigen::VectorXd& b) const {
    forEachBoundaryFace(mesh_, d, +1, [&](std::size_t f, std::size_t) {
        b(mesh_.owner(f)) += k_ * flux * mesh_.faceArea(f);
    });
}

template class BoundaryConditions<2>;
template class BoundaryConditions<3>;

} // namespace fvm

### src/fvm/BoundaryConditions.h

#pragma once

#include "fvm/SIMPLETypes.h"
#include "fvm/SIMPLEBoundaryConditions.h"
#include "mesh/Mesh.h"
#include "mesh/BoundaryUtils.h"
#include "fvm/Types.h"
#include <array>
#include <cstddef>
#include <map>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace fvm {

enum class BCType { Dirichlet, Neumann };

inline VelocityBCType toVelocityBCType(BCType type, double value) {
    (void)value;
    return (type == BCType::Dirichlet) ? VelocityBCType::Inlet : VelocityBCType::Outlet;
}

struct Patch {
    std::string name;
    std::size_t wallDim;
    int wallSign;
    BCType type;
    double value;
};

inline Patch toPatch(const VelocityPatch& vp) {
    return Patch{vp.name, vp.wallDim, vp.wallSign,
                 (vp.type == VelocityBCType::Inlet || vp.type == VelocityBCType::MovingWall)
                     ? BCType::Dirichlet
                     : BCType::Neumann,
                 vp.u};
}

inline VelocityPatch toVelocityPatch(const Patch& p, double value) {
    return VelocityPatch{p.name, p.wallDim, p.wallSign,
                         toVelocityBCType(p.type, value), value, 0.0, 0.0};
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
class BoundaryConditions {
public:
    BoundaryConditions(const Mesh<Dim>& mesh, double k = 1.0);

    void setWall(std::size_t d, int sign, BCType type, double value);
    void setMin(std::size_t d, BCType type, double value);
    void setMax(std::size_t d, BCType type, double value);

    void addPatch(const std::string& name, std::size_t d, int sign, BCType type, double value);

    bool bcsConfigured() const;

    const Patch* findPatch(const std::string& name) const;
    BCType patchType(const std::string& name) const;
    double patchValue(const std::string& name) const;
    const std::vector<Patch>& patches() const;

    void buildDirichletMask();

    const std::vector<char>& dirichletMask() const;
    const std::vector<double>& dirichletValues() const;

    void setDirichletOnFaces(const std::vector<std::size_t>& faceIndices, double value);
    void setNeumannOnFaces(const std::vector<std::size_t>& faceIndices, double flux);

    void addNeumannContributions(Eigen::VectorXd& b) const;

    const Mesh<Dim>& mesh() const;

private:
    void markDirichletMin_(std::size_t d, double value);
    void markDirichletMax_(std::size_t d, double value);
    void addNeumannMin_(std::size_t d, double flux, Eigen::VectorXd& b) const;
    void addNeumannMax_(std::size_t d, double flux, Eigen::VectorXd& b) const;

    const Mesh<Dim>& mesh_;
    double k_;
    SIMPLEBoundaryConditions<Dim> bc_;
    BCDiscretization disc_;

    std::vector<char> dirichletMask_;
    std::vector<double> dirichletValues_;

    std::vector<std::pair<std::size_t, double>> faceDirichlet_;
    std::vector<std::pair<std::size_t, double>> faceNeumann_;
    struct NeumannWall { std::size_t d; int sign; double flux; };
    std::vector<NeumannWall> neumannWalls_;
    mutable std::vector<Patch> patchesCache_;
    bool bcsConfigured_ = false;
};

extern template class BoundaryConditions<2>;
extern template class BoundaryConditions<3>;

} // namespace fvm

### src/fvm/Cancellable.h
```
#pragma once

#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <thread>

namespace fvm {

// Shared cancellation/pause state for all solvers.
//
// Pause semantics: a pause takes effect at a solver iteration boundary (one
// SIMPLE iteration, or one transient time step) so that the fields, the BDF2
// history and the time/step counters always describe a completed step and a
// Save made while paused is a valid restart point.
//
// Step is a one-shot budget: while paused, `requestStep()` lets the solver run
// exactly one iteration and then parks it again. It deliberately does NOT
// resume the run (the previous implementation cleared the pause flag, so one
// Step click restarted the whole solve).
struct Cancellable {
    void requestCancel() {
        cancelRequested_.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
        // A parked solver must notice the cancel instead of waiting forever.
        paused_.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
        stepBudget_.store(0, std::memory_order_release);
    }
    void resetCancel() { cancelRequested_.store(false, std::memory_order_release); }
    bool isCancelRequested() const { return cancelRequested_.load(std::memory_order_acquire); }

    void requestPause() { paused_.store(true, std::memory_order_release); }
    void requestResume() {
        stepBudget_.store(0, std::memory_order_release);
        pausedAck_.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
        paused_.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
    }
    // While paused: run exactly one iteration/time step, then pause again.
    void requestStep() {
        stepBudget_.store(1, std::memory_order_release);
        pausedAck_.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
        paused_.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    }
    // The pause was *requested* (may still be in flight).
    bool isPaused() const { return paused_.load(std::memory_order_acquire); }
    // The solver is actually parked at a step boundary. Only then is the
    // in-memory state a consistent restart point for Save.
    bool isPauseSettled() const { return pausedAck_.load(std::memory_order_acquire); }
    bool hasStepBudget() const { return stepBudget_.load(std::memory_order_acquire) > 0; }

protected:
    // Boundary handler: call at the top of the solver loop, before doing any
    // work for the next iteration. Blocks while a pause is pending and no step
    // budget is outstanding. Returns false when a cancel was requested while
    // parked, in which case the caller must stop without performing work.
    bool waitIfPaused() {
        for (;;) {
            if (cancelRequested_.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
                pausedAck_.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
                return false;
            }
            if (!paused_.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
                pausedAck_.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
                return true;
            }
            const int budget = stepBudget_.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
            if (budget > 0) {
                stepBudget_.store(budget - 1, std::memory_order_release);
                pausedAck_.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
                return true;
            }
            pausedAck_.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
            std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(10));
        }
    }

    std::atomic<bool> cancelRequested_{false};
    std::atomic<bool> paused_{false};
    std::atomic<bool> pausedAck_{false};
    std::atomic<int> stepBudget_{0};
};

} // namespace fvm
```

### src/fvm/Convection.cpp
```
#include "fvm/Convection.h"
#include "fvm/Gradient.h"
#include <stdexcept>

namespace fvm {

// Helper: Barth-Jespersen limited SOU correction
template<std::size_t Dim>
inline double limitedSOUCorrection(
    const Mesh<Dim>& mesh,
    std::size_t up,
    std::size_t f,
    double gradDotR,
    double phiUp,
    const Field<Dim>& phi,
    const std::vector<char>& dirichletMask,
    const std::vector<double>& dirichletValues)
{
    // Find min/max among neighbors of up (including up itself)
    double phiMin = phiUp;
    double phiMax = phiUp;
    const auto& neighbors = mesh.cellNeighbors(up);
    for (std::size_t nb : neighbors) {
        double val;
        if (!dirichletMask.empty() && nb < dirichletMask.size() && dirichletMask[nb]) {
            val = dirichletValues[nb];
        } else {
            val = phi[nb];
        }
        if (val < phiMin) phiMin = val;
        if (val > phiMax) phiMax = val;
    }
    double phiF = phiUp + gradDotR;
    // Also consider up itself for bounds already, but clamp
    if (phiF > phiMax) phiF = phiMax;
    else if (phiF < phiMin) phiF = phiMin;
    return phiF - phiUp;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
Convection<Dim>::Convection(const Mesh<Dim>& mesh) : mesh_(mesh) {}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void Convection<Dim>::setScheme(ConvectionScheme scheme) {
    scheme_ = scheme;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
ConvectionScheme Convection<Dim>::scheme() const {
    return scheme_;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The one implementation.
//
// The face velocity follows the rule of the momentum assembly: a cell with a
// prescribed velocity owns the WHOLE face it shares with a neighbour (the
// neighbour takes priority), otherwise the face velocity is the exact linear
// interpolation between the two cell centres.
//
// Second order upwind reconstructs the face value from the cell gradient.
// Without a gradient the scheme would silently degrade to plain upwind, so
// the call is rejected instead.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
template<std::size_t Dim>
void Convection<Dim>::discretizeImpl(std::vector<Triplet>& triplets, Eigen::VectorXd& b,
                                     std::vector<double>& diagInc,
                                     const Field<Dim>& phi,
                                     const std::array<const Field<Dim>*, Dim>& velocities,
                                     const ConvectionBCs& bcs,
                                     const std::array<Field<Dim>, Dim>* phiGrad) {
    const std::size_t n = mesh_.nCells();
    const std::size_t nF = mesh_.nFaces();
    const bool hasMask = !bcs.scalarMask.empty();
    const bool hasMaskAll = !bcs.velocityMask.empty();
    const bool useSOU = (scheme_ == ConvectionScheme::SecondOrderUpwind);
    const bool isUpwindBase = (scheme_ == ConvectionScheme::Upwind || useSOU);

    if (useSOU && phiGrad == nullptr)
        throw std::invalid_argument(
            "Convection::discretize: second order upwind needs the cell gradient");

    const std::array<Field<Dim>, Dim>* gradPtr = phiGrad;
    diagInc.assign(n, 0.0);

    // The flux of a face, split between the two cells it separates.
    auto addConvFlux = [&](double flux, std::size_t from, std::size_t to) {
        if (isUpwindBase) {
            if (flux >= 0.0) {
                diagInc[from] += flux;
            } else {
                if (hasMask && bcs.scalarMask[to]) b(from) -= flux * bcs.scalarValues[to];
                else if (!(hasMask && bcs.scalarMask[from])) triplets.emplace_back(from, to, flux);
            }
        } else {
            // Central
            diagInc[from] += 0.5 * flux;
            if (hasMask && bcs.scalarMask[to]) b(from) -= 0.5 * flux * bcs.scalarValues[to];
            else if (!(hasMask && bcs.scalarMask[from])) triplets.emplace_back(from, to, 0.5 * flux);
        }
    };

    for (std::size_t f = 0; f < nF; ++f) {
        const std::size_t P = mesh_.owner(f);
        const std::size_t N = mesh_.neighbor(f);
        if (N == std::size_t(-1)) {
            // Boundary face. The base flux has to be added for EVERY scheme:
            // the previous code only handled it inside the SOU branch, so with
            // plain upwind, central differencing or QUICK the convective flux
            // through the boundary was dropped entirely and the transported
            // quantity did not balance at the outlet.
            double un = 0.0;
            for (std::size_t dd = 0; dd < Dim; ++dd) {
                double uFace = 0.0;
                if (hasMaskAll && !bcs.velocityMask[dd].empty() && bcs.velocityMask[dd][P])
                    uFace = bcs.velocityValues[dd][P];
                else
                    uFace = (*velocities[dd])[P];
                un += uFace * mesh_.faceNormal(f)[dd];
            }
            const double F = un * mesh_.faceArea(f);

            if (hasMask && bcs.scalarMask[P]) {
                // The owner cell is prescribed: its row is an identity row, so
                // the face contributes nothing.
                continue;
            }

            if (F >= 0.0) {
                // Outflow: the face value is the owner value.
                diagInc[P] += F;
                if (useSOU) {
                    const double* xF = mesh_.faceCenterPtr(f);
                    const double* xUp = mesh_.cellCenterPtr(P);
                    double gradDotR = 0.0;
                    for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d)
                        gradDotR += (*gradPtr)[d][P] * (xF[d] - xUp[d]);
                    double limited = limitedSOUCorrection(mesh_, P, f, gradDotR, phi[P], phi,
                                                           bcs.scalarMask, bcs.scalarValues);
                    // Known LHS term -> RHS with a sign flip (see the SOU branch).
                    b(P) -= F * limited;
                }
            } else {
                // Inflow at the boundary (a reversed outflow): the upwind
                // value is outside the domain and unknown, so the convective
                // flux is suppressed rather than adding a destabilising
                // negative diagonal.
            }
            continue;
        }
        double w = mesh_.faceWeight(f);
        double un = 0.0;
        for (std::size_t dd = 0; dd < Dim; ++dd) {
            double uFace;
            if (hasMaskAll && !bcs.velocityMask[dd].empty() && bcs.velocityMask[dd][N])
                uFace = bcs.velocityValues[dd][N];
            else if (hasMaskAll && !bcs.velocityMask[dd].empty() && bcs.velocityMask[dd][P])
                uFace = bcs.velocityValues[dd][P];
            else
                uFace = (1.0 - w) * (*velocities[dd])[P] + w * (*velocities[dd])[N];
            un += uFace * mesh_.faceNormal(f)[dd];
        }
        double F = un * mesh_.faceArea(f);
        addConvFlux(F, P, N);
        addConvFlux(-F, N, P);
        if (useSOU) {
            const double* xF = mesh_.faceCenterPtr(f);
            // Upwind cell is P for F >= 0 and N for F < 0. The deferred
            // correction belongs to both cells; the downwind cell always needs
            // its share, even when the upwind cell is prescribed (then the
            // upwind contribution of this face was moved to the downwind
            // cell's right-hand side by addConvFlux and the two must still
            // cancel).
            const bool upIsP = (F >= 0.0);
            const std::size_t upCell = upIsP ? P : N;
            const std::size_t downCell = upIsP ? N : P;
            const bool upPrescribed = hasMask && bcs.scalarMask[upCell];
            const bool downPrescribed = hasMask && bcs.scalarMask[downCell];
            const double* xUp = mesh_.cellCenterPtr(upCell);
            double gradDotR = 0.0;
            for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) gradDotR += (*gradPtr)[d][upCell] * (xF[d] - xUp[d]);
            double phiUp = upPrescribed ? bcs.scalarValues[upCell] : phi[upCell];
            double limited = limitedSOUCorrection(mesh_, upCell, f, gradDotR, phiUp, phi,
                                                   bcs.scalarMask, bcs.scalarValues);
            if (upIsP) {
                if (!upPrescribed) b(P) -= F * limited;
                if (!downPrescribed) b(N) += F * limited;
            } else {
                if (!upPrescribed) b(N) -= (-F) * limited;
                if (!downPrescribed) b(P) += (-F) * limited;
            }
        }
        if (scheme_ == ConvectionScheme::QUICK) {
            const auto& fn = mesh_.faceNormal(f);
            std::array<double, Dim> fnArr{};
            for (std::size_t dd = 0; dd < Dim; ++dd) fnArr[dd] = fn[dd];
            auto [up, up2] = secondOrderUpwindCells(mesh_, P, N, un, fnArr);
            std::size_t down = (F >= 0.0) ? N : P;
            if (up != up2 && up != down && up2 != down) {
                const double* xUp2 = mesh_.cellCenterPtr(up2);
                const double* xUp = mesh_.cellCenterPtr(up);
                const double* xDown = mesh_.cellCenterPtr(down);
                const double* xFp = mesh_.faceCenterPtr(f);
                auto coord = [&](const double* x) {
                    double s = 0.0;
                    for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) s += x[d] * fn[d];
                    return s;
                };
                double s2 = coord(xUp2), sUp = coord(xUp), sDown = coord(xDown), sF = coord(xFp);
                double denomA = (s2 - sUp) * (s2 - sDown);
                double denomB = (sUp - s2) * (sUp - sDown);
                double denomC = (sDown - s2) * (sDown - sUp);
                if (std::abs(denomA) > 1e-30 && std::abs(denomB) > 1e-30 && std::abs(denomC) > 1e-30) {
                    double wa = (sF - sUp) * (sF - sDown) / denomA;
                    double wb = (sF - s2) * (sF - sDown) / denomB;
                    double wc = (sF - s2) * (sF - sUp) / denomC;
                    auto cellVal = [&](std::size_t c) {
                        return (hasMask && bcs.scalarMask[c]) ? bcs.scalarValues[c] : phi[c];
                    };
                    double phiF = wa * cellVal(up2) + wb * cellVal(up) + wc * cellVal(down);
                    double corr = phiF - cellVal(up);
                    // Same rule as the SOU branch: the downwind cell always
                    // receives its share of the correction.
                    const bool upIsP = (F >= 0.0);
                    const bool upPrescribed = hasMask && bcs.scalarMask[upIsP ? P : N];
                    const bool downPrescribed = hasMask && bcs.scalarMask[upIsP ? N : P];
                    if (upIsP) {
                        if (!upPrescribed) b(P) -= F * corr;
                        if (!downPrescribed) b(N) += F * corr;
                    } else {
                        if (!upPrescribed) b(N) -= (-F) * corr;
                        if (!downPrescribed) b(P) += (-F) * corr;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The three entry points. They differ only in where the result is delivered,
// so they always assemble the same operator.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

template<std::size_t Dim>
void Convection<Dim>::discretize(SparseMatrix& A, Eigen::VectorXd& b,
                                 const Field<Dim>& phi,
                                 const std::array<const Field<Dim>*, Dim>& velocities,
                                 const ConvectionBCs& bcs,
                                 const std::array<Field<Dim>, Dim>* phiGrad) {
    const std::size_t n = mesh_.nCells();
    std::vector<Triplet> convTriplets;
    std::vector<double> diagInc;
    convTriplets.reserve(n * (2 * Dim + 1));
    discretizeImpl(convTriplets, b, diagInc, phi, velocities, bcs, phiGrad);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        if (diagInc[i] != 0.0) convTriplets.emplace_back(static_cast<int>(i), static_cast<int>(i), diagInc[i]);
    SparseMatrix Aconv(n, n);
    Aconv.setFromTriplets(convTriplets.begin(), convTriplets.end());
    A += Aconv;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void Convection<Dim>::discretize(std::vector<Triplet>& triplets, Eigen::VectorXd& b,
                                 std::vector<double>& diagInc,
                                 const Field<Dim>& phi,
                                 const std::array<const Field<Dim>*, Dim>& velocities,
                                 const ConvectionBCs& bcs,
                                 const std::array<Field<Dim>, Dim>* phiGrad) {
    discretizeImpl(triplets, b, diagInc, phi, velocities, bcs, phiGrad);
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void Convection<Dim>::discretize(std::vector<Triplet>& triplets, Eigen::VectorXd& b,
                                 const Field<Dim>& phi,
                                 const std::array<const Field<Dim>*, Dim>& velocities,
                                 const ConvectionBCs& bcs,
                                 const std::array<Field<Dim>, Dim>* phiGrad) {
    const std::size_t n = mesh_.nCells();
    std::vector<double> diagInc;
    discretizeImpl(triplets, b, diagInc, phi, velocities, bcs, phiGrad);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        if (diagInc[i] != 0.0) triplets.emplace_back(static_cast<int>(i), static_cast<int>(i), diagInc[i]);
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
const Mesh<Dim>& Convection<Dim>::mesh() const { return mesh_; }

template class Convection<2>;
template class Convection<3>;

} // namespace fvm

### src/fvm/Convection.h
```
#pragma once

#include "mesh/Mesh.h"
#include "field/Field.h"
#include "fvm/Types.h"
#include <array>
#include <vector>
#include <cstddef>

namespace fvm {

// The boundary conditions of a convection operator:
//   - the prescribed value of the convected field, per cell;
//   - the prescribed values of the velocity components, per component.
//
// The velocity values are needed because the face velocity follows the rule of
// the momentum assembly: a cell with a prescribed velocity owns the WHOLE face
// it shares with a neighbour (the neighbour takes priority).
struct ConvectionBCs {
    std::vector<char> scalarMask;
    std::vector<double> scalarValues;
    std::vector<std::vector<char>> velocityMask;
    std::vector<std::vector<double>> velocityValues;
};

template<std::size_t Dim>
class Convection {
public:
    Convection(const Mesh<Dim>& mesh);

    void setScheme(ConvectionScheme scheme);
    ConvectionScheme scheme() const;

    // Assembles into a sparse matrix, which is ADDED to (the caller has
    // usually filled it with the diffusion operator first). The diagonal is
    // part of the matrix.
    void discretize(SparseMatrix& A, Eigen::VectorXd& b,
                    const Field<Dim>& phi,
                    const std::array<const Field<Dim>*, Dim>& velocities,
                    const ConvectionBCs& bcs,
                    const std::array<Field<Dim>, Dim>* phiGrad = nullptr);

    // Assembles into triplets; the diagonal is returned separately, for the
    // fused assembly that adds it itself.
    void discretize(std::vector<Triplet>& triplets, Eigen::VectorXd& b, std::vector<double>& diagInc,
                    const Field<Dim>& phi,
                    const std::array<const Field<Dim>*, Dim>& velocities,
                    const ConvectionBCs& bcs,
                    const std::array<Field<Dim>, Dim>* phiGrad = nullptr);

    // Assembles into triplets; the diagonal is part of them.
    void discretize(std::vector<Triplet>& triplets, Eigen::VectorXd& b,
                    const Field<Dim>& phi,
                    const std::array<const Field<Dim>*, Dim>& velocities,
                    const ConvectionBCs& bcs,
                    const std::array<Field<Dim>, Dim>* phiGrad = nullptr);

    const Mesh<Dim>& mesh() const;

private:
    // The one implementation all three entry points share.
    void discretizeImpl(std::vector<Triplet>& triplets, Eigen::VectorXd& b, std::vector<double>& diagInc,
                        const Field<Dim>& phi,
                        const std::array<const Field<Dim>*, Dim>& velocities,
                        const ConvectionBCs& bcs,
                        const std::array<Field<Dim>, Dim>* phiGrad);

    const Mesh<Dim>& mesh_;
    ConvectionScheme scheme_ = ConvectionScheme::Upwind;
};

extern template class Convection<2>;
extern template class Convection<3>;

} // namespace fvm

### src/fvm/ConvectionSchemes.hpp

#pragma once

#include <concepts>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstddef>

namespace fvm {

template<typename T>
concept ConvectionScheme = requires(T t, double r) {
    { T::name() } noexcept -> std::convertible_to<const char*>;
    { T::applyLimiter(r) } noexcept -> std::same_as<double>;
};

struct Upwind {
    static constexpr const char* name() { return "Upwind"; }
    static constexpr double applyLimiter(double) { return 0.0; }
};

struct Central {
    static constexpr const char* name() { return "Central"; }
    static constexpr double applyLimiter(double) { return 1.0; }
};

} // namespace fvm
