### src/fvm/PressureCorrection.cpp
```
#include "fvm/PressureCorrection.h"
#include "fvm/SSTConstants.h"
#include "mesh/BoundaryUtils.h"

#include <array>
#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
#include <limits>
#include <chrono>

namespace fvm {

template<std::size_t Dim>
PressureCorrection<Dim>::PressureCorrection(const Mesh<Dim>& mesh, const Config& config)
    : mesh_(mesh), config_(config), divU_(mesh, 0.0) {}

template<std::size_t Dim>
PressureCorrection<Dim>::PressureCorrection(const Mesh<Dim>& mesh)
    : mesh_(mesh), config_{}, divU_(mesh, 0.0) {
    config_.amgConfig.interpolationType = AMGHierarchy::InterpolationType::Direct;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void PressureCorrection<Dim>::solve(
    const VectorField<Dim>& uStar,
    const std::array<std::vector<double>, Dim>& dCoeff,
    const Field<Dim>& pressure,
    Field<Dim>& pPrime,
    const std::vector<std::pair<std::size_t, double>>& pressureOutletCells,
    const std::vector<char>& isPressureNeumann,
    const std::vector<char>* isPressureDirichletFace,
    const std::vector<std::pair<std::size_t, double>>* pressureOutletFaces,
    const std::vector<FaceVelocityBC>* faceBC,
    const std::vector<char>* faceHasBC,
    const std::vector<std::vector<char>>* velDirichletMask,
    const std::vector<std::vector<double>>* velDirichletVals) {

    const std::size_t n = mesh_.nCells();
    const std::size_t nF = mesh_.nFaces();

    pressureStats_.solves++;

    if (!gradientCalc_) {
        gradientCalc_ = std::make_unique<Gradient<Dim>>(mesh_, GradientScheme::LeastSquares);
        for (auto& g : pressureGrad_) g = Field<Dim>(mesh_, 0.0);
    }

    if (config_.compactRhieChow) {
        // Least-squares pressure gradient: the operator the velocity
        // correction applies and the one the compact Rhie-Chow flux needs.
        gradientCalc_->compute(pressure, pressureGrad_);
    } else {
        // Green-Gauss gradient is the diagnostic the legacy residuals report
        // (the matrix and the velocity correction are built from the
        // least-squares gradient; see VelocityCorrection.h).
        for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) pressureGrad_[d].assign(0.0);
        std::vector<double> invVol(n);
        const double* volPtr = mesh_.cellVolumePtr();
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            invVol[i] = (volPtr[i] > 1e-30) ? 1.0 / volPtr[i] : 0.0;
        for (std::size_t f = 0; f < nF; ++f) {
            const std::size_t P = mesh_.owner(f);
            const std::size_t N = mesh_.neighbor(f);
            const double w = mesh_.faceWeight(f);
            const double pFace = (N == std::size_t(-1))
                ? pressure[P]
                : (1.0 - w) * pressure[P] + w * pressure[N];
            const auto& fn = mesh_.faceNormal(f);
            const double area = mesh_.faceArea(f);
            for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) {
                const double contrib = pFace * fn[d] * area;
                pressureGrad_[d][P] += contrib * invVol[P];
                if (N != std::size_t(-1))
                    pressureGrad_[d][N] -= contrib * invVol[N];
            }
        }
    }
    const std::size_t* ownerPtr = mesh_.ownerPtr();
    const std::size_t* neighborPtr = mesh_.neighborPtr();
    const double* areaPtr = mesh_.faceAreaPtr();

    // Reuse pre-allocated buffers
    triplets_.clear();
    triplets_.reserve(n * (2 * Dim + 4));
    bVec_.resize(n);
    bVec_.setZero();

    if (pMask_.size() != n) pMask_.resize(n);
    if (pVals_.size() != n) pVals_.resize(n);
    if (isPressureOutlet_.size() != n) isPressureOutlet_.resize(n);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        pMask_[i] = false;
        pVals_[i] = 0.0;
        isPressureOutlet_[i] = false;
    }
    for (const auto& [cell, pRef] : pressureOutletCells) {
        isPressureOutlet_[cell] = true;
        pMask_[cell] = true;
        pVals_[cell] = 0.0;
    }
    // Face-based Dirichlet (exact per-face, fixes cell dedup loss)
    if (isPressureDirichletFace && pressureOutletFaces) {
        for (const auto& [face, pRef] : *pressureOutletFaces) {
            if (face < mesh_.nFaces() && mesh_.neighbor(face) == std::size_t(-1)) {
                std::size_t P = mesh_.owner(face);
                isPressureOutlet_[P] = true;
                pMask_[P] = true;
                pVals_[P] = 0.0;
            }
        }
        for (std::size_t f = 0; f < mesh_.nFaces() && f < isPressureDirichletFace->size(); ++f) {
            if ((*isPressureDirichletFace)[f] && mesh_.neighbor(f) == std::size_t(-1)) {
                std::size_t P = mesh_.owner(f);
                isPressureOutlet_[P] = true;
                pMask_[P] = true;
                pVals_[P] = 0.0;
            }
        }
    }

    // A boundary cell the pressure does not prescribe and an outlet does not
    // reach is a Dirichlet cell of the pressure correction (p' = 0 there).
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (mesh_.isBoundary(i) && !isPressureNeumann[i] && !isPressureOutlet_[i]) {
            pMask_[i] = true;
            pVals_[i] = 0.0;
        }
    }

    // A pure Neumann system (no Dirichlet pressure anywhere) is singular: it
    // needs ONE pinned reference cell (p' = 0 there) to fix the constant
    // mode. When the system already carries a Dirichlet row - an outlet, a
    // prescribed pressure boundary - nothing has to be pinned: pinning a
    // second cell would force a spurious local feature into p' exactly where
    // the mass balance must stay correct.
    bool hasDirichletPressure = false;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (pMask_[i]) { hasDirichletPressure = true; break; }
    }
    if (!hasDirichletPressure) {
        std::size_t refCell = config_.pressureRefCell;
        if (refCell >= n) {
            // The pinned cell is the one cell whose continuity error the
            // pressure correction cannot remove, so it belongs in a smooth
            // interior region - not at the first interior cell, which in a
            // cavity is a corner: the largest local imbalance, and exactly
            // where the corner vortices form.
            std::array<double, Dim> centroid{};
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                const auto& c = mesh_.cellCenter(i);
                for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) centroid[d] += c[d];
            }
            for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) centroid[d] /= static_cast<double>(n);
            double best = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                if (mesh_.isBoundary(i) || isPressureOutlet_[i] || pMask_[i]) continue;
                if (!isPressureNeumann[i] || mesh_.isBoundary(i)) continue;
                const auto& c = mesh_.cellCenter(i);
                double d2 = 0.0;
                for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) {
                    const double dd = c[d] - centroid[d];
                    d2 += dd * dd;
                }
                if (d2 < best) { best = d2; refCell = i; }
            }
            if (refCell >= n) {
                for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                    if (mesh_.isBoundary(i) || isPressureOutlet_[i]) continue;
                    refCell = i;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (refCell >= n) refCell = n - 1;
        }
        if (!pMask_[refCell]) { pMask_[refCell] = true; pVals_[refCell] = 0.0; }
    }

    // A cell without a single interior face has no pressure equation at all:
    // its mass balance can never be corrected. It is excluded from the
    // unknowns (carries p' = 0) and counted, so the run reports it instead of
    // silently never converging. The deliberately pinned reference cell - and
    // any other cell whose pressure is already prescribed - is a CHOICE, not a
    // discovery, so it is not reported as isolated.
    isolatedCellCount_ = 0;
    #pragma omp parallel for reduction(+:isolatedCellCount_) schedule(static)
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (pMask_[i])
            continue;
        bool hasInteriorFace = false;
        for (std::size_t f : mesh_.cellFaces(i)) {
            if (mesh_.neighbor(f) != std::size_t(-1)) { hasInteriorFace = true; break; }
        }
        if (!hasInteriorFace) {
            ++isolatedCellCount_;
            pMask_[i] = true;
            pVals_[i] = 0.0;
        }
    }

    divU_.assign(0.0);

    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
    for (std::size_t f = 0; f < nF; ++f) {
        const std::size_t P = ownerPtr[f];
        const std::size_t N = neighborPtr[f];
        const double* fn = mesh_.faceNormalPtr(f);
        const double area = areaPtr[f];

        // --- Divergence: use face-based BC for Dirichlet walls (general FVM) ---
        double un = 0.0;
        if (N == std::size_t(-1) && faceBC && faceHasBC && f < faceBC->size() && (*faceHasBC)[f]) {
            const auto &fbc = (*faceBC)[f];
            auto t = fbc.type;
            if (t == VelocityBCType::NoSlip || t == VelocityBCType::Symmetry || t == VelocityBCType::SlipWall) {
                un = 0.0; // no penetration
            } else if (t == VelocityBCType::MovingWall || t == VelocityBCType::Inlet) {
                un = fbc.u * fn[0] + fbc.v * fn[1];
                if constexpr (Dim==3) un += fbc.w * fn[2];
            } else if (t == VelocityBCType::PressureOutlet || t == VelocityBCType::Outlet) {
                for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) un += uStar[d][P] * fn[d];
                std::array<double, Dim> fnArr{};
                for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) fnArr[d] = fn[d];
                un = applyBackflowCorrection<Dim>(un, fnArr, fbc);
            } else {
                for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) un += uStar[d][P] * fn[d];
            }
        } else {
            double w = mesh_.faceWeight(f);
            for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) {
                // Face velocity must match the momentum assembly exactly
                // (Momentum.cpp interior-face rule): a cell with a prescribed
                // velocity contributes that prescribed value to the WHOLE face,
                // and the neighbour takes priority. Using a plain interpolation
                // here would balance a mass imbalance the momentum equation does
                // not have, which corrupts the pressure field near the walls.
                double uFace;
                bool dirN = false, dirP = false;
                if (velDirichletMask && velDirichletVals &&
                    d < velDirichletMask->size() && d < velDirichletVals->size()) {
                    const auto& m = (*velDirichletMask)[d];
                    const auto& v = (*velDirichletVals)[d];
                    if (!m.empty() && !v.empty()) {
                        if (N != std::size_t(-1) && m[N]) dirN = true;
                        if (m[P]) dirP = true;
                    }
                }
                if (dirN) {
                    uFace = (*velDirichletVals)[d][N];
                } else if (dirP) {
                    uFace = (*velDirichletVals)[d][P];
                } else if (N == std::size_t(-1)) {
                    uFace = uStar[d][P];
                } else {
                    uFace = (1.0 - w) * uStar[d][P] + w * uStar[d][N];
                }
                un += uFace * fn[d];
            }
        }

        // Rhie-Chow momentum interpolation for the compact pressure equation.
        // The interpolated cell velocity carries the wide cell gradient of the
        // pressure; the compact face flux must instead use the two-point
        // normal gradient. Adding the difference back is the collocated-grid
        // correction that damps the checkerboard mode. The same face
        // diffusivity is used by the compact matrix below, so the equation is
        // self-consistent.
        if (config_.compactRhieChow && N != std::size_t(-1)) {
            const double wRC = mesh_.faceWeight(f);
            double dFace = 0.0;
            for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) {
                const double dP = dCoeff[d][P];
                const double dN = dCoeff[d][N];
                dFace += ((1.0 - wRC) * dP + wRC * dN) * fn[d] * fn[d];
            }
            if (dFace != 0.0) {
                const auto& xP = mesh_.cellCenter(P);
                const auto& xN = mesh_.cellCenter(N);
                double dotSfd = 0.0;
                for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d)
                    dotSfd += fn[d] * (xN[d] - xP[d]);
                const double dist = mesh_.faceDist(f);
                const double normalFactor =
                    (dist > 1e-30) ? dotSfd / (dist * dist) : 0.0;
                double gradInterpN = 0.0;
                for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) {
                    gradInterpN += ((1.0 - wRC) * pressureGrad_[d][P] +
                                    wRC * pressureGrad_[d][N]) * fn[d];
                }
                const double gradFaceN = (pressure[N] - pressure[P]) * normalFactor;
                un += dFace * (gradInterpN - gradFaceN);
            }
        }

        double flux = un * area;
        #pragma omp atomic
        divU_[P] += flux;
        if (N != std::size_t(-1)) {
            #pragma omp atomic
            divU_[N] -= flux;
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Two pressure operators share the divergence above.
    //
    // compactRhieChow (PISO, collocated grid):
    //   A = div_f(d_f * (p_N - p_P)/d), the two-point face-normal Laplacian,
    //   with the Rhie-Chow face flux already on the right-hand side. With
    //   b = div(u*) the solved field satisfies div(u* - d grad p') = 0 in the
    //   FACE-FLUX sense; the Rhie-Chow term removes the checkerboard mode the
    //   central interpolation would otherwise admit.
    //
    // legacy composed operator (compactRhieChow = false):
    //   A = div(d * G) with the SAME per-cell least-squares gradient
    //   (gradientRows_, from Gradient::buildMatrices) the velocity correction
    //   applies. With b = div(u*) in raw flux-sum units the solved field then
    //   satisfies, cell by cell,
    //       div(u* - d * grad(p')) = 0
    //   exactly - not only in total. The composition is a wider stencil - a
    //   face sees the gradient of both of its cells and each gradient reaches
    //   that cell's own neighbours - which also makes the cross-diffusion part
    //   of the diffusion exact.
    //
    // In both modes a prescribed-velocity face (wall, inlet, moving lid) has a
    // fixed flux and contributes nothing. A pressure-outlet cell carries
    // p' = 0 and is an identity row.
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // A cell whose velocity is prescribed in EVERY component of EVERY
    // incident face has no p' sensitivity at all: its equation would be
    // empty, so it becomes a Dirichlet cell of the pressure system (p'
    // pinned to p' = 0), which keeps the matrix invertible.
    {
        std::vector<char> rowVoid(n, 1);
        for (std::size_t f = 0; f < nF; ++f) {
            const std::size_t P = ownerPtr[f];
            const std::size_t N = neighborPtr[f];
            for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) {
                bool dirN = false, dirP = false;
                if (velDirichletMask && d < velDirichletMask->size() && !(*velDirichletMask)[d].empty()) {
                    dirP = (*velDirichletMask)[d][P];
                    if (N != std::size_t(-1)) dirN = (*velDirichletMask)[d][N];
                }
                if (!dirN && !dirP) {
                    rowVoid[P] = 0;
                    if (N != std::size_t(-1)) rowVoid[N] = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            if (rowVoid[i] && !pMask_[i]) {
                pMask_[i] = true;
                pVals_[i] = 0.0;
            }
        }
    }

    // Assemble: the per-face flux sensitivity accumulated into per-row
    // column lists. Entries are summed on emit below so every
    // (row, column) pair lands in triplets_ exactly once and the A_ value
    // scatter map stays a bijection.
    std::vector<std::vector<std::pair<std::size_t, double>>> rowAcc(n);

    if (config_.compactRhieChow) {
        // Collocated-grid PISO operator: the two-point face-normal Laplacian.
        // The right-hand side above already carries the Rhie-Chow correction,
        // so this matrix and that face flux use the same d_f. Boundary faces
        // are deliberately absent: a prescribed-velocity face has a fixed
        // flux, and a pressure boundary carries p' = 0 (its cell is a
        // Dirichlet row), so neither has a p' sensitivity. That is the
        // standard zero-normal-gradient treatment of an open boundary.
        for (std::size_t f = 0; f < nF; ++f) {
            const std::size_t P = ownerPtr[f];
            const std::size_t N = neighborPtr[f];
            if (N == std::size_t(-1)) continue;

            const double* fn = mesh_.faceNormalPtr(f);
            const double area = areaPtr[f];
            const double w = mesh_.faceWeight(f);
            double dFace = 0.0;
            for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) {
                const double dP = dCoeff[d][P];
                const double dN = dCoeff[d][N];
                dFace += ((1.0 - w) * dP + w * dN) * fn[d] * fn[d];
            }
            if (dFace == 0.0) continue;

            const auto& xP = mesh_.cellCenter(P);
            const auto& xN = mesh_.cellCenter(N);
            double dotSfd = 0.0;
            for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d)
                dotSfd += fn[d] * (xN[d] - xP[d]);
            const double dist = mesh_.faceDist(f);
            if (dist <= 1e-30) continue;
            const double normalFactor = dotSfd / (dist * dist);
            const double coeff = dFace * area * normalFactor;
            if (coeff == 0.0) continue;

            // d_f = sum_d d_d n_d^2. The assembled matrix is -div(d_f grad),
            // i.e. positive diagonal / negative off-diagonal (an M-matrix);
            // the right-hand side is negated to match. Solving -A p' = -b
            // gives the same p' as A p' = b but lets CG/AMG operate on a
            // positive-definite system.
            rowAcc[P].emplace_back(P, +coeff);
            rowAcc[P].emplace_back(N, -coeff);
            rowAcc[N].emplace_back(N, +coeff);
            rowAcc[N].emplace_back(P, -coeff);
        }
    } else {
        if (!gradientRowsBuilt_) {
            gradientCalc_->buildMatrices(gradientRows_);
            gradientRowsBuilt_ = true;
        }

        for (std::size_t f = 0; f < nF; ++f) {
            const std::size_t P = ownerPtr[f];
            const std::size_t N = neighborPtr[f];
            const double* fn = mesh_.faceNormalPtr(f);
            const double area = areaPtr[f];

            if (N == std::size_t(-1)) {
                // A boundary face whose velocity the boundary condition FIXES
                // (walls, inlets, moving lids) does not respond to p' and
                // contributes nothing to the matrix; its prescribed flux is
                // already in b. Without a BC - and at pressure outlets, where
                // both the b-side and the divergence diagnostics use the
                // extrapolated owner value - the face velocity IS the corrected
                // owner value, so its p' sensitivity completes the composed
                // operator on the boundary ring: without it the continuity the
                // solver enforces and the divergence the run measures would
                // disagree exactly at the wall cells, and whatever the walls
                // leak would have nowhere to go but the reference cell.
                //
                // (The owner of a BC'd outlet face carries prescribed p' - its
                // row is replaced by the identity below - so its terms would be
                // discarded anyway.)
                if (pMask_[P])
                    continue;
                const bool hasBCEntry = faceBC && faceHasBC && f < faceBC->size() && (*faceHasBC)[f];
                bool ownerExtrapolated = !hasBCEntry;
                if (hasBCEntry) {
                    const auto t = (*faceBC)[f].type;
                    ownerExtrapolated = (t == VelocityBCType::PressureOutlet || t == VelocityBCType::Outlet);
                }
                if (!ownerExtrapolated)
                    continue;
                for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) {
                    bool dirP = false;
                    if (velDirichletMask && d < velDirichletMask->size() && !(*velDirichletMask)[d].empty())
                        dirP = (*velDirichletMask)[d][P];
                    if (dirP) continue; // corrected owner value = prescribed: fixed
                    const double local = -dCoeff[d][P] * fn[d] * area;
                    if (local != 0.0) {
                        for (const auto& [col, k] : gradientRows_[d][P])
                            rowAcc[P].emplace_back(col, local * k);
                    }
                }
                continue;
            }

            const double w = mesh_.faceWeight(f);

            for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) {
                // A cell with a prescribed velocity contributes the prescribed
                // value to the WHOLE face (the neighbour takes priority - the
                // same rule the divergence above uses), so the face velocity
                // does not respond to p' in that component.
                bool dirN = false, dirP = false;
                if (velDirichletMask && d < velDirichletMask->size() && !(*velDirichletMask)[d].empty()) {
                    dirN = (*velDirichletMask)[d][N];
                    dirP = (*velDirichletMask)[d][P];
                }
                if (dirN || dirP) continue;

                const double faceP = (1.0 - w) * dCoeff[d][P] * fn[d] * area;
                const double faceN = w * dCoeff[d][N] * fn[d] * area;
                // Face velocity = faceP * (G p')[d][P] + faceN * (G p')[d][N]:
                // +flux into the owner's row, -flux into the neighbour's row,
                // the same bookkeeping the divergence of u* uses above.
                if (faceP != 0.0) {
                    for (const auto& [col, k] : gradientRows_[d][P]) {
                        rowAcc[P].emplace_back(col, faceP * k);
                        rowAcc[N].emplace_back(col, -faceP * k);
                    }
                }
                if (faceN != 0.0) {
                    for (const auto& [col, k] : gradientRows_[d][N]) {
                        rowAcc[P].emplace_back(col, faceN * k);
                        rowAcc[N].emplace_back(col, -faceN * k);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    for (std::size_t r = 0; r < n; ++r) {
        if (pMask_[r]) {
            // Identity row: p' is prescribed here (reference cell, outlet,
            // isolated or degenerate cell).
            triplets_.emplace_back(r, r, 1.0);
            bVec_(r) = pVals_[r];
            rowAcc[r].clear();
            continue;
        }
        auto& entries = rowAcc[r];
        std::sort(entries.begin(), entries.end(),
                  [](const std::pair<std::size_t, double>& lhs, const std::pair<std::size_t, double>& rhs) {
                      return lhs.first < rhs.first;
                  });
        // b = div(u*) in raw flux-sum units (divU_ is divided per volume
        // only after the solve, where it is read back as a diagnostic). The
        // compact matrix carries the opposite sign, so its right-hand side is
        // negated with it.
        double rowB = divU_[r];
        if (config_.compactRhieChow) rowB = -rowB;
        std::size_t emitted = 0;
        std::size_t last = 0;
        for (std::size_t idx = 1; idx <= entries.size(); ++idx) {
            if (idx == entries.size() || entries[idx].first != entries[last].first) {
                double val = 0.0;
                for (std::size_t k = last; k < idx; ++k) val += entries[k].second;
                // Every column stays in the matrix, including those of pinned
                // / Dirichlet cells: their identity rows prescribe the value,
                // so the rows that reference them remain EXACT rows of the
                // composed operator. (Shifting prescribed columns into the
                // rhs instead would make the STORED matrix a truncated
                // operator whose action no longer matches the divergence of
                // the gradient it was built from.)
                triplets_.emplace_back(r, entries[last].first, val);
                ++emitted;
                last = idx;
            }
        }
        bVec_(r) = rowB;
        if (emitted == 0) {
            // Degenerate row (e.g. all incident dCoeff are zero): pin it so
            // the system stays invertible.
            pMask_[r] = true;
            pVals_[r] = 0.0;
            triplets_.emplace_back(r, r, 1.0);
            bVec_(r) = 0.0;
        }
    }

    // --- Reverse flow diagnostic (no topology change) ---
    std::size_t nReverseFlow = 0;
    for (std::size_t f = 0; f < nF; ++f) {
        const std::size_t P = mesh_.owner(f);
        const std::size_t N = mesh_.neighbor(f);
        if (N != std::size_t(-1)) continue;
        if (!isPressureOutlet_[P]) continue;
        double un = 0.0;
        for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) un += uStar[d][P] * mesh_.faceNormal(f)[d];
        if (un < 0.0) ++nReverseFlow;
    }
    if (nReverseFlow > 0) std::cerr << "  WARNING: " << nReverseFlow << " pressure outlet face(s) with reverse flow\n";

    for (std::size_t P = 0; P < n; ++P) {
        divU_[P] /= mesh_.cellVolume(P);
    }

    Eigen::VectorXd x;
    bool converged = false;

    // The stopping criterion of the linear solve has to follow the mesh: the
    // pressure equation drives a FLUX-SUM residual to zero, and the quantity
    // that must vanish is |r|/V - the divergence of the corrected velocity.
    // A fixed relative tolerance keeps |r| ~ tol*|b| independent of h, which
    // leaves a per-cell divergence floor of tol/V that GROWS as the mesh is
    // refined. Scaling the relative tolerance by the mean cell volume keeps
    // the resolved divergence ~ tol*h on average - strictly shrinking with
    // refinement - which is what makes the coupled velocity/pressure pair
    // converge at the same rate the truncation error does.
    double volSum = 0.0;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) volSum += mesh_.cellVolume(i);
    const double volScale = (n > 0) ? volSum / static_cast<double>(n) : 1.0;

    std::size_t patternHash = 0;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < pMask_.size(); ++i) {
        if (pMask_[i]) patternHash ^= (i * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL + 1);
    }
    patternHash ^= (triplets_.size() * 0x85ebca6b);
    // The compact and legacy operators have different sparsity patterns. Make
    // a mode switch invalidate the matrix/preconditioner caches even when the
    // triplet count happens to match.
    if (config_.compactRhieChow) patternHash ^= 0x27d4eb2d;

    bool maskChanged = (prevPMask_.size() != pMask_.size());
    if (!maskChanged) {
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < pMask_.size(); ++i) if (prevPMask_[i] != pMask_[i]) { maskChanged = true; break; }
    }
    const bool compactChanged = (config_.compactRhieChow != prevCompact_);

    if (!aPatternBuilt_ || patternHash != aPatternHash_) {
        A_.resize(n, n);
        A_.setFromTriplets(triplets_.begin(), triplets_.end());
        A_.makeCompressed();
        aPatternBuilt_ = true;
        aPatternHash_ = patternHash;
        // Build O(nnz) scatter map: triplet idx -> valuePtr idx (ColMajor: outer=col)
        aTripletToValuePos_.resize(triplets_.size());
        const int* outer = A_.outerIndexPtr();
        const int* inner = A_.innerIndexPtr();
        for (std::size_t t = 0; t < triplets_.size(); ++t) {
            int col = static_cast<int>(triplets_[t].col());
            int row = static_cast<int>(triplets_[t].row());
            int pos = -1;
            for (int k = outer[col]; k < outer[col + 1]; ++k) {
                if (inner[k] == row) { pos = k; break; }
            }
            aTripletToValuePos_[t] = pos;
        }
    } else {
        // O(nnz) direct scatter — no sort, no hash, no allocation
        // Rebuild map if size mismatch (defensive)
        if (aTripletToValuePos_.size() != triplets_.size()) {
            const int* outer = A_.outerIndexPtr();
            const int* inner = A_.innerIndexPtr();
            aTripletToValuePos_.resize(triplets_.size());
            for (std::size_t t = 0; t < triplets_.size(); ++t) {
                int col = static_cast<int>(triplets_[t].col());
                int row = static_cast<int>(triplets_[t].row());
                int pos = -1;
                for (int k = outer[col]; k < outer[col + 1]; ++k) {
                    if (inner[k] == row) { pos = k; break; }
                }
                aTripletToValuePos_[t] = pos;
            }
        }
        double* vals = A_.valuePtr();
        for (std::size_t t = 0; t < triplets_.size(); ++t) {
            int pos = aTripletToValuePos_[t];
            if (pos >= 0) vals[pos] = triplets_[t].value();
        }
        // Values changed but pattern same -> coarse hierarchy is stale (Ac = P^T A P depends on A).
        // Updating only fine level is insufficient; force rebuild of full hierarchy next use.
        if (amgBuilt_) {
            amg_.invalidate();
            amgBuilt_ = false;
        }
    }

    // Adaptive threshold: use AMG only for larger systems where setup cost is amortized.
    // For pressure Poisson, CG+IC is faster for n < ~10k; AMG overhead dominates and
    // pure Neumann (cavity) is difficult for AMG due to pinned reference cell.
    // Use AMG only for n >= the configured threshold where it actually pays off.
    const std::size_t amgThreshold = config_.amgThreshold;
    // For pure Neumann cavity, prefer CG even for larger sizes until AMG is hardened
    bool isPureNeumann = true;
    for (char v : isPressureOutlet_) if (v) { isPureNeumann = false; break; }
    if (isPureNeumann) {
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) if (mesh_.isBoundary(i) && !isPressureNeumann[i]) { isPureNeumann = false; break; }
    }
    const std::size_t effectiveThreshold = isPureNeumann ? 20000 : amgThreshold;
    if (config_.useAMG && config_.useAMGPreconditioner && n >= effectiveThreshold) {
        if (!amgBuilt_ || patternHash != amgPatternHash_) {
            amg_.invalidate();
            auto amgCfg = config_.amgConfig;
            amgCfg.tolerance *= volScale;
            amg_.setConfig(amgCfg);
            auto tBuild = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
            amg_.build(A_);
            pressureStats_.amgBuilds++;
            pressureStats_.buildSeconds += std::chrono::duration<double>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - tBuild).count();
            amgPrec_.setAMG(&amg_);
            amgBuilt_ = true;
            amgPatternHash_ = patternHash;
            prevPMask_ = pMask_;
            prevNonZeroPattern_ = triplets_.size();
        }

        if (amg_.isBuilt()) {
            if (!pPatternAnalyzed_ || compactChanged) {
                bicgSolver_.setMaxIterations(1000);
                bicgSolver_.setTolerance(1e-4 * volScale);
                bicgSolver_.analyzePattern(A_);
                pPatternAnalyzed_ = true;
                prevCompact_ = config_.compactRhieChow;
            }
            bicgSolver_.factorize(A_);
            bicgSolver_.preconditioner().setAMG(&amg_);
            auto tSolve = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
            x = bicgSolver_.solve(bVec_);
            pressureStats_.amgSolves++;
            pressureStats_.amgKrylovIters += bicgSolver_.iterations();
            pressureStats_.amgSeconds += std::chrono::duration<double>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - tSolve).count();
            converged = (bicgSolver_.info() == Eigen::Success);
            if (!converged) {
                pressureStats_.amgRejected++;
                std::cerr << "  WARNING: AMG-preconditioned BiCGSTAB did not converge (iters="
                          << bicgSolver_.iterations() << ", resid=" << bicgSolver_.error()
                          << "), falling back to CG+IC\n";
            }
        }
    } else if (config_.useAMG && n >= effectiveThreshold) {
        if (!amgBuilt_ || patternHash != amgPatternHash_) {
            amg_.invalidate();
            auto amgCfg = config_.amgConfig;
            amgCfg.tolerance *= volScale;
            amg_.setConfig(amgCfg);
            auto tBuild = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
            amg_.build(A_);
            pressureStats_.amgBuilds++;
            pressureStats_.buildSeconds += std::chrono::duration<double>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - tBuild).count();
            amgBuilt_ = true;
            amgPatternHash_ = patternHash;
            prevPMask_ = pMask_;
            prevNonZeroPattern_ = triplets_.size();
        }

        if (amg_.isBuilt()) {
            auto tSolve = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
            converged = amg_.solve(bVec_, x);
            pressureStats_.amgSolves++;
            pressureStats_.amgSeconds += std::chrono::duration<double>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - tSolve).count();
            if (!converged) {
                pressureStats_.amgRejected++;
                std::cerr << "  WARNING: AMG solve did not converge, falling back to CG+IC\n";
            }
        }
    }

    if (!converged) {
        std::size_t nz = triplets_.size();
        if (!pPatternAnalyzed_ || maskChanged || compactChanged || nz != prevNonZeroPattern_) {
            bicgFallbackSolver_.setMaxIterations(10000);
            bicgFallbackSolver_.setTolerance(1e-8 * volScale);
            bicgFallbackSolver_.analyzePattern(A_);
            bicgSolver_.setMaxIterations(1000);
            bicgSolver_.setTolerance(1e-4 * volScale);
            bicgSolver_.analyzePattern(A_);
            cgSolver_.setMaxIterations(10000);
            cgSolver_.setTolerance(1e-8 * volScale);
            cgSolver_.analyzePattern(A_);
            pPatternAnalyzed_ = true;
            prevPMask_ = pMask_;
            prevNonZeroPattern_ = nz;
            prevCompact_ = config_.compactRhieChow;
        }
        // The legacy composed pressure matrix is NOT symmetric: its rows are
        // built from one-sided least-squares gradient fits, so A = A^T fails
        // almost everywhere. CG + Incomplete Cholesky is only meaningful for
        // SPD systems and either stalls or diverges there, so the nonsymmetric
        // Krylov solve (BiCGSTAB + ILU) goes first and CG stays as a fallback.
        // The compact Rhie-Chow matrix is the two-point Laplacian stored with
        // the opposite sign (positive diagonal, negative off-diagonal), i.e.
        // SPD; BiCGSTAB still solves it, and CG remains the fallback.
        auto tIlu = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        bicgFallbackSolver_.factorize(A_);
        x = bicgFallbackSolver_.solve(bVec_);
        pressureStats_.iluSolves++;
        pressureStats_.krylovIters += bicgFallbackSolver_.iterations();
        pressureStats_.iluSeconds += std::chrono::duration<double>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - tIlu).count();
        converged = (bicgFallbackSolver_.info() == Eigen::Success);
        lastSolveIterations_ = bicgFallbackSolver_.iterations();
        lastSolveResidual_ = bicgFallbackSolver_.error();
        if (!converged) {
            std::cerr << "  WARNING: pressure BiCGSTAB+ILU failed (iters=" << bicgFallbackSolver_.iterations()
                      << ", resid=" << bicgFallbackSolver_.error() << "), falling back to CG+IC\n";
        }
        if (!converged) {
            cgSolver_.factorize(A_);
            x = cgSolver_.solve(bVec_);
            pressureStats_.krylovIters += cgSolver_.iterations();
            converged = (cgSolver_.info() == Eigen::Success);
            lastSolveIterations_ = cgSolver_.iterations();
            lastSolveResidual_ = cgSolver_.error();

            if (!converged) {
                std::cerr << "  WARNING: pressure CG fallback also failed (iters=" << cgSolver_.iterations()
                          << ", resid=" << cgSolver_.error() << ")\n";
            }
        }
    }

    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (std::isnan(x(static_cast<Eigen::Index>(i))) || std::isinf(x(static_cast<Eigen::Index>(i)))) {
            pPrime[i] = 0.0;
        } else {
            pPrime[i] = x(static_cast<Eigen::Index>(i));
        }
    }
}

template class PressureCorrection<2>;
template class PressureCorrection<3>;

} // namespace fvm
```

### src/fvm/PressureCorrection.h
```
#pragma once

#include "mesh/Mesh.h"
#include "field/Field.h"
#include "field/VectorField.h"
#include "fvm/Types.h"
#include "fvm/SIMPLETypes.h"
#include "fvm/Gradient.h"
#include "fvm/RhieChow.h"
#include "fvm/AMG.h"
#include <Eigen/Sparse>
#include <Eigen/IterativeLinearSolvers>
#include <array>
#include <vector>
#include <memory>
#include <cstddef>
#include <utility>

namespace fvm {

template<std::size_t Dim>
class PressureCorrection {
public:
    struct Config {
        // Diagnostic Rhie-Chow switch (the residual reports the correction).
        bool rhieChow = true;
        // Assemble the pressure equation from the compact face-normal
        // Laplacian and use the Rhie-Chow face flux on its right-hand side.
        // This is the collocated-grid formulation: the pressure matrix is the
        // two-point operator div(d_f (p_N-p_P)/d), the Rhie-Chow term removes
        // the checkerboard mode, and the velocity correction remains
        // u = u* - d grad(p'). Enabled for PISO; the legacy composed
        // least-squares operator (compactRhieChow = false) is kept for the
        // steady path and its exact-cancellation contracts.
        bool compactRhieChow = false;
        std::size_t pressureRefCell = SIZE_MAX;
        bool useAMG = true;
        bool useAMGPreconditioner = true;
        // Number of cells below which the AMG setup cost is not amortised and
        // the solve falls back to CG+IC (or BiCGSTAB+ILU). Pure-Neumann meshes
        // use twice this, because AMG handles a pinned reference cell poorly.
        std::size_t amgThreshold = 10000;
        // How many times the pressure matrix may change its VALUES before the
        // AMG hierarchy is rebuilt. The coarse levels depend on the matrix
        // through the Galerkin product, so a value change makes the hierarchy
        // stale - but rebuilding it on every outer iteration costs more than
        // the solve it accelerates. The matrix moves by a few percent per
        // iteration, so a hierarchy a few iterations old is still a good
        // preconditioner.
        std::size_t amgRebuildInterval = 10;
        AMGHierarchy::Config amgConfig = []{
            AMGHierarchy::Config c;
            c.interpolationType = AMGHierarchy::InterpolationType::Extended;
            c.coarseningType = AMGHierarchy::CoarseningType::RS;
            c.cycleType = AMGHierarchy::CycleType::V;
            c.strengthThreshold = 0.25;
            c.truncThreshold = 0.2;
            c.preSweeps = 2;
            c.postSweeps = 2;
            c.maxIterations = 100;
            c.tolerance = 1e-8;
            return c;
        }();
    };

    struct PressureSolverStats {
        std::size_t solves = 0;
        std::size_t amgSolves = 0;
        std::size_t iluSolves = 0;
        std::size_t amgBuilds = 0;
        std::size_t amgRejected = 0;
        std::size_t krylovIters = 0;
        std::size_t amgKrylovIters = 0;
        double iluSeconds = 0.0;
        double amgSeconds = 0.0;
        double buildSeconds = 0.0;
    };

    PressureCorrection(const Mesh<Dim>& mesh, const Config& config);
    PressureCorrection(const Mesh<Dim>& mesh);
    void setConfig(const Config& cfg) { config_ = cfg; }
    const std::vector<char>& pressureMask() const { return pMask_; }
    const std::array<Field<Dim>, Dim>& pressureGradient() const { return pressureGrad_; }

    // The number of cells that have no pressure equation at all (no interior
    // face: a detached cell). Such a cell is excluded from the pressure
    // unknowns and its mass balance can never be corrected, so the count is
    // reported - otherwise the run silently never converges.
    std::size_t isolatedCellCount() const { return isolatedCellCount_; }

    // Diagnostics of the last linear solve: the iteration count and the
    // residual the solver ended with.
    std::size_t lastSolveIterations() const { return lastSolveIterations_; }
    double lastSolveResidual() const { return lastSolveResidual_; }
    const PressureSolverStats& pressureStats() const { return pressureStats_; }
    void resetPressureStats() { pressureStats_ = PressureSolverStats{}; }
    // The assembled system of the last solve (diagnostics).
    const SparseMatrix& lastMatrix() const { return A_; }
    const Eigen::VectorXd& lastRhs() const { return bVec_; }

    void solve(
        const VectorField<Dim>& uStar,
        const std::array<std::vector<double>, Dim>& dCoeff,
        const Field<Dim>& pressure,
        Field<Dim>& pPrime,
        const std::vector<std::pair<std::size_t, double>>& pressureOutletCells,
        const std::vector<char>& isPressureNeumann,
        const std::vector<char>* isPressureDirichletFace = nullptr,
        const std::vector<std::pair<std::size_t, double>>* pressureOutletFaces = nullptr,
        const std::vector<FaceVelocityBC>* faceBC = nullptr,
        const std::vector<char>* faceHasBC = nullptr,
        // Velocity Dirichlet data (cell-level). When a cell carries a prescribed
        // velocity the momentum assembly uses that prescribed value for the WHOLE
        // face; the divergence here must use the very same face velocity, or the
        // pressure correction balances a mass imbalance that the momentum
        // equation never had.
        const std::vector<std::vector<char>>* velDirichletMask = nullptr,
        const std::vector<std::vector<double>>* velDirichletVals = nullptr);

private:
    const Mesh<Dim>& mesh_;
    Config config_;
    // The least-squares gradient of the pressure field. In compact Rhie-Chow
    // mode it supplies the face-interpolated gradient that the Rhie-Chow
    // correction subtracts; in legacy mode it is also the operator whose
    // divergence the pressure matrix is assembled from. It is the same
    // operator the velocity correction applies.
    std::unique_ptr<Gradient<Dim>> gradientCalc_;
    std::array<Field<Dim>, Dim> pressureGrad_;
    // The per-cell least-squares gradient as row coefficients
    // (gradientRows_[d][cell] = (column, coefficient) pairs), built once per
    // PressureCorrection object: the pressure matrix is assembled from them.
    std::array<std::vector<std::vector<std::pair<std::size_t, double>>>, Dim> gradientRows_;
    bool gradientRowsBuilt_ = false;

    // Reusable buffers to avoid per-iteration allocation
    mutable std::vector<Triplet> triplets_;
    mutable Eigen::VectorXd bVec_;
    mutable std::vector<char> pMask_;
    mutable std::vector<double> pVals_;
    mutable std::vector<char> isPressureOutlet_;
    mutable Field<Dim> divU_;

    // The number of cells that have no pressure equation at all (no interior
    // face: a detached cell). Such a cell is excluded from the pressure
    // unknowns and its mass balance can never be corrected, so the count is
    // reported - otherwise the run silently never converges.
    std::size_t isolatedCellCount_ = 0;
    // Diagnostics of the last linear solve.
    std::size_t lastSolveIterations_ = 0;
    double lastSolveResidual_ = 0.0;
    mutable PressureSolverStats pressureStats_{};

    Eigen::ConjugateGradient<SparseMatrix, Eigen::Lower|Eigen::Upper,
                             Eigen::IncompleteCholesky<double>> cgSolver_;
    Eigen::BiCGSTAB<SparseMatrix, AMGPreconditioner> bicgSolver_;
    Eigen::BiCGSTAB<SparseMatrix, Eigen::IncompleteLUT<double>> bicgFallbackSolver_;
    bool pPatternAnalyzed_ = false;
    mutable std::vector<char> prevPMask_;
    mutable std::size_t prevNonZeroPattern_ = 0;
    // The compact and legacy operators have different stencils. A transition
    // between them (e.g. when PISO forces Rhie-Chow after construction) must
    // re-analyse the preconditioner, not just overwrite values.
    bool prevCompact_ = false;

    AMGHierarchy amg_;
    AMGPreconditioner amgPrec_;
    bool amgBuilt_ = false;
    std::size_t amgPatternHash_ = 0;
    // Number of value changes of the pressure matrix since the hierarchy was
    // last built (see Config::amgRebuildInterval).
    std::size_t amgValueUpdates_ = 0;

    mutable SparseMatrix A_;
    mutable bool aPatternBuilt_ = false;
    mutable std::size_t aPatternHash_ = 0;
    // O(nnz) value update — avoids O(nnz log nnz) sort + O(nnz) hash per iter
    mutable std::vector<int> aTripletToValuePos_;
    mutable bool aNeedPosRebuild_ = false;
};

extern template class PressureCorrection<2>;
extern template class PressureCorrection<3>;

} // namespace fvm
```

### src/fvm/Residual.h
```
#pragma once

#include "mesh/Mesh.h"
#include "mesh/BoundaryUtils.h"
#include "field/Field.h"
#include "field/VectorField.h"
#include "fvm/Divergence.h"
#include "fvm/RhieChow.h"
#include "fvm/SIMPLETypes.h"
#include <array>
#include <cstddef>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <utility>
#include <cstdlib>

namespace fvm {

struct ResidualResult {
    double continuity;
    double momU;
    double momV;
    double momW;
};

template<std::size_t Dim>
inline ResidualResult computeResiduals(
    const Mesh<Dim>& mesh,
    const VectorField<Dim>& velocity,
    const VectorField<Dim>& velocityOld,
    const std::array<Field<Dim>, Dim>& diag,
    Field<Dim>& divBuffer,
    const std::vector<std::vector<char>>& dirichletMask,
    const std::vector<std::vector<double>>& dirichletVals,
    const std::vector<FaceVelocityBC>* faceBC = nullptr,
    const std::vector<char>* faceHasBC = nullptr,
    const std::array<std::vector<double>, Dim>* dCoeff = nullptr,
    const Field<Dim>* pressure = nullptr,
    const std::array<Field<Dim>, Dim>* pressureGrad = nullptr,
    const std::vector<char>* pMask = nullptr,
    bool rhieChow = false) {

    // Compute divergence with faceBC-aware, distance-weighted face values
    // This mirrors PressureCorrection's divergence for consistency
    const std::size_t nF = mesh.nFaces();
    const std::size_t n = mesh.nCells();
    std::vector<char> emptyMask;
    const std::vector<char>& maskRef = pMask ? *pMask : emptyMask;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) divBuffer[i] = 0.0;
    double sumFlux = 0.0;
    for (std::size_t f = 0; f < nF; ++f) {
        const std::size_t P = mesh.owner(f);
        const std::size_t N = mesh.neighbor(f);
        const double* fn = mesh.faceNormalPtr(f);
        double area = mesh.faceArea(f);
        double un = 0.0;
        bool hasBC = faceBC && faceHasBC && f < faceBC->size() && f < faceHasBC->size() && (*faceHasBC)[f];
        if (N == std::size_t(-1) && hasBC) {
            const auto& fbc = (*faceBC)[f];
            auto t = fbc.type;
            if (t == VelocityBCType::NoSlip || t == VelocityBCType::Symmetry || t == VelocityBCType::SlipWall) {
                un = 0.0;
            } else if (t == VelocityBCType::MovingWall || t == VelocityBCType::Inlet) {
                un = fbc.u * fn[0] + fbc.v * fn[1];
                if constexpr (Dim==3) un += fbc.w * fn[2];
            } else if (t == VelocityBCType::PressureOutlet || t == VelocityBCType::Outlet) {
                for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) un += velocity[d][P] * fn[d];
                std::array<double, Dim> fnArr{};
                for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) fnArr[d] = fn[d];
                un = applyBackflowCorrection<Dim>(un, fnArr, fbc);
            } else {
                for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) un += velocity[d][P] * fn[d];
            }
        } else {
            double w = mesh.faceWeight(f);
            if (N == std::size_t(-1)) {
                // Boundary without faceBC: use dirichletMask if available
                // Check any component dirichlet
                bool anyDirichlet = false;
                for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) if (!dirichletMask.empty() && d < dirichletMask.size() && !dirichletMask[d].empty() && dirichletMask[d][P]) { anyDirichlet = true; break; }
                if (anyDirichlet) {
                    for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) {
                        double uFace = (!dirichletMask.empty() && d < dirichletMask.size() && !dirichletMask[d].empty() && dirichletMask[d][P]) ? dirichletVals[d][P] : velocity[d][P];
                        un += uFace * fn[d];
                    }
                } else {
                    for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) un += velocity[d][P] * fn[d];
                }
            } else {
                // Interior: distance-weighted
                for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) {
                    double uFace;
                    const bool hasDirP = !dirichletMask.empty() && d < dirichletMask.size() && !dirichletMask[d].empty() && dirichletMask[d][P];
                    const bool hasDirN = !dirichletMask.empty() && d < dirichletMask.size() && !dirichletMask[d].empty() && dirichletMask[d][N];
                    // The SAME rule as the momentum assembly and the pressure
                    // correction: a cell with a prescribed velocity owns the
                    // whole face it shares with a neighbour and the NEIGHBOUR
                    // takes priority. The residual has to be built from the
                    // same face velocity as the operators it measures,
                    // otherwise the number printed as "continuity" is not the
                    // quantity the pressure correction drives to zero.
                    if (hasDirN) {
                        uFace = dirichletVals[d][N];
                    } else if (hasDirP) {
                        uFace = dirichletVals[d][P];
                    } else {
                        uFace = (1.0 - w) * velocity[d][P] + w * velocity[d][N];
                    }
                    un += uFace * fn[d];
                }
            }
        }
        if (rhieChow && N != std::size_t(-1) && dCoeff && pressure && pressureGrad) {
            un += rhieChowCorrection(mesh, f, *dCoeff, *pressure, *pressureGrad, maskRef);
        }

        double flux = un * area;
        sumFlux += std::abs(flux);
        divBuffer[P] += flux / mesh.cellVolume(P);
        if (N != std::size_t(-1)) {
            divBuffer[N] -= flux / mesh.cellVolume(N);
        }
    }

    double maxDiv = 0.0;
    double sumAbsDivVol = 0.0;
    double totalVol = 0.0;
    #pragma omp parallel for reduction(max:maxDiv) reduction(+:sumAbsDivVol,totalVol) schedule(static)
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (mesh.isBoundary(i)) continue;
        double ad = std::abs(divBuffer[i]);
        if (ad > maxDiv) maxDiv = ad;
        sumAbsDivVol += ad * mesh.cellVolume(i);
        totalVol += mesh.cellVolume(i);
    }
    // Primary residual: sumAbsDivVol normalized by sumFlux (mass imbalance / total flux)
    // Fallback to maxDiv * L / Uchar if sumFlux is tiny (e.g., all walls)
    double contResid = 0.0;
    if (sumFlux > 1e-30) {
        contResid = sumAbsDivVol / sumFlux;
    } else {
        double maxUmag = 0.0;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) if (!mesh.isBoundary(i)) {
            double um2 = 0.0;
            for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) um2 += velocity[d][i]*velocity[d][i];
            double um = std::sqrt(um2);
            if (um > maxUmag) maxUmag = um;
        }
        if (maxUmag < 1e-30) maxUmag = 1.0;
        double charLen = (totalVol>0)? std::pow(totalVol, 1.0/static_cast<double>(Dim)):1.0;
        contResid = maxDiv * charLen / maxUmag;
    }

    double maxUChange = 0.0, maxVChange = 0.0, maxWChange = 0.0;
    double maxU = 0.0, maxV = 0.0, maxW = 0.0;
    #pragma omp parallel for reduction(max:maxUChange,maxVChange,maxWChange,maxU,maxV,maxW) schedule(static)
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (mesh.isBoundary(i)) continue;
        double du = std::abs(velocity[0][i] - velocityOld[0][i]);
        if (du > maxUChange) maxUChange = du;
        double dv = std::abs(velocity[1][i] - velocityOld[1][i]);
        if (dv > maxVChange) maxVChange = dv;
        double au = std::abs(velocity[0][i]);
        if (au > maxU) maxU = au;
        double av = std::abs(velocity[1][i]);
        if (av > maxV) maxV = av;
        if constexpr (Dim == 3) {
            double dw = std::abs(velocity[2][i] - velocityOld[2][i]);
            if (dw > maxWChange) maxWChange = dw;
            double aw = std::abs(velocity[2][i]);
            if (aw > maxW) maxW = aw;
        }
    }
    double momScale = maxU;
    if (maxV > momScale) momScale = maxV;
    if constexpr (Dim==3) if (maxW > momScale) momScale = maxW;
    if (momScale < 1e-30) momScale = 1e-30;

    ResidualResult res;
    res.continuity = contResid;
    // Relative per-outer-iteration change. This is a useful diagnostic but NOT
    // a linear residual: it is proportional to (1-alphaU) times the correction,
    // so it measures iteration progress rather than how well the momentum
    // equation is satisfied. Callers that need a convergence criterion should
    // use the linear residual |A u - b| / sum|b| instead.
    res.momU = maxUChange / momScale;
    res.momV = maxVChange / momScale;
    if constexpr (Dim == 3) res.momW = maxWChange / momScale;
    else res.momW = 0.0;
    return res;
}

} // namespace fvm
```

### src/fvm/RhieChow.h
```
#pragma once

#include "mesh/Mesh.h"
#include "field/Field.h"
#include "fvm/Types.h"
#include <array>
#include <cstddef>
#include <vector>

namespace fvm {

template<std::size_t Dim>
inline double rhieChowCorrection(
    const Mesh<Dim>& mesh,
    std::size_t f,
    const std::array<std::vector<double>, Dim>& dCoeff,
    const Field<Dim>& pressure,
    const std::array<Field<Dim>, Dim>& pressureGrad,
    const std::vector<char>& pMask) {

    const std::size_t P = mesh.owner(f);
    const std::size_t N = mesh.neighbor(f);

    const auto& fn = mesh.faceNormal(f);
    const auto& xP = mesh.cellCenter(P);
    const auto& xN = mesh.cellCenter(N);

    std::array<double, Dim> dVec{};
    for (std::size_t dd = 0; dd < Dim; ++dd)
        dVec[dd] = xN[dd] - xP[dd];

    double dotSfd = 0.0;
    for (std::size_t dd = 0; dd < Dim; ++dd)
        dotSfd += fn[dd] * dVec[dd];

    double dist = mesh.faceDist(f);

    double w = mesh.faceWeight(f);
    double dFaceN = 0.0;
    for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) {
        double nd = fn[d];
        double dP_eff = pMask[P] ? 0.0 : dCoeff[d][P];
        double dN_eff = pMask[N] ? 0.0 : dCoeff[d][N];
        dFaceN += ((1.0 - w) * dP_eff + w * dN_eff) * nd * nd;
    }

    double gradP_interp_n = 0.0;
    for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d)
        gradP_interp_n += ((1.0 - w) * pressureGrad[d][P] + w * pressureGrad[d][N]) * fn[d];

    double gradP_face_n = (pressure[N] - pressure[P]) * dotSfd / (dist * dist);

    return dFaceN * (gradP_interp_n - gradP_face_n);
}

} // namespace fvm
```

### src/fvm/SIMPLE.cpp
```
#include "fvm/SIMPLE.h"

#include "fvm/PressureCorrection.h"
#include "fvm/Residual.h"
#include "fvm/VelocityCorrection.h"
#include "fvm/SSTConstants.h"
#include "io/VTKXMLWriter.h"

#include <iomanip>
#include <cmath>
#include <limits>
#include <cctype>
#include <fstream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <thread>

namespace fvm {

template<std::size_t Dim>
SIMPLE<Dim>::SIMPLE(const Mesh<Dim>& mesh, double rho, double nu, const Config& config)
    : mesh_(mesh),
      rho_(rho),
      nu_(nu),
      config_(config),
      momentum_(mesh, rho, nu),
      pressureCorrection_(mesh),
      pPrime_(mesh, 0.0),
      momDiag_(mesh, 0.0),
      uStar_(mesh, 0.0),
      bc_(mesh) {
    applyPressureSolverConfig_();
    for (auto& dc : dCoeff_) dc.assign(mesh.nCells(), 0.0);
    for (auto& g : velGrad_) g = Field<Dim>(mesh, 0.0);
    for (auto& g : pressureGrad_) g = Field<Dim>(mesh, 0.0);
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
bool SIMPLE<Dim>::isPiso_() const {
    return (config_.solverType == SolverType::PISO) ||
           (config_.transient.enabled && config_.transient.piso);
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void SIMPLE<Dim>::applyPressureSolverConfig_() {
    typename PressureCorrection<Dim>::Config pcCfg;
    // The compact face-normal Laplacian + Rhie-Chow flux is the collocated
    // operator the PISO correctors need. The steady path keeps the legacy
    // composed least-squares operator (and its exact-cancellation tests).
    pcCfg.compactRhieChow = isPiso_() && config_.rhieChow;
    pcCfg.rhieChow = config_.rhieChow;
    pcCfg.pressureRefCell = config_.pressureRefCell;
    pcCfg.useAMG = config_.pressureUseAMG;
    pcCfg.useAMGPreconditioner = config_.pressureUseAMGPreconditioner;
    pcCfg.amgThreshold = config_.pressureAmgThreshold;
    pcCfg.amgConfig = config_.pressureAmgConfig;
    pressureCorrection_.setConfig(pcCfg);
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void SIMPLE<Dim>::bindVelocity(VectorField<Dim>& velocity) {
    velocity_.emplace(std::ref(velocity));
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void SIMPLE<Dim>::bindPressure(Field<Dim>& pressure) {
    pressure_.emplace(std::ref(pressure));
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
VectorField<Dim>& SIMPLE<Dim>::boundVelocity() {
    return velocity_->get();
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
const VectorField<Dim>& SIMPLE<Dim>::boundVelocity() const {
    return velocity_->get();
}

Field<Dim>& SIMPLE<Dim>::boundPressure() {
    return pressure_->get();
}

template<std::size_t Dim>

    return pressure_->get();
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void SIMPLE<Dim>::enableTurbulence(double kInf, double omegaInf,
                                   double alphaK, double alphaOmega) {
    config_.turbulenceEnabled = true;
    config_.kInf = kInf;
    config_.omegaInf = omegaInf;
    config_.alphaK = alphaK;
    config_.alphaOmega = alphaOmega;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void SIMPLE<Dim>::initializeSolve_(VectorField<Dim>& velocity, Field<Dim>& pressure) {
    bindVelocity(velocity);
    bindPressure(pressure);

    lastIterations_ = 0;
    lastContResid_ = 0.0;
    lastMomResid_ = 0.0;
    convergedStreak_ = 0;
    aborted_ = false;
    {
        bool isPISO = (config_.solverType == SolverType::PISO) ||
                      (config_.transient.enabled && config_.transient.piso);
        adaptiveAlphaP_ = isPISO ? 1.0 : config_.alphaP;
    }
    prevContResid_ = 0.0;
    stallCount_ = 0;
    headerCounter_ = 0;

    if (!config_.checkpoint.restartFrom.empty()) {
        std::size_t savedIter = 0;
        double savedCont = 0.0, savedMom = 0.0;
        double savedAlphaP = config_.alphaP;
        std::size_t savedStall = 0;
        double savedPrev = 0.0;

        Field<Dim>* kPtr = nullptr;
        Field<Dim>* omegaPtr = nullptr;
        Field<Dim>* nutPtr = nullptr;
        if (turbulence_) {
            kPtr = &turbulence_->k();
            omegaPtr = &turbulence_->omega();
            nutPtr = &turbulence_->nut();
        }

        if (Checkpoint::load(config_.checkpoint.restartFrom, mesh_,
                             savedIter, savedCont, savedMom,
                             savedAlphaP, savedStall, savedPrev,
                             velocity, pressure,
                             kPtr, omegaPtr, nutPtr)) {
            startIteration_ = savedIter;
            restarting_ = true;
            {
                bool isPISO = (config_.solverType == SolverType::PISO) ||
                              (config_.transient.enabled && config_.transient.piso);
                adaptiveAlphaP_ = isPISO ? 1.0 : savedAlphaP;
            }
            stallCount_ = savedStall;
            prevContResid_ = savedPrev;
            lastContResid_ = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();
            lastMomResid_ = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();
            std::cout << "  [checkpoint] loaded from " << config_.checkpoint.restartFrom
                      << " at iteration " << savedIter << "\n";
        } else {
            std::cerr << "  [checkpoint] WARNING: failed to load " << config_.checkpoint.restartFrom
                      << ", starting from scratch\n";
            startIteration_ = 0;
        }
    } else {
        startIteration_ = 0;
    }

    updateMaxInletSpeed_();

    divBuffer_ = Field<Dim>(mesh_, 0.0);

    for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) {
        dpdx_[d] = Field<Dim>(mesh_, 0.0);
    }

    gradientCalc_ = std::make_unique<Gradient<Dim>>(mesh_);
    gradientCalc_->setScheme(config_.gradientScheme);
    // The pressure operator is always least squares: the pressure matrix, the
    // PISO corrector and the velocity correction are built from it.
    pressureGradientCalc_ = std::make_unique<Gradient<Dim>>(
        mesh_, GradientScheme::LeastSquares);
    for (auto& g : pressureGrad_) g = Field<Dim>(mesh_, 0.0);

    if (config_.turbulenceEnabled) {
        typename SSTModel<Dim>::Config sstCfg;
        sstCfg.kInf       = config_.kInf;
        sstCfg.omegaInf   = config_.omegaInf;
        sstCfg.alphaK     = config_.alphaK;
        sstCfg.alphaOmega = config_.alphaOmega;
        turbulence_ = std::make_unique<SSTModel<Dim>>(mesh_, sstCfg);
        turbulence_->initialize(nu_ * rho_, rho_);

        using BC = VelocityBCType;
        std::array<BC, 2*Dim> velBCEnums{};
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < 2 * Dim; ++i)
            velBCEnums[i] = bc_.velBCs()[i].type;
    turbulence_->computeWallDistance(velBCEnums);
    turbulence_->setBoundaryConditions(velBCEnums);
    for (const auto& it : config_.inletTurbulence) {
        auto git = mesh_.boundaryGroups().find(it.patch);
        if (git == mesh_.boundaryGroups().end()) continue;
        turbulence_->setInletTurbulence(git->second, it.k, it.omega);
    }
    }

    // Apply a queued restart payload. This must happen HERE, after
    // turbulence_ has been constructed: restoring k/omega/nut before that
    // point would let initialize() overwrite them with kInf/omegaInf.
    if (restartState_) {
        const RestartState& rs = *restartState_;
        const std::size_t n = mesh_.nCells();
        if (rs.hasVelocity) {
            for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) {
                const std::size_t m = std::min(n, rs.velocity[d].size());
                for (std::size_t i = 0; i < m; ++i) velocity[d][i] = rs.velocity[d][i];
            }
            const std::size_t mp = std::min(n, rs.pressure.size());
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < mp; ++i) pressure[i] = rs.pressure[i];
        }
        if (turbulence_ && rs.hasTurbulence) {
            const std::size_t mk = std::min(n, rs.k.size());
            const std::size_t mo = std::min(n, rs.omega.size());
            const std::size_t mn = std::min(n, rs.nut.size());
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < mk; ++i) turbulence_->k()[i] = rs.k[i];
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < mo; ++i) turbulence_->omega()[i] = rs.omega[i];
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < mn; ++i) turbulence_->nut()[i] = rs.nut[i];
        }
        if (rs.hasTransient) {
            time_ = rs.time;
            dt_ = rs.dt;
            dtPrev_ = rs.dtPrev;
            timeStep_ = rs.step;
            hasRestoredTransientState_ = true;
        }
        if (rs.hasVelocityHistory) {
            velocityNM1_ = VectorField<Dim>(mesh_, 0.0);
            for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) {
                const std::size_t m = std::min(n, rs.velocityNM1[d].size());
                for (std::size_t i = 0; i < m; ++i) velocityNM1_[d][i] = rs.velocityNM1[d][i];
            }
            hasVelocityHistory_ = true;
        }
        if (rs.hasTurbulenceHistory) {
            kNM1_ = Field<Dim>(mesh_, 0.0);
            omegaNM1_ = Field<Dim>(mesh_, 0.0);
            const std::size_t mk = std::min(n, rs.kNM1.size());
            const std::size_t mo = std::min(n, rs.omegaNM1.size());
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < mk; ++i) kNM1_[i] = rs.kNM1[i];
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < mo; ++i) omegaNM1_[i] = rs.omegaNM1[i];
        }
        restartState_.reset();
    } else {
        // No queued restart payload: this solver object starts a fresh run.
        // Without this reset a second solve()/solveTransient() call on the same
        // object would inherit the previous run's clock and BDF2 history.
        // A checkpoint-based transient restart re-loads these in solveTransient().
        time_ = 0.0;
        timeStep_ = 0;
        dtPrev_ = 0.0;
        hasRestoredTransientState_ = false;
        hasVelocityHistory_ = false;
        velocityNM1_ = VectorField<Dim>();
        kNM1_ = Field<Dim>();
        omegaNM1_ = Field<Dim>();
    }

    velocityOld_ = VectorField<Dim>(mesh_, 0.0);
    nutOld_ = Field<Dim>(mesh_, 0.0);
    initialMassImbalance_ = 0.0;
    initialMassImbalanceSet_ = false;
    residualHistory_.clear();
    divergenceCount_ = 0;
    stallCount_ = 0;
    prevContResid_ = 0.0;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void SIMPLE<Dim>::performIteration_(VectorField<Dim>& velocity, Field<Dim>& pressure, std::size_t iter) {
    for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d)
        std::copy((boundVelocity())[d].values().begin(), (boundVelocity())[d].values().end(),
                  velocityOld_[d].values().begin());

    // The boundary discretization is rebuilt only when the boundary
    // conditions actually changed. Rebuilding it every outer iteration copied
    // six per-cell vectors (and their allocations) for nothing.
    if (bc_.isDirty()) bcDiscretization_ = bc_.build();

    solveMomentum_(uStar_, velocityOld_);

    int nCorr = static_cast<int>(config_.pressureCorrectors);
    if (nCorr < 1) nCorr = 1;
    for (int corr = 0; corr < nCorr; ++corr) {
        pressureCorrection_.solve(uStar_, dCoeff_, boundPressure(), pPrime_,
                                 bcDiscretization_.pressureOutletCells(), bcDiscretization_.isPressureNeumann(),
                                 &bcDiscretization_.isPressureDirichletFaces(), &bcDiscretization_.pressureOutletFaces(),
                                 &bcDiscretization_.faceBCs(), &bcDiscretization_.faceHasBCs(),
                                 &bcDiscretization_.dirichletMask(), &bcDiscretization_.dirichletVals());

        // Scale p' only if extreme (configurable multiple of dynamic pressure).
        limitPressureCorrection_(pPrime_);

        pressureBeforeCorrection_ = boundPressure();
        pressureGradBefore_ = pressureCorrection_.pressureGradient();

        correctVelocity(mesh_, uStar_, pPrime_, dCoeff_,
                    bcDiscretization_.dirichletMask(), bcDiscretization_.dirichletVals(), dpdx_, boundVelocity(),
                    &bcDiscretization_.faceBCs(), &bcDiscretization_.faceHasBCs());

        #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < mesh_.nCells(); ++i) {
            (boundPressure())[i] += adaptiveAlphaP_ * pPrime_[i];
        }

        // Face-based pressure outlet (exact per-face pRef, fixes cell dedup loss)
        if (!bcDiscretization_.pressureOutletFaces().empty()) {
            for (const auto& [face, pRef] : bcDiscretization_.pressureOutletFaces()) {
                if (face < mesh_.nFaces()) {
                    std::size_t cell = mesh_.owner(face);
                    (boundPressure())[cell] = pRef;
                }
            }
        } else {
            for (const auto& [cell, pRef] : bcDiscretization_.pressureOutletCells()) {
                (boundPressure())[cell] = pRef;
            }
        }

        // For second corrector, update uStar to corrected velocity for next div calculation
        if (corr + 1 < nCorr) {
            uStar_ = boundVelocity();
        }
    }

    if (turbulence_) {
        nutOld_ = turbulence_->nut();
        turbulence_->solveIteration(boundVelocity(), config_.convectionScheme);
        double alphaNut = nutUnderRelax;
        auto& nut = turbulence_->nut();
        #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < mesh_.nCells(); ++i) {
            nut[i] = alphaNut * nut[i] + (1.0 - alphaNut) * nutOld_[i];
        }
    }
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
std::size_t SIMPLE<Dim>::sparsityHash_(const SparseMatrix& A) {
    // FNV-1a over the structural (i, j) pairs only — values are excluded so the
    // hash changes only when the stencil does.
    std::size_t h = 1469598103934665603ull;
    auto mix = [&h](std::size_t v) {
        h ^= v;
        h *= 1099511628211ull;
    };
    for (Eigen::Index j = 0; j < A.outerSize(); ++j) {
        for (SparseMatrix::InnerIterator it(A, j); it; ++it) {
            mix(static_cast<std::size_t>(it.row()));
            mix(static_cast<std::size_t>(it.col()));
        }
    }
    return h;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
bool SIMPLE<Dim>::hasPositiveOffDiagonals_(const SparseMatrix& A) {
    for (Eigen::Index k = 0; k < A.outerSize(); ++k) {
        for (SparseMatrix::InnerIterator it(A, k); it; ++it) {
            if (it.row() != it.col() && it.value() > 0.0) return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

template <std::size_t Dim>
Eigen::VectorXd SIMPLE<Dim>::solveMomentumILU_(std::size_t d, std::size_t& itersOut) {
    if (!momPatternAnalyzed_) {
        momSolver_.setMaxIterations(50000);
        momSolver_.setTolerance(1e-8);
        momSolver_.analyzePattern(momA_);
        momPatternAnalyzed_ = true;
    }
    momSolver_.factorize(momA_);
    Eigen::VectorXd x = momSolver_.solve(momB_);
    itersOut = static_cast<std::size_t>(momSolver_.iterations());
    if (momSolver_.info() != Eigen::Success) {
        std::cerr << "  WARNING: momentum-" << (d == 0 ? "U" : d == 1 ? "V" : "W")
                  << " BiCGSTAB failed (iters=" << momSolver_.iterations()
                  << ", resid=" << momSolver_.error() << ")\n";
    }
    return x;
}

template <std::size_t Dim>
Eigen::VectorXd SIMPLE<Dim>::solveMomentumLinear_(std::size_t d) {
    const std::size_t n = mesh_.nCells();
    ++momStats_.solves;

    const bool amgEligible =
        config_.useAMGMomentum &&
        !momAmgDisabledReason_ &&
        n >= config_.momentumAmgThreshold;

    if (!amgEligible) {
        if (config_.useAMGMomentum && !momAmgDisabledReason_ &&
            n < config_.momentumAmgThreshold) {
            momAmgDisabledReason_ = true;  // decision is permanent
        }
        std::size_t iters = 0;
        const auto t0 = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        Eigen::VectorXd x = solveMomentumILU_(d, iters);
        momStats_.iluSeconds += std::chrono::duration<double>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - t0).count();
        ++momStats_.iluSolves;
        momStats_.krylovIters += iters;
        return x;
    }

    // Central differencing puts positive entries on the outflow off-diagonals,
    // which destroys the M-matrix property the interpolation relies on. Detect
    // it from the assembled matrix rather than trusting the scheme enum, since
    // the sign pattern also depends on BC configuration.
    if (hasPositiveOffDiagonals_(momA_)) {
        momAmgDisabledReason_ = true;
        std::cerr << "  NOTE: momentum matrix has positive off-diagonal entries "
                     "(not an M-matrix) — AMG preconditioning disabled, using ILU.\n";
        std::size_t iters = 0;
        Eigen::VectorXd x = solveMomentumILU_(d, iters);
        ++momStats_.iluSolves;
        momStats_.krylovIters += iters;
        return x;
    }

    const std::size_t hash = sparsityHash_(momA_);
    const bool needBuild = !momAmgBuilt_[d] || hash != momAmgPatternHash_[d];

    if (needBuild) {
        const auto tb = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        momAmg_[d].setConfig(config_.momentumAmgConfig);
        momAmg_[d].build(momA_);
        momAmgPatternHash_[d] = hash;
        momAmgBuilt_[d] = momAmg_[d].isBuilt();
        momAmgValueUpdates_[d] = 0;
        ++momStats_.amgBuilds;
        momStats_.buildSeconds += std::chrono::duration<double>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - tb).count();
    } else if (++momAmgValueUpdates_[d] >= std::max<std::size_t>(1, config_.momentumAmgRebuildInterval)) {
        // The momentum matrix VALUES change every solve (convective flux,
        // pressure gradient, under-relaxation, rho*V/dt), unlike the pressure
        // correction matrix which is constant between pattern changes. Without
        // this the fine-level smoother runs on iteration-1 coefficients and the
        // preconditioner degrades until BiCGSTAB stalls.
        //
        // The rebuild is amortised: updateFineValues() rebuilds the whole
        // hierarchy (the coarse levels depend on A through the Galerkin
        // product, so a value-only fine update would be unsound), and doing
        // that on every solve costs more than the solve it accelerates.
        momAmgValueUpdates_[d] = 0;
        momAmg_[d].updateFineValues(momA_);
    }

    if (!momAmgBuilt_[d]) {
        std::size_t iters = 0;
        Eigen::VectorXd x = solveMomentumILU_(d, iters);
        ++momStats_.iluSolves;
        momStats_.krylovIters += iters;
        return x;
    }

    momAmgPrec_[d].setAMG(&momAmg_[d]);
    momAmgPrec_[d].setCycles(config_.momentumAmgCycles);
    if (!momAmgPatternAnalyzed_[d]) {
        momAmgSolver_[d].setMaxIterations(5000);
        momAmgSolver_[d].setTolerance(config_.momentumAmgMaxResidual);
        momAmgSolver_[d].analyzePattern(momA_);
        momAmgPatternAnalyzed_[d] = true;
    }

    const auto t0 = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
    momAmgSolver_[d].factorize(momA_);
    Eigen::VectorXd x = momAmgSolver_[d].solve(momB_);
    momStats_.amgSeconds += std::chrono::duration<double>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - t0).count();

    // Verify the true residual rather than trusting the Krylov solver's own
    // estimate: BiCGSTAB can break down with a nonsymmetric preconditioner and
    // return a plausible-looking wrong answer. The threshold has to be tight —
    // a 1e-4-accurate velocity solve fed back into SIMPLE compounds over
    // hundreds of outer iterations and saturates the velocity clamp.
    const double bnorm = momB_.norm();
    const double rnorm = (momA_ * x - momB_).norm();
    const double rel = bnorm > 0.0 ? rnorm / bnorm : rnorm;

    // NaN-safe: `rel > tol` is FALSE when rel is NaN, so a diverged solve
    // would slip through a naive comparison. Negating the `<=` catches it.
    const bool residualOk = (rel <= config_.momentumAmgMaxResidual);
    const bool bad =
        !residualOk ||
        !x.allFinite() ||
        !std::isfinite(rel) ||
        (momAmgSolver_[d].info() != Eigen::Success);

    if (bad) {
        ++momStats_.amgRejected;
        std::size_t iters = 0;
        Eigen::VectorXd xf = solveMomentumILU_(d, iters);
        ++momStats_.iluSolves;
        momStats_.krylovIters += iters;
        return xf;
    }

    ++momStats_.amgSolves;
    momStats_.amgKrylovIters += static_cast<std::size_t>(momAmgSolver_[d].iterations());
    momStats_.krylovIters += static_cast<std::size_t>(momAmgSolver_[d].iterations());
    return x;
}

template <std::size_t Dim>
void SIMPLE<Dim>::printMomentumSolverStats_() const {
    if (!config_.momentumSolverStats) return;
    std::cerr << "\n  Momentum linear solver statistics\n";
    std::cerr << "    solves:            " << momStats_.solves << "\n";
    std::cerr << "    AMG solves:        " << momStats_.amgSolves << "\n";
    std::cerr << "    ILU solves:        " << momStats_.iluSolves << "\n";
    std::cerr << "    AMG builds:        " << momStats_.amgBuilds << "\n";
    std::cerr << "    AMG rejected:      " << momStats_.amgRejected
              << "  (fell back to ILU)\n";
    std::cerr << "    Krylov iters:      " << momStats_.krylovIters << "\n";
    if (momStats_.solves > 0) {
        std::cerr << "    Krylov iters/solve:"
                  << "  " << (static_cast<double>(momStats_.krylovIters) /
                              static_cast<double>(momStats_.solves)) << "\n";
    }
    std::cerr << "    AMG build time:    " << momStats_.buildSeconds << " s\n";
    std::cerr << "    AMG solve time:    " << momStats_.amgSeconds << " s\n";
    std::cerr << "    ILU solve time:    " << momStats_.iluSeconds << " s\n";
}

template <std::size_t Dim>
void SIMPLE<Dim>::printPressureSolverStats_() const {
    const auto& s = pressureCorrection_.pressureStats();
    std::cerr << "\n  Pressure linear solver statistics\n";
    std::cerr << "    solves:            " << s.solves << "\n";
    std::cerr << "    AMG solves:        " << s.amgSolves << "\n";
    std::cerr << "    ILU solves:        " << s.iluSolves << "\n";
    std::cerr << "    AMG builds:        " << s.amgBuilds << "\n";
    std::cerr << "    AMG rejected:      " << s.amgRejected << "  (fell back to ILU/CG)\n";
    std::cerr << "    Krylov iters:      " << s.krylovIters << "\n";
    if (s.solves > 0) {
        std::cerr << "    Krylov iters/solve:"
                  << "  " << (static_cast<double>(s.krylovIters) /
                              static_cast<double>(s.solves)) << "\n";
    }
    std::cerr << "    AMG build time:    " << s.buildSeconds << " s\n";
    std::cerr << "    AMG solve time:    " << s.amgSeconds << " s\n";
    std::cerr << "    ILU solve time:    " << s.iluSeconds << " s\n";
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
double SIMPLE<Dim>::momentumResidual_(std::size_t d) const {
    if (d >= Dim) return 0.0;
    // Use the per-direction snapshot. momA_/momB_ are shared across
    // components and hold only the LAST component's system, so using them
    // here scores the u field against the v operator.
    const SparseMatrix& A = momAsnap_[d];
    const Eigen::VectorXd& b = momBsnap_[d];
    const Eigen::Index n = A.rows();
    if (n <= 0 || A.cols() != n || b.size() != n) return 0.0;
    const auto& u = (boundVelocity()[d]).values();
    if (static_cast<Eigen::Index>(u.size()) != n) return 0.0;

    // |A u - b| / sum|b| evaluated at the current velocity. The equation was
    // assembled with the previous pressure, so at convergence this measures
    // how much the pressure/velocity corrections displaced the solution, which
    // is the same convention Fluent uses. It tends to zero as p' -> 0.
    // A is stored column-major, so the row-wise dot products must be computed
    // via a proper matrix-vector product rather than by iterating columns.
    Eigen::Map<const Eigen::VectorXd> uvec(u.data(), n);
    Eigen::VectorXd r = A * uvec - b;
    double num = r.cwiseAbs().sum();
    double den = b.cwiseAbs().sum();
    return den > 1e-30 ? num / den : num;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void SIMPLE<Dim>::updateResiduals_() {    ResidualResult resid = computeResiduals(mesh_, boundVelocity(), velocityOld_, diag_,
                                             divBuffer_, bcDiscretization_.dirichletMask(), bcDiscretization_.dirichletVals(),
                                              &bcDiscretization_.faceBCs(), &bcDiscretization_.faceHasBCs(),
                                              &dCoeff_, &pressureBeforeCorrection_, &pressureGradBefore_, &pressureCorrection_.pressureMask(),
                                              config_.rhieChow);
    if (!initialMassImbalanceSet_) {
        initialMassImbalance_ = resid.continuity;
        initialMassImbalanceSet_ = true;
    }
    // resid.continuity is ALREADY a normalised, scale-free mass imbalance
    // (sum|div|*V / sum|flux|), exactly the quantity Fluent reports. Dividing it
