                        const auto& otherBC  = spec.velBcs[other_d  * 2 + (other_sign < 0 ? 0 : 1)];
                        auto isDirichletWall = [](VelocityBCType t) {
                            return t == VelocityBCType::NoSlip ||
                                   t == VelocityBCType::MovingWall ||
                                   t == VelocityBCType::Inlet;
                        };
                        if (!isDirichletWall(cornerBC.type) || !isDirichletWall(otherBC.type)) {
                            continue;
                        }
                        bool cMoving = (cornerBC.type == VelocityBCType::MovingWall);
                        bool oMoving = (otherBC.type  == VelocityBCType::MovingWall);
                        bool mixedMovingStationary = (cMoving != oMoving);

                        double cornerVals[Dim]{};
                        bool   cornerValid[Dim]{};
                        for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) {
                            double vC = (d == 0) ? cornerBC.u : (d == 1) ? cornerBC.v : cornerBC.w;
                            double vO = (d == 0) ? otherBC.u  : (d == 1) ? otherBC.v  : otherBC.w;
                            if (mixedMovingStationary) {
                                // Let mixed corners float: do not force a Dirichlet value
                                // for either velocity component; the momentum equations
                                // will determine the cell value from face fluxes.
                                cornerValid[d] = false;
                            } else if (cMoving && oMoving) {
                                if (std::abs(vC - vO) < 1e-12) {
                                    cornerVals[d] = vC;
                                    cornerValid[d] = true;
                                } else {
                                    cornerVals[d] = 0.0;
                                    cornerValid[d] = true;
                                }
                            } else {
                                // Both stationary: no override needed.
                                cornerValid[d] = false;
                            }
                        }
                        forEachBoundaryCell(mesh, corner_d, corner_sign, [&](std::size_t cell) {
                            auto c = mesh.cellCoords(cell);
                            if (c[other_d] == (other_sign < 0 ? 0 : mesh.n(other_d) - 1)) {
                                if (mixedMovingStationary) {
                                    for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) {
                                        disc.dirichletMask_[d][cell] = 0;
                                    }
                                } else {
                                    for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) {
                                        if (cornerValid[d]) {
                                            disc.dirichletMask_[d][cell] = 1;
                                            disc.dirichletVals_[d][cell] = cornerVals[d];
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        });
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (!mesh.isUnstructured()) {
        for (std::size_t wall_d = 0; wall_d < Dim; ++wall_d) {
            for (int sign : {-1, +1}) {
                std::size_t idx = wall_d * 2 + (sign < 0 ? 0 : 1);
                const auto& bc = spec.velBcs[idx];
                if (bc.type == VelocityBCType::Outlet ||
                    bc.type == VelocityBCType::Symmetry ||
                    bc.type == VelocityBCType::SlipWall ||
                    bc.type == VelocityBCType::Inlet ||
                    bc.type == VelocityBCType::NoSlip ||
                    bc.type == VelocityBCType::MovingWall) {
                    forEachBoundaryFace(mesh, wall_d, sign, [&](std::size_t f, std::size_t) {
                        disc.isPressureNeumannFace_[f] = 1;
                    });
                } else if (bc.type == VelocityBCType::PressureOutlet) {
                    forEachBoundaryFace(mesh, wall_d, sign, [&](std::size_t f, std::size_t cell) {
                        (void)f;
                        disc.pressureOutletCells_.emplace_back(cell, bc.pressureValue);
                    });
                }
            }
        }
    }

    for (const auto& [faceIdx, fbc] : spec.faceVelBCs) {
        std::size_t cell = mesh.owner(faceIdx);
        if (fbc.type == VelocityBCType::Inlet) {
            disc.isPressureNeumannFace_[faceIdx] = 1;
        } else if (fbc.type == VelocityBCType::NoSlip || fbc.type == VelocityBCType::MovingWall) {
            disc.isPressureNeumannFace_[faceIdx] = 1;
        } else if (fbc.type == VelocityBCType::Symmetry || fbc.type == VelocityBCType::SlipWall) {
            if (!mesh.isUnstructured()) {
                const auto& fn = mesh.faceNormal(faceIdx);
                std::size_t maxD = 0;
                double maxAbs = 0.0;
                for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) {
                    double absN = std::abs(fn[d]);
                    if (absN > maxAbs) {
                        maxAbs = absN;
                        maxD = d;
                    }
                }
                for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) {
                    if (d != maxD) disc.slipWallMask_[d][cell] = 1;
                }
            }
            disc.isPressureNeumannFace_[faceIdx] = 1;
        } else if (fbc.type == VelocityBCType::Outlet) {
            disc.isPressureNeumannFace_[faceIdx] = 1;
        } else if (fbc.type == VelocityBCType::PressureOutlet) {
            disc.pressureOutletCells_.emplace_back(cell, fbc.pressureValue);
        }
    }

    std::sort(disc.pressureOutletCells_.begin(), disc.pressureOutletCells_.end(),
              [](const auto& a, const auto& b) { return a.first < b.first; });
    disc.pressureOutletCells_.erase(
        std::unique(disc.pressureOutletCells_.begin(), disc.pressureOutletCells_.end(),
                    [](const auto& a, const auto& b) { return a.first == b.first; }),
        disc.pressureOutletCells_.end());

    for (std::size_t f = 0; f < mesh.nFaces(); ++f) {
        if (mesh.neighbor(f) != std::size_t(-1)) continue;
        auto it = spec.faceVelBCs.find(f);
        if (it != spec.faceVelBCs.end()) {
            disc.faceBC_[f] = it->second;
            disc.faceHasBC_[f] = 1;
            if (it->second.type == VelocityBCType::PressureOutlet) {
                disc.isPressureDirichletFace_[f] = 1;
                disc.pressureOutletFaces_.emplace_back(f, it->second.pressureValue);
            }
            continue;
        }
        if (!mesh.isUnstructured()) {
            const auto& wallMap = faceToWallMap[f];
            if (wallMap.first != static_cast<std::size_t>(-1)) {
                std::size_t wall_d = wallMap.first;
                int sign = wallMap.second;
                std::size_t idx = wall_d * 2 + (sign < 0 ? 0 : 1);
                const auto& bc = spec.velBcs[idx];
                FaceVelocityBC fbc;
                fbc.type = bc.type;
                fbc.u = bc.u; fbc.v = bc.v; fbc.w = bc.w;
                fbc.pressureValue = bc.pressureValue;
                disc.faceBC_[f] = fbc;
                disc.faceHasBC_[f] = 1;
                if (bc.type == VelocityBCType::PressureOutlet) {
                    disc.isPressureDirichletFace_[f] = 1;
                    disc.pressureOutletFaces_.emplace_back(f, bc.pressureValue);
                }
            } else {
                disc.faceBC_[f].type = VelocityBCType::NoSlip;
                disc.faceHasBC_[f] = 1;
                disc.isPressureNeumannFace_[f] = 1;
            }
        } else {
            // Unstructured mesh: deduce the wall direction from the face
            // normal so that a direction based BC (inlet, outlet, no-slip
            // wall, moving wall, ...) still applies to this face. The
            // previous code applied the direction based BCs only when NO face
            // based BC existed at all, so on an unstructured mesh a single
            // face based BC silently discarded every direction based BC and
            // those walls fell back to the default no-slip.
            const auto& fn = mesh.faceNormal(f);
            std::size_t wall_d = 0;
            double maxA = 0.0;
            for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) {
                const double a = std::abs(fn[d]);
                if (a > maxA) { maxA = a; wall_d = d; }
            }
            const int sign = (fn[wall_d] < 0.0) ? -1 : 1;
            if (maxA >= 0.5) {
                // The face is aligned with a coordinate direction: use the
                // direction based boundary condition.
                const auto& bc = spec.velBcs[wall_d * 2 + (sign < 0 ? 0 : 1)];
                FaceVelocityBC fbc;
                fbc.type = bc.type;
                fbc.u = bc.u; fbc.v = bc.v; fbc.w = bc.w;
                fbc.pressureValue = bc.pressureValue;
                disc.faceBC_[f] = fbc;
                disc.faceHasBC_[f] = 1;
                if (bc.type == VelocityBCType::PressureOutlet) {
                    disc.isPressureDirichletFace_[f] = 1;
                    disc.pressureOutletFaces_.emplace_back(f, bc.pressureValue);
                } else {
                    disc.isPressureNeumannFace_[f] = 1;
                }
            } else {
                // Oblique face: no direction based condition applies.
                disc.faceBC_[f].type = VelocityBCType::NoSlip;
                disc.faceHasBC_[f] = 1;
                // A no-slip wall is a pressure-Neumann boundary. Without this flag the
                // owning cell fails the "every boundary face is Neumann" test below,
                // and PressureCorrection then drops that cell from the Poisson system
                // as a p' = 0 Dirichlet cell - i.e. it invents a p = 0 constraint on a
                // wall that the momentum equation treats as a solid no-slip surface.
                // The two must agree, otherwise the pressure field that drives the
                // recirculation is corrupted exactly at the boundary.
                disc.isPressureNeumannFace_[f] = 1;
            }
        }
    }

    // Cell-level pressure condition: a boundary cell is pressure-Neumann only
    // when EVERY boundary face it owns is Neumann. This must run after the
    // face BC assignment above, because that is where the fallback no-slip wall
    // is installed - and the fallback has to contribute its Neumann flag.
    {
        std::vector<int> boundaryFaceCount(mesh.nCells(), 0);
        std::vector<int> pressureNeumannCount(mesh.nCells(), 0);
        for (std::size_t f = 0; f < mesh.nFaces(); ++f) {
            if (mesh.neighbor(f) != std::size_t(-1)) continue;
            std::size_t P = mesh.owner(f);
            ++boundaryFaceCount[P];
            if (disc.isPressureNeumannFace_[f]) ++pressureNeumannCount[P];
        }
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < mesh.nCells(); ++i) {
            disc.isPressureNeumann_[i] = (boundaryFaceCount[i] > 0 &&
                                         pressureNeumannCount[i] == boundaryFaceCount[i]);
        }
    }

    std::sort(disc.pressureOutletFaces_.begin(), disc.pressureOutletFaces_.end(),
              [](const auto& a, const auto& b){ return a.first < b.first; });
    disc.pressureOutletFaces_.erase(
        std::unique(disc.pressureOutletFaces_.begin(), disc.pressureOutletFaces_.end(),
                    [](const auto& a, const auto& b){ return a.first == b.first; }),
        disc.pressureOutletFaces_.end());

    return disc;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
SIMPLEBoundaryConditions<Dim>::SIMPLEBoundaryConditions(const Mesh<Dim>& mesh)
    : mesh_(mesh),
      velBcs_(2 * Dim),
      velPatches_(),
      faceVelBCs_() {
    for (auto& bc : velBcs_) bc = VelocityBC{};
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void SIMPLEBoundaryConditions<Dim>::setVelocityBC(std::size_t d, int sign, VelocityBCType type,
                                                   double val1, double val2, double val3) {
    std::size_t idx = d * 2 + (sign < 0 ? 0 : 1);
    velBcs_[idx] = type == VelocityBCType::Inlet || type == VelocityBCType::MovingWall
                       ? VelocityBC{type, val1, val2, val3}
                       : VelocityBC{type, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
    dirty_ = true;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void SIMPLEBoundaryConditions<Dim>::setPressureOutlet(std::size_t d, int sign, double pressure) {
    std::size_t idx = d * 2 + (sign < 0 ? 0 : 1);
    velBcs_[idx].type = VelocityBCType::PressureOutlet;
    velBcs_[idx].u = 0.0;
    velBcs_[idx].v = 0.0;
    velBcs_[idx].w = 0.0;
    velBcs_[idx].pressureValue = pressure;
    dirty_ = true;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void SIMPLEBoundaryConditions<Dim>::addVelocityPatch(const std::string& name, std::size_t d, int sign,
                                                      VelocityBCType type, double u, double v, double w) {
    velPatches_.push_back({name, d, sign, type, u, v, w});
    setVelocityBC(d, sign, type, u, v, w);
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
const VelocityPatch* SIMPLEBoundaryConditions<Dim>::findVelocityPatch(const std::string& name) const {
    for (const auto& p : velPatches_) {
        if (p.name == name) return &p;
    }
    return nullptr;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void SIMPLEBoundaryConditions<Dim>::setVelocityBCOnFaces(const std::vector<std::size_t>& faceIndices,
                                                          VelocityBCType type,
                                                          double u, double v, double w) {
    FaceVelocityBC fbc;
    fbc.type = type;
    fbc.u = (type == VelocityBCType::Inlet || type == VelocityBCType::MovingWall) ? u : 0.0;
    fbc.v = (type == VelocityBCType::Inlet || type == VelocityBCType::MovingWall) ? v : 0.0;
    fbc.w = (type == VelocityBCType::Inlet || type == VelocityBCType::MovingWall) ? w : 0.0;
    for (std::size_t f : faceIndices) {
        faceVelBCs_[f] = fbc;
    }
    dirty_ = true;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void SIMPLEBoundaryConditions<Dim>::setVelocityBCOnFacesWithSlip(const std::vector<std::size_t>& faceIndices,
                                                                  const std::string& typeStr,
                                                                  double u, double v, double w,
                                                                  bool slip,
                                                                  double pressure) {
    std::string t;
    t.reserve(typeStr.size());
    for (char c : typeStr) t += static_cast<char>(std::tolower(static_cast<unsigned char>(c)));

    if (t == "inlet" || t == "velocity_inlet") {
        setVelocityBCOnFaces(faceIndices, VelocityBCType::Inlet, u, v, w);
    } else if (t == "outlet") {
        setVelocityBCOnFaces(faceIndices, VelocityBCType::Outlet);
    } else if (t == "pressure_outlet") {
        setPressureOutletOnFaces(faceIndices, pressure);
    } else if (t == "moving_wall") {
        setVelocityBCOnFaces(faceIndices, VelocityBCType::MovingWall, u, v, w);
    } else if (t == "symmetry") {
        setVelocityBCOnFaces(faceIndices, VelocityBCType::Symmetry);
    } else if (slip || t == "slip" || t == "slip_wall" || t == "slipwall") {
        setVelocityBCOnFaces(faceIndices, VelocityBCType::SlipWall);
    } else {
        setVelocityBCOnFaces(faceIndices, VelocityBCType::NoSlip);
    }
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void SIMPLEBoundaryConditions<Dim>::setPressureOutletOnFaces(const std::vector<std::size_t>& faceIndices,
                                                              double pressure) {
    FaceVelocityBC fbc;
    fbc.type = VelocityBCType::PressureOutlet;
    fbc.u = 0.0;
    fbc.v = 0.0;
    fbc.w = 0.0;
    fbc.pressureValue = pressure;
    for (std::size_t f : faceIndices) {
        faceVelBCs_[f] = fbc;
    }
    dirty_ = true;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void SIMPLEBoundaryConditions<Dim>::setPressureOutletOnFacesWithBackflow(const std::vector<std::size_t>& faceIndices,
                                                                          double pressure,
                                                                          bool suppressBackflow,
                                                                          double backflowU, double backflowV, double backflowW,
                                                                          double backflowK, double backflowOmega) {
    FaceVelocityBC fbc;
    fbc.type = VelocityBCType::PressureOutlet;
    fbc.u = 0.0;
    fbc.v = 0.0;
    fbc.w = 0.0;
    fbc.pressureValue = pressure;
    fbc.suppressBackflow = suppressBackflow;
    fbc.backflowU = backflowU;
    fbc.backflowV = backflowV;
    fbc.backflowW = backflowW;
    fbc.backflowK = backflowK;
    fbc.backflowOmega = backflowOmega;
    for (std::size_t f : faceIndices) {
        faceVelBCs_[f] = fbc;
    }
    dirty_ = true;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
double SIMPLEBoundaryConditions<Dim>::maxInletSpeed(double fallback) const {
    double maxS = 0.0;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < 2 * Dim; ++i) {
        if (velBcs_[i].type == VelocityBCType::Inlet) {
            double spd = std::sqrt(velBcs_[i].u * velBcs_[i].u
                                 + velBcs_[i].v * velBcs_[i].v
                                 + velBcs_[i].w * velBcs_[i].w);
            maxS = std::max(maxS, spd);
        }
    }
    for (const auto& [faceIdx, fbc] : faceVelBCs_) {
        if (fbc.type == VelocityBCType::Inlet) {
            double spd = std::sqrt(fbc.u * fbc.u + fbc.v * fbc.v + fbc.w * fbc.w);
            maxS = std::max(maxS, spd);
        }
    }
    if (maxS < 1e-12) maxS = fallback;
    return maxS;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
BCDiscretization SIMPLEBoundaryConditions<Dim>::build() {
    BCDiscretization disc = buildBCMasks(mesh_, {velBcs_, velPatches_, faceVelBCs_});
    if (firstBuild_) {
        firstBuild_ = false;
        debugPrint(disc);
    }
    dirty_ = false;
    return disc;
}

template <std::size_t Dim>
double SIMPLEBoundaryConditions<Dim>::maxPrescribedSpeed(double fallback) const {
    double maxS = 0.0;
    auto consider = [&](double u, double v, double w) {
        double s = u * u + v * v;
        if constexpr (Dim >= 3) s += w * w;
        if (s > maxS) maxS = s;
    };
    for (const auto& bc : velBcs_) {
        if (bc.type != VelocityBCType::Inlet && bc.type != VelocityBCType::MovingWall) continue;
        consider(bc.u, bc.v, bc.w);
    }
    for (const auto& bc : faceVelBCs_) {
        if (bc.second.type != VelocityBCType::Inlet && bc.second.type != VelocityBCType::MovingWall) continue;
        consider(bc.second.u, bc.second.v, bc.second.w);
    }
    if (maxS <= 0.0) return fallback;
    return std::sqrt(maxS);
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void SIMPLEBoundaryConditions<Dim>::debugPrint(const BCDiscretization& disc) const {
    std::size_t faceVelBCCount = faceVelBCs_.size();
    std::size_t dirichletCount[Dim]{};
    std::size_t neumannCount = 0;
    std::size_t neumannFaceCount = 0;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < mesh_.nCells(); ++i) {
        if (disc.isPressureNeumann_[i]) ++neumannCount;
        for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d)
            if (disc.dirichletMask_[d][i]) dirichletCount[d]++;
    }
    for (std::size_t f = 0; f < mesh_.nFaces(); ++f) {
        if (disc.isPressureNeumannFace_[f]) ++neumannFaceCount;
    }
    std::cout << "  [BC] faceVelBCs=" << faceVelBCCount
              << " dirichlet U=" << dirichletCount[0] << " V=" << dirichletCount[1];
    if constexpr (Dim == 3) std::cout << " W=" << dirichletCount[2];
    std::cout << " pressureNeumann cells=" << neumannCount
              << " faces=" << neumannFaceCount
              << " pressureOutlet cells=" << disc.pressureOutletCells_.size()
              << " faces=" << disc.pressureOutletFaces_.size() << "\n";
}

template class SIMPLEBoundaryConditions<2>;
template class SIMPLEBoundaryConditions<3>;

} // namespace fvm

    const std::vector<std::vector<double>>& dirichletVals() const { return dirichletVals_; }
    const std::vector<std::vector<char>>& slipWallMask() const { return slipWallMask_; }
    const std::vector<char>& isPressureNeumannFace() const { return isPressureNeumannFace_; }
    const std::vector<char>& isPressureNeumann() const { return isPressureNeumann_; }

    const std::vector<double>& dirichletVals(std::size_t d) const { return dirichletVals_[d]; }
    const std::vector<char>& slipWallMask(std::size_t d) const { return slipWallMask_[d]; }
};

template<std::size_t Dim>
class SIMPLEBoundaryConditions {
public:
    explicit SIMPLEBoundaryConditions(const Mesh<Dim>& mesh);

    void setVelocityBC(std::size_t d, int sign, VelocityBCType type,
                       double u = 0.0, double v = 0.0, double w = 0.0);
    void setPressureOutlet(std::size_t d, int sign, double pressure);

    void addVelocityPatch(const std::string& name, std::size_t d, int sign,
                          VelocityBCType type, double u = 0.0, double v = 0.0, double w = 0.0);
    const VelocityPatch* findVelocityPatch(const std::string& name) const;
    const std::vector<VelocityBC>& velBCs() const { return velBcs_; }
    const std::unordered_map<std::size_t, FaceVelocityBC>& faceVelBCs() const { return faceVelBCs_; }

    const std::vector<VelocityPatch>& velocityPatches() const { return velPatches_; }

    void setVelocityBCOnFaces(const std::vector<std::size_t>& faceIndices,
                              VelocityBCType type,
                              double u = 0.0, double v = 0.0, double w = 0.0);
    void setVelocityBCOnFacesWithSlip(const std::vector<std::size_t>& faceIndices,
                                      const std::string& typeStr,
                                      double u, double v, double w,
                                      bool slip,
                                      double pressure = 0.0);
    void setPressureOutletOnFaces(const std::vector<std::size_t>& faceIndices, double pressure);
    void setPressureOutletOnFacesWithBackflow(const std::vector<std::size_t>& faceIndices,
                                              double pressure,
                                              bool suppressBackflow,
                                              double backflowU, double backflowV, double backflowW,
                                              double backflowK, double backflowOmega);

    bool isDirty() const { return dirty_; }
    void markDirty() { dirty_ = true; }
    BCDiscretization build();
    void ensureBuilt() { if (dirty_) build(); }

    BCSpec spec() const { return {velBcs_, velPatches_, faceVelBCs_}; }

    double maxInletSpeed(double fallback = 1.0) const;

    // Largest *prescribed* velocity magnitude anywhere in the domain, counting
    // moving walls as well as inlets. This is the correct scale for the
    // velocity-correction clamp and the p' limiter: a lid-driven cavity has no
    // inlet at all, so maxInletSpeed() would fall back to an arbitrary 1.0 and
    // the clamp could then override the lid velocity itself.
    double maxPrescribedSpeed(double fallback = 1.0) const;

    void debugPrint(const BCDiscretization& disc) const;

private:
    const Mesh<Dim>& mesh_;

    std::vector<VelocityBC> velBcs_;
    std::vector<VelocityPatch> velPatches_;
    std::unordered_map<std::size_t, FaceVelocityBC> faceVelBCs_;

    mutable bool dirty_ = true;
    mutable bool firstBuild_ = true;
};

### src/fvm/SIMPLETypes.h

#pragma once

#include <string>
#include <cstddef>

namespace fvm {

enum class SolverType { SIMPLE, PISO, PIMPLE };

inline SolverType solverTypeFromString(const std::string& s) {
    std::string t;
    t.reserve(s.size());
    for (char c : s) t += static_cast<char>(std::tolower(static_cast<unsigned char>(c)));
    if (t == "piso") return SolverType::PISO;
    if (t == "pimple") return SolverType::PIMPLE;
    return SolverType::SIMPLE;
}

inline std::string solverTypeToString(SolverType t) {
    switch (t) {
        case SolverType::PISO: return "PISO";
        case SolverType::PIMPLE: return "PIMPLE";
        default: return "SIMPLE";
    }
}

// Velocity boundary condition types — dimension-independent.
// Extracted from SIMPLE<Dim>::VelocityBCType to break the god-file cycle.
// SIMPLE<Dim> re-exports these as nested aliases for backward compatibility.
enum class VelocityBCType { NoSlip, Inlet, Outlet, PressureOutlet, Symmetry, SlipWall, MovingWall };

struct VelocityBC {
    VelocityBCType type = VelocityBCType::NoSlip;
    double u = 0.0;
    double v = 0.0;
    double w = 0.0;
    double pressureValue = 0.0;
};

struct VelocityPatch {
    std::string name;
    std::size_t wallDim = 0;
    int wallSign = 0;
    VelocityBCType type = VelocityBCType::NoSlip;
    double u = 0.0;
    double v = 0.0;
    double w = 0.0;
};

struct FaceVelocityBC {
    VelocityBCType type = VelocityBCType::NoSlip;
    double u = 0.0;
    double v = 0.0;
    double w = 0.0;
    double pressureValue = 0.0;
    // Fluent-like pressure outlet backflow handling
    bool suppressBackflow = false; // if true, clamp U·n >=0 (prevent inflow through outlet)
    double backflowU = 0.0;
    double backflowV = 0.0;
    double backflowW = 0.0;
    double backflowK = 0.0;
    double backflowOmega = 0.0;
};

struct PressureOutletConfig {
    double p0 = 0.0; // gauge static pressure at outlet
    double operatingPressure = 0.0; // operating pressure offset (Fluent)
    bool radialEquilibrium = false;
    bool suppressBackflow = false;
    double backflowU = 0.0;
    double backflowV = 0.0;
    double backflowW = 0.0;
    double backflowK = 0.0;
    double backflowOmega = 0.0;
};

} // namespace fvm

### src/fvm/SSTModel.cpp
```
#include "fvm/SSTModel.h"
#include <cstdio>
#include <Eigen/IterativeLinearSolvers>
#include <queue>

namespace fvm {

template<std::size_t Dim>
SSTModel<Dim>::SSTModel(const Mesh<Dim>& mesh, Config config)
    : mesh_(mesh),
      config_(config),
      k_(mesh, config.kInf),
      omega_(mesh, config.omegaInf),
      nut_(mesh, 0.0),
      wallDist_(mesh, 0.0),
      S_(mesh, 0.0),
      F1_(mesh, 0.0),
      F2_(mesh, 0.0),
      poisson_(mesh),
      convection_(mesh),
      gradient_(mesh) {
    for (auto& g : gradK_) g = Field<Dim>(mesh, 0.0);
    for (auto& g : gradOmega_) g = Field<Dim>(mesh, 0.0);
    for (auto& g : scalarGradBuffer_) g = Field<Dim>(mesh, 0.0);
    kSolver_.setMaxIterations(static_cast<int>(sstMaxIterations));
    kSolver_.setTolerance(sstTolerance);
    omegaSolver_.setMaxIterations(static_cast<int>(sstMaxIterations));
    omegaSolver_.setTolerance(sstTolerance);
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void SSTModel<Dim>::initialize(double mu, double rho) {
    mu_ = mu;
    rho_ = rho;
    const std::size_t n = mesh_.nCells();
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        k_[i] = config_.kInf;
        omega_[i] = config_.omegaInf;
        // Seed eddy viscosity from the initial k/omega so the first momentum
        // solve already feels the turbulent viscosity instead of running laminar.
        nut_[i] = config_.kInf / std::max(config_.omegaInf, config_.omegaMin);
    }
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void SSTModel<Dim>::computeWallDistance() {
    const std::size_t n = mesh_.nCells();
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        wallDist_[i] = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();

    for (std::size_t f = 0; f < mesh_.nFaces(); ++f) {
        if (mesh_.neighbor(f) != std::size_t(-1)) continue;
        const std::size_t P = mesh_.owner(f);
        auto center = mesh_.cellCenter(P);
        double dist2 = 0.0;
        for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) {
            double diff = mesh_.faceCenter(f)[d] - center[d];
            dist2 += diff * diff;
        }
        wallDist_[P] = std::min(wallDist_[P], std::sqrt(dist2));
    }

    std::vector<bool> visited(n, false);
    using Entry = std::pair<double, std::size_t>;
    std::priority_queue<Entry, std::vector<Entry>, std::greater<Entry>> pq;

    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (wallDist_[i] < std::numeric_limits<double>::max()) {
            pq.push({wallDist_[i], i});
        }
    }

    while (!pq.empty()) {
        auto [dist, cell] = pq.top();
        pq.pop();
        if (visited[cell]) continue;
        visited[cell] = true;

        for (std::size_t neighbor : mesh_.cellNeighbors(cell)) {
            if (visited[neighbor]) continue;
            auto cP = mesh_.cellCenter(cell);
            auto cN = mesh_.cellCenter(neighbor);
            double d2 = 0.0;
            for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) {
                double diff = cN[d] - cP[d];
                d2 += diff * diff;
            }
            double newDist = dist + std::sqrt(d2);
            if (newDist < wallDist_[neighbor]) {
                wallDist_[neighbor] = newDist;
                pq.push({newDist, neighbor});
            }
        }
    }

    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (wallDist_[i] == std::numeric_limits<double>::max())
            wallDist_[i] = 0.0;
    }
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void SSTModel<Dim>::solveIteration(const VectorField<Dim>& velocity,
                                   ConvectionScheme scheme) {
     computeStrainRate(velocity);
     gradK_ = computeScalarGradients(k_);
     gradOmega_ = computeScalarGradients(omega_);
     computeBlendingFunctions();
     computeEddyViscosity();
    solveKTransport(velocity, scheme);
    solveOmegaTransport(velocity, scheme);
    computeEddyViscosity();
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
const Field<Dim>& SSTModel<Dim>::k() const { return k_; }

template<std::size_t Dim>
const Field<Dim>& SSTModel<Dim>::omega() const { return omega_; }

template<std::size_t Dim>
const Field<Dim>& SSTModel<Dim>::nut() const { return nut_; }

template<std::size_t Dim>
Field<Dim>& SSTModel<Dim>::nut() { return nut_; }

template<std::size_t Dim>
const Field<Dim>& SSTModel<Dim>::wallDistance() const { return wallDist_; }

template<std::size_t Dim>
Field<Dim>& SSTModel<Dim>::k() { return k_; }

template<std::size_t Dim>
Field<Dim>& SSTModel<Dim>::omega() { return omega_; }

// --- Private method implementations ---

template<std::size_t Dim>
std::array<Field<Dim>, Dim> SSTModel<Dim>::computeScalarGradients(const Field<Dim>& phi) const {
    for (auto& g : scalarGradBuffer_) g.assign(0.0);

    const std::size_t n = mesh_.nCells();
    const std::size_t nF = mesh_.nFaces();
    // Precompute 1/vol to replace division in inner loop: O(n) once vs O(nF*Dim) divisions
    std::vector<double> invVol(n);
    const double* volPtr = mesh_.cellVolumePtr();
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        double v = volPtr[i];
        invVol[i] = (v > 1e-30) ? 1.0 / v : 0.0;
    }
    const std::size_t* ownerPtr = mesh_.ownerPtr();
    const std::size_t* neighborPtr = mesh_.neighborPtr();
    const double* areaPtr = mesh_.faceAreaPtr();

    for (std::size_t f = 0; f < nF; ++f) {
        const std::size_t P = ownerPtr[f];
        const std::size_t N = neighborPtr[f];
        double phiFace = (N == std::size_t(-1)) ? phi[P] : 0.5 * (phi[P] + phi[N]);
        const double* fn = mesh_.faceNormalPtr(f);
        double area = areaPtr[f];
        double phiArea = phiFace * area;
        for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) {
            double contrib = phiArea * fn[d];
            scalarGradBuffer_[d][P] += contrib * invVol[P];
            if (N != std::size_t(-1)) scalarGradBuffer_[d][N] -= contrib * invVol[N];
        }
    }
    return scalarGradBuffer_;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void SSTModel<Dim>::computeStrainRate(const VectorField<Dim>& velocity) {
    const std::size_t n = mesh_.nCells();
    const std::size_t nF = mesh_.nFaces();

    S_.assign(0.0);

    // Reuse pre-allocated buffer to avoid O(Dim^2 * n) allocation per iteration
    auto& dUdx = dUdxBuffer_;
    if (!dUdxInitialized_) {
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < Dim; ++i)
            for (std::size_t j = 0; j < Dim; ++j)
                dUdx[i][j] = Field<Dim>(mesh_, 0.0);
        dUdxInitialized_ = true;
    } else {
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < Dim; ++i)
            for (std::size_t j = 0; j < Dim; ++j)
                dUdx[i][j].assign(0.0);
    }

    // Precompute 1/vol for inner loop
    std::vector<double> invVol(n);
    const double* volPtr = mesh_.cellVolumePtr();
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        double v = volPtr[i];
        invVol[i] = (v > 1e-30) ? 1.0 / v : 0.0;
    }
    const std::size_t* ownerPtr = mesh_.ownerPtr();
    const std::size_t* neighborPtr = mesh_.neighborPtr();
    const double* areaPtr = mesh_.faceAreaPtr();

    for (std::size_t f = 0; f < nF; ++f) {
        const std::size_t P = ownerPtr[f];
        const std::size_t N = neighborPtr[f];
        std::array<double, Dim> uFace{};
        for (std::size_t dd = 0; dd < Dim; ++dd) {
            uFace[dd] = (N == std::size_t(-1)) ? velocity[dd][P] : 0.5 * (velocity[dd][P] + velocity[dd][N]);
        }
        const double* fn = mesh_.faceNormalPtr(f);
        double area = areaPtr[f];
        double invVolP = invVol[P];
        double invVolN = (N == std::size_t(-1)) ? 0.0 : invVol[N];
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < Dim; ++i) {
            double uAi = uFace[i] * area;
            for (std::size_t j = 0; j < Dim; ++j) {
                double contrib = uAi * fn[j];
                dUdx[i][j][P] += contrib * invVolP;
                if (N != std::size_t(-1)) dUdx[i][j][N] -= contrib * invVolN;
            }
        }
    }

    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
    for (std::size_t idx = 0; idx < n; ++idx) {
        double S2 = 0.0;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < Dim; ++i) {
            for (std::size_t j = 0; j < Dim; ++j) {
                double Sij = 0.5 * (dUdx[i][j][idx] + dUdx[j][i][idx]);
                S2 += Sij * Sij;
            }
        }
        S_[idx] = std::sqrt(2.0 * S2);
    }
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void SSTModel<Dim>::computeBlendingFunctions() {
    const auto& c = config_.constants;
    const double eps = 1e-30;

    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < mesh_.nCells(); ++i) {
        double y  = wallDist_[i];
        double k  = std::max(k_[i], config_.kMin);
        double w  = std::max(omega_[i], config_.omegaMin);
        double y2 = y * y;

        double arg1a = std::sqrt(k) / (c.beta_star * w * y + eps);
        double arg1b = wallDistFactor * mu_ / (rho_ * w * y2 + eps);

        double dotProd = 0.0;
        for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d)
            dotProd += gradK_[d][i] * gradOmega_[d][i];
        double CDomega = std::max(
            2.0 * c.sigma_w2 * dotProd / (w + eps), 1e-10);

        double arg1c = 4.0 * rho_ * c.sigma_w2 * k
                     / (CDomega * y2 + eps);

        double arg1 = std::min(std::max(arg1a, arg1b), arg1c);
        F1_[i] = std::tanh(arg1 * arg1 * arg1 * arg1);

        double arg2a = 2.0 * std::sqrt(k) / (c.beta_star * w * y + eps);
        double arg2b = wallDistFactor * mu_ / (rho_ * w * y2 + eps);
        double arg2 = std::max(arg2a, arg2b);
        F2_[i] = std::tanh(arg2 * arg2);
    }
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void SSTModel<Dim>::computeEddyViscosity() {
    const auto& c = config_.constants;
    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < mesh_.nCells(); ++i) {
        double k = std::max(k_[i], config_.kMin);
        double w = std::max(omega_[i], config_.omegaMin);
        double denom = std::max(c.a1 * w, S_[i] * F2_[i]);
        nut_[i] = c.a1 * k / std::max(denom, 1e-20);
        if (nut_[i] > 1e5 * (mu_ / rho_)) nut_[i] = 1e5 * (mu_ / rho_);
        if (nut_[i] < 0.0) nut_[i] = 0.0;
    }
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void SSTModel<Dim>::solveKTransport(const VectorField<Dim>& velocity,
                                    ConvectionScheme scheme) {
    const std::size_t n = mesh_.nCells();
    const auto& c = config_.constants;

    Field<Dim> diffCoeff(mesh_, 0.0);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        double sigmaK = F1_[i] * c.sigma_k1 + (1.0 - F1_[i]) * c.sigma_k2;
        diffCoeff[i] = (mu_ / rho_) + sigmaK * nut_[i];
    }

    Field<Dim> sourceK(mesh_, 0.0);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        double Pk = nut_[i] * S_[i] * S_[i];
        double PkLim = std::min(Pk, sstProductionLimitFactor * c.beta_star
                                    * std::max(omega_[i], config_.omegaMin)
                                    * std::max(k_[i], config_.kMin));
        sourceK[i] = PkLim;
    }

    SparseMatrix A;
    Eigen::VectorXd b;
    poisson_.discretize(A, b, diffCoeff, sourceK, kBCMask_, kBCVals_);

    std::array<const Field<Dim>*, Dim> velPtrs{};
    for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d)
        velPtrs[d] = &velocity[d];
    convection_.setScheme(scheme);

    std::array<Field<Dim>, Dim> gradK;
    for (auto& g : gradK) g = Field<Dim>(mesh_, 0.0);
    convection_.discretize(A, b, k_, velPtrs, ConvectionBCs{kBCMask_, kBCVals_, {}, {}},
                           &gradK_);

    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (kBCMask_[i]) continue;
        double destroyCoeff = c.beta_star
                            * std::max(omega_[i], config_.omegaMin)
                            * mesh_.cellVolume(i);
        for (SparseMatrix::InnerIterator it(A, static_cast<Eigen::Index>(i)); it; ++it) {
            if (it.col() == static_cast<Eigen::Index>(i)) {
                it.valueRef() += destroyCoeff;
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    // Under-relaxation of k equation
    {
        double alpha = config_.alphaK;
        double relax = (1.0 - alpha) / alpha;
        if (relax > 1e-14) {
            A.makeCompressed();
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                if (kBCMask_[i]) continue;
                for (SparseMatrix::InnerIterator it(A, static_cast<Eigen::Index>(i)); it; ++it) {
                    if (it.col() == static_cast<Eigen::Index>(i)) {
                        double aP = it.value();
                        if (aP > 1e-15) {
                            b(static_cast<Eigen::Index>(i)) += relax * aP * k_[i];
                            it.valueRef() = aP / alpha;
                        }
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    Eigen::VectorXd x = solveKSystem_(A, b);

    // Compute K residual
    Eigen::VectorXd rK = b - A * x;
    kResidual_ = rK.lpNorm<2>();

    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        double newVal = std::max(x(static_cast<Eigen::Index>(i)),
                                 config_.kMin);
        if (newVal > 1e-2) newVal = 1e-2;
        k_[i] = std::max(newVal, config_.kMin);
    }
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void SSTModel<Dim>::solveOmegaTransport(const VectorField<Dim>& velocity,
                                        ConvectionScheme scheme) {
    const std::size_t n = mesh_.nCells();
    const auto& c = config_.constants;

    Field<Dim> diffCoeff(mesh_, 0.0);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        double sigmaW = F1_[i] * c.sigma_w1 + (1.0 - F1_[i]) * c.sigma_w2;
        diffCoeff[i] = (mu_ / rho_) + sigmaW * nut_[i];
    }

    Field<Dim> sourceOmega(mesh_, 0.0);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        double w = std::max(omega_[i], config_.omegaMin);
        double k = std::max(k_[i], config_.kMin);
        double alpha = F1_[i] * c.alpha1 + (1.0 - F1_[i]) * c.alpha2;
        double nut = std::max(nut_[i], 1e-20);

        double Pk = nut_[i] * S_[i] * S_[i];
        double PkLim = std::min(Pk, sstProductionLimitFactor * c.beta_star * w * k);
        double prodTerm;
        if (PkLim >= Pk * 0.999999) {
            // Uncapped: exact cancellation Pk/nut = S^2
            prodTerm = alpha * S_[i] * S_[i];
        } else {
            // Capped: guard against tiny nut and bound the term
            double nutSafe = std::max(nut_[i], 1e-12);
            prodTerm = (alpha / nutSafe) * PkLim;
            if (prodTerm > 1e3) prodTerm = 1e3;
            if (prodTerm < -1e3) prodTerm = -1e3;
        }

        double dotProd = 0.0;
        for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d)
            dotProd += gradK_[d][i] * gradOmega_[d][i];
        double crossDiff = 2.0 * (1.0 - F1_[i]) * c.sigma_w2
                         * dotProd / w;
        if (crossDiff > 1e3) crossDiff = 1e3;
        if (crossDiff < -1e3) crossDiff = -1e3;

        sourceOmega[i] = prodTerm + crossDiff;
    }

    SparseMatrix A;
    Eigen::VectorXd b;
    poisson_.discretize(A, b, diffCoeff, sourceOmega,
                        omegaBCMask_, omegaBCVals_);

    std::array<const Field<Dim>*, Dim> velPtrs{};
    for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d)
        velPtrs[d] = &velocity[d];
    convection_.setScheme(scheme);

    std::array<Field<Dim>, Dim> gradOmega;
    for (auto& g : gradOmega) g = Field<Dim>(mesh_, 0.0);

    convection_.discretize(A, b, omega_, velPtrs,
                           ConvectionBCs{omegaBCMask_, omegaBCVals_, {}, {}},
                           &gradOmega_);

    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (omegaBCMask_[i]) continue;
        double beta = F1_[i] * c.beta1 + (1.0 - F1_[i]) * c.beta2;
        double w = std::max(omega_[i], config_.omegaMin);
        double diagInc = beta * w * mesh_.cellVolume(i);
        for (SparseMatrix::InnerIterator it(A, static_cast<Eigen::Index>(i)); it; ++it) {
            if (it.col() == static_cast<Eigen::Index>(i)) {
                it.valueRef() += diagInc;
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    // Under-relaxation of omega equation
    {
        double alpha = config_.alphaOmega; // config_.alphaOmega;
        double relax = (1.0 - alpha) / alpha;
        if (relax > 1e-14) {
            A.makeCompressed();
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                if (omegaBCMask_[i]) continue;
                for (SparseMatrix::InnerIterator it(A, static_cast<Eigen::Index>(i)); it; ++it) {
                    if (it.col() == static_cast<Eigen::Index>(i)) {
                        double aP = it.value();
                        if (aP > 1e-15) {
                            b(static_cast<Eigen::Index>(i)) += relax * aP * omega_[i];
                            it.valueRef() = aP / alpha;
                        }
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    Eigen::VectorXd x = solveOmegaSystem_(A, b);

    // Compute omega residual
    Eigen::VectorXd rOmega = b - A * x;
    omegaResidual_ = rOmega.lpNorm<2>();

    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        double newVal = std::max(x(static_cast<Eigen::Index>(i)),
                                  config_.omegaMin);
        if (newVal > 1e3) newVal = 1e3;
        omega_[i] = std::max(newVal, config_.omegaMin);
    }
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void SSTModel<Dim>::solveIterationTransient(const VectorField<Dim>& velocity,
                                           ConvectionScheme scheme,
                                           double dt,
                                           double dtPrev,
                                           TimeScheme timeScheme,
                                           const Field<Dim>& kOld,
                                           const Field<Dim>& omegaOld,
                                           const Field<Dim>* kOldPrev,
                                           const Field<Dim>* omegaOldPrev) {
    computeStrainRate(velocity);
    gradK_ = computeScalarGradients(k_);
    gradOmega_ = computeScalarGradients(omega_);
    computeBlendingFunctions();
    computeEddyViscosity();
    solveKTransportTransient(velocity, scheme, dt, dtPrev, timeScheme, kOld, kOldPrev);
    solveOmegaTransportTransient(velocity, scheme, dt, dtPrev, timeScheme, omegaOld, omegaOldPrev);
    computeEddyViscosity();
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void SSTModel<Dim>::solveKTransportTransient(const VectorField<Dim>& velocity,
                                            ConvectionScheme scheme,
                                            double dt,
                                            double dtPrev,
                                            TimeScheme timeScheme,
                                            const Field<Dim>& kOld,
                                            const Field<Dim>* kOldPrev) {
    const std::size_t n = mesh_.nCells();
    const auto& c = config_.constants;
    Field<Dim> diffCoeff(mesh_, 0.0);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        double sigmaK = F1_[i] * c.sigma_k1 + (1.0 - F1_[i]) * c.sigma_k2;
        diffCoeff[i] = (mu_ / rho_) + sigmaK * nut_[i];
    }
    Field<Dim> sourceK(mesh_, 0.0);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        double Pk = nut_[i] * S_[i] * S_[i];
        double PkLim = std::min(Pk, sstProductionLimitFactor * c.beta_star
                                    * std::max(omega_[i], config_.omegaMin)
                                    * std::max(k_[i], config_.kMin));
        sourceK[i] = PkLim;
    }
    SparseMatrix A;
    Eigen::VectorXd b;
    poisson_.discretize(A, b, diffCoeff, sourceK, kBCMask_, kBCVals_);
    std::array<const Field<Dim>*, Dim> velPtrs{};
    for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) velPtrs[d] = &velocity[d];
    convection_.setScheme(scheme);
    std::array<Field<Dim>, Dim> gradK;
    for (auto& g : gradK) g = Field<Dim>(mesh_, 0.0);
    convection_.discretize(A, b, k_, velPtrs, ConvectionBCs{kBCMask_, kBCVals_, {}, {}}, &gradK_);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (kBCMask_[i]) continue;
        double destroyCoeff = c.beta_star * std::max(omega_[i], config_.omegaMin) * mesh_.cellVolume(i);
        for (SparseMatrix::InnerIterator it(A, static_cast<Eigen::Index>(i)); it; ++it) {
            if (it.col() == static_cast<Eigen::Index>(i)) { it.valueRef() += destroyCoeff; break; }
        }
    }
    // Transient term
    if (dt > 0 && dt < 1e14) {
        ImplicitTimeCoeffs tc;
        if (timeScheme == TimeScheme::BDF2 && kOldPrev != nullptr) {
            tc = implicitTimeCoeffs(dt, dtPrev);
        }
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            if (kBCMask_[i]) continue;
            double vol = mesh_.cellVolume(i);
            const double coeff = tc.c0 * vol;
            const double rhs = tc.secondOrder
                ? vol * (tc.cOld * kOld[i] + tc.cOldPrev * (*kOldPrev)[i])
                : coeff * kOld[i];
            for (SparseMatrix::InnerIterator it(A, static_cast<Eigen::Index>(i)); it; ++it) {
                if (it.col() == static_cast<Eigen::Index>(i)) { it.valueRef() += coeff; break; }
            }
            b(static_cast<Eigen::Index>(i)) += rhs;
        }
    }
    Eigen::VectorXd x = solveKSystem_(A, b);
    Eigen::VectorXd rK = b - A * x;
    kResidual_ = rK.lpNorm<2>();
    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        double newVal = std::max(x(static_cast<Eigen::Index>(i)), config_.kMin);
        k_[i] = config_.alphaK * newVal + (1.0 - config_.alphaK) * k_[i];
        k_[i] = std::max(k_[i], config_.kMin);
    }
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void SSTModel<Dim>::solveOmegaTransportTransient(const VectorField<Dim>& velocity,
                                                ConvectionScheme scheme,
                                                double dt,
                                                double dtPrev,
                                                TimeScheme timeScheme,
                                                const Field<Dim>& omegaOld,
                                                const Field<Dim>* omegaOldPrev) {
    const std::size_t n = mesh_.nCells();
    const auto& c = config_.constants;
    Field<Dim> diffCoeff(mesh_, 0.0);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        double sigmaW = F1_[i] * c.sigma_w1 + (1.0 - F1_[i]) * c.sigma_w2;
        diffCoeff[i] = (mu_ / rho_) + sigmaW * nut_[i];
    }
    Field<Dim> sourceOmega(mesh_, 0.0);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        double w = std::max(omega_[i], config_.omegaMin);
        double k = std::max(k_[i], config_.kMin);
        double alpha = F1_[i] * c.alpha1 + (1.0 - F1_[i]) * c.alpha2;
        double nut = std::max(nut_[i], 1e-20);
        double Pk = nut_[i] * S_[i] * S_[i];
        double PkLim = std::min(Pk, sstProductionLimitFactor * c.beta_star * w * k);
        double prodTerm = (alpha / nut) * PkLim;
        double dotProd = 0.0;
        for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) dotProd += gradK_[d][i] * gradOmega_[d][i];
        double crossDiff = 2.0 * (1.0 - F1_[i]) * c.sigma_w2 * dotProd / w;
        sourceOmega[i] = prodTerm + crossDiff;
    }
    SparseMatrix A;
    Eigen::VectorXd b;
    poisson_.discretize(A, b, diffCoeff, sourceOmega, omegaBCMask_, omegaBCVals_);
    std::array<const Field<Dim>*, Dim> velPtrs{};
    for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) velPtrs[d] = &velocity[d];
    convection_.setScheme(scheme);
    std::array<Field<Dim>, Dim> gradOmega;
    for (auto& g : gradOmega) g = Field<Dim>(mesh_, 0.0);
    convection_.discretize(A, b, omega_, velPtrs,
                           ConvectionBCs{omegaBCMask_, omegaBCVals_, {}, {}}, &gradOmega_);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (omegaBCMask_[i]) continue;
        double beta = F1_[i] * c.beta1 + (1.0 - F1_[i]) * c.beta2;
        double w = std::max(omega_[i], config_.omegaMin);
        double diagInc = beta * w * mesh_.cellVolume(i);
        for (SparseMatrix::InnerIterator it(A, static_cast<Eigen::Index>(i)); it; ++it) {
            if (it.col() == static_cast<Eigen::Index>(i)) { it.valueRef() += diagInc; break; }
        }
    }
    if (dt > 0 && dt < 1e14) {
        ImplicitTimeCoeffs tc;
        if (timeScheme == TimeScheme::BDF2 && omegaOldPrev != nullptr) {
            tc = implicitTimeCoeffs(dt, dtPrev);
        }
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            if (omegaBCMask_[i]) continue;
            double vol = mesh_.cellVolume(i);
            const double coeff = tc.c0 * vol;
            const double rhs = tc.secondOrder
                ? vol * (tc.cOld * omegaOld[i] + tc.cOldPrev * (*omegaOldPrev)[i])
                : coeff * omegaOld[i];
            for (SparseMatrix::InnerIterator it(A, static_cast<Eigen::Index>(i)); it; ++it) {
                if (it.col() == static_cast<Eigen::Index>(i)) { it.valueRef() += coeff; break; }
            }
            b(static_cast<Eigen::Index>(i)) += rhs;
        }
    }
    Eigen::VectorXd x = solveOmegaSystem_(A, b);
    Eigen::VectorXd rOmega = b - A * x;
    omegaResidual_ = rOmega.lpNorm<2>();
    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        double newVal = std::max(x(static_cast<Eigen::Index>(i)), config_.omegaMin);
        omega_[i] = config_.alphaOmega * newVal + (1.0 - config_.alphaOmega) * omega_[i];
        omega_[i] = std::max(omega_[i], config_.omegaMin);
    }
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
Eigen::VectorXd SSTModel<Dim>::solveKSystem_(const SparseMatrix& A,
                                              const Eigen::VectorXd& b) {
    // Use compute (analyze+factorize) for robustness; IncompleteLUT needs compute
    kSolver_.compute(A);
    Eigen::VectorXd x = kSolver_.solve(b);
    if (kSolver_.info() != Eigen::Success) {
        // Fallback: try without preconditioner if fails
        Eigen::BiCGSTAB<SparseMatrix> fallback;
        fallback.setMaxIterations(static_cast<int>(sstMaxIterations));
        fallback.setTolerance(sstTolerance);
        fallback.compute(A);
        x = fallback.solve(b);
    }
    for (Eigen::Index i = 0; i < x.size(); ++i)
        if (std::isnan(x(i)) || std::isinf(x(i))) {
            std::fprintf(stderr, "  WARNING: SST solver produced non-finite value at %ld\n", (long)i);
            x(i) = 0.0;
        }
    return x;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
Eigen::VectorXd SSTModel<Dim>::solveOmegaSystem_(const SparseMatrix& A,
                                                  const Eigen::VectorXd& b) {
    omegaSolver_.compute(A);
    Eigen::VectorXd x = omegaSolver_.solve(b);
    // fallback check
    if (omegaSolver_.info() != Eigen::Success) {
        Eigen::BiCGSTAB<SparseMatrix> fallback;
        fallback.setMaxIterations(static_cast<int>(sstMaxIterations));
        fallback.setTolerance(sstTolerance);
        fallback.compute(A);
        x = fallback.solve(b);
    }
    for (Eigen::Index i = 0; i < x.size(); ++i)
        if (std::isnan(x(i)) || std::isinf(x(i))) {
            std::fprintf(stderr, "  WARNING: SST solver produced non-finite value at %ld\n", (long)i);
            x(i) = 0.0;
        }
    return x;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
Eigen::VectorXd SSTModel<Dim>::biCGSTABSolve(const SparseMatrix& A,
                                              const Eigen::VectorXd& b) {
    Eigen::VectorXd x;
    Eigen::BiCGSTAB<SparseMatrix, Eigen::IncompleteLUT<double>> solver;
    solver.setMaxIterations(static_cast<int>(sstMaxIterations));
    solver.setTolerance(sstTolerance);
    if (patternAnalyzed_) {
        solver.analyzePattern(A);
    } else {
        solver.compute(A);
        patternAnalyzed_ = true;
    }
    solver.factorize(A);
    x = solver.solve(b);
    for (Eigen::Index i = 0; i < x.size(); ++i)
        if (std::isnan(x(i)) || std::isinf(x(i))) {
            std::fprintf(stderr, "  WARNING: SST solver produced non-finite value at %ld\n", (long)i);
            x(i) = 0.0;
        }
    return x;
}

template class SSTModel<2>;
template class SSTModel<3>;

} // namespace fvm
```

### src/fvm/SSTModel.h
```
#pragma once

#include "fvm/SSTConstants.h"
#include "mesh/Mesh.h"
#include "field/Field.h"
#include "field/VectorField.h"
#include "fvm/Types.h"
#include "fvm/Poisson.h"
#include "fvm/Convection.h"
#include "fvm/Gradient.h"
#include "mesh/BoundaryUtils.h"
#include <Eigen/IterativeLinearSolvers>
#include <array>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstddef>
#include <limits>
#include <queue>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>
#include <type_traits>

namespace fvm {

template<std::size_t Dim>
class SSTModel {
public:
    struct Config {
        SSTConstants constants;
        double kInf       = 1e-3;
        double omegaInf   = 1.0;
        double alphaK     = 0.7;
        double alphaOmega = 0.7;
        double kMin       = 1e-14;
        double omegaMin   = 1e-14;
    };

    SSTModel(const Mesh<Dim>& mesh, Config config);

    void initialize(double mu, double rho);
    void computeWallDistance();

    template<typename VelocityBCType>
    void computeWallDistance(const std::array<VelocityBCType, 2 * Dim>& velBCs) {
        const std::size_t n = mesh_.nCells();
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            wallDist_[i] = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();

        // Seed propagation only from no-slip wall boundary faces
        for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) {
            for (int sign : {-1, +1}) {
                std::size_t idx = d * 2 + (sign < 0 ? 0 : 1);
                auto bcType = velBCs[idx];
                if (!isWallBC(bcType)) continue;

                forEachBoundaryFace(mesh_, d, sign, [&](std::size_t f, std::size_t cell) {
                    auto center = mesh_.cellCenter(cell);
                    double dist2 = 0.0;
                    for (std::size_t dd = 0; dd < Dim; ++dd) {
                        double diff = mesh_.faceCenter(f)[dd] - center[dd];
                        dist2 += diff * diff;
                    }
                    double d0 = std::sqrt(dist2);
                    if (d0 < wallDist_[cell]) wallDist_[cell] = d0;
                });
            }
        }

        std::vector<bool> visited(n, false);
        using Entry = std::pair<double, std::size_t>;
        std::priority_queue<Entry, std::vector<Entry>, std::greater<Entry>> pq;

        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            if (wallDist_[i] < std::numeric_limits<double>::max())
                pq.push({wallDist_[i], i});
        }

        while (!pq.empty()) {
            auto [dist, cell] = pq.top();
            pq.pop();
            if (visited[cell]) continue;
            visited[cell] = true;

            for (std::size_t neighbor : mesh_.cellNeighbors(cell)) {
                if (visited[neighbor]) continue;
                auto cP = mesh_.cellCenter(cell);
                auto cN = mesh_.cellCenter(neighbor);
                double d2 = 0.0;
                for (std::size_t dd = 0; dd < Dim; ++dd) {
                    double diff = cN[dd] - cP[dd];
                    d2 += diff * diff;
                }
                double newDist = dist + std::sqrt(d2);
                if (newDist < wallDist_[neighbor]) {
                    wallDist_[neighbor] = newDist;
                    pq.push({newDist, neighbor});
                }
            }
        }

        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            if (wallDist_[i] == std::numeric_limits<double>::max())
                wallDist_[i] = 0.0;
        }
    }

    template<typename VelocityBCType>
    void setBoundaryConditions(
        const std::array<VelocityBCType, 2 * Dim>& velBCs) {

        const std::size_t n = mesh_.nCells();
        kBCMask_.assign(n, 0);
        kBCVals_.assign(n, 0.0);
        omegaBCMask_.assign(n, 0);
        omegaBCVals_.assign(n, 0.0);

        for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) {
            for (int sign : {-1, +1}) {
                std::size_t idx = d * 2 + (sign < 0 ? 0 : 1);
                auto bcType = velBCs[idx];

                if (isWallBC(bcType)) {
                    forEachBoundaryFace(mesh_, d, sign, [&](std::size_t f, std::size_t cell) {
                        kBCMask_[cell] = 1;
                        kBCVals_[cell] = 0.0;
                        omegaBCMask_[cell] = 1;
                        double y1 = wallDist_[cell];
                        double om = 6.0 * mu_
                                             / (rho_ * config_.constants.beta1 * y1 * y1 + 1e-30);
                        if (om > 1e6) om = 1e6;
                        omegaBCVals_[cell] = om;
                    });
                 } else if (isInletBC(bcType)) {
                    forEachBoundaryFace(mesh_, d, sign, [&](std::size_t f, std::size_t cell) {
                        kBCMask_[cell] = 1;
                        kBCVals_[cell] = config_.kInf;
                        omegaBCMask_[cell] = 1;
                        omegaBCVals_[cell] = config_.omegaInf;
                    });
                } else {
                    // Outlet, Symmetry, SlipWall, PressureOutlet: zero-gradient (natural BC)
                    // No explicit BC needed — transport equation handles it
                }
            }
        }
    }

    void setInletTurbulence(const std::vector<std::size_t>& faces, double k, double omega) {
        for (std::size_t f : faces) {
            std::size_t cell = mesh_.owner(f);
            if (cell < kBCMask_.size()) {
                kBCMask_[cell] = 1;
                kBCVals_[cell] = k;
                omegaBCMask_[cell] = 1;
                omegaBCVals_[cell] = omega;
            }
        }
    }
    void solveIteration(const VectorField<Dim>& velocity,
                        ConvectionScheme scheme);
    void solveIterationTransient(const VectorField<Dim>& velocity,
                                 ConvectionScheme scheme,
                                 double dt,
                                 double dtPrev,
                                 TimeScheme timeScheme,
                                 const Field<Dim>& kOld,
                                 const Field<Dim>& omegaOld,
                                 const Field<Dim>* kOldPrev = nullptr,
                                 const Field<Dim>* omegaOldPrev = nullptr);

    const Field<Dim>& k() const;
    const Field<Dim>& omega() const;
    const Field<Dim>& nut() const;
    Field<Dim>& nut();
    const Field<Dim>& wallDistance() const;
    Field<Dim>& k();
    Field<Dim>& omega();

    double finalKResid() const { return kResidual_; }
    double finalOmegaResid() const { return omegaResidual_; }

private:
    static bool isWallBC(auto bcType) {
        using BC = std::decay_t<decltype(bcType)>;
        return bcType == BC::NoSlip || bcType == BC::MovingWall;
    }

    static bool isInletBC(auto bcType) {
        using BC = std::decay_t<decltype(bcType)>;
        return bcType == BC::Inlet;
    }

    static bool isOutletBC(auto bcType) {
        using BC = std::decay_t<decltype(bcType)>;
        return bcType == BC::Outlet || bcType == BC::PressureOutlet;
    }

    std::array<Field<Dim>, Dim> computeScalarGradients(const Field<Dim>& phi) const;

    void computeStrainRate(const VectorField<Dim>& velocity);
    void computeBlendingFunctions();
    void computeEddyViscosity();
    void solveKTransport(const VectorField<Dim>& velocity,
                         ConvectionScheme scheme);
    void solveOmegaTransport(const VectorField<Dim>& velocity,
                            ConvectionScheme scheme);
    void solveKTransportTransient(const VectorField<Dim>& velocity,
                                  ConvectionScheme scheme,
                                  double dt,
                                  double dtPrev,
                                  TimeScheme timeScheme,
                                  const Field<Dim>& kOld,
                                  const Field<Dim>* kOldPrev);
    void solveOmegaTransportTransient(const VectorField<Dim>& velocity,
                                      ConvectionScheme scheme,
                                      double dt,
                                      double dtPrev,
                                      TimeScheme timeScheme,
                                      const Field<Dim>& omegaOld,
                                      const Field<Dim>* omegaOldPrev);

    Eigen::VectorXd solveKSystem_(const SparseMatrix& A, const Eigen::VectorXd& b);
    Eigen::VectorXd solveOmegaSystem_(const SparseMatrix& A, const Eigen::VectorXd& b);
    Eigen::VectorXd biCGSTABSolve(const SparseMatrix& A,
                                   const Eigen::VectorXd& b);

    bool kPatternAnalyzed_ = false;
    bool omegaPatternAnalyzed_ = false;
    bool patternAnalyzed_ = false;

    const Mesh<Dim>& mesh_;
    Config config_;
    double mu_ = 1e-5;
    double rho_ = 1.0;

    Field<Dim> k_;
    Field<Dim> omega_;
    Field<Dim> nut_;
    Field<Dim> wallDist_;
    Field<Dim> S_;
    Field<Dim> F1_;
    Field<Dim> F2_;
    std::array<Field<Dim>, Dim> gradK_{};
    std::array<Field<Dim>, Dim> gradOmega_{};
    mutable std::array<Field<Dim>, Dim> scalarGradBuffer_{};
    // Reusable strain-rate buffer to avoid per-iteration Field allocations (Dim x Dim fields)
    mutable std::array<std::array<Field<Dim>, Dim>, Dim> dUdxBuffer_{};
    mutable bool dUdxInitialized_ = false;

    std::vector<char>   kBCMask_;
    std::vector<double> kBCVals_;
    std::vector<char>   omegaBCMask_;
    std::vector<double> omegaBCVals_;

    double kResidual_ = 0.0;
    double omegaResidual_ = 0.0;

    Poisson<Dim>    poisson_;
    Convection<Dim> convection_;
    Gradient<Dim>   gradient_;

    mutable Eigen::BiCGSTAB<SparseMatrix, Eigen::IncompleteLUT<double>> kSolver_;
    mutable Eigen::BiCGSTAB<SparseMatrix, Eigen::IncompleteLUT<double>> omegaSolver_;
};

extern template class SSTModel<2>;
extern template class SSTModel<3>;

} // namespace fvm

namespace fvm {

template<typename Derived, std::size_t Dim>
class DiscretizationScheme {
public:
    DiscretizationScheme() = default;

    template<typename MeshType, typename Triplets, typename Vector>
    void assemble(Triplets& triplets, Vector& b, const MeshType& mesh) const {
        static_cast<const Derived*>(this)->assembleImpl(triplets, b, mesh);
    }

    void ensureWorkspace(std::size_t n) {
        if (workspace_.size() < n) {
            workspace_.resize(n);
        }
    }

    std::span<double> workspace() noexcept { return workspace_.span(); }

protected:
    ~DiscretizationScheme() = default;

private:
    AlignedBuffer<double> workspace_;
};

#include "fvm/Solver.h"
#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
#include <memory>

namespace fvm {

namespace detail {

template<std::size_t Dim>
std::array<Field<Dim>, Dim> makeVelocities(const Mesh<Dim>& mesh) {
    std::array<Field<Dim>, Dim> vels{};
    for (auto& v : vels) v = Field<Dim>(mesh, 0.0);
    return vels;
}

template std::array<Field<2>, 2> makeVelocities<2>(const Mesh<2>&);
template std::array<Field<3>, 3> makeVelocities<3>(const Mesh<3>&);

} // namespace detail

template<std::size_t Dim>
AdvectionDiffusionSolver<Dim>::AdvectionDiffusionSolver(const Mesh<Dim>& mesh, double k)
    : mesh_(mesh),
      k_(k),
      bcs_(mesh, k),
      laplacian_(mesh, k),
      convection_(mesh),
      velocities_(detail::makeVelocities(mesh)),
      source_(mesh, 0.0),
      solution_(mesh, 0.0),
      gradCalc_(std::make_unique<Gradient<Dim>>(mesh)) {}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void AdvectionDiffusionSolver<Dim>::setScheme(ConvectionScheme scheme) {
    scheme_ = scheme;
    convection_.setScheme(scheme);
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void AdvectionDiffusionSolver<Dim>::setUniformVelocity(double u, double v) {
    if constexpr (Dim == 2) {
        velocities_[0].assign(u);
        velocities_[1].assign(v);
    }
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void AdvectionDiffusionSolver<Dim>::setUniformVelocity(double u, double v, double w) {
    if constexpr (Dim == 3) {
        velocities_[0].assign(u);
        velocities_[1].assign(v);
        velocities_[2].assign(w);
    }
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void AdvectionDiffusionSolver<Dim>::setSource(const Field<Dim>& source) {
    const auto src = source.values();
    auto dst = source_.values();
    std::copy(src.begin(), src.end(), dst.begin());
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
BoundaryConditions<Dim>& AdvectionDiffusionSolver<Dim>::bc() { return bcs_; }

template<std::size_t Dim>
const BoundaryConditions<Dim>& AdvectionDiffusionSolver<Dim>::bc() const { return bcs_; }

template<std::size_t Dim>
Convection<Dim>& AdvectionDiffusionSolver<Dim>::convection() { return convection_; }

template<std::size_t Dim>
const Convection<Dim>& AdvectionDiffusionSolver<Dim>::convection() const { return convection_; }

template<std::size_t Dim>
Eigen::VectorXd AdvectionDiffusionSolver<Dim>::solveSteady() {
    if (cancelRequested_.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) return Eigen::VectorXd();

    bcs_.buildDirichletMask();

    const bool isSOU = isSecondOrderUpwind(scheme_);
    const bool nonlinear = isSOU;
    const int maxOuterIters = nonlinear ? 50 : 1;
    const double outerTol = 1e-6;

    for (int outer = 0; outer < maxOuterIters; ++outer) {
        if (cancelRequested_.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) break;

        SparseMatrix A;
        Eigen::VectorXd b;
        laplacian_.discretize(A, b, bcs_.dirichletMask(),
                              bcs_.dirichletValues(), source_.values());

        std::array<const Field<Dim>*, Dim> velPtrs{};
        for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) {
            velPtrs[d] = &velocities_[d];
        }

        std::array<Field<Dim>, Dim> solGrad;
        for (auto& g : solGrad) g = Field<Dim>(mesh_, 0.0);
        if (nonlinear) {
            gradCalc_->compute(solution_, solGrad);
        }

        convection_.discretize(A, b, solution_, velPtrs,
                                ConvectionBCs{bcs_.dirichletMask(), bcs_.dirichletValues(), {}, {}},
                                nonlinear ? &solGrad : nullptr);

        bcs_.addNeumannContributions(b);

        Eigen::BiCGSTAB<SparseMatrix, Eigen::IncompleteLUT<double>> solver;
        solver.setMaxIterations(50000);
        solver.setTolerance(1e-10);
        solver.compute(A);
        Eigen::VectorXd x = solver.solve(b);
        lastIterations_ = static_cast<int>(solver.iterations());
        lastResidual_  = solver.error();

        if (solver.info() != Eigen::Success) {
            std::cerr << "  WARNING: advection-diffusion BiCGSTAB failed at outer iter "
                      << outer << " (iters=" << solver.iterations()
                      << ", resid=" << solver.error() << ")\n";
        }

        Field<Dim> oldSolution = solution_;
        bool hasNaN = false;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < solution_.size(); ++i) {
            double val = x(static_cast<Eigen::Index>(i));
            if (std::isnan(val) || std::isinf(val)) {
                hasNaN = true;
                break;
            }
            solution_[i] = val;
        }

        if (hasNaN) {
            std::cerr << "  WARNING: solution contains NaN/Inf at outer iter "
                      << outer << ", keeping previous solution\n";
            break;
        }

        if (!nonlinear) break;

        double maxChange = 0.0;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < solution_.size(); ++i) {
            maxChange = std::max(maxChange, std::abs(solution_[i] - oldSolution[i]));
        }
        double scale = 0.0;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < solution_.size(); ++i) {
            scale = std::max(scale, std::abs(solution_[i]));
        }
        scale = std::max(scale, 1e-30);

        if (maxChange / scale < outerTol) break;
    }

    Eigen::VectorXd x(solution_.size());
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < solution_.size(); ++i) {
        x(static_cast<Eigen::Index>(i)) = solution_[i];
    }
    return x;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
const Field<Dim>& AdvectionDiffusionSolver<Dim>::solution() const {
    return solution_;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
int AdvectionDiffusionSolver<Dim>::lastIterations() const {
    return lastIterations_;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
double AdvectionDiffusionSolver<Dim>::lastResidual() const {
    return lastResidual_;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
std::array<Field<Dim>, Dim>& AdvectionDiffusionSolver<Dim>::velocities() {
    return velocities_;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
const std::array<Field<Dim>, Dim>& AdvectionDiffusionSolver<Dim>::velocities() const {
    return velocities_;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
const Mesh<Dim>& AdvectionDiffusionSolver<Dim>::mesh() const { return mesh_; }

template<std::size_t Dim>
double AdvectionDiffusionSolver<Dim>::k() const { return k_; }

template class AdvectionDiffusionSolver<2>;
template class AdvectionDiffusionSolver<3>;

} // namespace fvm
