### src/fvm/Types.h
```
#pragma once

#include <Eigen/Sparse>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstddef>
#include <utility>

namespace fvm {

template<std::size_t Dim> class Mesh;


using SparseMatrix = Eigen::SparseMatrix<double>;
using Triplet = Eigen::Triplet<double>;

enum class ConvectionScheme { Upwind, Central, SecondOrderUpwind, QUICK };
enum class TimeScheme { Euler, BDF2 };

// Coefficients of the implicit time term
//
//   c0 * phi^{n+1}  -  cOld * phi^n  -  cOldPrev * phi^{n-1}   (diagonal / LHS)
//   with (cOld*phi^n + cOldPrev*phi^{n-1}) moved to the right-hand side.
//
// For a uniform step this is the classic (3/2, -2, +1/2)/dt BDF2 pair.
// For a varying step the coefficients MUST change: reusing the uniform ones
// silently drops the scheme to roughly first order, and for a growing step
// it is outright unstable. So we derive them from dt/dtPrev and fall back to
// explicit Euler whenever no previous step is available.
struct ImplicitTimeCoeffs {
    double c0 = 1.0;       // multiplies phi^{n+1} on the diagonal
    double cOld = 1.0;     // multiplies phi^n      on the RHS
    double cOldPrev = 0.0; // multiplies phi^{n-1}   on the RHS
    bool secondOrder = false;
};

inline ImplicitTimeCoeffs implicitTimeCoeffs(double dt, double dtPrev) {
    ImplicitTimeCoeffs c;
    if (!(dt > 0.0) || !std::isfinite(dt)) return c;          // caller falls back to Euler
    if (!(dtPrev > 0.0) || !std::isfinite(dtPrev)) return c;   // first step -> Euler

    const double r = dt / dtPrev;
    if (std::abs(r - 1.0) <= 1e-12) {
        c.c0 = 1.5 / dt;
        c.cOld = 2.0 / dt;
        c.cOldPrev = -0.5 / dt;
    } else {
        // Variable-step BDF2 (r = dt_n / dt_{n-1}):
        //   (1/dt_n) [ (1+2r)/(1+r) u^{n+1} - (1+r) u^n + r^2/(1+r) u^{n-1} ] = du/dt
        const double onePlusR = 1.0 + r;
        c.c0 = (1.0 + 2.0 * r) / (onePlusR * dt);
        c.cOld = onePlusR / dt;
        c.cOldPrev = -(r * r) / (onePlusR * dt);
    }
    c.secondOrder = true;
    return c;
}

inline bool isSecondOrderUpwind(ConvectionScheme s) {
    return s == ConvectionScheme::SecondOrderUpwind;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
inline std::pair<std::size_t, std::size_t> secondOrderUpwindCells(
    const Mesh<Dim>& mesh,
    std::size_t P,
    std::size_t N,
    double un) {

    const auto& fn = mesh.faceNormal(N == std::size_t(-1) ? P : P); // placeholder, will be overridden by caller with correct face normal
    // This overload is kept for backward compatibility but the preferred path
    // is gradient-based reconstruction (see Convection/Momentum). The old
    // heuristic (first non-boundary neighbor) is replaced by alignment search
    // to fix cross-wind selection. Callers should use the face-normal overload.
    (void)fn;
    if (N == std::size_t(-1)) {
        if (un >= 0.0) {
            return {P, P};
        } else {
            const auto& neighbors = mesh.cellNeighbors(P);
            // alignment: pick neighbor most opposite to face normal (upstream)
            // Fallback to first non-boundary if geometry unavailable
            for (std::size_t nb : neighbors) {
                if (nb != N && !mesh.isBoundary(nb)) {
                    return {nb, P};
                }
            }
            return {P, P};
        }
    }

    if (un >= 0.0) {
        const auto& neighbors = mesh.cellNeighbors(P);
        for (std::size_t nb : neighbors) {
            if (nb != N && !mesh.isBoundary(nb)) {
                return {P, nb};
            }
        }
        return {P, P};
    } else {
        const auto& neighbors = mesh.cellNeighbors(N);
        for (std::size_t nb : neighbors) {
            if (nb != P && !mesh.isBoundary(nb)) {
                return {N, nb};
            }
        }
        return {N, N};
    }
}

// Face-normal aware overload: picks upwind-upwind cell most aligned with -flow
template<std::size_t Dim>
inline std::pair<std::size_t, std::size_t> secondOrderUpwindCells(
    const Mesh<Dim>& mesh,
    std::size_t P,
    std::size_t N,
    double un,
    const std::array<double, Dim>& faceNormal) {

    auto pickUpwindUpwind = [&](std::size_t up, std::size_t downwindToExclude) -> std::size_t {
        const auto& neighbors = mesh.cellNeighbors(up);
        if (neighbors.empty()) return up;
        const double* xUp = mesh.cellCenterPtr(up);
        double bestDot = (un >= 0.0 ? 1e100 : -1e100);
        std::size_t best = up;
        bool found = false;
        for (std::size_t nb : neighbors) {
            if (nb == downwindToExclude) continue;
            // Allow boundary cells as up_up now (second-order at boundary via extrapolation)
            const double* xNb = mesh.cellCenterPtr(nb);
            double dot = 0.0;
            for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) dot += (xNb[d] - xUp[d]) * faceNormal[d];
            // For un>=0 (flow P->N), up=P, want most negative dot (upstream)
            // For un<0 (flow N->P), up=N, want most positive dot (upstream is +normal)
            if (un >= 0.0) {
                if (dot < bestDot) { bestDot = dot; best = nb; found = true; }
            } else {
                if (dot > bestDot) { bestDot = dot; best = nb; found = true; }
            }
        }
        return found ? best : up;
    };

    if (N == std::size_t(-1)) {
        if (un >= 0.0) return {P, P}; // outflow, no up_up needed for inflow logic
        std::size_t up2 = pickUpwindUpwind(P, std::size_t(-1));
        return {up2, P};
    }
    if (un >= 0.0) {
        std::size_t up2 = pickUpwindUpwind(P, N);
        return {P, up2};
    } else {
        std::size_t up2 = pickUpwindUpwind(N, P);
        return {N, up2};
    }
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
inline double computeSecondOrderUpwindFaceValue(
    const Mesh<Dim>& mesh,
    std::size_t P,
    std::size_t N,
    double un,
    const double* phiVals) {

    // Distance-weighted extrapolation: phi_f = phi_up + (phi_up - phi_up2) * |x_f - x_up| / |x_up - x_up2|
    // Falls back to 1.5/-0.5 on uniform meshes
    const std::size_t f = 0; // dummy, caller should use face-aware overload
    (void)f;
    auto [upwind, downwind] = secondOrderUpwindCells(mesh, P, N, un);
    double phiUpwind = phiVals[upwind];
    double phiDownwind = phiVals[downwind];
    if (upwind == downwind) return phiUpwind;
    // Uniform weight fallback (will be overridden by gradient path)
    return 1.5 * phiUpwind - 0.5 * phiDownwind;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
inline double computeSecondOrderUpwindFaceValueWeighted(
    const Mesh<Dim>& mesh,
    std::size_t f,
    std::size_t P,
    std::size_t N,
    double un,
    const double* phiVals) {

    auto fn = mesh.faceNormal(f);
    auto [upwind, up2] = secondOrderUpwindCells(mesh, P, N, un, fn);
    if (upwind == up2) return phiVals[upwind];
    double phiUp = phiVals[upwind];
    double phiUp2 = phiVals[up2];
    const double* xF = mesh.faceCenterPtr(f);
    const double* xUp = mesh.cellCenterPtr(upwind);
    const double* xUp2 = mesh.cellCenterPtr(up2);
    double distF = 0.0, distUp = 0.0;
    for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) {
        double df = xF[d] - xUp[d];
        double du = xUp[d] - xUp2[d];
        distF += df * df;
        distUp += du * du;
    }
    distF = std::sqrt(distF);
    distUp = std::sqrt(distUp);
    if (distUp < 1e-12) return phiUp;
    double w = distF / distUp;
    // Clamp w to [0.1, 2.0] to avoid extreme stretched mesh weights
    if (w > 2.0) w = 2.0;
    if (w < 0.0) w = 0.0;
    return phiUp + w * (phiUp - phiUp2);
}

} // namespace fvm
```

### src/fvm/Validation.h
```
#pragma once

#include <stdexcept>
#include <vector>
#include <cstddef>

namespace fvm {

// A Dirichlet mask/value pair must cover every cell: otherwise the prescribed
// values are read out of bounds while the operator is assembled.
inline void validateDirichlet(std::size_t nCells, const std::vector<char>& mask,
                              const std::vector<double>& values) {
    if (mask.empty()) return;
    if (mask.size() != nCells)
        throw std::invalid_argument("operator::discretize: the Dirichlet mask needs one entry per cell");
    if (values.size() != nCells)
        throw std::invalid_argument("operator::discretize: the Dirichlet values need one entry per cell");
}

// The mask must cover every cell and every component, otherwise the
// prescribed values would be read out of bounds.
inline void validateVelocityMask(std::size_t dim, std::size_t nCells,
                                 const std::vector<std::vector<char>>& mask,
                                 const std::vector<std::vector<double>>& values) {
    if (mask.empty()) return;
    if (mask.size() < dim)
        throw std::invalid_argument("computeDivergenceInto: the Dirichlet mask needs one entry per component");
    for (std::size_t d = 0; d < dim; ++d) {
        if (mask[d].size() != nCells)
            throw std::invalid_argument("computeDivergenceInto: the Dirichlet mask needs one entry per cell");
        if (!values.empty() && values[d].size() != nCells)
            throw std::invalid_argument("computeDivergenceInto: the Dirichlet values need one entry per cell");
    }
}

} // namespace fvm
```

### src/fvm/VelocityCorrection.h
```
#pragma once

#include "mesh/Mesh.h"
#include "field/Field.h"
#include "field/VectorField.h"
#include "fvm/Gradient.h"
#include "fvm/SIMPLETypes.h"
#include <Eigen/Dense>
#include <array>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstddef>
#include <vector>

namespace fvm {

// u = u* - d * grad(p').
//
// The gradient here IS the operator whose divergence the pressure matrix is
// assembled from (the per-cell least-squares gradient, see Gradient.h): the
// pressure equation solves div(d grad p') = div(u*), so the correction below
// cancels the divergence it was built for EXACTLY - on every cell, not only
// in total. A different gradient would make the two operators disagree where
// p' has a local feature, which is where the mass balance then leaks.
template<std::size_t Dim>
inline void correctVelocity(
    const Mesh<Dim>& mesh,
    const VectorField<Dim>& uStar,
    const Field<Dim>& pPrime,
    const std::array<std::vector<double>, Dim>& dCoeff,
    const std::vector<std::vector<char>>& dirichletMask,
    const std::vector<std::vector<double>>& dirichletVals,
    std::array<Field<Dim>, Dim>& dpdx,
    VectorField<Dim>& velocity,
    const std::vector<FaceVelocityBC>* faceBC = nullptr,
    const std::vector<char>* faceHasBC = nullptr) {

    Gradient<Dim> gradient(mesh, GradientScheme::LeastSquares);
    std::array<Field<Dim>, Dim> lsqGrad{};
    for (auto& g : lsqGrad) g = Field<Dim>(mesh, 0.0);
    gradient.compute(pPrime, lsqGrad);

    for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) dpdx[d] = lsqGrad[d];

    for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) {
        #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < mesh.nCells(); ++i) {
            if (dirichletMask[d][i]) velocity[d][i] = dirichletVals[d][i];
            else velocity[d][i] = uStar[d][i] - dCoeff[d][i] * dpdx[d][i];
        }
    }
    if (faceBC && faceHasBC) {
        for (std::size_t f = 0; f < mesh.nFaces(); ++f) {
            if (mesh.neighbor(f) != std::size_t(-1)) continue;
            if (f >= faceBC->size() || f >= faceHasBC->size()) continue;
            if (!(*faceHasBC)[f]) continue;
            auto t = (*faceBC)[f].type;
            if (t == VelocityBCType::Symmetry || t == VelocityBCType::SlipWall) {
                std::size_t P = mesh.owner(f);
                const auto& n = mesh.faceNormal(f);
                double un = 0.0;
                for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) un += velocity[d][P] * n[d];
                for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) velocity[d][P] -= un * n[d];
            }
        }
    }
}

} // namespace fvm
```

### src/io/ANSYSMeshReader.cpp
```
#include "io/ANSYSMeshReader.h"

#include "core/cell_topology.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>
#include <cmath>
#include <iostream>
#include <set>
#include <sstream>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <unordered_map>

namespace fvm {

// ============================================================================
// Tokenizer
// ============================================================================

template<std::size_t Dim>
typename ANSYSMeshReader<Dim>::Token
ANSYSMeshReader<Dim>::Tokenizer::next() {
    if (hasBuffer_) {
        hasBuffer_ = false;
        return buffer_;
    }
    return readToken();
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
typename ANSYSMeshReader<Dim>::Token
ANSYSMeshReader<Dim>::Tokenizer::peek() {
    if (!hasBuffer_) {
        buffer_ = readToken();
        hasBuffer_ = true;
    }
    return buffer_;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
typename ANSYSMeshReader<Dim>::Token
ANSYSMeshReader<Dim>::Tokenizer::readToken() {
    int c;
    while (true) {
        c = in_.get();
        if (c == std::char_traits<char>::eof()) return {Token::End, ""};
        if (!std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(c))) break;
    }

    if (c == '(') return {Token::LParen, "("};
    if (c == ')') return {Token::RParen, ")"};

    if (c == '"') {
        std::string s;
        while (true) {
            c = in_.get();
            if (c == std::char_traits<char>::eof()) {
                throw std::runtime_error("ANSYSMeshReader: unterminated string");
            }
            if (c == '"') break;
            s += static_cast<char>(c);
        }
        return {Token::String, s};
    }

    std::string word;
    word += static_cast<char>(c);
    while (true) {
        c = in_.get();
        if (c == std::char_traits<char>::eof()) break;
        if (std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(c))) break;
        if (c == '(' || c == ')' || c == '"') {
            in_.unget();
            break;
        }
        word += static_cast<char>(c);
    }
    return classify(word);
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
typename ANSYSMeshReader<Dim>::Token
ANSYSMeshReader<Dim>::Tokenizer::classify(const std::string& word) {
    if (word.empty()) return {Token::End, word};

    bool hasDot = false;
    bool hasExp = false;
    bool hasHex = false;
    std::size_t start = 0;

    if (word[0] == '-' || word[0] == '+') {
        if (word.size() == 1) return {Token::Integer, word};
        start = 1;
    }

    for (std::size_t i = start; i < word.size(); ++i) {
        char c = word[i];
        if (c == '.') hasDot = true;
        else if (c == 'e' || c == 'E') hasExp = true;
        else if (std::isxdigit(static_cast<unsigned char>(c)) && !std::isdigit(static_cast<unsigned char>(c))) {
            hasHex = true;
        }
    }

    if (hasDot || hasExp) return {Token::Real, word};
    return {Token::Integer, word};
}

// ============================================================================
// S-Expression Parser
// ============================================================================

template<std::size_t Dim>
typename ANSYSMeshReader<Dim>::Section
ANSYSMeshReader<Dim>::parseGroup_(Tokenizer& tok) {
    Section sec;
    sec.code = -1;

    Token t = tok.next();
    if (t.kind != Token::LParen) {
        throw std::runtime_error("ANSYSMeshReader: expected '('");
    }

    while (true) {
        t = tok.peek();
        if (t.kind == Token::RParen) {
            tok.next();
            break;
        }
        if (t.kind == Token::LParen) {
            sec.children.push_back(parseGroup_(tok));
        } else if (t.kind == Token::End) {
            throw std::runtime_error("ANSYSMeshReader: unexpected end of file");
        } else {
            tok.next();
            sec.values.push_back(t.raw);
        }
    }

    return sec;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
typename ANSYSMeshReader<Dim>::Section
ANSYSMeshReader<Dim>::parseNode(Tokenizer& tok) {
    Section sec;

    Token t = tok.next();
    if (t.kind != Token::LParen) {
        throw std::runtime_error("ANSYSMeshReader: expected '('");
    }

    t = tok.peek();
    if (t.kind == Token::Integer) {
        tok.next();
        sec.code = parseInt(t.raw);
    }

    if (sec.code == 0) {
        int depth = 1;
        while (depth > 0) {
            t = tok.next();
            if (t.kind == Token::End) {
                throw std::runtime_error("ANSYSMeshReader: unexpected end of file in comment");
            }
            if (t.kind == Token::LParen) depth++;
            else if (t.kind == Token::RParen) depth--;
        }
        return sec;
    }

    while (true) {
        t = tok.peek();
        if (t.kind == Token::RParen) {
            tok.next();
            break;
        }
        if (t.kind == Token::LParen) {
            sec.children.push_back(parseGroup_(tok));
        } else if (t.kind == Token::End) {
            throw std::runtime_error("ANSYSMeshReader: unexpected end of file");
        } else {
            tok.next();
            sec.values.push_back(t.raw);
        }
    }

    return sec;
}

// ============================================================================
// Utility Parsers
// ============================================================================

template<std::size_t Dim>
std::size_t ANSYSMeshReader<Dim>::parseHex(const std::string& s) {
    if (s.empty()) throw std::runtime_error("ANSYSMeshReader: empty hex number");
    try {
        return std::stoul(s, nullptr, 16);
    } catch (...) {
        throw std::runtime_error("ANSYSMeshReader: invalid hex number '" + s + "'");
    }
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
double ANSYSMeshReader<Dim>::parseDouble(const std::string& s) {
    if (s.empty()) throw std::runtime_error("ANSYSMeshReader: empty double");
    try {
        return std::stod(s);
    } catch (...) {
        throw std::runtime_error("ANSYSMeshReader: invalid double '" + s + "'");
    }
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
int ANSYSMeshReader<Dim>::parseInt(const std::string& s) {
    if (s.empty()) throw std::runtime_error("ANSYSMeshReader: empty integer");
    bool isHex = false;
    std::size_t start = 0;
    if (s[0] == '-' || s[0] == '+') start = 1;
    for (std::size_t i = start; i < s.size(); ++i) {
        if (!std::isdigit(static_cast<unsigned char>(s[i]))) {
            isHex = true;
            break;
        }
    }
    try {
        if (isHex) return static_cast<int>(std::stoul(s, nullptr, 16));
        return std::stoi(s);
    } catch (...) {
        throw std::runtime_error("ANSYSMeshReader: invalid integer '" + s + "'");
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Section Handlers
// ============================================================================

template<std::size_t Dim>
void ANSYSMeshReader<Dim>::handleSection(const Section& sec, ParseState& state) {
    switch (sec.code) {
        case 0:  // comment
        case 1:  // header
            break;
        case 2: {  // dimension
            if (!sec.values.empty()) {
                int dim = parseInt(sec.values[0]);
                if (dim != static_cast<int>(Dim)) {
                    throw std::runtime_error(
                        "ANSYSMeshReader: file dimension " + std::to_string(dim) +
                        " does not match expected " + std::to_string(Dim));
                }
            }
            break;
        }
        case 10: {  // nodes
            if (sec.children.size() < 2) break;
            const auto& header = sec.children[0].values;
            if (header.size() < 4) break;
            int zoneId = static_cast<int>(parseHex(header[0]));
            std::size_t firstIndex = parseHex(header[1]);
            std::size_t lastIndex = parseHex(header[2]);
            int nComponents = 0;
            if (header.size() >= 5) nComponents = parseInt(header[4]);
            if (nComponents == 0) nComponents = Dim;
            if (nComponents > static_cast<int>(Dim)) nComponents = Dim;

            std::size_t nNodes = lastIndex - firstIndex + 1;
            const auto& data = sec.children[1].values;
            std::size_t expected = nNodes * nComponents;
            if (data.size() < expected) {
                throw std::runtime_error(
                    "ANSYSMeshReader: node zone " + std::to_string(zoneId) +
                    " expected " + std::to_string(expected) +
                    " values, got " + std::to_string(data.size()));
            }

            std::size_t globalOffset = state.vertices.size();
            if (firstIndex > 0 && firstIndex - 1 != globalOffset) {
                throw std::runtime_error(
                    "ANSYSMeshReader: node zone " + std::to_string(zoneId) +
                    " first index " + std::to_string(firstIndex) +
                    " does not match expected offset " +
                    std::to_string(globalOffset + 1));
            }

            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < nNodes; ++i) {
                std::array<double, Dim> coord{};
                coord.fill(0.0);
                for (int c = 0; c < nComponents; ++c) {
                    coord[c] = parseDouble(data[i * nComponents + c]);
                }
                state.vertices.push_back(coord);
            }
            break;
        }
        case 12: {  // cells
            if (sec.children.empty()) break;
            const auto& header = sec.children[0].values;
            if (header.size() < 5) break;
            CellZone zone;
            zone.zoneId = static_cast<int>(parseHex(header[0]));
            zone.firstIndex = parseHex(header[1]);
            zone.lastIndex = parseHex(header[2]);
            zone.zoneType = parseInt(header[3]);
            zone.elementType = parseInt(header[4]);

            if (zone.zoneId == 0) {
                state.totalCells = zone.lastIndex - zone.firstIndex + 1;
            } else if (zone.zoneType != 0) {
                state.totalCells = zone.lastIndex - zone.firstIndex + 1;
                if (zone.elementType == 0 && sec.children.size() >= 2) {
                    for (const auto& v : sec.children[1].values) {
                        zone.perCellTypes.push_back(parseInt(v));
                    }
                }
                state.cellZones.push_back(std::move(zone));
            }
            break;
        }
        case 13: {  // faces
            if (sec.children.size() < 2) break;
            const auto& header = sec.children[0].values;
            if (header.size() < 5) break;
            int zoneId = static_cast<int>(parseHex(header[0]));
            std::size_t firstFaceIndex = parseHex(header[1]);
            std::size_t lastFaceIndex = parseHex(header[2]);
            int type = static_cast<int>(parseHex(header[3]));
            int elemType = static_cast<int>(parseHex(header[4]));

            state.faceZoneTypes[zoneId] = type;

            std::size_t nFaces = lastFaceIndex - firstFaceIndex + 1;

            int nodesPerFace = 2;
            switch (elemType) {
                case 2: nodesPerFace = 2; break;
                case 3: nodesPerFace = 3; break;
                case 4: nodesPerFace = 4; break;
                default: nodesPerFace = 2; break;
            }

            if (Dim == 2) nodesPerFace = 2;

            const auto& data = sec.children[1].values;
            std::size_t valuesPerFace = static_cast<std::size_t>(nodesPerFace) + 2;
            std::size_t expected = nFaces * valuesPerFace;
            if (data.size() < expected) {
                throw std::runtime_error(
                    "ANSYSMeshReader: face zone " + std::to_string(zoneId) +
                    " expected " + std::to_string(expected) +
                    " values, got " + std::to_string(data.size()));
            }

            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < nFaces; ++i) {
                FaceRecord face;
                face.zoneId = zoneId;
                for (int n = 0; n < nodesPerFace; ++n) {
                    face.vertices.push_back(parseHex(data[i * valuesPerFace + n]) - 1);
                }
                face.rightCell = static_cast<int>(parseHex(data[i * valuesPerFace + nodesPerFace])) - 1;
                face.leftCell = static_cast<int>(parseHex(data[i * valuesPerFace + nodesPerFace + 1])) - 1;
                state.faces.push_back(std::move(face));
            }
            break;
        }
        case 39:  // element group (legacy zone)
        case 45: {  // zone name/type
            if (sec.children.empty()) break;
            const auto& header = sec.children[0].values;
            if (header.size() < 3) break;
            int zoneId = parseInt(header[0]);
            state.zoneTypes[zoneId] = header[1];
            state.zoneNames[zoneId] = header[2];
            break;
        }
        default:
            break;
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Cell Reconstruction
// ============================================================================

template<std::size_t Dim>
std::vector<std::vector<std::size_t>>
ANSYSMeshReader<Dim>::reconstructCells(
    const std::vector<FaceRecord>& faces,
    std::size_t cellCount,
    const std::vector<std::array<double, Dim>>& points) {

    std::vector<std::vector<std::size_t>> cellToFaces(cellCount);

    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < faces.size(); ++i) {
        const auto& f = faces[i];
        if (f.rightCell >= 0 && static_cast<std::size_t>(f.rightCell) < cellCount) {
            cellToFaces[f.rightCell].push_back(i);
        }
        if (f.leftCell >= 0 && static_cast<std::size_t>(f.leftCell) < cellCount) {
            cellToFaces[f.leftCell].push_back(i);
        }
    }

    std::vector<std::vector<std::size_t>> cells(cellCount);
    for (std::size_t c = 0; c < cellCount; ++c) {
        const auto& cf = cellToFaces[c];
        if (cf.empty()) continue;

        if (cf.size() == 1) {
            cells[c] = faces[cf[0]].vertices;
            continue;
        }

        if constexpr (Dim == 3) {
            // In 3D a cell face is a polygon, not an edge, so the edge walk
            // below cannot reconstruct a vertex loop. The vertices are the
            // union of the cell's face vertices; that order is arbitrary, so
            // canonicalize it into the VTK corner order here. Everything
            // downstream (VTU export, isosurface tets, volume voxelization)
            // then sees a well-defined element layout.
            std::vector<std::size_t> verts;
            std::unordered_map<std::size_t, char> seen;
            for (std::size_t fi : cf) {
                for (std::size_t v : faces[fi].vertices) {
                    if (seen.emplace(v, 1).second) verts.push_back(v);
                }
            }

            std::vector<std::vector<std::size_t>> loops;
            loops.reserve(cf.size());
            for (std::size_t fi : cf) loops.push_back(faces[fi].vertices);
            cell_topology::canonicalize(verts, loops, points);

            cells[c] = std::move(verts);
            continue;
        }

        std::unordered_map<std::size_t, std::vector<std::size_t>> vertToFaces;
        for (std::size_t fi : cf) {
            for (std::size_t v : faces[fi].vertices) {
                vertToFaces[v].push_back(fi);
            }
        }

        std::vector<std::size_t> orderedVerts;
        std::vector<bool> used(cf.size(), false);

        std::size_t firstFaceIdx = cf[0];
        const FaceRecord& firstFace = faces[firstFaceIdx];
        std::size_t startVert = firstFace.vertices[0];
        std::size_t currentVert = firstFace.vertices[1];
        orderedVerts.push_back(startVert);
        orderedVerts.push_back(currentVert);
        used[0] = true;

        int iterations = 0;
        int maxIterations = static_cast<int>(cf.size()) * 4;
        while (currentVert != startVert && iterations < maxIterations) {
            bool found = false;
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < cf.size(); ++i) {
                if (used[i]) continue;
                const FaceRecord& f = faces[cf[i]];
                if (f.vertices[0] == currentVert) {
                    currentVert = f.vertices[1];
                    used[i] = true;
                    found = true;
                    if (currentVert != startVert) orderedVerts.push_back(currentVert);
                    break;
                } else if (f.vertices[1] == currentVert) {
                    currentVert = f.vertices[0];
                    used[i] = true;
                    found = true;
                    if (currentVert != startVert) orderedVerts.push_back(currentVert);
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!found) break;
            iterations++;
        }

        if (orderedVerts.size() >= 3 && orderedVerts.back() == orderedVerts.front()) {
            orderedVerts.pop_back();
        }

        cells[c] = std::move(orderedVerts);
    }

    return cells;
}

// ============================================================================
// Cell Face Topology
// ============================================================================

template<std::size_t Dim>
std::vector<std::vector<std::vector<std::size_t>>>
ANSYSMeshReader<Dim>::reconstructCellFaces(
    const std::vector<FaceRecord>& faces,
    std::size_t cellCount) {

    std::vector<std::vector<std::size_t>> cellToFaces(cellCount);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < faces.size(); ++i) {
        const auto& f = faces[i];
        if (f.rightCell >= 0 && static_cast<std::size_t>(f.rightCell) < cellCount) {
            cellToFaces[f.rightCell].push_back(i);
        }
        if (f.leftCell >= 0 && static_cast<std::size_t>(f.leftCell) < cellCount) {
            cellToFaces[f.leftCell].push_back(i);
        }
    }

    std::vector<std::vector<std::vector<std::size_t>>> cellFaces(cellCount);
    for (std::size_t c = 0; c < cellCount; ++c) {
        cellFaces[c].reserve(cellToFaces[c].size());
        for (std::size_t fi : cellToFaces[c]) {
            cellFaces[c].push_back(faces[fi].vertices);
        }
    }
    return cellFaces;
}

// ============================================================================
// Boundary Group Extraction
// ============================================================================

template<std::size_t Dim>
std::map<std::string, std::vector<std::size_t>>
ANSYSMeshReader<Dim>::extractBoundaryGroups(
    const Mesh<Dim>& mesh,
    const std::vector<FaceRecord>& faces,
    const std::map<int, std::string>& zoneNames,
    const std::map<int, std::string>& zoneTypes,
    const std::map<int, int>& faceZoneTypes) {

    std::size_t nFaces = mesh.nFaces();
    std::map<std::vector<std::size_t>, std::size_t> faceVertexToIdx;
    for (std::size_t fi = 0; fi < nFaces; ++fi) {
        auto verts = mesh.faceVertices(fi);
        std::sort(verts.begin(), verts.end());
        faceVertexToIdx[verts] = fi;
    }

    std::map<std::string, std::vector<std::size_t>> boundaryGroups;

    auto collectZoneFaces = [&](int zoneId, const std::vector<FaceRecord>& faces,
                                 const std::map<std::vector<std::size_t>, std::size_t>& faceMap) {
        std::vector<std::size_t> indices;
        for (const auto& face : faces) {
            if (face.zoneId != zoneId) continue;
            if (face.rightCell >= 0 && face.leftCell >= 0) continue;

            std::vector<std::size_t> fv = face.vertices;
            std::sort(fv.begin(), fv.end());
            auto it = faceMap.find(fv);
            if (it != faceMap.end()) {
                indices.push_back(it->second);
            }
        }
        return indices;
    };

    for (const auto& [zoneId, zoneName] : zoneNames) {
        auto indices = collectZoneFaces(zoneId, faces, faceVertexToIdx);
        if (!indices.empty()) {
            boundaryGroups[zoneName] = std::move(indices);
        }
    }

    std::set<int> namedZones;
    for (const auto& [zoneId, zoneName] : zoneNames) {
        namedZones.insert(zoneId);
    }

    for (const auto& [zoneId, zoneType] : faceZoneTypes) {
        if (namedZones.count(zoneId)) continue;

        bool hasBoundaryFaces = false;
        for (const auto& face : faces) {
            if (face.zoneId != zoneId) continue;
            if (face.rightCell < 0 || face.leftCell < 0) {
                hasBoundaryFaces = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (!hasBoundaryFaces) continue;

        auto indices = collectZoneFaces(zoneId, faces, faceVertexToIdx);
        if (!indices.empty()) {
            boundaryGroups["boundary_" + std::to_string(zoneId)] = std::move(indices);
        }
    }

    return boundaryGroups;
}

// ============================================================================
// Main Read Function
// ============================================================================

template<std::size_t Dim>
int ANSYSMeshReader<Dim>::detectDimension(const std::string& filename) {
    std::ifstream in(filename, std::ios::binary);
    if (!in) {
        throw std::runtime_error("ANSYSMeshReader: cannot open file '" + filename + "'");
    }

    // The Fluent format starts with small top-level sections (comment, header,
    // dimension) before the bulk data, so stopping at section 2 costs nothing.
    Tokenizer tokenizer(in);
    while (true) {
        auto t = tokenizer.peek();
        if (t.kind == Token::End) break;
        if (t.kind == Token::LParen) {
            Section sec = parseNode(tokenizer);
            if (sec.code == 2) {
                if (sec.values.empty()) {
                    throw std::runtime_error(
                        "ANSYSMeshReader: empty dimension section in '" + filename + "'");
                }
                const int dim = parseInt(sec.values[0]);
                if (dim != 2 && dim != 3) {
                    throw std::runtime_error(
                        "ANSYSMeshReader: unsupported mesh dimension " + std::to_string(dim));
                }
                return dim;
            }
        } else {
            tokenizer.next();
        }
    }

    throw std::runtime_error(
        "ANSYSMeshReader: no dimension section found in '" + filename + "'");
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
typename ANSYSMeshReader<Dim>::Result
ANSYSMeshReader<Dim>::read(const std::string& filename) {
    std::ifstream in(filename, std::ios::binary);
    if (!in) {
        throw std::runtime_error("ANSYSMeshReader: cannot open file '" + filename + "'");
    }

    Tokenizer tokenizer(in);
    ParseState state;

    while (true) {
        auto t = tokenizer.peek();
        if (t.kind == Token::End) break;
        if (t.kind == Token::LParen) {
            Section sec = parseNode(tokenizer);
            handleSection(sec, state);
        } else {
            tokenizer.next();
        }
    }

    if (state.vertices.empty()) {
        throw std::runtime_error("ANSYSMeshReader: no vertices found in '" + filename + "'");
    }
    if (state.faces.empty()) {
        throw std::runtime_error("ANSYSMeshReader: no faces found in '" + filename + "'");
    }
    if (state.totalCells == 0) {
        throw std::runtime_error("ANSYSMeshReader: no cells found in '" + filename + "'");
    }

    auto cellVerts = reconstructCells(state.faces, state.totalCells, state.vertices);
    auto cellFaces = reconstructCellFaces(state.faces, state.totalCells);

    // The explicit face topology keeps the element node order irrelevant: the
    // mesh builds its faces from the face records instead of assuming a VTK
    // element layout that ANSYS does not use.
    std::vector<std::vector<std::size_t>> meshCells;
    std::vector<std::vector<std::vector<std::size_t>>> meshCellFaces;
    meshCells.reserve(cellVerts.size());
    meshCellFaces.reserve(cellVerts.size());
    for (std::size_t c = 0; c < cellVerts.size(); ++c) {
        if (cellVerts[c].empty()) continue;
        meshCells.push_back(std::move(cellVerts[c]));
        // The face list must follow the SAME cells as the vertex list, so it
        // is filtered with the same predicate.
        meshCellFaces.push_back(c < cellFaces.size() ? cellFaces[c]
                                                     : std::vector<std::vector<std::size_t>>{});
    }

    if (meshCells.empty()) {
        throw std::runtime_error("ANSYSMeshReader: cell reconstruction produced no valid cells");
    }

    Mesh<Dim> mesh(state.vertices, meshCells, meshCellFaces);

    auto boundaryGroups = extractBoundaryGroups(
        mesh, state.faces, state.zoneNames, state.zoneTypes, state.faceZoneTypes);

    mesh.setBoundaryGroups(boundaryGroups);

    Result result;
    result.mesh = std::move(mesh);
    result.boundaryGroups = std::move(boundaryGroups);
    return result;
}

// ============================================================================
// Template Instantiation
// ============================================================================

template class ANSYSMeshReader<2>;
template class ANSYSMeshReader<3>;

} // namespace fvm
```

### src/io/ANSYSMeshReader.h
```
#pragma once

#include "mesh/Mesh.h"
#include <array>
#include <cstddef>
#include <fstream>
#include <map>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace fvm {

template<std::size_t Dim>
class ANSYSMeshReader {
public:
    struct Result {
        Mesh<Dim> mesh;
        std::map<std::string, std::vector<std::size_t>> boundaryGroups;
    };

    static Result read(const std::string& filename);

    // Reads only the leading dimension section and returns 2 or 3, so a caller
    // can pick the right read<Dim>() instantiation before parsing the whole
    // file. The tokenizer/parser do not depend on Dim, so call this as
    // ANSYSMeshReader<2>::detectDimension(path) regardless of the mesh.
    static int detectDimension(const std::string& filename);

private:
    struct Token {
        enum Kind { LParen, RParen, Integer, Real, String, End };
        Kind kind;
        std::string raw;
    };

    class Tokenizer {
    public:
        explicit Tokenizer(std::ifstream& in) : in_(in) {}

        Token next();
        Token peek();

    private:
        std::ifstream& in_;
        Token buffer_{Token::End, ""};
        bool hasBuffer_ = false;

        Token readToken();
        static Token classify(const std::string& word);
    };

    struct Section {
        int code = -1;
        std::vector<Section> children;
        std::vector<std::string> values;
    };

    struct FaceRecord {
        std::vector<std::size_t> vertices;
        int rightCell = 0;
        int leftCell = 0;
        int zoneId = 0;
    };

    struct CellZone {
        int zoneId = 0;
        std::size_t firstIndex = 0;
        std::size_t lastIndex = 0;
        int zoneType = 0;
        int elementType = 0;
        std::vector<int> perCellTypes;
    };

    struct ParseState {
        std::vector<std::array<double, Dim>> vertices;
        std::vector<FaceRecord> faces;
        std::vector<CellZone> cellZones;
        std::map<int, std::string> zoneNames;
        std::map<int, std::string> zoneTypes;
        std::map<int, int> faceZoneTypes;
        std::size_t totalCells = 0;
    };

    static Section parseGroup_(Tokenizer& tok);
    static Section parseNode(Tokenizer& tok);
    static void handleSection(const Section& sec, ParseState& state);

    static std::vector<std::vector<std::size_t>> reconstructCells(
        const std::vector<FaceRecord>& faces,
        std::size_t cellCount,
        const std::vector<std::array<double, Dim>>& points);

    // Builds, for every cell, the ordered vertex loop of each of its faces.
    // The ANSYS face records carry the face nodes in order around the face, so
    // the loops can be handed to the mesh as an explicit topology. Without it
    // the mesh has to infer the topology from the cell vertex count, which is
    // wrong for every element whose nodes are not in VTK/Gmsh order.
    static std::vector<std::vector<std::vector<std::size_t>>> reconstructCellFaces(
        const std::vector<FaceRecord>& faces,
        std::size_t cellCount);

    static std::map<std::string, std::vector<std::size_t>> extractBoundaryGroups(
        const Mesh<Dim>& mesh,
        const std::vector<FaceRecord>& faces,
        const std::map<int, std::string>& zoneNames,
        const std::map<int, std::string>& zoneTypes,
        const std::map<int, int>& faceZoneTypes);

    static std::size_t parseHex(const std::string& s);
    static double parseDouble(const std::string& s);
    static int parseInt(const std::string& s);
};

extern template class ANSYSMeshReader<2>;
extern template class ANSYSMeshReader<3>;

} // namespace fvm

### src/io/Checkpoint.h
```
#pragma once

#include "mesh/Mesh.h"
#include "field/Field.h"
#include "field/VectorField.h"
#include <nlohmann/json.hpp>
#include <cstddef>
#include <string>
#include <fstream>
#include <sstream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <vector>
#include <iostream>

namespace fvm {

struct CheckpointConfig {
    std::size_t saveEvery = 0;
    std::size_t retainCount = 3;
    std::string file = "checkpoint.cpt";
    std::string restartFrom = "";
};

// Everything needed to resume a transient run at the correct physical time.
// Without this a restart silently replays from t=0 on top of a mid-run field,
// and the BDF2 history (u^n, u^{n-1}) is lost so the scheme drops to Euler.
template <std::size_t Dim>
struct TransientBlock {
    double time = 0.0;
    double dt = 0.0;
    double dtPrev = 0.0;   // 0 => next step uses explicit Euler
    std::size_t step = 0;

    VectorField<Dim>* velocityN = nullptr;
    VectorField<Dim>* velocityNM1 = nullptr;
    Field<Dim>* kN = nullptr;
    Field<Dim>* kNM1 = nullptr;
    Field<Dim>* omegaN = nullptr;
    Field<Dim>* omegaNM1 = nullptr;

    std::vector<std::string> pvdEntries;
};

class Checkpoint {
public:
    static constexpr unsigned int MAGIC = 0x434D5646;
    static constexpr unsigned int FORMAT_VERSION = 1;

    static void writeU32(std::ofstream& out, std::size_t val) {
        auto v = static_cast<unsigned int>(val);
        out.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&v), sizeof(v));
    }

    static std::size_t readU32(std::ifstream& in) {
        unsigned int v = 0;
        in.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(&v), sizeof(v));
        return static_cast<std::size_t>(v);
    }

    static std::string makeIndexedName(const std::string& base, std::size_t index) {
        return base + "." + std::to_string(index);
    }

    static void rotate(const CheckpointConfig& config) {
        if (config.retainCount == 0) return;
        std::string base = config.file;
        std::string oldest = makeIndexedName(base, config.retainCount);
        std::remove(oldest.c_str());
        for (std::size_t i = config.retainCount - 1; i >= 1; --i) {
            std::string from = makeIndexedName(base, i);
            std::string to = makeIndexedName(base, i + 1);
            std::rename(from.c_str(), to.c_str());
        }
        std::string first = makeIndexedName(base, 1);
        std::rename(base.c_str(), first.c_str());
    }

    template <std::size_t Dim>
    static bool save(const CheckpointConfig& config,
                     std::size_t iteration,
                     double contResid, double momResid,
                     double adaptiveAlphaP, std::size_t stallCount, double prevContResid,
                     const VectorField<Dim>& velocity,
                     const Field<Dim>& pressure,
                     const Field<Dim>* k = nullptr,
                     const Field<Dim>* omega = nullptr,
                     const Field<Dim>* nut = nullptr,
                     const TransientBlock<Dim>* transient = nullptr) {
        rotate(config);

        std::ofstream out(config.file, std::ios::binary);
        if (!out.is_open()) return false;

        const bool hasTransient = (transient != nullptr);

        std::ostringstream metadata;
        metadata << "{";
        metadata << "\"format_version\":" << FORMAT_VERSION << ",";
        metadata << "\"dimension\":" << Dim << ",";
        metadata << "\"n_cells\":" << pressure.size() << ",";
        metadata << "\"iteration\":" << iteration << ",";
        metadata << "\"cont_resid\":" << std::scientific << contResid << ",";
        metadata << "\"mom_resid\":" << std::scientific << momResid << ",";
        metadata << "\"adaptive_alpha_p\":" << std::scientific << adaptiveAlphaP << ",";
        metadata << "\"stall_count\":" << stallCount << ",";
        metadata << "\"prev_cont_resid\":" << std::scientific << prevContResid << ",";
        metadata << "\"turbulence_enabled\":" << (k != nullptr ? "true" : "false") << ",";
        metadata << "\"has_transient\":" << (hasTransient ? "true" : "false") << ",";
        metadata << "\"fields\":[\"u\"";
        if constexpr (Dim >= 2) metadata << ",\"v\"";
        if constexpr (Dim >= 3) metadata << ",\"w\"";
        metadata << ",\"p\"";
        if (k != nullptr) metadata << ",\"k\",\"omega\",\"nut\"";
        metadata << "]";
        metadata << "}";

        std::string metaStr = metadata.str();

        writeU32(out, MAGIC);
        writeU32(out, FORMAT_VERSION);
        writeU32(out, metaStr.size());
        out.write(metaStr.c_str(), static_cast<std::streamsize>(metaStr.size()));

        for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d)
            writeFieldData(out, velocity[d]);

        writeFieldData(out, pressure);

        if (k != nullptr) writeFieldData(out, *k);
        if (omega != nullptr) writeFieldData(out, *omega);
        if (nut != nullptr) writeFieldData(out, *nut);

        if (hasTransient) {
            out.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&transient->time), sizeof(double));
            out.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&transient->dt), sizeof(double));
            out.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&transient->dtPrev), sizeof(double));
            writeU32(out, transient->step);
            if (transient->velocityN)   for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) writeFieldData(out, (*transient->velocityN)[d]);
            if (transient->velocityNM1) for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) writeFieldData(out, (*transient->velocityNM1)[d]);
            if (transient->kN)          writeFieldData(out, *transient->kN);
            if (transient->kNM1)        writeFieldData(out, *transient->kNM1);
            if (transient->omegaN)      writeFieldData(out, *transient->omegaN);
            if (transient->omegaNM1)    writeFieldData(out, *transient->omegaNM1);
            writeU32(out, transient->pvdEntries.size());
            for (const auto& e : transient->pvdEntries) {
                writeU32(out, e.size());
                out.write(e.data(), static_cast<std::streamsize>(e.size()));
            }
        }

        return out.good();
    }

    template <std::size_t Dim>
    static bool load(const std::string& filename,
                     const Mesh<Dim>& mesh,
                     std::size_t& iteration,
                     double& contResid, double& momResid,
                     double& adaptiveAlphaP, std::size_t& stallCount, double& prevContResid,
                     VectorField<Dim>& velocity,
                     Field<Dim>& pressure,
                     Field<Dim>* k = nullptr,
                     Field<Dim>* omega = nullptr,
                     Field<Dim>* nut = nullptr,
                     TransientBlock<Dim>* transient = nullptr) {
        std::ifstream in(filename, std::ios::binary);
        if (!in.is_open()) return false;

        std::size_t magic = readU32(in);
        if (magic != MAGIC) return false;

        std::size_t version = readU32(in);
        if (version > FORMAT_VERSION) return false;

        std::size_t metaLen = readU32(in);
        std::string metaStr(metaLen, '\0');
        in.read(&metaStr[0], static_cast<std::streamsize>(metaLen));

        auto j = nlohmann::json::parse(metaStr);

        if (j.contains("n_cells") && j["n_cells"].get<std::size_t>() != mesh.nCells())
            return false;

        if (j.contains("iteration"))      iteration      = j["iteration"].get<std::size_t>();
        if (j.contains("cont_resid"))     contResid      = j["cont_resid"].get<double>();
        if (j.contains("mom_resid"))      momResid       = j["mom_resid"].get<double>();
        if (j.contains("adaptive_alpha_p")) adaptiveAlphaP = j["adaptive_alpha_p"].get<double>();
        if (j.contains("stall_count"))    stallCount     = j["stall_count"].get<std::size_t>();
        if (j.contains("prev_cont_resid")) prevContResid = j["prev_cont_resid"].get<double>();

        std::size_t nCells = mesh.nCells();

        for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) {
            if (!readFieldData(in, velocity[d], nCells)) return false;
        }

        if (!readFieldData(in, pressure, nCells)) return false;

        if (k != nullptr) {
            if (!readFieldData(in, *k, nCells)) return false;
        }
        if (omega != nullptr) {
            if (!readFieldData(in, *omega, nCells)) return false;
        }
        if (nut != nullptr) {
            if (!readFieldData(in, *nut, nCells)) return false;
        }

        if (transient != nullptr && j.value("has_transient", false)) {
            if (!readDouble(in, transient->time))   return false;
            if (!readDouble(in, transient->dt))     return false;
            if (!readDouble(in, transient->dtPrev)) return false;
            transient->step = readU32(in);
            if (transient->velocityN) {
                for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d)
                    if (!readFieldData(in, (*transient->velocityN)[d], nCells)) return false;
            }
            if (transient->velocityNM1) {
                for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d)
                    if (!readFieldData(in, (*transient->velocityNM1)[d], nCells)) return false;
            }
            if (transient->kN       && !readFieldData(in, *transient->kN, nCells))       return false;
            if (transient->kNM1     && !readFieldData(in, *transient->kNM1, nCells))     return false;
            if (transient->omegaN   && !readFieldData(in, *transient->omegaN, nCells))   return false;
            if (transient->omegaNM1 && !readFieldData(in, *transient->omegaNM1, nCells)) return false;

            transient->pvdEntries.clear();
            const std::size_t nEntries = readU32(in);
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < nEntries; ++i) {
                const std::size_t len = readU32(in);
                std::string entry(len, '\0');
                if (len > 0) in.read(&entry[0], static_cast<std::streamsize>(len));
                if (!in.good()) return false;
                transient->pvdEntries.push_back(std::move(entry));
            }
        }

        return in.good() || in.eof();
    }

private:
    static bool readDouble(std::ifstream& in, double& out) {
        in.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(&out), sizeof(double));
        return in.good();
    }

    template<std::size_t Dim>
    static void writeFieldData(std::ofstream& out, const Field<Dim>& field) {
        const auto vals = field.values();
        out.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(vals.data()),
                  static_cast<std::streamsize>(vals.size() * sizeof(double)));
    }

    template<std::size_t Dim>
    static bool readFieldData(std::ifstream& in, Field<Dim>& field, std::size_t expectedSize) {
        auto vals = field.values();
        if (vals.size() != expectedSize) return false;
        in.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(vals.data()),
                static_cast<std::streamsize>(expectedSize * sizeof(double)));
        return in.good();
    }
};

} // namespace fvm
```

### src/io/GmshReader.cpp
```
#include "io/GmshReader.h"
#include <cstdlib>

namespace fvm {

template<std::size_t Dim>
int GmshReader<Dim>::detectDimension(const std::string& filename) {
    std::ifstream in(filename);
    if (!in) {
        throw std::runtime_error("GmshReader: cannot open file '" + filename + "'");
    }

    std::string line;
    while (std::getline(in, line)) {
        trim_(line);
        if (!line.empty() && line[0] != '#') break;
    }
    if (line != "$MeshFormat") {
        throw std::runtime_error("GmshReader: expected $MeshFormat, got '" + line + "'");
    }
    if (!std::getline(in, line)) {
        throw std::runtime_error("GmshReader: unexpected end of file in MeshFormat");
    }
    trim_(line);
    const std::string version = line.substr(0, line.find_first_of(" \t"));
    if (version != "2.2") {
        throw std::runtime_error("GmshReader: only MSH 2.2 supported, got '" + version + "'");
    }
    skipTo_(in, "$EndMeshFormat");

    // MSH 2.2 element types that describe a volume cell. Higher-order variants
    // are listed too: the current reader rejects them later, but the dimension
    // decision must still be 3D so the diagnostic names the real problem.
    auto isVolumeType = [](int type) {
        switch (type) {
            case 4:  // tetrahedron
            case 5:  // hexahedron
            case 6:  // prism
            case 7:  // pyramid
            case 11: // 10-node tetrahedron
            case 12: // 27-node hexahedron
            case 13: // 18-node prism
            case 14: // 14-node pyramid
            case 17: // 20-node hexahedron
                return true;
            default:
                return false;
        }
    };

    while (std::getline(in, line)) {
        trim_(line);
        if (line != "$Elements") continue;

        if (!std::getline(in, line)) {
            throw std::runtime_error("GmshReader: unexpected end of file in Elements");
        }
        const int totalElements = std::stoi(trimmed(line));
        for (int i = 0; i < totalElements; ++i) {
            if (!std::getline(in, line)) {
                throw std::runtime_error("GmshReader: truncated Elements section");
            }
            trim_(line);
            std::size_t pos = 0;
            parseInt_(line, pos);              // element tag
            const int type = parseInt_(line, pos);
            if (isVolumeType(type)) return 3;
        }
        return 2;  // $Elements existed but held only lower-dimensional cells
    }

    throw std::runtime_error("GmshReader: no $Elements section found in '" + filename + "'");
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
typename GmshReader<Dim>::Result
GmshReader<Dim>::read(const std::string& filename) {
    std::ifstream in(filename);
    if (!in) {
        throw std::runtime_error("GmshReader: cannot open file '" + filename + "'");
    }

    std::string line;

    while (std::getline(in, line)) {
        trim_(line);
        if (!line.empty() && line[0] != '#') break;
    }
    if (line != "$MeshFormat") {
        throw std::runtime_error("GmshReader: expected $MeshFormat, got '" + line + "'");
    }
    if (!std::getline(in, line)) {
        throw std::runtime_error("GmshReader: unexpected end of file in MeshFormat");
    }
    trim_(line);
    std::string version = line.substr(0, line.find_first_of(" \t"));
    if (version != "2.2") {
        throw std::runtime_error("GmshReader: only MSH 2.2 supported, got '" + version + "'");
    }
    skipTo_(in, "$EndMeshFormat");

    std::map<int, std::pair<int, std::string>> physicalNames;
    std::vector<std::array<double, Dim>> vertices;
    std::vector<std::vector<std::size_t>> cells;
    std::vector<int> elemPhysTags;
    std::vector<std::pair<FaceKey, int>> boundaryFaces;

    std::map<int, std::size_t> nodeTagMap;

    while (std::getline(in, line)) {
        trim_(line);
        if (line == "$PhysicalNames") {
            parsePhysicalNames_(in, physicalNames);
        } else if (line == "$Nodes") {
            parseNodes_(in, vertices, nodeTagMap);
        } else if (line == "$Elements") {
            parseElements_(in, cells, elemPhysTags, boundaryFaces, nodeTagMap);
        }
    }

    if (vertices.empty()) {
        throw std::runtime_error("GmshReader: no nodes found in '" + filename + "'");
    }
    if (cells.empty()) {
        throw std::runtime_error("GmshReader: no volume elements found in '" + filename + "'");
    }

    Mesh<Dim> mesh(std::move(vertices), std::move(cells));

    std::map<std::string, std::vector<std::size_t>> boundaryGroups;
    if (!physicalNames.empty()) {
        auto groupsFromFaces = extractBoundaryGroupsFromFaces_(mesh, boundaryFaces, physicalNames);
        auto groupsFromCells = extractBoundaryGroupsFromCells_(mesh, elemPhysTags, physicalNames);
        // Merge: face-based takes precedence (it uses boundary element tags)
        for (const auto& [name, faces] : groupsFromFaces) {
            boundaryGroups[name] = faces;
        }
        for (const auto& [name, faces] : groupsFromCells) {
            if (boundaryGroups.find(name) == boundaryGroups.end()) {
                boundaryGroups[name] = faces;
            }
        }

        // Collect boundary-dim physical group names (those with dim < Dim)
        std::vector<std::string> boundaryDimNames;
        for (const auto& [tag, dimName] : physicalNames) {
            if (dimName.first < static_cast<int>(Dim)) {
                boundaryDimNames.push_back(dimName.second);
            }
        }

        // Find all boundary faces not yet assigned to any group
        std::vector<bool> assigned(mesh.nFaces(), false);
        for (const auto& [name, faces] : boundaryGroups) {
            for (auto f : faces) assigned[f] = true;
        }

        // Compute bounding box of ALL boundary face centers
        std::array<double, Dim> bbMin{}, bbMax{};
        bool first = true;
        for (std::size_t f = 0; f < mesh.nFaces(); ++f) {
            if (mesh.neighbor(f) != std::size_t(-1)) continue;
            const auto& fc = mesh.faceCenter(f);
            if (first) {
                bbMin = fc;
                bbMax = fc;
                first = false;
            } else {
                for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) {
                    bbMin[d] = std::min(bbMin[d], fc[d]);
                    bbMax[d] = std::max(bbMax[d], fc[d]);
                }
            }
        }

        // For each boundary-dim group that already has faces, compute its centroid
        // to determine which edge it's on
        std::map<std::string, std::array<double, Dim>> groupCentroids;
        std::map<std::string, int> groupCounts;
        for (const auto& [name, faces] : boundaryGroups) {
            for (auto f : faces) {
                const auto& fc = mesh.faceCenter(f);
                for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) {
                    groupCentroids[name][d] += fc[d];
                }
                groupCounts[name]++;
            }
        }
        for (auto& [name, centroid] : groupCentroids) {
            int cnt = groupCounts[name];
            if (cnt > 0) {
                for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) centroid[d] /= cnt;
            }
        }

        // For unmatched boundary faces, find closest group centroid and assign
        for (std::size_t f = 0; f < mesh.nFaces(); ++f) {
            if (mesh.neighbor(f) != std::size_t(-1)) continue;
            if (assigned[f]) continue;

            const auto& fc = mesh.faceCenter(f);

            std::string bestGroup;
            double bestDist = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();
            for (const auto& [name, centroid] : groupCentroids) {
                double dist = 0.0;
                for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) {
                    double diff = fc[d] - centroid[d];
                    dist += diff * diff;
                }
                if (dist < bestDist) {
                    bestDist = dist;
                    bestGroup = name;
                }
            }

            if (!bestGroup.empty()) {
                boundaryGroups[bestGroup].push_back(f);
            }
        }
    }

    return {std::move(mesh), std::move(boundaryGroups)};
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
typename GmshReader<Dim>::FaceKey
GmshReader<Dim>::sortedFaceVerts(const std::vector<std::size_t>& verts) {
    FaceKey key(verts.begin(), verts.end());
    std::sort(key.begin(), key.end());
    return key;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void GmshReader<Dim>::trim_(std::string& s) {
    s.erase(0, s.find_first_not_of(" \t\r\n"));
    std::size_t end = s.find_last_not_of(" \t\r\n");
    if (end != std::string::npos) s.erase(end + 1);
    else s.clear();
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
std::string GmshReader<Dim>::trimmed(const std::string& s) {
    std::string t(s);
    trim_(t);
    return t;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void GmshReader<Dim>::skipTo_(std::ifstream& in, const std::string& marker) {
    std::string line;
    while (std::getline(in, line)) {
        trim_(line);
        if (line == marker) return;
    }
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void GmshReader<Dim>::parsePhysicalNames_(std::ifstream& in,
                                           std::map<int, std::pair<int, std::string>>& names) {
    std::string line;
    std::getline(in, line);
    int count = std::stoi(trimmed(line));
    for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
        std::getline(in, line);
        trim_(line);
        std::size_t pos = 0;
        int dim = parseInt_(line, pos);
        int tag = parseInt_(line, pos);
        while (pos < line.size() && (line[pos] == ' ' || line[pos] == '\t')) ++pos;
        if (pos < line.size() && line[pos] == '"') {
            ++pos;
            std::size_t end = line.find('"', pos);
            if (end == std::string::npos) end = line.size();
            names[tag] = {dim, line.substr(pos, end - pos)};
        }
    }
    skipTo_(in, "$EndPhysicalNames");
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void GmshReader<Dim>::parseNodes_(std::ifstream& in,
                                  std::vector<std::array<double, Dim>>& vertices,
                                  std::map<int, std::size_t>& nodeTagMap) {
    std::string line;
    std::getline(in, line);
    int totalNodes = std::stoi(trimmed(line));

    vertices.resize(totalNodes);
    nodeTagMap.clear();

    for (int i = 0; i < totalNodes; ++i) {
        std::getline(in, line);
        trim_(line);
        std::size_t pos = 0;
        int tag = parseInt_(line, pos);
        std::size_t idx = static_cast<std::size_t>(i);
        nodeTagMap[tag] = idx;
        for (std::size_t d = 0; d < Dim; ++d) {
            vertices[idx][d] = parseDouble_(line, pos);
        }
    }
    skipTo_(in, "$EndNodes");
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
std::vector<std::size_t> GmshReader<Dim>::resolveNodeTags_(const std::string& line,
                                                            std::size_t& pos,
                                                            int count,
                                                            const std::map<int, std::size_t>& nodeTagMap) {
    std::vector<std::size_t> result(count);
    for (int v = 0; v < count; ++v) {
        int nodeTag = parseInt_(line, pos);
        auto it = nodeTagMap.find(nodeTag);
        if (it == nodeTagMap.end()) {
            throw std::runtime_error(
                "GmshReader: node tag " + std::to_string(nodeTag) + " not found");
        }
        result[v] = it->second;
    }
    return result;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void GmshReader<Dim>::parseElements_(std::ifstream& in,
                                     std::vector<std::vector<std::size_t>>& cells,
                                     std::vector<int>& elemPhysTags,
                                     std::vector<std::pair<FaceKey, int>>& boundaryFaces,
                                     const std::map<int, std::size_t>& nodeTagMap) {
    std::string line;
    std::getline(in, line);
    int totalElements = std::stoi(trimmed(line));

    int simplexType = (Dim == 2) ? 2 : 4;
    int quadType = (Dim == 2) ? 3 : 5;
    int boundaryType = (Dim == 2) ? 1 : 2;

    for (int i = 0; i < totalElements; ++i) {
        std::getline(in, line);
        trim_(line);
        std::size_t pos = 0;
        parseInt_(line, pos); // elem tag
        int elemType = parseInt_(line, pos);
        int nTags = parseInt_(line, pos);

        if (elemType == simplexType || elemType == quadType) {
            int physicalTag = 0;
            int elementaryTag = 0;
            for (int t = 0; t < nTags; ++t) {
                int tv = parseInt_(line, pos);
                if (t == 0) physicalTag = tv;
                else if (t == 1) elementaryTag = tv;
            }
            int effectiveTag = (physicalTag != 0) ? physicalTag : elementaryTag;

            int vertsPerCell;
            if (elemType == simplexType) {
                vertsPerCell = Dim + 1;
            } else {
                vertsPerCell = (Dim == 2) ? 4 : 8;
            }

            std::vector<std::size_t> cell(vertsPerCell);
            for (int v = 0; v < vertsPerCell; ++v) {
                int nodeTag = parseInt_(line, pos);
                auto it = nodeTagMap.find(nodeTag);
                if (it == nodeTagMap.end()) {
                    throw std::runtime_error(
                        "GmshReader: node tag " + std::to_string(nodeTag) + " not found");
                }
                cell[v] = it->second;
            }
            cells.push_back(std::move(cell));
            elemPhysTags.push_back(effectiveTag);
        } else if (elemType == boundaryType) {
            int physicalTag = 0;
            int elementaryTag = 0;
            for (int t = 0; t < nTags; ++t) {
                int tv = parseInt_(line, pos);
                if (t == 0) physicalTag = tv;
                else if (t == 1) elementaryTag = tv;
            }
            int effectiveTag = (physicalTag != 0) ? physicalTag : elementaryTag;
            int vertsPerBoundary = boundaryType + 1;
            auto verts = resolveNodeTags_(line, pos, vertsPerBoundary, nodeTagMap);
            std::sort(verts.begin(), verts.end());
            boundaryFaces.emplace_back(std::move(verts), effectiveTag);
        } else {
            for (int t = 0; t < nTags + elemType; ++t) {
                parseInt_(line, pos);
            }
        }
    }
    skipTo_(in, "$EndElements");
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
std::map<std::string, std::vector<std::size_t>>
GmshReader<Dim>::extractBoundaryGroupsFromFaces_(
    const Mesh<Dim>& mesh,
    const std::vector<std::pair<FaceKey, int>>& boundaryFaces,
    const std::map<int, std::pair<int, std::string>>& physicalNames) {

    std::map<FaceKey, std::size_t> meshFaceMap;
    for (std::size_t f = 0; f < mesh.nFaces(); ++f) {
        if (mesh.neighbor(f) != std::size_t(-1)) continue;
        meshFaceMap[sortedFaceVerts(mesh.faceVertices(f))] = f;
    }

    std::map<std::size_t, int> facePhysTags;
    for (const auto& [key, physTag] : boundaryFaces) {
        auto it = meshFaceMap.find(key);
        if (it != meshFaceMap.end()) {
            facePhysTags[it->second] = physTag;
        }
    }

    std::map<std::string, std::vector<std::size_t>> groups;
    for (const auto& [faceIdx, physTag] : facePhysTags) {
        if (physTag == 0) continue;
        auto nameIt = physicalNames.find(physTag);
        if (nameIt != physicalNames.end()) {
            groups[nameIt->second.second].push_back(faceIdx);
        }
    }

    return groups;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
std::map<std::string, std::vector<std::size_t>>
GmshReader<Dim>::extractBoundaryGroupsFromCells_(
    const Mesh<Dim>& mesh,
    const std::vector<int>& elemPhysTags,
    const std::map<int, std::pair<int, std::string>>& physicalNames) {

    std::map<std::string, std::vector<std::size_t>> groups;

    for (std::size_t f = 0; f < mesh.nFaces(); ++f) {
        if (mesh.neighbor(f) != std::size_t(-1)) continue;

        std::size_t owner = mesh.owner(f);
        if (owner >= elemPhysTags.size()) continue;

        int physTag = elemPhysTags[owner];
        if (physTag == 0) continue;

        auto it = physicalNames.find(physTag);
        if (it != physicalNames.end()) {
            if (it->second.first >= static_cast<int>(Dim)) continue;
            groups[it->second.second].push_back(f);
        }
    }

    return groups;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
int GmshReader<Dim>::parseInt_(const std::string& s, std::size_t& pos) {
    skipSpace_(s, pos);
    char* end;
    long val = std::strtol(s.c_str() + pos, &end, 10);
    if (end == s.c_str() + pos) {
        throw std::runtime_error("GmshReader: expected integer");
    }
    pos = static_cast<std::size_t>(end - s.c_str());
    return static_cast<int>(val);
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
double GmshReader<Dim>::parseDouble_(const std::string& s, std::size_t& pos) {
    skipSpace_(s, pos);
    char* end;
    double val = std::strtod(s.c_str() + pos, &end);
    if (end == s.c_str() + pos) {
        throw std::runtime_error("GmshReader: expected double");
    }
    pos = static_cast<std::size_t>(end - s.c_str());
    return val;
}

template<std::size_t Dim>
void GmshReader<Dim>::skipSpace_(const std::string& s, std::size_t& pos) {
    while (pos < s.size() && (s[pos] == ' ' || s[pos] == '\t')) ++pos;
}

template class GmshReader<2>;
template class GmshReader<3>;

} // namespace fvm
```

### src/io/GmshReader.h
```
#pragma once

#include "mesh/Mesh.h"
#include <array>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstddef>
#include <fstream>
#include <map>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace fvm {

template<std::size_t Dim>
class GmshReader {
public:
    struct Result {
        Mesh<Dim> mesh;
        std::map<std::string, std::vector<std::size_t>> boundaryGroups;
    };

    static Result read(const std::string& filename);

    // Scans $Elements for element types and returns 3 when the file contains
    // volume elements, 2 otherwise. Only MSH 2.2 is supported, so a file that
    // read() would reject is rejected here with the same diagnostic.
    static int detectDimension(const std::string& filename);

private:
    using FaceKey = std::vector<std::size_t>;

    static FaceKey sortedFaceVerts(const std::vector<std::size_t>& verts);
    static void trim_(std::string& s);
    static std::string trimmed(const std::string& s);
    static void skipTo_(std::ifstream& in, const std::string& marker);
    static void parsePhysicalNames_(std::ifstream& in,
                                    std::map<int, std::pair<int, std::string>>& names);
    static void parseNodes_(std::ifstream& in,
                            std::vector<std::array<double, Dim>>& vertices,
                            std::map<int, std::size_t>& nodeTagMap);
    static std::vector<std::size_t> resolveNodeTags_(const std::string& line,
                                                     std::size_t& pos,
                                                     int count,
                                                     const std::map<int, std::size_t>& nodeTagMap);
    static void parseElements_(std::ifstream& in,
                               std::vector<std::vector<std::size_t>>& cells,
                               std::vector<int>& elemPhysTags,
                               std::vector<std::pair<FaceKey, int>>& boundaryFaces,
                               const std::map<int, std::size_t>& nodeTagMap);
    static std::map<std::string, std::vector<std::size_t>> extractBoundaryGroupsFromFaces_(
        const Mesh<Dim>& mesh,
        const std::vector<std::pair<FaceKey, int>>& boundaryFaces,
        const std::map<int, std::pair<int, std::string>>& physicalNames);
    static std::map<std::string, std::vector<std::size_t>> extractBoundaryGroupsFromCells_(
        const Mesh<Dim>& mesh,
        const std::vector<int>& elemPhysTags,
        const std::map<int, std::pair<int, std::string>>& physicalNames);
    static int parseInt_(const std::string& s, std::size_t& pos);
    static double parseDouble_(const std::string& s, std::size_t& pos);
    static void skipSpace_(const std::string& s, std::size_t& pos);
};

extern template class GmshReader<2>;
extern template class GmshReader<3>;

} // namespace fvm
